prompts.title: A Maglev Train Traveling Through History
prompts.prompt:
Create a 30-second vertical 9:16 first-person smartphone video, filmed by one standing passenger inside an extremely crowded maglev commuter train. One continuous take only: no cuts, jump cuts, fades, dissolves, overlays, double exposure, scene resets, or artificial transitions.

The same train, same carriage, same passengers, same camera, and same interior remain consistent throughout. The camera is a cheap smartphone held at chest height, one-handed while the other hand grips a pole. The phone is never visible. Footage is crooked, shaky, partially blocked by shoulders, and realistically imperfect: rolling-shutter distortion, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, blown highlights, noisy shadows, compression artifacts, motion smear, and no stabilization or cinematic movement.

The camera always looks through the left-side window at roughly 90° to the train's direction. The train always moves forward and the outside world flows from front to back.

Timeline

0–2s — Present Day
Ordinary modern weekday morning: glass buildings, traffic, pedestrians passing outside. Tired commuters barely react. Announcement: “Next stop: 1944.” The train suddenly accelerates; passengers grab poles and sway.

2–4s — Time Turbulence
Modern scenery is physically swallowed by a dense silver-gray temporal mist tunnel. It has real depth, airflow, parallax, and particles. Old newspapers, yellowed pages, and radio-static-like fragments fly naturally from front to back. Carriage lights flicker. This is a real tunnel, not a transition effect.

4–8s — June 1944, Normandy
The mist clears as the train physically emerges beside the Normandy coast. Gray dawn, naval ships, landing craft, barrage balloons, distant explosions, smoke, and soldiers as distant silhouettes in the surf. No graphic violence. Passengers become solemn and tense.

8–9s — Time Turbulence
Parchment fragments and quill-like light streaks rush past the window. Radio-static texture and distant voices. Announcement: “Next stop: 1789.”

9–13s — May 1789, Versailles
The train emerges beside Versailles. Stone walls, wrought-iron gates, horse-drawn carriages, formally dressed representatives, and large crowds. Warm golden morning light. Church bells and murmuring voices. Atmosphere of expectation and historical change.

13–14s — Time Turbulence
Flying pamphlets and paper fragments fill the temporal mist. Announcement: “Next stop: 1776.”

14–18s — July 1776, Philadelphia
The train emerges beside a red-brick bell-tower building and crowded stone square. A bell rings, representatives exit, a proclamation is read, papers flutter, and the crowd celebrates quietly. Warm summer evening light. A passenger smiles and softly says: “Look.”

18–19s — Time Turbulence
Rough dark mist, ash-like particles, glowing embers, distant horns. Announcement: “Next stop: 1184 BC.”

19–23s — April 1184 BC, Troy
The train emerges at night beside a massive fortified city. Burning walls, smoke, a huge wooden horse being pulled through a damaged gate, shield-bearing silhouettes, and ships along the shore. Convey war only through fire, smoke, silhouettes, and scale. No blood, injuries, or graphic violence. Passengers lean toward the window, visibly grave.

23–24s — Time Turbulence
Golden swirling sand replaces the mist. Luminous fragments resembling ancient symbols and distant chanting pass through the window. Announcement: “Next stop: 2500 BC.”

24–28s — Approximately 2500 BC, Giza
The turbulence clears to reveal a gigantic unfinished pyramid under intense white-gold desert sunlight. Thousands of workers haul limestone blocks up massive ramps using ropes, rollers, and levers. Supervisors stand above; boats move along the distant Nile. Immense scale and photorealistic ancient construction. A passenger whispers: “Ohh.”

28–30s — Ending
The train keeps moving beside the enormous pyramid. Dust floats through the sunlight; distant workers continue their labor. Every passenger is silent and stunned. At approximately 29.7s, the announcement quietly says: “Welcome to 2500 BC.” The train continues moving and the video ends naturally—no fade or cut.

Physics, Lighting & Sound

Passengers, hand loops, clothing, backpacks, and loose objects react naturally to acceleration and turbulence. Keep the same people and interior throughout.

Lighting changes physically with each era: cool modern morning → gray-blue Normandy dawn → warm Versailles morning → warm Philadelphia evening → orange-red Troy firelight → intense white-gold Giza sunlight. Light always enters from the left window and illuminates passengers naturally.

Use only diegetic sound: maglev hum, mechanical rattling, vibrating poles, compressed phone-mic audio, plus era-specific ambience. Every time jump includes a brief radio-static scan and historical echoes before naturally becoming the new environment's sound.

Critical Rules

prompts.title: Kitchen Cabinet Creak Turns Out to Be a Man Bending Over
prompts.prompt:
【真实系前缀】

15秒，竖屏9:16，30fps。以未经处理的iPhone原生相机录像风格呈现，自动曝光、自动白平衡、自动对焦，无美颜、滤镜、后期调色或电影化特效。

一名不入镜的旁观者站在厨房入口亲手持机，保持双人中全景。画面有真实呼吸起伏、轻微不规则手腕抖动和偶尔偏斜的构图。人物突然弯腰或听见异响时，镜头稍迟半拍做小幅调整，不使用稳定器滑行、环绕或戏剧性推近。

使用厨房实际顶灯和窗边自然光。画面整体平坦、略泛白，保留皮肤纹理、发丝、衣料褶皱、橱柜反光、暗部压缩噪点、边缘轻微软化和动作模糊。自动曝光及白平衡只随实际光线小幅变化，不添加霓虹或闪光灯。

对焦偶尔在人物和柜门之间短暂搜索，随后恢复。女主开柜无声、柜门静止而男子弯腰发声，这两个关键验证过程必须清楚，不能被模糊、遮挡或剧烈抖动掩盖。

整体像偶然录下的真实生活片段。人物先听见、再观察、再验证、最后明白，不提前对镜头暗示笑点。

【人物与海妖风姿态】

女主：@1784453e-362e-4524-8a01-57f6d8b2fa82成年女性，带着装饰眼镜@08d81baa-1563-44a8-b3e3-12915431a04a，穿着@7a3d2825-d0d6-45a8-b26b-6a1aa6eaefa5手持一个小白瓷碗。

开场身体微侧形成自然S曲线，肩部放松下沉，颈部舒展，下巴略抬，胯部轻偏，双腿前后错位，眼皮略垂，神态平静、从容、有距离感。

这是自然等候时的姿态，不单独走秀。听到异响后立刻转为疑惑和观察，不持续摆造型、不提前笑。双手拿碗时不同时摸头发或抚颈。

男主：成年男性，黑色略蓬松中短发，深灰色宽松短袖衬衫、褪色蓝色牛仔裤。行动自然，开始时不扶腰、不表现疼痛，自己也以为是柜门出了问题。

两人外貌、衣服、位置保持一致，不新增角色。

【空间与道具】

真实紧凑家庭厨房，奶油白上下橱柜、细长金色把手、浅色瓷砖墙和地面、白色操作台、黑色抽油烟机与燃气灶。

灶上两口带盖粉色锅，墙边有粉色长柄勺。锅具不移动，不冒夸张烟雾。

女主在画面左侧灶台旁，男主从右侧靠近下柜。全程只操作同一扇下柜门，铰链方向固定，向外打开，合拢后与柜体平齐。不能变成抽屉或更换另一扇门。

女主检查柜门时左手拿碗、右手操作，碗不消失、不换手瞬移。

【声音反转：最高优先级】

“嘎——吱”是男主弯腰时产生的荒诞身体声，音色干涩、略拖长，类似旧柜门铰链摩擦。

第一次，弯腰和开门同时发生，制造柜门响的错觉。

女主单独开合柜门时，绝不出现这段嘎吱声。

后来柜门完全不动，男主空手弯腰，同一种嘎吱声再次出现，证明声音来自他。

最后再用一次小幅弯腰确认。

每次嘎吱都与躯干弯曲同步，动作停止，声音随即结束；不要人物停住了，声音还持续。

几次使用同一种音色，不变成放屁、惨叫、骨折、鞋底或锅盖声。

第一次不突出腰部声源，揭晓时再让声音与男子位置明确对应。

【0.00—0.70秒｜日常开场】

双人中全景，同时看见人物表情、男子腰背与下柜门。

女主双手捧碗于腹前，微侧身、肩颈舒展，呈现克制海妖风站姿。

男主从右侧靠近柜子。两人都没有提前预知异响。

【0.70—2.50秒｜开柜、弯腰、第一次嘎吱】

男主右手拉住柜门把手，一边打开门，一边自然弯腰查看柜内。

躯干明显折下与柜门转动重叠时，响起约0.6秒的干涩“嘎——吱”。

镜头保持全景，不切腰部特写，不用表情提前泄露来源。

女主听见后才低头看柜门，眉头轻皱。

男主也停顿一下，随后直起身，轻轻把门关好。起身和关门不额外重复嘎吱声。

【2.50—4.40秒｜误以为柜门老化】

女主先看柜门，再抬眼问：

女主：“啥声啊？”

男主看一眼把手，随口回答：

男主：“柜门老化了吧。”

语气平常，两人真心相信这个解释。男主向右让开半步，保持直立。

【4.40—6.80秒｜女主验证，开关柜门没有嘎吱】

女主左手稳住碗，右手抓同一把手，轻微屈膝前倾，把柜门拉开，再轻轻合上。

这一完整开合必须可见，不能用剪切省略。

这里只有手碰把手、衣料摩擦和轻微合门声，没有嘎吱。

男主站在右侧直立不动，不同时弯腰。

女主看门缝，再看男主，疑惑地说：

女主：“没有啊。”

她站直，右手离开把手。门已经完全关闭。

【6.80—9.30秒｜柜门不动，男子弯腰却响】

男主不相信，向前探身查看。双手自然垂着，明显没有碰门、把手、台面或其他物品。

同一画面清楚保留三个证据：

柜门已经关好；

门和把手完全不动；

只有男主的躯干在弯曲。

他弯到接近第一次的角度时，同样的“嘎——吱”再次响起，约0.6秒。

男主立即停在半弯腰状态，声音随动作停止。

女主视线先看静止的柜门，再移向他的腰背，最后看他的脸。眉头从疑惑逐渐松开，眼睛略睁大，但先不要笑。

男主也意识到不对，慢慢站直。保留短暂安静，让观众自己发现。

【9.30—12.00秒｜再弯一次，彻底确认】

两人对视半拍。男主低头看一眼自己，带着不相信的表情，空手再做一次幅度更小的弯腰。

柜门依然完全关闭、静止。

身体刚折下，同音色的短促“嘎吱”再次出现，约0.35秒。他立刻停住，声音同步结束。

男主站直，嘴角尴尬地动一下，低声说：

男主：“哎哟喂。”

女主先抿住嘴，随后嘴角压不住地扬起，肩膀轻轻颤一下。此时才露出真正明白后的笑意。

【12.00—15.00秒｜忍笑与尴尬收尾】

男主看看柜门，又看看女主，像终于承认“响的是自己”。一只手这时才自然扶一下后腰，动作克制，不表现受伤或剧痛，不摔倒。

女主左手继续拿碗，右手将耳侧一缕发丝拨回，试图恢复从容，却仍忍不住轻笑。身体微侧，肩颈重新放松，带一点海妖风的淡淡笑意，但不是刻意挑逗或嘲讽。

镜头始终保留两人和关闭的柜门。

15秒在他们尴尬对视的生活化反应中结束，不补充解释、不定格、不淡出。

【现场收音】

手机内置麦克风质感，保留房间底噪、脚步、衣料摩擦、手碰把手和轻微合门声。对白自然，有实际空间感，不是干净棚录配音。

无BGM、旁白、罐头笑声或揭晓提示音。

嘎吱声是唯一突出的喜剧声音，不盖住台词。

女主开柜验证时的“没有嘎吱”，必须留出可听见的安静，不用配乐或其他声音填满。

结尾仅允许女主轻微自然笑声。

【真实系后缀与硬约束】

先误认柜门，再用开合无声排除柜门，最后用独立弯腰发声证明来源。因果顺序不可改变。

禁止柜门和男主都发出同一种嘎吱声；禁止柜门在揭晓时晃动；禁止女主开柜时男主同时弯腰。

禁止首次异响前扶腰、龇牙或提前笑；禁止字幕直接写出答案。

“啥声啊”“没有啊”由女主说；“柜门老化了吧”“哎哟喂”由男主说，口型和说话人必须一致。

禁止额外笑点、掉落物、抽屉、摔倒、物件瞬移、多余手臂、夸张身体变形、电影运镜、慢动作、标题、字幕和水印。

prompts.prompt:
15-Second Ultra-Realistic Live Water Game Show Scene

Create a high-energy live television water game show, filmed like a premium international sports-entertainment broadcast. A confident young female contestant competes on a huge outdoor obstacle course above a massive swimming pool. Large audience stands, other contestants, cheering, dramatic stadium lighting, multiple broadcast cameras, realistic water physics, and authentic live-TV atmosphere.

0–3 sec — Game 1:
She races across floating platforms, jumping quickly from one platform to another while the audience and contestants cheer. She nearly slips but regains balance and reaches the checkpoint.

3–6 sec — Game 2:
She immediately faces a rotating obstacle and carefully times her movement, ducking under the spinning bar and climbing over a wet ramp. She lands safely, visibly determined.

6–9 sec — Game 3:

She angrily slaps the surface of the water several times, creating dramatic splashes, then looks toward the finish platform with determination. prompts.title: Bullied Schoolgirl Fights Back with Wind in a Shrine Courtyard
prompts.prompt:
One single continuous 20-second shot, 16:9 landscape, 1080p. NO cuts, NO edits, NO transitions, NO fades, NO title card, NO slow-motion. One unbroken handheld-gimbal camera that moves with the action the entire time. Photoreal supernatural school drama.

STORY
A quiet girl is cornered by four classmates in an old shrine courtyard behind her school. They tear out the pressed-flower pages she has been collecting in her journal and shove her down. Her hurt turns to resolve, and the wind itself answers her. She defeats the four one at a time with acrobatic moves that create visible gusts, calls her flying pages back out of the air, and walks away with them.

REFERENCES
@image1 = the heroine. One girl shown in two views (full body and face close-up); both views are the SAME person. Keep her exact face, dark teal-black layered shoulder-length hair with side-swept bangs, silver hairclip, brown eyes, small beauty mark, slim build.
@image2 = four antagonists, mapped left to right: A = tall, long straight black hair, center part (the leader); B = chestnut bob with blunt bangs; C = high black ponytail with white scrunchie; D = wavy dark-brown hair past the shoulders. Keep each face and hairstyle independent and consistent; never swap identities.
All five wear the reference uniform exactly: navy double-button blazer with white lapel trim, white shirt, red ribbon tie, plaid pleated knee-length skirt, black tights, brown loafers. No other clothing. Do NOT show the white studio backgrounds, lineup poses or split-screen layouts from the references. All five people are the same real-world scale.

NO DISAPPEARING (CRITICAL)
Exactly five real people exist in this scene from the first frame to the last frame: the heroine, A, B, C and D. NOBODY vanishes, fades, dissolves, turns into leaves or dust, teleports, gets blown out of the scene, or is swallowed by the wind. Wind never removes a person from the shot. When the camera moves away from a character and returns, she is still exactly where she was left. Every defeated girl stays physically on the ground in her defeated position, visible, solid and breathing, until the very last frame. Nobody walks or runs out of the courtyard. The count of people stays at five at all times.

SETTING
An old shrine courtyard behind a high school, late-afternoon golden light, soft overcast sky. Gravel and stone-slab ground, two moss-covered stone lanterns, a small wooden shrine gate (torii) in the background, a large ginkgo tree dropping yellow leaves. A low wooden bench on the left. Everything is flat and open, no stairs, no drops, no water. The wind is NOT a storm: it is a controlled, localized swirl of a limited number of yellow ginkgo leaves, light gravel dust and moving hair. The leaves stay thin and sparse, never form a thick cloud or wall, and never cover a person's body or face. Wind is transparent: no glowing beams, no neon, no smoke, no animal shapes, no tornado.

PROPS

Exactly five thin washi-paper pages, each holding a pressed flower (a pink cosmos, a blue hydrangea, a red maple leaf, a tiny forget-me-not, a white camellia), are torn out together. The journal is dropped near the heroine's feet and stays there until she picks it up. The five pages float in the air at the left side of the courtyard during the fight and never act as weapons. Two school bags rest against the shrine wall from the start and are never touched.

CAMERA, ONE CONTINUOUS MOVE
The camera starts in a tight handheld medium shot on the heroine's face, drifts around her, then follows each action in a smooth flowing path at eye level and side three-quarter angles, mostly medium to medium-full so every acrobatic move is fully visible. It never cuts. It sweeps from character to character with whip-pan-style swings that settle on the next target. After each defeat, the camera glides briefly across the fallen girl so the audience sees she is still there. At the climax the camera does one 100-degree orbit around the heroine at normal speed. In the final seconds the camera slowly pulls back to a medium-wide view that shows all five people.

PERFORMANCE TIMELINE (all in one take)

0–4s: Camera starts close on the heroine, holding her green journal against her chest. A (long black hair) snatches it, holds it out of reach and says in a mocking voice, in English: "This is trash." She tears five pressed-flower pages out in one handful and flings them into the air while the others laugh. Camera pans with the pages fluttering, then returns.

4–7s: She turns to chase the pages. B (chestnut bob) steps in and shoves her; she stumbles, drops to one knee and one palm, the journal falls near her. A few loose ginkgo leaves skitter across the gravel. Camera pushes in on her wet eyes and tight jaw. Laughter fades. Hold the hurt for a beat. A, B, C and D are all visible standing nearby.

7–9s: She says quietly and firmly, in English: "Stop it already." Her hair lifts, a few leaves begin to circle, and the five pages stop and hover on the left. The four step back, uneasy, all clearly visible. B moves in first.

9–12s: DEFEAT 1, B. The heroine pushes off her palm into a single handspring into a side cartwheel. Her spinning legs pull the air into one narrow gust that travels sideways across the gravel into B's chest. B is thrown off balance, slides, and ends seated against the left stone lantern base. She stays there, visible, for the rest of the video.

12–16s: DEFEAT 2, C. The camera glances at B still seated, then whips to C, who charges from the right. The heroine drops into a low crouch and slides on the gravel into one long circular leg sweep. The sweep sends a flat current of leaves and dust along the ground into C's ankles. C's feet slip and she falls forward onto her hands and knees at the right edge. She stays there, visible.

16–20s: DEFEAT 3, D. D rushes in with both hands out. The heroine springs up, performs one standing back handspring into a backflip. As she rotates, her heels drag a wide, flat wall of air in front of her that hits D at torso height. D is pushed back two steps and sits down hard on the wooden bench. She stays seated, visible. Nobody collides with anyone else.

DEFEAT POSITIONS (never reset)
B: seated at the left stone lantern. C: hands and knees at the right edge. D: seated on the bench. A: seated alone near the torii gate. All four stay conscious, remain in the courtyard, never rejoin the fight and are never hit by another person's attack.

RULES FOR THE POWERS
Every technique follows: acrobatic movement, wind forms, wind travels, wind makes contact, reaction. The heroine's feet never touch anyone. Each gust fades after its own hit. Only the targeted person is affected; the others may flinch. No blades of air, no blood, no injuries, no one hits their head. One execution per move: no repeated flips, no extra spins.

AUDIO
Natural courtyard ambience, distant cicadas, rustling leaves, gravel scrapes, shoes, paper tearing, mocking laughter, breathing, cloth movement, wind whooshes, bodies landing on gravel. Only TWO spoken lines in the whole video, both in clear natural English with accurate lip sync: A says "This is trash." and the heroine says "Stop it already." No other dialogue. No music, no narrator, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

LOOK
Natural daylight color with warm golden tones, fine film grain, soft halation, real skin texture, no plastic faces, no HDR glow, no vignette, no letterboxing. Side-on, athletic stunt framing; clothing moves naturally with the acrobatics, never framed as spectacle.

AVOID
Anyone disappearing, fading, dissolving, teleporting or leaving the courtyard; a storm, tornado or thick leaf cloud; cuts, split-screens, studio backgrounds, duplicated heroine, extra characters, group takedowns, changed uniforms, mint or green hair on anyone, sliding planted feet, extra limbs, extra pages (exactly five), extra dialogue, music, subtitles, logos.

END
Exactly 20.0 seconds in one unbroken take. The heroine stands holding her journal with all five pressed-flower pages recovered. All four defeated girls are visibly present in their separate positions. Two bags remain by the shrine wall.

CHARACTERS

Man: Young man in his late 20s, tall and lean, dark hair, wearing an elegant white dinner jacket, white shirt, black bow tie and black trousers.

00:00–00:06 — TERRIFYING CHASE

Open inside a long underground pedestrian tunnel with cold turquoise-green fluorescent lighting, tiled walls, concrete ceiling beams and repeating rectangular ceiling lights disappearing into the distance.

The woman runs desperately toward camera.

Her long hair whips violently behind her. She is breathing hard, terrified and repeatedly looking over her shoulder.

Behind her, the man in the white dinner jacket runs after her.

The man stretches one arm toward her.

Cut to an extreme close-up of his horrifying blackened, damaged hand getting closer and closer to her bare shoulder.

Just before his fingers touch her—

00:06–00:12 — MATCH CUT INTO THE MEMORY

Make a seamless visual match cut.

The frightening dark hand instantly becomes the man's normal healthy hand, positioned in exactly the same place.

The cold turquoise tunnel transforms into a beautiful sunset beach.

Warm golden sunlight floods the frame.

The woman is now laughing happily while running barefoot beside the ocean. Her black dress flows naturally in the sea breeze.

The man is completely normal and handsome again, still wearing his elegant white dinner jacket.

He playfully reaches toward her shoulder while chasing her.

She turns around laughing.

They run together along the shoreline, holding hands and smiling.

Golden sun reflects across the ocean behind them. Wind moves their hair and clothing. Their body language shows that this was once a deeply happy relationship.

Use dreamy handheld tracking, warm backlighting, natural lens flare and intimate close-ups.

The sequence should briefly feel like a completely different film: romantic, nostalgic, peaceful and genuinely joyful.

00:12–00:13 — SNAP BACK TO REALITY

Without warning, smash-cut back to the cold underground tunnel.

Same framing.

Same reaching-hand composition.

But his hand is once again dark, damaged and frightening.

All warm colors disappear instantly.

Return to harsh cyan-green fluorescent lighting and deep shadows.

00:13–00:20 — CORNERED

The woman reaches the end/side of the tunnel and backs against the tiled wall.

She has nowhere left to run.

She suddenly pulls out a small black knife and holds it defensively with both hands.

Her hands shake badly.

She is crying, breathing rapidly and staring at the approaching man.

Camera slowly pushes toward her face.

Her expression changes from pure terror to confusion and recognition.

The man approaches slowly instead of attacking.

Show an extreme shallow-focus shot of his damaged hand cautiously reaching toward her.

She raises the knife—

but cannot bring herself to use it.

Tears fill her eyes.

00:20–00:27 — EMOTIONAL REVEAL

The man steps close.

Instead of hurting her, he suddenly embraces her tightly.

She freezes for a fraction of a second.

Then recognition overwhelms her.

The knife lowers out of frame.

She wraps both arms around him.

She begins sobbing uncontrollably against his shoulder, gripping the back of his white jacket as if she has finally found someone she believed she had lost.

Hold an intimate close-up on her face over his shoulder.

Her makeup is slightly disturbed by tears. Her breathing is uneven. Her hands tremble against his back.

The frightening figure is revealed emotionally as someone she once deeply loved.

Slowly push closer to her crying face and her hand clutching his jacket.

End without explaining whether the man is real, dead, imagined, remembered, or something supernatural.

charred hand reaching toward shoulder → identical composition of healthy hand reaching toward shoulder on the beach → charred hand again in the tunnel.

Duration: 30 seconds | Aspect Ratio: 16:9 | No music

ONE-TAKE LOCK:
This is ONE SINGLE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT lasting the full 30 seconds.
ZERO cuts. ZERO dissolves. ZERO fades. ZERO match-cuts. ZERO time jumps.
ZERO scene resets. The camera never leaves the action and every location
change happens physically inside the shot: the camera passes through torn
doors, over railings and up the roof with Kazemiru. Time runs in real time.

STYLE:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action Japanese dark-action cinema with restrained
subtle VFX. Impossible anime-inspired dual-sword choreography performed by
real human bodies. Large-format cinema look, natural daylight, muted earthy
color palette, soft realistic shadows, no oversaturated colors.

@Image1 is KAZEMIRU. Preserve her exact face, silver-white ponytail, torn
ivory kimono, charcoal split hakama, wind-swirl forearm tattoo and gold hoop
earrings in every frame.
@Image2 shows the five elite guards. @Image3 shows Captain Tetsugan.

POSITIVE LOCKS (true for all 30 seconds):
- Exactly ONE Kazemiru with exactly TWO real steel katanas, one in each
  hand, both always visible and independently controlled.
- Her face always matches @Image1.
- Every enemy comes from @Image2 or @Image3 and stays visually consistent.
- Her body physically crosses every distance, with no teleportation.
- It is always daytime with bright natural light.

PERSONALITY:
Cold, calm, battle-hungry. Minimal expression, steady breathing, focused
eyes. Her hunger shows through relentless speed and escalating ferocity,
never through grinning or shouting.

JADE-WIND EFFECT:
Every fast movement leaves a thin, soft jade-green wind trace that follows
her exact physical path and fades almost instantly: sword arcs leave fine
blade trails, spins bend the air, footsteps kick tiny wakes, supersonic
bursts add a brief compressed-air ripple. Always thin, subtle and realistic.
No aura, no smoke, no glowing body, no effects moving on their own.

CAMERA (one continuous handheld-style pursuit):
Constant dutch angle of 25–35°. Wide field of view around 75° in the
interior and courtyard, tightening to about 50° for the rooftop duel.
Kazemiru moves first and the camera follows 0.1–0.3 seconds late: whip-pan,
overshoot, correct, reacquire at the moment of contact. The camera flows
through rear over-the-shoulder, low-angle pursuit, side tracking,
ground-level chase and front three-quarter retreat, always in one connected
movement. Never static, never perfectly smooth.

══ 0:00–0:10: THE GRAND AUDIENCE HALL ══
Setting: bright daylight through large shoji panels, gold folding screens,
tall dark timber pillars, tatami sections, raised platform, armor displays,
low lacquer tables, silk curtains.

0:00–0:03: Rear over-the-shoulder, five guards closing in. Her fingers tighten
on both hilts. BURST: a thin jade streak snaps across the hall and the silk
curtains whip. The camera loses her, whip-pans, and finds her inside
Guard 1's reach. Left blade parries, right blade slashes diagonally, a pivot,
a reverse cut. He drops.

0:03–0:06: Guards 2 and 3 converge. She ducks under a swing, plants a foot on
a pillar and pushes off, dust bursting from the wood. Mid-air her left
sword deflects Guard 2 and her right sword cuts down. She lands on the edge
of a lacquer table, which slides back, and rebounds straight toward Guard 3.

0:06–0:10: Aerial right slash, left reverse slash, dual cross-slash with two
separate jade trails. She lands low and bursts across the floor. Guard 4's
spear thrusts: she runs two steps up a wall, flips off, and cuts him down
through a folding screen. Guard 5 charges: she catches his blade with one
sword, vaults the railing above him, and finishes with a cross-slash as she
lands behind him.

══ 0:10–0:20: THE PALACE COURTYARD ══
Transition inside the same shot: she does not pose. Both swords still in
hand, she drives straight through the paper doors in one burst. The torn
paper flutters past the lens as the camera follows her through the doorway
onto the wooden veranda and out into a stone courtyard with lanterns, a koi
pond, a red lacquer arched bridge and pine trees. Eight new guards: swordsmen
below and archers on the roofs.

0:10–0:13: A volley of arrows. She cuts two out of the air with a spinning
double slash and a third grazes her sleeve. She sprints along the veranda,
pivoting off each post, a jade ripple following her feet.

0:13–0:16: She kicks off a stone lantern, which tips over, and leaps onto the
bridge railing. Three swordsmen charge. She runs along the rail, slashes the
first, flips over the second, and lands in the koi pond with a huge splash.
In the water she parries two blades and cuts both guards. Droplets scatter
across the lens.

0:16–0:20: She bursts out of the pond and sprints up a pine trunk in three
steps. The camera tilts up with her. She launches onto the roof among the
archers: left sword disarms, right sword strikes, roof tiles scatter. Two
archers fall.

══ 0:20–0:30: THE ROOFTOP DUEL ══
Transition inside the same shot: she keeps climbing over the roof ridge and
the camera rises with her, tightening to a 50° field of view. The tiled
castle rooftop opens up with wind in her ponytail and the town far below.
Captain Tetsugan (@Image3) waits with his naginata, calm and unflinching.

0:20–0:23: Tetsugan sweeps the naginata in a wide arc. Kazemiru ducks, slides
down the sloping tiles, and crosses both swords to stop the blade. Sharp
metal sound as his strength pushes her back a step. Her expression stays

0:23–0:27: Fast exchange: his thrust, her left parry, her right slash that cuts
his armor cord. He spins the pole and sweeps for her feet: she jumps, kicks

her path. He staggers, strikes back, and she narrowly dodges as the blade
cuts a roof beam.

0:27–0:30: Supersonic burst along the ridge line, the jade streak slightly
brighter but still thin. She slides under the naginata, and as she rises

one knee, defeated but alive. Kazemiru stands, both swords still in hand,
and the last jade filaments disappear. She turns her cold eyes toward the
courtyard far below, where dozens more guards pour in. The camera slowly
pulls back and up to a wide shot of the whole castle. She lowers her body for
the next burst. THE FIGHT CONTINUES.

AUDIO:
Sword resonance, compressed-air whooshes, metal clashes, footsteps on wood
and tiles, arrows, water splashes, fluttering silk and paper, enemy shouts,
wind over the rooftops. No dialogue, no music.

HUMAN-FIRST LOCK:
Kazemiru is always a real human: natural skin pores, real eyes, individual
hair strands, believable anatomy and cloth physics. Only her choreography is

NEGATIVE:
cuts, edits, dissolves, fades, scene transitions, time jumps, multiple

LEADER: “고개 숙여.”

Her fear changes to disbelief. Tiny blue-white sparks appear on her sleeve.

prompts.title: Seedance 2.5 Old European Town Morning Travel Vlog
prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-photorealistic travel vlog featuring the SAME young European woman throughout the entire video. She has natural skin texture, subtle facial imperfections, realistic hair movement, authentic body proportions, and completely natural expressions. The video must look like genuine footage recorded by a real travel creator, NOT AI-generated or cinematic CGI.
SHOT 1 — 0–3 seconds:
Selfie-style handheld footage. The woman walks naturally down a beautiful European old-town street in the morning. She holds a small vlog camera at arm's length, looks directly into the lens and gives a subtle genuine smile. Natural walking bounce, slight handheld shake, realistic breathing and hair movement. Background includes pedestrians casually walking, parked bicycles, small cafés, textured historic buildings and soft morning sunlight.
SHOT 2 — 3–6 seconds:
She turns the camera away from herself toward the street. A natural handheld pan reveals detailed European architecture, outdoor café tables, people having coffee, bicycles passing and a small bakery. The camera movement is imperfect and human, with slight exposure adjustment as it moves from shadow into sunlight.
SHOT 3 — 6–9 seconds:
Cut naturally back to selfie footage. She continues walking and briefly says something casually to the camera with natural lip movement and relaxed facial expressions. A light breeze moves a few strands of her hair. People pass behind her naturally without looking at the camera. Realistic depth, authentic street ambience and subtle camera shake.
SHOT 4 — 9–12 seconds:
POV-style footage from her camera as she enters a small local café. The camera moves naturally through the doorway toward a wooden table with a freshly prepared coffee and a small pastry. Realistic reflections on glass, steam rising subtly from the coffee, natural indoor lighting, background conversations and realistic movement.
SHOT 5 — 12–15 seconds:
She sits outside the café and turns the camera back toward herself. She takes a small sip of coffee, looks into the lens and smiles naturally. The camera remains handheld and slightly imperfect. Background pedestrians, bicycles and café activity continue moving naturally. End with a subtle realistic focus shift from her face toward the street behind her.
VISUAL REQUIREMENTS:
Absolute photorealism, real-world physics, realistic human motion, authentic handheld smartphone/vlog camera behavior, natural skin pores and texture, realistic eyes and hair, physically accurate lighting and shadows, natural exposure changes, realistic reflections, detailed European environment, believable background pedestrians, consistent face and clothing across every shot.
Avoid overly smooth camera movements, artificial beauty filters, plastic skin, exaggerated expressions, perfect symmetry, CGI appearance, dramatic movie-style transitions, unrealistic background motion, floating objects, warped hands, distorted faces or AI-looking details.
The final result should feel like an actual 15-second travel vlog filmed spontaneously by a real European woman on a high-quality handheld camera.

prompts.title: A Journey Through The Last Supper in Three Dimensions
prompts.prompt:
What if you could see what Da Vinci NEVER painted?

I went INSIDE The Last Supper using Seedance 2.5 in @FishCreativeHQ

Prompt👇

upload the painting image as first frame and use this video prompt

[First-Frame.png] Create a 20-second vertical 9:16 image-to-video film, using the supplied image as the exact first frame and matching final frame. One continuous camera journey through the room, with macro detail, a gradual emotional reveal, an orbit behind the central figure and a seamless return.

Build the supplied scene as complete 3D geometry while preserving its Renaissance oil-painted appearance. The table stands in real space, the tablecloth drapes over its edges, the food and vessels sit on its surface, and every figure has a fully dimensional body beneath their robes. As the camera passes around them, reveal the sides and rear surfaces hidden from the opening viewpoint. Retain the original brushwork, warm earthy colours, soft daylight and expressive faces.

IDENTIFY AND PRESERVE THE FIGURES

The central figure sits at the middle of the table. He has long wavy brown hair, a full brown beard and downcast, calm eyes. He wears a deep red robe with a rich blue mantle draped across his left shoulder and lap. His right hand rests palm-down on the tablecloth at the left of the frame; his left hand lies open, palm-up, beside a small glass of red wine.

To his right (left of frame) sits a young apostle with long golden-brown hair, a green mantle over a red garment, his sorrowful gaze turned toward the centre. In front of him, a balding older man with a dark beard, wearing red and blue, leans in with a pointing gesture. A partly visible figure with curly hair sits at the far left edge.

To his left (right of frame) a man with thick black curly hair and a dark beard, in a blue robe, turns to speak with a grey-bearded elder in an olive-green robe at the right edge, who raises both hands in an open, questioning gesture.

Keep every pose, gesture, gaze direction and costume exactly as in the reference. No figure moves.

THE ROOM AND TABLE

A dark coffered wooden ceiling. A grey back wall with three tall windows opening onto a sunlit Tuscan landscape of blue hills, cypress trees, terracotta villas and a bell tower. Dark blue and gold damask panels on both side walls.

A long table covered in white linen with a visible grid of fold creases, hanging almost to the floor. On it: scattered bread rolls and crumbs, pewter plates, a central plate of fish, the small glass of red wine, a bowl of green olives, a plate of red and green grapes at the right, a blue-and-white decorated bowl with bread at the left, and a dark glazed ceramic jug at the far left. Wooden trestle legs and the hems of robes are visible below the cloth.

0–3 SECONDS — ENTER OVER THE BREAD

Begin on the exact supplied image for approximately half a second.

The camera then flies forward into the room and descends toward the bread roll resting on the tablecloth just left of centre. Pass macro-close above it.

Reveal the roll's rounded volume, cracked golden crust, flour-dusted ridges and the small crumbs scattered around it, each casting a tiny shadow on the linen. The nearest crust passes softly out of focus beneath the lens as the camera glides on.

The tablecloth has physical relief: woven threads, raised fold creases and shallow dips where objects press into it. The bread falls behind the moving camera while the central figure stays fixed farther into the room. This changing perspective establishes real depth immediately.

3–7 SECONDS — GLIDE ACROSS THE TABLE TO THE WINE

Travel low and smoothly across the linen toward the centre of the table, skimming past the rim of the fish plate. Reveal the plate's worn pewter edge, its curved depth and the painted fish resting inside.

Continue to the small glass of red wine. Curve partly around it at macro distance, revealing the thickness of the glass, the flat surface of the wine, and daylight from the windows refracting through it as a soft red glow on the cloth.

The glass crosses the near foreground, the open palm-up hand appears just beyond it, and the back wall shifts more slowly behind. Maintain forward momentum throughout.

7–10 SECONDS — RISE ALONG THE OPEN HAND AND MANTLE

Rise past the open hand, revealing the gentle curve of the fingers, the creases of the palm and its weight resting on the cloth.

Continue upward along the blue mantle where it falls across his lap and left shoulder. Travel close to the fabric without touching it. Show the painted texture, the deep blue folds as dimensional surfaces: raised crests catch the window light, undersides fall into shadow, and the red robe shows beneath the mantle's edge.

The blue fabric passes beside the lens as his face comes into view above.

10–13 SECONDS — REVEAL THE CENTRAL FACE

Curve inward and slightly upward toward his face.

Approach a close view of his lowered eyes, calm brow, nose and the soft strands of his beard and hair. Preserve the exact face from the reference. Reveal the three-dimensional shape of the cheekbones and brow, and the subtle painted texture of the skin, fully connected to his neck and shoulders.

Ease the camera's speed for approximately one second while continuing a gentle sideways drift. Let the stillness and quiet sorrow register. He does not move; the emotion comes from discovering the expression already present in the painting.

13–17 SECONDS — ORBIT BEHIND HIM TO THE WINDOW

Continue past the outside of his face, over his blue-draped left shoulder, and orbit smoothly behind him into the narrow space between his back and the central window.

Reveal the back of his long wavy hair, the rear folds of the blue mantle and red robe, and the thickness of his shoulders beneath the fabric. His shoulder passes close beside the lens as a soft foreground shape.

Turn gently to look past him through the central window: the sunlit Tuscan hills, cypresses and villas gain real depth, the far hills hazy and the near trees sharper. Then continue the arc so the view swings back over his other shoulder, revealing from behind the backs of the apostles' heads, the young apostle's green mantle, and the whole table spread out before them toward where the viewer began.

17–20 SECONDS — RETURN TO THE ORIGINAL COMPOSITION

Rise and retreat in one smooth arc over the table, passing above the grey-bearded elder's raised open hands at the right, then curving back onto the opening camera axis.

Reveal all figures again in their exact positions. The bread, plates, wine glass, olives, grapes, decorated bowl and ceramic jug settle back onto the table as in the supplied image. The coffered ceiling, three windows and damask walls realign with the frame.

Gently decelerate into the exact opening viewpoint, lens perspective, framing and lighting. End on a frame matching the supplied image so the next repetition flows directly into the opening movement.

CAMERA, STYLE AND CONTINUITY

Use one uninterrupted physical camera path: over the bread, across the table to the wine, up the open hand and blue mantle, to the central face, around behind him to the window, back over his shoulder and out to the original wide composition.

Use natural motion blur and shallow depth of field during macro passes. Transfer focus smoothly to the next detail along the route. Foreground objects pass the lens because the camera moves around them; no figure changes pose, blinks, speaks or moves toward the camera.

Maintain one coherent room with stable geometry and consistent warm daylight from the windows. Hidden surfaces belong to the existing figures, clothing, table and walls and match their visible design. Preserve the oil painting's brushwork, canvas texture and colour at every scale.

No cuts, crash zooms, dissolves, flat canvas flyovers, wall-relief effects, scene morphing, additional people, new props, extra food, text or watermark.

Coffee erupts into long liquid ribbons and perfect suspended droplets. Camera immediately begins a smooth continuous orbit around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the girl at the counter keeps moving, completely unfazed.

8-17s: [Slow 360° Orbital] Camera glides in a full elegant orbit through the frozen diner. Coffee hangs in mid-air as glassy ribbons and spheres with perfect volume and surface tension. Bacon strips, eggs and the spinning tray float weightlessly. Patrons and waitress remain locked in startled expressions. The girl at the counter takes one slow, deliberate sip, eyes half-lidded, almost bored, while the entire frozen world (except her) begins an elegant reverse: every droplet, every piece of food and every person rewinds smoothly back to the exact starting positions.

17-24s: [Medium Shot] Rewind lands perfectly. Waitress stands balanced again with tray and coffee pot. The girl lifts her eyes, raises two fingers in a small casual gesture and softly calls the waitress by name. The waitress turns toward her just before the older lady begins to stand, completely avoiding the collision. A tiny private smile crosses the girl’s face.

24-30s: [Extreme Close-Up] Hard cut to her face as she takes one last slow sip. Soft knowing smile, eyes almost closed in quiet satisfaction, like she has done this a hundred times. Shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh of the neon diner behind her.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fluid physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.

prompts.title: Solo K-POP MV · Second-by-Second Y2K Candy World Storyboard
prompts.prompt:
使用@音频1《Zero to Pop》作为唯一音乐、节拍和口型依据，生成一支30秒、16:9、24fps的原创单人K-POP MV。

视频必须完整覆盖音频的0.00–30.00秒，不得截断、延长、变速或自动淡出。不要重新生成背景音乐，不要加入另一首歌曲。

全片只有@图1是主角和主唱。允许出现2—6名伴舞，但伴舞不能获得面部特写、不能对口型、不能遮挡主角或成为第二视觉中心。

主角的脸、发型、发色、身材比例、服装和饰品全程锁定。只有主角按照@音频1中的实际人声精确对口型；没有人声的段落保持闭唇表演。

【整体视觉】

高预算真人K-POP MV，结合Y2K未来主义、怪诞糖果世界和千禧年数字文化：

CRT电子宠物、透明翻盖手机、像素图标、果冻便利店、充气卧室、镭射洗车通道、巨型CD舞台、镀铬金属、透明塑料和CD彩虹衍射。

色彩以泡泡糖粉、电光蓝、蓝莓紫、酸性绿和镀铬银为主。

怪诞元素必须像真正搭建的实景、机械装置和高级视觉特效，不能像廉价AI拼贴、普通夜店或传统赛博朋克城市。

【主角造型】

主角穿原创Y2K未来女团服装：

银白色不对称短夹克、糖果粉亮片内搭、蓝紫渐变低腰工装裤、透明树脂腰带、镀铬圆环饰品、银白厚底运动鞋，以及一个迷你透明翻盖手机挂饰。

服装全程不变。金属、塑料、布料、头发和饰品必须表现真实重量、反光、惯性和自然摆动。

【音频同步原则】

歌曲约128 BPM，每个主节拍间隔约0.469秒。

最重要的画面锁点：

2.78秒：第一个强重拍，正式进入舞蹈。
6.06秒：第一次换景。
9.82秒：进入翻盖手机表演镜头。
12.63秒：进入第一段收束动作。
14.02秒：音乐明显降能量，切入失重卧室。
17.78秒：节奏重新启动。
21.07秒：高潮副歌和巨型CD舞台出现。
24.82秒：音乐突然抽空，伴舞冻结。
28.95秒：最后一句和最终特写。
29.90—30.00秒：翻盖手机合上，画面硬停。

所有剪辑、甩发、转身、手势、踩地、队形变化和摄影机冲击都必须落在@音频1的真实重拍上。

【逐秒镜头时间线】

0.00–0.47秒：

黑暗中出现一条细窄的CRT扫描线，随歌曲第一个电子启动声闪亮。

不要出现人物，不要添加片名或文字。

0.47–1.88秒：

扫描线展开为一台圆角CRT显示器。

屏幕内出现一只原创像素电子宠物。它随着音频中的电子声睁开眼睛，头顶依次跳出像素爱心、电池和小星星。

所有图标只使用抽象像素图形，不要出现品牌、角色或乱码文字。

1.88–2.78秒：

摄影机快速从CRT屏幕中后退，揭示完整的半透明粉色街机房。

主角已经站在CRT前，侧身背对镜头。摄影机停稳时，她缓慢回头，眼神锁定镜头。

她必须在2.78秒第一个强重拍准确击中开场姿势。

2.78–6.06秒：

低机位鱼眼单人中近景。

主角进入第一段独舞：按键式手指动作、肩部弹动、手臂波浪、髋部重心切换和一次快速半转。

所有动作根据@音频1逐拍执行，不要机械地平均分配动作。

主角按照实际人声自然对口型。背景CRT里的像素宠物同步模仿她的节奏，但不能变成人类或复制她的脸。

摄影机围绕主角移动约45度，同时缓慢推进。

6.06秒，主角手掌拍向镜头，形成遮挡式硬切。

6.06–9.82秒：

进入外星果冻便利店。

主角站在粉色自动传送带中央，4名伴舞从两侧货架后滑入，形成主角在最前方的V形队列。

五人完成连续行进编舞：两步滑行、交叉手臂、肩部撞击、一次同步下沉和快速回弹。

主角距离摄影机最近，服装颜色最鲜明，面部始终清晰。伴舞动作统一但幅度略小。

摄影机正面后退，与传送带保持相同速度。

9.82–12.63秒：

中长焦主角单人镜头。

伴舞退到背景并失焦。主角从货架上拿起一只巨大的透明果冻翻盖手机。

她对着手机完成歌曲中这一段的实际对口型，通过眼神和嘴角表现出俏皮、略带嫌弃的态度。

手机按键根据音乐节拍发光。摄影机在强音上做两次短促punch zoom，但不改变主角身份或面部结构。

12.63–14.02秒：

切回全身镜头。

主角把果冻手机抛向空中，4名伴舞重新进入队形。

全员在三个主要节拍上依次完成：

第一拍：双臂向外展开；
第二拍：快速转身并甩发；
第三拍：身体下沉后锐利定格。

主角踩亮地面上的圆形像素按钮。一道蓝紫色扫描光从脚底向上扫过所有人物。

14.02秒，音乐降能量的瞬间完成场景转换。

14.02–15.55秒：

进入淡紫色失重充气卧室。

画面由快速舞蹈突然转为稳定、梦幻的长镜头。主角坐在充气床边，房间和家具开始缓慢旋转，但主角仍保持正常垂直方向。

不出现伴舞。

摄影机缓慢靠近。主角根据实际音频进行克制、贴近耳语感的对口型，不做大幅度舞蹈。

透明枕头、小型CD和银色耳机线缓慢漂浮。

15.55–17.78秒：

主角从床边站起，向摄影机走来。

两名伴舞出现在旋转房间的左右墙面，制造重力方向错乱的视觉效果，但不能抢夺主角注意力。

主角伸手触碰一张漂浮的小型CD。CD逐渐膨胀为彩虹色圆形入口。

17.78秒节奏重新出现时，主角迈步穿过CD入口，摄影机紧随她穿过，形成无缝转场。

17.78–21.07秒：

进入镭射泡泡洗车隧道。

节奏重新启动，主角带领4名伴舞向前完成行进式编舞：强力踏步、交叉手臂、头部转向、肩部重击和左右展开队形。

镀铬拱门、粉蓝旋转软刷和彩灯按照真实节拍运动。透明泡泡从人物之间经过，但不得遮挡主角面部。

摄影机在主角正前方快速后退，主角始终位于中心。

20.60–21.07秒之间，主角踢向一个巨大的透明泡泡。泡泡表面转化为CD彩虹纹理。

21.07秒高潮重拍时，泡泡爆开并完成换景。

21.07–24.82秒：

进入巨型CD终章舞台，这是全片能量最高的段落。

主角站在直径12米的旋转CD中心，6名伴舞组成对称半圆。摄影机从高位快速下降至略低于腰部的英雄角度。

主角按照歌曲高潮段落精确对口型，全员完成副歌核心编舞：

两拍快速手臂切换；
一次髋部重击；
一次同步旋转；
一次全身下沉；
最后伴舞向两侧打开，把舞台中心完全让给主角。

摄影机在主角旋转时绕行半圈，但不能越过轴线或造成左右翻转。

CD表面产生真实彩虹衍射，像素星空和镀铬行星随节奏闪动。

24.82秒音乐突然抽空时，所有伴舞立刻冻结。

24.82–27.00秒：

主角继续保持运动，伴舞像卡顿的电子游戏角色一样定格在背景。

主角独自向摄影机走两步。画面根据音频中的断奏出现克制的数字卡顿效果：同一个动作短暂重复1—2帧，但主角面部保持稳定。

随着音乐继续变空，冻结的伴舞依次化为方形像素颗粒并消失。

主角不得消失、复制或变形。

27.00–28.95秒：

舞台上只剩主角。

巨型CD停止旋转，背景灯光大部分熄灭。摄影机缓慢推近主角面部。

主角取下腰间的迷你透明翻盖手机，将它举到脸旁。她保持闭唇，直到@音频1最后一句人声真正开始。

画面运动变得极简，把注意力完全留给最后一句和主角表情。

28.95–29.90秒：

主角精确对口型歌曲最后一句。

她直视镜头，从冷静表情逐渐变成带有恶作剧感的轻微笑容。摄影机继续推进至面部特写。

只保留银粉色轮廓光和眼睛里的小型方形反光。

29.90–30.00秒：

主角"啪"地合上翻盖手机。

合盖动作必须与歌曲最终收尾音完全同步。背景灯光瞬间熄灭，画面硬切为黑色。

不要淡出，不要延长尾音，不要字幕、Logo或额外结束镜头。

【表演与口型】

只允许主角对口型。口型必须依据@音频1中的真实语音和节奏生成，不要根据文字自行猜测，不要在纯器乐段随机张嘴。

主角在快速舞蹈时仍保持自然呼吸、面部肌肉运动和稳定身份。表情变化需要与音乐能量一致：

前半段俏皮、自信；
14.02秒后变得梦幻、克制；
17.78秒重新充满力量；
21.07秒进入主打歌级舞台状态；
24.82秒后变得冷静、带恶作剧感。

【硬性限制】

不得改变@音频1的速度、结构或长度。
不得加入新的背景音乐、对白或无关人声。
音效只能作为非常轻微的视觉反馈，不能覆盖原曲。
主角从第一帧到最后一帧必须保持同一张脸。
不得生成主角克隆体或第二名主唱。
伴舞最多6名，面孔必须互不相同。
禁止人物融合、额外肢体、畸形手指、脚底漂移、错误倒影、服装突变和随机换景。
禁止乱码文字、品牌、商标、字幕和水印。

prompts.title: Mini DV Coffee ASMR Vlog
prompts.prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright kitchen morning light. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.
STYLE: Cozy coffee-prep vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: bean grinder whirring, portafilter tamping, steam wand hissing, cup clinking, milk frothing.
SUBJECT: Young man in his mid-20s, plain t-shirt, hair slightly tousled, minimal accessories. Calm, focused energy while making his morning coffee.
SETTING: Small kitchen counter with an espresso machine on a bright morning. Natural daylight, coffee beans and a mug nearby, quiet atmosphere.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the counter, switches on the machine. "Morning coffee, the proper way."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Grinds fresh coffee beans, fine grounds falling into the portafilter.
→ (3s, close-up) Tamps the grounds down firmly and evenly.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Locks the portafilter into the machine. "Here we go."
→ (3s, detail shot) Espresso streams slowly into a small cup. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Pours cold milk into a small steel pitcher. "Time for the milk."
→ (3s, macro shot) Steam wand hissing as it froths the milk.
→ (3s, propped shot) Pours frothed milk carefully over the espresso, forming light layers.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Holds the finished cup, takes a small sip, satisfied smile. "That's exactly what I needed."
→ (3s, final shot) Reaches toward camera, still holding the cup. "See you later." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural kitchen ambience — grinder whirring, tamping, steam hissing, milk pouring should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine focused smiles, occasional careful pauses while pouring, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright morning light shifts. Should resemble a genuine personal coffee vlog on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial or AI-generated production.

不会有人认为这是真的吧？😄

Seedance 2.5 也过于逼真了啊🫠连影子都那么真实

上传自己的图片，加上下面的提示词，你也能这么跳😂

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

Duration: 10秒
Aspect ratio: 9:16
Reference: @图片1，锁定主角面部、发型和人物造型，不额外描述或更换穿着
Audio: 真实城市夜景环境声、助跑脚步、强风呼啸、弹性装置低频回弹声、落地闷响、朋友欢呼；无对白、无旁白、无字幕
Overall style: 极限运动手机实拍，真实高空距离，强烈临场感，一镜到底，轻微手持与高速运动模糊，拒绝游戏CG感

GLOBAL CONTINUITY

Setting:
夜晚城市高楼屋顶，绿色直升机停机坪，黄色圆形标线，低矮水泥护墙。两栋高楼之间形成垂直街道峡谷，地面可见车辆、路灯和十字路口。

Lower apparatus:
街道中央设置一座巨大的圆形黑色弹性回弹装置，中心为深黑色弹性面，外圈环绕连续彩虹灯带。装置尺寸巨大，正对屋顶边缘，作为主角下落和反弹的准确落点。

Main subject:
@图片1为唯一主角。人物身份、面部和造型全程一致。

Bystanders:
三至四名朋友站在屋顶左侧，用手机拍摄并等待主角返回。不能抢占主体。

CAMERA CONTINUITY

全片为屋顶朋友手持手机拍摄的一镜到底。

摄影者先在主角身后跟拍助跑；主角跃下后，摄影者迅速冲到护墙边俯拍；随后镜头持续锁定主角，从垂直向下逐渐抬向天空；主角反弹回到屋顶后，镜头恢复平视。

不切镜、不瞬移、不更换视角。

STUNT ENGINE

动作闭环必须固定：

屋顶助跑 → 飞越护墙 → 高空下落 → 命中圆形弹性面中心 → 装置深度下陷 → 强力回弹 → 主角高速升空 → 空中团身翻腾 → 展体定位 → 双脚返回同一屋顶 → 屈膝落地 → 欢呼庆祝。

SHOT 1（00:00-00:10）高空反弹往返特技

Subject:
@图片1主角站在屋顶停机坪后方，正对远处护墙。朋友位于画面左侧拍摄。

Action:

00:00-00:01.50｜快速助跑

主角背对镜头，从停机坪中央快速冲向屋顶边缘。步幅逐渐加大，身体前倾，双臂自然摆动。

摄影者手持手机紧跟主角向前跑，画面产生真实脚步震动。朋友站在左侧举起手机，紧张注视。

00:01.50-00:02.30｜跃出屋顶

主角最后一步用力蹬地，身体越过低矮护墙。离开屋顶的瞬间，双臂向左右展开，身体稍微前倾，主动朝两栋高楼之间俯冲。

摄影者冲到护墙边，镜头快速向下俯转，始终把主角保持在画面中央。

00:02.30-00:04.80｜高空下落

镜头接近垂直俯拍。主角沿楼宇之间的空间快速下降，身体由前倾逐渐调整为面向下方，双臂保持展开以稳定方向。

随着主角下降，街道、车辆和十字路口迅速显现。巨型黑色圆形弹性装置从画面下方出现，彩虹灯环照亮周围建筑。

主角的下降轨迹必须准确对准黑色弹性面的圆心，不能偏向灯环或撞向建筑。

00:04.80-00:05.50｜命中中心

主角身体落在黑色弹性面正中心。弹性面受到冲击后明显向下形成深凹，彩虹灯环保持固定，装置不能破裂。

短暂压缩后，弹性面以巨大力量恢复原状，将主角垂直向上弹出。

必须清楚表现“接触—下陷—压缩—回弹”四个阶段，不能在接触前提前反向飞行。

00:05.50-00:08.20｜高速反弹与空中翻腾

摄影者仍站在屋顶护墙边。画面底部短暂出现摄影者的双脚，强化真实第一视角和高空距离。

主角从圆形装置中心高速升起，沿原来的垂直路线返回屋顶。摄影机从垂直向下持续向上抬起，跟随主角穿过城市楼宇之间的空间。

主角升空后收紧腰腹，双膝靠近胸口，双臂抱住小腿，形成紧凑团身，在空中完成连续快速翻腾。不要锁定具体翻转方向，以自然连续旋转为准。

主角接近屋顶高度时开始打开身体：松开双腿、抬起头寻找屋顶、双脚转向下方，双臂向两侧展开保持平衡。

00:08.20-00:09.40｜返回屋顶

主角高速接近镜头，从屋顶护墙外侧越回停机坪。双脚同时接触绿色地面，膝盖和髋部深度弯曲，以低位蹲姿吸收落地冲击。

落地必须具有明显重量：鞋底或脚掌接触、腿部压缩、身体下沉、轻微反弹恢复。不能站直着轻飘落地。

摄影者快速后退半步，避免主角撞上镜头，同时继续保持正面近景。

00:09.40-00:10.00｜真实庆祝

主角从蹲姿快速站起，兴奋地看向镜头，张口欢呼。屋顶朋友冲进画面，举着手机围过来，拍肩、挥拳、大声庆祝。

镜头因人群靠近产生轻微晃动，以真实手机自拍视频状态结束。

Environment:
高楼灯光、街道车辆和彩虹灯环保持空间位置稳定。下落和上升必须发生在同一条垂直路线，主角最后返回起跳的同一栋屋顶。

Style:
真实夜间手机曝光，高楼具有准确透视和尺度。下落阶段风声增强，城市灯光形成自然运动拖影；主角返回屋顶时速度极快，但人体轮廓仍然清晰。

Constraints:

prompts.title: A Summer Walk by Young Lovers in Rural West Java

30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic early-2000s consumer DV home video in rural West Java, warm afternoon in Indonesia.

REFERENCE 2: raised Sundanese house. Preserve woven bamboo bilik walls, timber, tiled roof, veranda and stairs.

00–05 — She exits the bilik house, closes the door, sees him and greets him.
05–10 — At a warung, she picks up a bottled drink, shows it and says, “I want this one.” He laughs as she pays.
10–15 — she opens and drinks it. The sour taste makes her react, then she laughs with him.
15–21 — They sit on the veranda. He moves her loose hair. She smiles: “Thank you.”

Raw early-2000s DV: handheld shake, imperfect framing, accidental zooms, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, faded colors, soft detail, noise and motion blur. No stabilization or polished cinematography.

Ambience: footsteps, birds, insects, leaves, distant motorcycles, voices, warung sounds, bottle opening laughter. No music, narration, subtitles, captions, watermark.

Ultra-realistic skin, hair, hands, clothing and movement; tropical light, shadows, sweat and fabric physics. No CGI, distorted faces, extra fingers, duplicated people or artificial acting.!

prompts.title: A Korean Woman's Quiet Morning Routine
prompts.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | Ultra-photorealistic live-action

Create a natural Korean morning-routine day-in-the-life video featuring one young Korean woman waking up 
and easing into her quiet morning at home.

Use the reference image as the EXACT starting frame — she is lying in bed, just waking up. Use the 
reference image for her exact facial identity, hairstyle, skin tone, and body proportions. Keep her 
appearance consistent throughout the entire video. The video begins from this reference pose and moves 
forward naturally.

OUTFIT: Soft cream/white cotton loungewear or a light pajama set to start; she stays in comfortable 
loungewear throughout (no wardrobe change). Minimal or no jewelry. Hair natural and slightly tousled 
from sleep at the start, settling as the morning goes on.

TIME & LIGHTING: Soft early-morning summer sunlight, gradually warming as the morning progresses. Gentle, 
consistent natural light, shadows, color temperature, and time of day across every scene.

00–05s — Waking up (starts from reference image)
The video opens on the exact reference pose — she is lying in bed, eyes just opening, waking up slowly. 
Soft morning light filters through sheer curtains onto the bed. She stirs gently, blinks, and slowly 
sits up, stretching her arms with a soft, sleepy motion. Her hair is naturally tousled.
She rubs her eyes, looks softly toward the window, and quietly says:
"Morning already…"

05–11s — Out of bed
She swings her legs off the bed and stands, stretching gently. She pads across the room and opens the 
curtains — bright morning light floods in. She looks out the window for a moment at the quiet neighborhood 
outside (rooftops, trees, soft sky). Natural, unhurried movement.

11–17s — Washing up
She walks to the bathroom sink. She turns on the faucet and splashes cool water on her face, then pats 
it dry with a soft towel. Water droplets fall naturally. She looks at herself briefly in the mirror, 
tucks her hair behind her ear, and takes a slow breath. Fresh and calm.

17–23s — Making breakfast / morning drink
She moves to the kitchen. She fills a kettle and sets it to boil, then takes a mug and a tea bag (or 
pour-over coffee) from the counter. Steam rises as she pours the hot water — the liquid swirls naturally 
in the mug. She sets a simple breakfast on a small plate (toast, fruit, or a pastry). Gentle, homey 
morning movements.

23–30s — Quiet morning moment
She sits by the window with her warm mug and breakfast, both hands wrapped around the cup. She takes a 
slow first sip, pauses, and smiles softly.
She looks out at the morning light and quietly says:
"Perfect start."
The camera slowly drifts backward, capturing the cozy bedroom/kitchen, the open window, gentle curtain 
movement, soft morning light, and the calm start-of-day atmosphere.
Cut naturally at the end.

CAMERA STYLE: Documentary lifestyle footage with smooth handheld movement. Natural tracking shots, 
occasional subtle camera sway, realistic focus transitions, restrained depth of field, natural lens 
behavior, and authentic perspective. Avoid overly cinematic shots or commercial advertising aesthetics.

AUDIO: Real environmental audio only — soft morning ambience, birdsong outside, sheets rustling, a gentle 
yawn, curtains sliding open, water running, towel patting, kettle boiling, water pouring into a mug, a 
spoon clinking, breathing, and natural sipping sounds. No background music.

PHYSICAL REALISM: The bedsheets shift and drape naturally as she wakes and rises. Her stretching, standing, 
and walking feel spontaneous and physically accurate. Water flows and droplets fall naturally. The kettle 
steams and the liquid pours with realistic fluid dynamics. Hands maintain believable grip and pressure. 
All body movements — waking, stretching, walking, washing, pouring, sitting, sipping — should feel natural 
and unforced.

prompts.prompt: ## 一、镜头核心 - 成片时长：约 15 秒。 - 推荐画幅：16:9。原文件是 9:16 教程排版，但其中的人物表演画面本身接近横向 16:9。 - 镜头形式：第三人称、正面越肩构图、一镜到底，不切正反打。 - 景别变化：从近景/胸上景开始，结尾因女主后撤自然变为稍松的中近景。 - 情绪路径：紧张准备 → 听见熟悉问候 → 短暂动摇 → 苦笑掩饰 → 决绝宣告 → 克制退场。 - 核心表演链：刺激（门开、听见男声）→ 理解停顿 → 无意识反应（闭眼、吸气）→ 主动选择（抬眼、苦笑）→ 台词（“WE'RE DONE.”）→ 残留情绪（仍不舍但拉开距离）。 ## 二、人物与场景 ### 女主 参考上传图片 {{Mixed 1}} 外表柔软、干净，真实皮肤质感，不过度磨皮。她来这里之前已经做过决定，但真正见到男主时仍会动摇；表演不是愤怒，而是压住痛苦后的告别。 ### 男主 只以镜头右前方的深色失焦肩部、头部轮廓出现，不露脸、不抢焦、不进入清晰景深。声音温和、亲昵，尚未意识到女主是来结束关系的。 ### 场景与氛围 住宅门口或临近庭院的入口，背景可见柔化的绿色植物、浅灰路面和几颗暖色圆形散景。整体是傍晚前后的自然光感：人物左前方约 45° 的柔和冷白主光，背景带少量暖金色轮廓光。空间安静，空气似乎刚下过雨或带着潮湿感。氛围温柔、克制、疏离，不做强烈戏剧化灯光。 > 说明：焦段与灯光参数是根据画面反推的复拍建议，并非原视频元数据。建议使用全画幅等效 70–100mm 中长焦、较浅景深；焦点始终锁定女主双眼。 ## 三、15 秒连续表演脚本 ### 0.0–0.8 秒｜门开，人物被揭示 画面先被男主深色、严重失焦的身体轮廓大面积遮住。门打开后，男主略微向镜头右侧移动，女主从遮挡后被揭示，站在门外，正对男主。机位保持稳定，不突然推拉。 女主没有立刻抬头。她下巴轻收，视线停在男主胸口或门槛附近，嘴唇自然分开一点。身体看似安静，但肩颈带着轻微僵硬，像已经在门外排练过很多次。 声音：轻微开门声、衣料摩擦、安静的户外底噪。 ### 0.8–3.2 秒｜用呼吸压住情绪 女主缓慢吸气，动作很小：胸口与锁骨区域轻微抬起，肩膀先绷紧一点，再缓慢落下。她的目光仍向下，眼睑逐渐闭合，闭眼时间略长于正常眨眼。 不要立刻流泪，不要夸张皱眉。只保留两个可见信号：呼吸变深、唇角轻微发紧。她试图把即将失控的情绪压回去。 镜头：固定近景，浅景深，男主虚化轮廓留在画面右侧作为关系压力。 ### 3.2–5.4 秒｜听见熟悉的问候 男主画外音自然地说：“Hey, what's up, baby?” 语气轻松、带一点笑意，像平常迎接她一样。 女主先保持闭眼约半秒，让声音真正落进身体。随后喉咙轻轻吞咽，眉心只出现很浅的紧张，不抬头、不回答。她缓慢呼出刚才那口气，嘴唇微动，却没有形成语言。 表演重点：反应必须发生在听见台词之后；熟悉的亲昵让她短暂动摇，但没有改变决定。 ### 5.4–7.5 秒｜抬眼，对视，短暂动摇 女主先睁眼，再抬视线，最后才微微抬起下巴，动作分三层完成。焦点从男主胸口缓慢移到男主眼睛。眼神由散乱转为清晰，眼底有湿润感，但泪水不掉落。 她与男主对视后停住。鼻息稍乱，嘴唇轻轻抿合，面部仍然保持克制。镜头不要推进，让观众主动观察她的变化。 ### 7.5–9.3 秒｜苦笑成为最后一道防线 女主嘴角极轻地向一侧抬起，形成一个不完整、略不对称的苦笑。笑意只停留在嘴角，没有进入眼睛。她仍望着男主，像在确认自己熟悉的人还在，却也确认这段关系已经无法继续。 苦笑持续不到两秒，随后慢慢消失。消失后不要立刻变成冷脸，仍保留一点不舍和受伤，让悲伤与决心同时存在。 ### 9.3–10.6 秒｜宣告结束 女主保持眼神接触，以很轻、很清晰、没有怒气的声音说：“We're done.” 说话前留一个短促吸气；“We're”仍带着残余的温柔，“done”落下时眼神变得更稳定。嘴部动作自然，不刻意咬字，不大幅摇头。台词结束后双唇轻合，停顿半秒。 声音：保留真实呼吸和轻微环境声；不需要煽情配乐，不需要额外字幕。 ### 10.6–13.4 秒｜让沉默完成切割 女主继续看着男主，不马上离开。她的表情逐渐回到近乎平静，眼睛仍有水光，下巴轻轻收紧。身体重心开始从前脚转向后脚，显示她准备离开，但上半身还有一点不愿拉开距离的迟疑。 镜头保持停留，不切男主反应。男主仍只是右侧虚焦前景，让观众只能从女主脸上感受这句话的重量。 ### 13.4–15.1 秒｜后撤，关系距离被具象化 女主缓慢向后退一至两小步，眼神最初仍留在男主脸上。她的身体在画面中自然变小，景别由近景松到中近景；肩膀放松、站姿重新变直，表情从痛苦转为疏离而坚定。 最后定格状态：女主与男主之间的距离已经被拉开，她没有转身逃跑，也没有情绪崩溃，只用平静的后撤完成告别。焦点仍锁在她脸上，背景与男主保持柔和虚化。 ## 四、摄影执行要点 - 机位在男主肩后、接近女主眼睛高度，男主位于画面右侧前景，女主居中略偏左。 - 始终遵守同一条视线轴，不跳轴、不突然切换主观视角。 - 主要使用固定机位或极轻微的稳定呼吸感；结尾的景别变化来自女主后撤，不用明显变焦。 - 对焦点始终在女主眼睛；男主轮廓、庭院背景和灯光散景保持失焦。 - 曝光保护女主肤色与浅金发丝，避免高光溢出；保留真实皮肤纹理、细小不对称和自然眨眼。 - 每个情绪段只保留 1–3 个可见信号，避免眉毛、眼睛、鼻翼、嘴角同时机械运动。 ## 五、连续性与禁止项 - 女主身份、发型、耳环、项链、灰色翻领针织上衣、体型和年龄感全程一致。 - 男主始终不露脸、不抢焦，不突然变成清晰人物，也不与女主发生肢体接触。 - 不新增眼泪滚落、歇斯底里哭泣、愤怒瞪眼、突然大笑或夸张摇头。 - 不使用正反打、快速推镜、环绕镜头、突然变焦或多机位切换。 - 不改变光线方向、背景空间、两人站位轴线和女主视线高度。 - 不继承原教程视频顶部的参考图、底部滚动文字、平台水印和排版黑边；只复刻其中人物表演画面的镜头与情绪逻辑。

prompts.title: Her Autumn Day in the City
prompts.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A 20-year-old East Asian woman spends an autumn day moving through a big city — leaving her apartment, riding the subway, grabbing coffee from a cart, cutting through a park in falling leaves, browsing a bookstore, catching golden hour on a rooftop, and riding home at night — filmed as a candid, mixed-format day-in-the-city vlog, 30 seconds total.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@image1: 20-year-old East Asian woman, soft round face, warm ivory skin, dark brown hair in a loose high bun with face-framing strands, natural dewy makeup, gentle expressive eyes, wearing a wine-burgundy ribbed knit off-shoulder sweater and a small silver flower pendant necklace. 100% matches the reference throughout every shot.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot. HARD CUTs only at the stated seconds; camera does not cut on its own between them. Mixed scene styles — not every shot has dialogue; some are silent candid b-roll.

0.0s–4.0s — HARD CUT
4.0s–8.0s — HARD CUT
8.0s–12.0s — HARD CUT
12.0s–17.0s — HARD CUT
17.0s–21.0s — HARD CUT
21.0s–26.0s — HARD CUT
26.0s–30.0s — end

OPTICS
Shot 1: 63° wide, POV-adjacent handheld. Shot 2: 47° neutral, static-ish lean. Shot 3: 29° portrait-compression, quick transactional. Shot 4: 18° natural-portrait, slow-mo detail. Shot 5: 29° portrait-compression, candid unaware angle. Shot 6: 47° neutral, two-shot-adjacent solo toast. Shot 7: 18° natural-portrait, close reflective. No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Handheld throughout with natural 1–2cm tremor. Shot 1: phone-height POV-style, walking at 4 km/h. Shot 2: camera rests low against a pole, minimal movement, observational. Shot 3: quick whip from hand to face and back. Shot 4: slowed to half real-time, camera drifts sideways at 1 km/h following falling leaves. Shot 5: camera appears to catch her off-guard, slight delay before she notices it. Shot 6: static-ish, propped, she moves into frame. Shot 7: static through car window glass, reflections passing over her face.

ACTION
0.0s–4.0s: She steps out of an apartment building onto a leaf-scattered sidewalk, adjusting her bag strap, glancing at her phone, morning light low and warm through bare branches. She looks up at the camera briefly, half-smiles: "Okay — let's do this."

4.0s–8.0s: Inside a subway car, she leans against a pole, earbuds in, watching the platform lights blur past the window, city sounds muffled and rhythmic. No dialogue — just her quiet, unbothered expression, occasional sway with the train's motion.

8.0s–12.0s: At a small street coffee cart, steam rising from the machine, she hands over cash, receives a paper cup, wraps both hands around it immediately for warmth. Brief exchange, she says only: "Thanks, you're the best."

12.0s–17.0s: Slow-motion through a park path thick with falling amber leaves, she tips her head back mid-step and turns once, leaves catching in her hair and sweater, genuine unguarded laugh, no spoken line — just breath and laughter audible.

17.0s–21.0s: Inside a small bookstore, she runs a finger along a shelf, pulls a book halfway out, flips a few pages, unaware of the camera, soft window light across her face, ambient store quiet. No dialogue.

21.0s–26.0s: On a rooftop at golden hour, city skyline hazy behind her, she raises a takeaway coffee cup slightly toward the lens like a small toast, warm low sun rim-lighting her hair, says only: "To days like this."

26.0s–30.0s: Inside a taxi at night, warm amber streetlights sliding across the window glass and over her face in soft passing bands, she rests her head against the seat, tired contented smile, looks toward the lens and says: "Best day, hands down."

PERFORMANCE
Restrained, natural reactions — no performed excitement. Shots 2 and 5 specifically read as candid/unaware of the camera. Living eyes with catch-light in every close shot, visible breath in shot 1, natural skin and fabric texture throughout.

PHYSICS
Leaves fall and scatter with real weight and drift, catching briefly in hair and sweater fibers before falling away. Coffee steam rises and dissipates naturally. Streetlight bands move across her face and the window glass with correct parallax as the car moves. Train sway shifts her weight subtly and believably.

LIGHTING
Shot 1: low warm morning sun through bare branches, soft shadow lines. Shot 2: cool fluorescent subway light with warm practicals flickering past outside. Shot 3: overcast daylight, soft even key. Shot 4: dappled warm sun through park canopy, backlit leaf edges. Shot 5: soft window-diffused daylight, low contrast. Shot 6: warm low-angle golden hour key, strong rim light, soft haze. Shot 7: warm amber sodium streetlight passing bands only, otherwise dark interior.

COLOR GRADE
Warm autumn palette — amber, rust, and soft gold tones with muted city grays. Warm amber streetlight at night, never neon or saturated colored signage anywhere in frame. No cool-cyan or magenta tint.

WARDROBE
Wine-burgundy ribbed knit off-shoulder sweater and silver flower pendant necklace, unchanged and clearly visible in every shot. A loosely draped scarf or open coat may sit over it in the subway and taxi shots without covering it.

AUDIO
Shot 1: quiet street ambience, rustling leaves. Shot 2: muffled train rumble, distant announcement, no dialogue. Shot 3: espresso machine hiss, brief exchange. Shot 4: crunch of leaves, natural laughter, no line. Shot 5: quiet store ambience, page-turning, no dialogue. Shot 6: distant city hum, wind. Shot 7: engine hum, soft radio murmur under her line.

STYLE
Authentic day-in-the-life vlog cinematography, dreamy 35mm film aesthetic, fine natural grain, realistic autofocus hunting, mix of talking and silent candid shots for a lived-in, unscripted feel.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
4K, 24fps, 35mm grain, real-time except shot 4 (half real-time slow motion), realistic handheld motion, no neon or saturated signage in the color palette anywhere.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same woman's face and build in every shot, matching @image1 exactly. Wine-burgundy sweater and silver necklace stay visible in every shot. Hair stays in the same loose high bun throughout. Cuts only at stated seconds, camera does not cut on its own. Shots 2 and 5 stay dialogue-free and candid. Warm amber tones hold throughout — no neon, no cool-cyan tint anywhere.

prompts.title: A Korean Girl’s Early-2000s Birthday Celebration
prompts.prompt:
A birthday worth remembering 🎂

Generated with seedance 2.5

Prompt
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Korean birthday vlog set in South Korea in the early 2000s, filmed casually by a friend on an authentic consumer DV camcorder. It must feel like genuine home-video footage, not a modern video with a retro filter.

EXACT ORDER — 7 SCENES:

0–4s — GETTING READY: The same young Korean birthday girl gets ready in her early-2000s bedroom, fixes her hair, adjusts makeup, picks up her handbag and smiles toward the camera.

4–8s — MEETING FRIENDS: She walks through an authentic Korean neighborhood, meets the same 2–3 friends, they congratulate her and walk together toward a bakery.

8–11s — BAKERY: They enter a small early-2000s Korean bakery, browse cakes and choose one birthday cake.

11–14s — BUYING CAKE: A friend pays with cash. The worker puts the cake into a box and hands it over. The same cake box remains visible as they walk to the café.

14–23s — CAFÉ CELEBRATION: They sit in a cozy early-2000s café. The cake is opened, a candle is lit, everyone sings Happy Birthday, the girl makes a wish and blows it out. They clap and laugh. She then cuts the cake, places pieces on plates, personally gives a piece to each friend, watches them eat, then takes a piece herself. Keep the entire sequence clearly visible and in order.

23–26s — PHOTOS: After eating, they take group photos using a small early-2000s disposable film camera. No smartphones or modern digital cameras. They pose, the shutter clicks and they laugh afterward.

26–30s — EVENING WALK: They leave the café and walk through the same neighborhood as it becomes evening. The girl carries her handbag, a friend carries the empty cake box/bag, and they chat and laugh while the camera follows from behind.

CONTINUITY: Same girl, friends, outfits, hairstyles, handbag and cake throughout. No teleporting, identity drift, outfit changes, disappearing props or reordered actions.

ERA: Everything must look authentically early 2000s Korean—fashion, hair, bakery, café, cars, signs, furniture, cake packaging and technology. No smartphones, AirPods, modern cars, LED screens or contemporary interiors.

CAMERA: Raw consumer DV footage with subtle handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft digital detail, mild CCD/DV noise, motion blur, compression and occasional awkward zooms. Natural candid behavior, realistic skin and movement. No cinematic stabilization, 4K sharpness, beauty filters, VHS effects or professional filmmaking.

FINAL FEEL: A genuine Korean birthday memory from the early 2000s, with every scene and action clearly shown in the exact requested order.

prompts.title: A Cozy Winter Getaway in a Snowy Alpine Village
prompts.prompt:
A cinematic 30-second alpine winter vlog montage featuring the same young woman exploring a snow-covered mountain village during a cozy winter getaway. Shot like an authentic luxury travel diary with handheld camera movement, candid moments, soft overcast daylight transitioning to warm firelight, dreamy 35mm film aesthetics, cool-toned color grading with warm amber accents, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, atmospheric lighting, and cinematic storytelling. Maintain the same woman throughout every scene: dark hair, youthful appearance, natural makeup, relaxed happy expression — identity locked to the reference image. Format: 4K cinematic video, 24fps, 35mm film grain, realistic handheld camera, soft focus, cool-warm contrast palette, travel documentary style.

Scene 1 (0-4s) — Arrival at the Chalet Village: A crisp winter morning, light snow falling. She steps out of a wooden chalet doorway wearing a cream cable-knit sweater, faux-fur-trimmed parka, and a knit beanie, breath visible in the cold air. Camera trails her from behind down a snowy cobblestone lane lined with timber cottages, then swings into a close-up as she turns and smiles, saying softly, "Okay, this already feels like a movie."

Scene 2 (4-8s) — First Ski Run: She glides down a gentle beginner slope, snow spraying softly at her skis, pine trees blurred past on either side. Low chase shots from behind, then a front-facing GoPro-style angle catching her laughing as she wobbles slightly and steadies herself.

Scene 3 (8-12s) — Snow-Covered Pine Forest Walk: A worm's-eye view looking up through frosted pine branches, pale sunlight filtering through with soft lens flares on ice crystals. prompts.title: POV Cliff Jump into a Turquoise Volcanic Canyon Spring
prompts.prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 | TEXT TO VIDEO | SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE | 22s | 1080x1920 | 9:16 | 30fps | 1080p

SCENE AND LOCATION
A hidden volcanic spring canyon deep in a Pacific Northwest pine forest on a bright summer day. A narrow, deep gorge with steep, very high walls of dark gray basalt made of vertical hexagonal columns, streaked with tan and rust tones and covered in patches of bright green moss, ferns and small shrubs.
At the bottom is a crystal-clear natural spring pool. The shallow edges glow bright turquoise and aqua, fading to deep sapphire blue in the center. The water is so transparent that the bottom is fully visible: honeycomb-patterned volcanic rock, mossy boulders, and two long pale submerged logs lying diagonally across the bottom.
Two white waterfalls pour into the pool: a thin one at the far back of the canyon and a larger one spilling from the right-hand cliff wall, making white foam where it hits the water. Tall dark-green conifer and pine trees line the canyon rim. Above is a vivid clear blue sky with a few small white clouds. Hard, bright midday sunlight with strong contrast, and sun sparkles on the water.

THE JUMPER
A young man seen only from his own first-person view. Tanned bare feet and lightly hairy shins, and loose navy-blue swim shorts with a large mustard-yellow hibiscus flower pattern and white drawstrings. No shirt, no shoes, no gloves. His hands and forearms appear naturally in frame when he moves them.

CAMERA AND REALISM
First-person POV from a GoPro strapped to his forehead. It looks like real action-cam footage, not a cinematic camera. 16mm-equivalent ultra-wide lens with slight barrel distortion, and saturated but natural color.
Use real action-cam behavior throughout: small head bob and micro-jitter from breathing and body weight, rolling-shutter wobble on fast moves, quick auto-exposure shifts between bright sky and the shaded canyon, a small sun flare on upward tilts, light sensor noise in the shadows, and wind buffeting that shakes the frame during the fall.
The cliff is about 35 meters high. Gravity, body motion and water physics are fully realistic.

0-2s | THE EDGE (real time)
POV looking straight down from the top of the basalt cliff. His bare feet stand on the rough, dark rock ledge at the bottom of frame, with the shorts visible at the lower edge. Both hands hover forward at the sides of frame. The turquoise pool, the submerged logs and the waterfalls are far, far below. His toes curl over the edge and small grit crumbles off. His right hand tosses a pink-and-white striped inflatable tube out over the drop; it tumbles down and lands as a tiny speck on the water far below. Wind, distant waterfall roar, upbeat chill electronic music starts.

2-4s | THE COUNTDOWN (real time)
A quick nervous tilt down at the drop, a sharp exhale, then two fast steps back from the edge, with the ledge bouncing in frame. Young male voice, hyped: "Three, two, one!"

4-7s | THE TAKEOFF (natural slow motion, about 50% speed)
Two running steps forward, then his last foot pushes off the ledge in slow motion. Rock grit kicks up and floats in the sunlight, the cliff edge slides away beneath his feet, his arms swing forward and out wide, and the whole turquoise canyon opens up below. The slow motion looks like a real high-frame-rate action-cam clip, not a frozen hang. Deep bass swell, stretched wind.

7-13s | THE FALL (real time, fast and continuous)
The speed ramps smoothly back to normal and the stomach drops.
7-9s: The frame dips and wobbles, his arms flail slightly for balance at the edges of frame, and his feet kick at the bottom of frame. A loud yell: "Woooooo!"
9-11s: The basalt column wall, moss and ferns streak upward past the lens, and the right-side waterfall rushes by with spray catching the sun. Wind roars louder and the frame shakes from air buffeting.
11-13s: The glowing turquoise water rushes up and fills the frame, and the pink tube and submerged logs grow fast. His arms snap tight to his body and his legs lock straight for a feet-first pencil dive. The music builds to the drop.

13-14s | IMPACT
A hard feet-first hit into the water and a white explosion of bubbles swallows the lens. Loud plunge splash, deep impact whoosh, and the music goes heavily muffled underwater.

14-17s | UNDERWATER (short, energetic, real time)
A violent swirl of silver bubbles clears to reveal crystal-clear blue water, bright sun shafts cutting down from the surface, the pale submerged logs and honeycomb volcanic rock bottom below, and small fish darting away. His hands push into frame for one strong breaststroke pull, then fast kicks straight up toward the bright glowing surface, with bubbles streaming past the lens. No slow sinking.

17-19s | SURFACE BREAK
The camera bursts through the surface, water droplets sliding across the lens, and bright sunlight floods in. The music snaps back to full clarity on the beat drop. His hand grabs the pink-and-white tube floating right beside him.

19-22s | THE REWARD
POV bobbing on the turquoise water holding the tube, then a sharp tilt up revealing the towering basalt cliff, the tiny ledge he jumped from far above, the pine trees on the rim and the vivid blue sky, with the waterfall splashing on the right. Same voice, out of breath and triumphant: "Yeah, dude! That was insane!" Faint distant cheering. Music plays clean to the final frame.

AUDIO
Continuous upbeat chill electronic track: a bass swell on takeoff, a fast build through the fall, muffled underwater, then a clean drop on surfacing. Real ambient layers: wind that grows with speed, fabric flapping, heavy breathing, waterfall roar, splash, bubbles. Dialogue clear over the music.

KEEP
One continuous take, first-person only. The same shorts, feet and hands throughout, and the same canyon layout with two waterfalls, turquoise pool and submerged logs. The slow motion lasts only 3 seconds at takeoff. The fall is fast, real time and builds speed without pausing. Every beat is quick and punchy.

AVOID
Extra slow motion beyond the takeoff, hovering or floating mid-air, smooth cinematic gimbal movement, cuts to third person, showing the jumper's face, extra people, distorted hands or extra fingers, morphing cliffs, changing water color, text, subtitles, watermarks.

A pretty young woman with dark hair in a loose ponytail, gold hoop earrings, burgundy long-sleeve top and beige trench coat. Soft, natural young female voice speaking casually to camera in a warm, slightly British/neutral accent, like a personal vlog.
She starts by a rain-streaked window looking out at wet cobblestone streets and says:
“Yeah, I definitely wasn't planning on going anywhere today, but staying home sounded boring.”
She puts on her trench coat, steps out the black front door into light rain, walks on shiny cobbles, smiles and says:
“Okay, maybe this was a bad idea.”
She notices a warm glowing independent bookshop, stops surprised:
“Wait, I've never been in here.”
She goes inside, browses wooden shelves, picks up a book and says:
“Okay, this was worth leaving the house for.”
Cut to her sitting by a rainy cafe window sipping coffee from a brown paper cup:
“This is exactly what I needed.”
She walks down a long empty cobblestone street at golden hour with coffee and a paper bag, sunlight flaring through her hair, then turns to camera smiling:
“Okay, I'm really glad I went out.”
“Random plans are usually the best ones.”
Soft natural lighting, wet reflections, cozy cinematic color grade, handheld but smooth camera, quiet rain and footsteps under her voice. Warm, slightly melancholic then happy mood. No text on screen.

Soft golden sunlight streaming through frosted windows. She steps onto the wooden engawa porch, crouches to scatter seeds for small sparrows hopping in the fresh snow. Later she sweeps snow off the porch with a traditional straw broom. Inside she kneels on tatami pouring steaming tea from a ceramic teapot into a small cup, holding it with both hands and gazing peacefully out the window. Then she walks away along a snowy path beside the wooden house, wearing a light beige coat, looking out over a picturesque snow-blanketed village with traditional houses, wooden fences, snow-laden pine trees, distant mountains, and chimney smoke rising in the golden sunrise light. prompts.title: A Woman’s Late-Night Routine from Above
prompts.prompt:

She wakes on the mattress. Sits up under the lens.
Still centered under the lens, reaches to the floor. Picks up the cigarette and lighter. Places the cigarette between her lips. Lights it. Drops the lighter on the mattress. Stands up with the cigarette still with her.
