prompts.title: A Night at the Riverside Shrine Summer Festival
prompts.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A young Japanese woman films a handheld selfie vlog at a riverside shrine summer festival at night — paper lanterns strung along a stone embankment, floating lanterns drifting on the water below. She walks the lantern-lined path, buys a skewer of grilled mochi, plays a cork-gun shooting gallery and wins a small bell charm, then sits on the riverbank and watches fireworks burst over the water before signing off to camera.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@image1: young woman, dark hair styled loosely up with soft face-framing strands, warm brown eyes, soft round face, light natural makeup, delicate floral hair ornament. 100% matches the reference.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: her extended selfie arm holding the phone, natural front-camera framing. Midground: stone embankment path lined with red and cream paper lanterns on bamboo poles, food stalls and a shooting-gallery stall with warm bulb lighting to one side. Background: the river below reflecting lantern light, distant silhouettes of festival-goers, a low wooden footbridge. Practical light sources: paper lanterns (warm amber), stall string-lights (soft white-warm), no signage or neon of any kind.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
She is centered-left in frame, phone held at arm's length and slightly above eye level, walking toward camera along the lantern path, lantern glow rimming her hair, river visible over her shoulder in the background.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot — HARD CUTs at stated seconds, cuts only at the specified points, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
0–8s: 84° wide FOV, selfie-arm framing, natural handheld phone-camera distortion at the frame edges.
8–16s: 63° FOV, still selfie framing, slight downward tilt toward the food stall.
16–23s: 63° FOV, selfie framing angled toward the shooting-gallery counter, phone held lower to keep both her face and the targets visible.
23–30s: 84° FOV, selfie framing seated on the riverbank, wide enough to hold her face in the lower third and the firework bursts in the upper frame simultaneously — no phone-flip needed.
No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Handheld selfie-arm operator throughout: natural micro-shake, small vertical bounce matched to her walking pace, arm drifts and re-centers her face every few seconds the way a real phone selfie does. At 23s she lowers herself to sit, camera settles into a steadier handheld hold braced on her knee, minor sway only.

ACTION
0.0s to 8.0s — She walks along the lantern path, glancing between the camera and the path ahead, loose hair strands lifting slightly in the warm night breeze, lanterns passing softly out of focus behind her.
8.0s HARD CUT
8.0s to 16.0s — She stops at a grilled-mochi stall, takes the skewer from the vendor's hand just out of frame, bites it, chews, and grins wide at the camera with her cheeks puffed, steam rising faintly from the mochi.
16.0s HARD CUT
16.0s to 23.0s — She leans over a cork-gun shooting-gallery counter, one eye closed aiming the toy gun at a shelf of small prizes, fires, a cork dart knocks a tin bell off its stand with a clatter, she yelps and claps once, the stall attendant hands her the small bell charm on a cord.
23.0s HARD CUT
23.0s to 27.0s — She walks a few steps to the riverbank and sits down cross-legged facing the water, phone still held at selfie angle, the first fireworks bloom in the sky behind and above her, their glow and color briefly washing across her upturned, delighted face as she watches over the top of the phone.
27.0s HARD CUT
27.0s to 30.0s — Still seated, she turns her focus back to the lens, face lit warm from the lantern light and cool flicker from the fireworks above, she waves once at the camera and says, "That's tonight's little adventure — catch you on the next one, bye!"

PERFORMANCE
Unscripted, lightly breathless energy between beats from walking; sharp startled-delight micro-expression at the shooting gallery (eyebrows lift, small flinch at the clatter, then a laugh); softer, awed half-smile during the fireworks with eyes tracking upward before returning to camera; catch-lights from lantern glow visible in her eyes throughout; pore-level skin realism, soft natural blush.

PHYSICS
Hair and kimono sleeve fabric move naturally with her walking pace and the night breeze; steam rises and dissipates off the grilled mochi; the cork dart travels in a real short arc and knocks the tin bell with a visible small bounce and wobble; water ripples naturally under the floating lanterns and firework reflections; her seated weight settles naturally onto the stone embankment.

LIGHTING
Warm 3200K practical key from paper lanterns and stall bulbs throughout, soft ambient fill from the diffuse night sky; at 23–30s a secondary cool-white and amber flicker from fireworks washes across her face and the river in time with each burst, without overpowering the warm base tone.

WARDROBE
Sage-green cotton kimono-style summer robe with a subtle white crane-and-wave print, pale blush obi sash tied in a simple bow at the back, wide sleeves trimmed in cream, fabric soft and slightly loose from a night of walking.

AUDIO
Ambient festival murmur, distant taiko drum, crunch of gravel underfoot, sizzle from the food stall, clatter of the tin bell at the shooting gallery, crackle and boom of fireworks overhead, her voice: "That's tonight's little adventure — catch you on the next one, bye!"

STYLE
Photoreal smartphone vlog look, natural front-camera color science, ultra-high-definition 4K clarity with fine authentic skin and fabric micro-detail, slight authentic handheld imperfection, no artificial neon or synthetic lighting anywhere in the scene.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9 widescreen, 4K resolution, real-time throughout, natural phone-camera dynamic range and grain.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Her face and identity stay consistent with the reference in every cut. Lighting stays warm-lantern-based throughout, only fireworks add a brief cool-amber accent. No neon signage or neon-colored light sources anywhere in frame. Kimono-style robe, obi, and bell-charm prop stay visually consistent across all cuts.

prompts.title: A Red-Jacketed Traveler’s Journey Through China
prompts.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | premium travel music video / fashion travel film | 2024–2026 commercial grade | MULTISHOT

CORE CONCEPT
A young traveler experiences China through an energetic but natural sequence of movement, culture, fashion, food, architecture and landscapes. The film feels like a premium Chinese tourism campaign combined with an elite fashion travel film. The traveler is always physically present in the environment. Every location feels photographed rather than generated. Music drives the edit, but the footage retains the imperfections and spontaneity of real travel photography.

CHARACTER
ONE TRAVELER — young adult international traveler wearing a contemporary Adidas travel outfit: premium red Adidas jacket, neutral trousers, sneakers, compact crossbody bag. Natural hair, realistic skin texture, minimal accessories. Same face, clothing, hairstyle, proportions and accessories throughout the entire film. Do not invent additional Adidas branding.

SETTING
Modern and historic China: high-speed railway, Shanghai streets, traditional water-town lanes, Chengdu food streets, ancient architecture, dramatic mountain valleys, elevated viewpoints and vibrant nighttime streets. Real pedestrians, vendors, commuters, vehicles and local activity. Locations feel naturally connected through the journey.

STORY — MUSIC-DRIVEN MULTISHOT VISUALS

00:00–02.5 — CLOSE-UP HOOK
85mm close-up of the traveler beside a high-speed train window. Warm sunlight catches the face while reflections of the moving Chinese landscape slide across the glass. Traveler looks outside, then turns toward camera as the first beat begins.

02.5–05 — MOVEMENT
24mm wide shot from the platform as the traveler walks alongside the departing high-speed train. Wind moves the red jacket naturally. The train accelerates through frame. Cut precisely with the music.

05–07.5 — CITY ARRIVAL
35mm handheld follow shot as the traveler exits a busy station into a dense Chinese city street. Real pedestrians cross naturally. Electric scooters, taxis and buses move through the background. Camera operator follows slightly behind rather than perfectly framing the subject.

07.5–10 — STREET LIFE
50mm observational shot. Traveler moves through a crowded neighborhood while a food vendor prepares steaming street food nearby. Traveler briefly stops, watches the preparation and smiles naturally. Steam passes across the foreground.

10–12.5 — CULTURAL TRANSITION
24mm shot following the traveler through a traditional Chinese water-town street. Stone paths, wooden buildings, bridges and hanging signs surround them. People move naturally through the scene. Traveler crosses a small bridge as sunlight breaks through the buildings.

12.5–15 — FOOD / HUMAN MOMENT
50mm close-up. A local vendor hands the traveler a freshly prepared dish. Traveler takes a bite and reacts naturally. Shallow depth of field, warm skin tones, authentic background activity and subtle handheld movement.

15–17.5 — MOUNTAIN REVEAL
24mm deep-focus landscape. Traveler walks up a long stone staircase through dense greenery. Camera follows from behind. As the traveler reaches the top, a vast mountain valley emerges through cool atmospheric mist.

17.5–20 — FASHION MOMENT
50mm side-tracking shot in golden sunlight. Traveler walks along the mountain viewpoint. Red Adidas jacket contrasts strongly against deep green vegetation. Golden rim light catches the hair and shoulders. Natural wind moves fabric.

20–22.5 — LANDSCAPE / SCALE
24mm wide. Traveler becomes small against enormous mountains disappearing into mist. Clouds move slowly through the valley. No artificial drone aesthetic; perspective feels like a real elevated camera position.

22.5–25 — NIGHT TRANSITION
50mm handheld street shot at blue hour. Traveler enters a lively nighttime food district. Warm lanterns, cool ambient light, scooters and pedestrians create layered depth. The music increases in intensity.

25–27.5 — CITY ENERGY
35mm tracking shot as traveler walks beside a modern riverside district. Reflections ripple across the water. Modern towers illuminate behind them while boats move naturally through the frame.

27.5–30 — FINAL REVEAL
24mm wide composition from behind the traveler. They stop briefly at the riverside and look across the illuminated skyline. Camera slowly moves backward rather than flying upward. Traveler then continues walking as the music reaches its final beat.

CAMERA
35mm and 50mm for portraits and human moments, 24mm for landscapes, architecture and stairs, occasional 85mm compression on faces. Shallow DOF on close-ups, deep focus on mountain wides. Handheld and physically motivated tracking movement. Natural camera micro-movement, imperfect framing, subtle autofocus adjustment, realistic exposure adaptation and occasional foreground obstruction. No impossible camera movement, no floating drone aesthetic.

VISUAL / COLOR SETTING
Premium travel music video / fashion travel film, 2024–2026 commercial grade. Look: photoreal cinema, slight filmic grain, mild halation on highlights, teal-cyan skies, punchy crimson reds, deep forest greens, warm skin, crushed-but-not-crushed blacks.

COLOR GRADE
Cinematic teal-and-warm, greens slightly cyan, red Adidas pops hard against foliage, golden rim on faces in sun, cool mist in mountain valleys. Maintain realistic skin tones and natural environmental color. No excessive saturation or artificial HDR.

MOTION
180-degree cinematic shutter, natural motion blur on hair and fabric, 24fps. No soap-opera 60fps look. Movement should retain the subtle imperfections of real location photography.

LIGHTING
Natural daylight, soft overcast city light, warm direct sunlight, golden-hour rim light, cool mountain mist, practical lanterns and nighttime city illumination. Lighting must originate naturally from the environment.

AUDIO
Premium contemporary travel soundtrack with subtle modern Chinese-inspired textures. Music drives the transitions and rhythm. Keep authentic location sound underneath: train ambience, station announcements, footsteps, scooters, traffic, vendors, cooking sounds, crowd chatter, wind, birds, distant city noise and riverside ambience. Environmental sound should occasionally become prominent during intimate moments.

REALISM
No CGI look, no plastic skin, no beauty-filter smoothing, no extra fingers, no warped architecture, no artificial crowd synchronization, no impossible reflections, no floating objects, no exaggerated depth of field. Realistic skin pores, hair strands, fabric texture, water reflections, atmospheric perspective and human movement.

BRAND CONTROL
The only Adidas branding visible is the existing Adidas trefoil already present on the traveler’s garments. Do not invent additional logos, advertisements, storefront branding or branded products. Do not add watermarks or random UI.

EDITING
Music-synchronized commercial editing without excessive effects. Cuts are motivated by movement, reflections, steam, architectural shapes, walking direction and changes in light. Use clean match cuts and occasional speed changes only when physically believable. Avoid generic AI transitions, artificial zooms, excessive whip transitions and over-edited montage pacing.

CONTINUITY
The traveler remains identical throughout all shots. Preserve face, hairstyle, red Adidas jacket, trousers, sneakers, bag and accessories. Maintain realistic weather and lighting progression from daylight → golden hour → blue hour → night. Each location should feel like part of one continuous journey through China.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET
The final film should look like genuine footage captured by an elite travel filmmaker for a major Chinese tourism/fashion campaign—not a collection of AI-generated beauty shots. The realism comes first; the commercial polish comes from cinematography, color, music, editing and art direction.

prompts.title: POV: The Turkish Ice Cream Guy Had Other Plans
prompts.prompt:
CHARACTER:
A young woman wearing a cute, stylish amusement-park outfit with a clearly visible Mickey Mouse ears headband. Keep the headband consistent throughout the entire video. She is excited, playful, and expressive.
A cheerful Turkish ice cream vendor stands behind a traditional Turkish ice cream stall, holding a long metal ice cream paddle.

0–3 SEC — ORDER
Start with a cinematic wide shot of the colorful amusement park, then smoothly move toward the Turkish ice cream stall.

The girl approaches the counter, smiling excitedly. Her Mickey Mouse ears headband is clearly visible. She points toward the ice cream.
The vendor prepares a cone with a scoop of ice cream and extends it toward her.

3–6 SEC — THE FIRST TEASE
Cut to a medium shot.

The girl eagerly reaches for the cone.

Just as she is about to grab it, the vendor smoothly pulls the ice cream away with the long paddle.
She looks at him in surprise.

He smiles mischievously and offers it again.

6–9 SEC — MORE TEASING
She reaches again.

The vendor smoothly moves the cone from left to right, then slightly upward, always just out of reach.

The girl follows the cone, laughing and becoming increasingly determined.

Keep the interaction fluid, realistic, and playful, with natural body movement and timing.
9–11 SEC — THE NOSE TRICK
The vendor finally brings the ice cream toward her.

She confidently leans forward, expecting to receive it.

Instead, he gently places a small dab of ice cream on the tip of her nose.

Close-up on her shocked expression.

She pauses, looks cross-eyed toward the ice cream on her nose, then looks back at the vendor with a playful annoyed expression.
11–15 SEC — SHE WINS
Before the vendor can tease her again, she quickly grabs the cone from the paddle.

She successfully gets the ice cream.

The vendor laughs and raises his hands in playful defeat.

She proudly holds up the cone, smiles toward the camera, wipes the ice cream from her nose, and takes a happy bite.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Photorealistic live-action, premium cinematic quality, warm golden-hour lighting, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, shallow depth of field, soft background bokeh, subtle anamorphic lens characteristics, natural motion blur, smooth gimbal movement, cinematic push-ins and tracking shots, realistic amusement-park atmosphere.

IMPORTANT:
Keep the Mickey Mouse ears headband clearly visible and consistent throughout the scene. Maintain consistent faces, wardrobe, hairstyle, ice cream cone, vendor paddle, and environment. All movements must be smooth and physically realistic. No exaggerated cartoon movement, no 3D animation, no jerky motion, no teleporting, no object duplication, and no unnatural hand movements.

prompts.title: Schoolgirl Fights Back Against Pranking Upperclassmen
prompts.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
An old wooden Japanese school corridor during festival-prep week. Yuki stands on a low wooden stepladder, tying paper crane streamers along an overhead beam. Three upperclassmen — led by Ren — approach from the corridor's far end and shove the ladder to startle her.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@yuki: 17-year-old Japanese high school girl, black hair to shoulder blades, navy seifuku uniform, red neck tie, calm composed expression. 100% matches the reference.
@ren: 18-year-old Japanese upperclassman, short messy black hair, loosened uniform blazer, smug expression. 100% matches the reference. Two additional upperclassmen share his uniform and build, faces unremarkable and non-distinct.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: worn wooden floorboards, paper crane streamers hanging overhead. Midground: Yuki on the stepladder, corridor stretching back toward sliding shoji-style windows. Background: soft-focus students passing at the far end of the hall. Warm light spills in from the windows on camera-left; camera holds on the shadow side.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Yuki stands mid-step on the ladder, one hand raised tying a streamer, weight balanced, facing the beam — not the camera. Ren and the two upperclassmen enter frame from the right background, walking casually.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot. Hard cuts only at the stated seconds; the camera does not cut on its own between them.

OPTICS
0:00–0:04 — 63° wide observational FOV. 0:04–0:09 — 47° neutral FOV, tightening to 29° on close reactions. 0:09–0:15 — 47° neutral FOV. No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
0:00–0:02: Static low 63° wide shot from floor height, holding Yuki on the ladder mid-corridor.
0:02–0:04: Sharp handheld push-in as the ladder tips, camera drops slightly with her fall.
0:04–0:06: Rapid tracking shot alongside her cartwheel, whip-pan into a 29° close-up on her face as she lands.
0:06–0:09: 360-degree combat orbit around the group as she trades blows with two attackers.
0:09–0:12: Static 47° medium shot, holding the throw and final takedown.
0:12–0:15: Slow 47° push-in on Yuki's face as she finishes tying the streamer.

ACTION
0:00–0:02 — Yuki calmly loops a paper crane streamer around a nail on the beam, humming lightly, unaware of the group approaching.
0:02–0:04 — Ren kicks the base of the stepladder. It skids and tips sideways under real weight and momentum. Yuki loses footing but stays composed — she pushes off the falling ladder into a controlled aerial cartwheel, hair trailing with the rotation, and lands the rotation directly into a spinning back kick that catches the nearest attacker in the shoulder, pushing him back two steps. Slow-motion only through the cartwheel and kick transition, then snap to real-time on impact.
0:04–0:06 — She lands lightly, weight absorbed through bent knees. A second attacker lunges; Yuki sidesteps by centimeters, pivots, and drives a palm-block into his forearm, redirecting his momentum past her.

prompts.title: An Unexpected Little Adventure on a Rainy Day
prompts.prompt:
Authentic handheld mini-DV camcorder footage with a soft early-digital-video aesthetic. The video should feel like a spontaneous personal vlog filmed throughout the day rather than a professionally produced commercial.

Most shots are recorded by the woman herself in arm’s-length selfie mode, combined with a few naturally positioned external angles and brief first-person POV shots.

Keep the camera imperfect and human:

- Subtle natural hand shake
- Slightly crooked framing
- Occasional autofocus hunting
- Tiny exposure fluctuations
- Mild motion blur
- Imperfect zooms
- Natural reflections
- Small framing mistakes
- Realistic handheld movement

Never show the woman setting up, placing, adjusting, or operating a camera. The camera itself must never be visible in the frame.

Use natural jump cuts between locations and perspectives. Avoid overly smooth transitions or cinematic camera movements.

VISUAL LOOK

Soft consumer-DV texture with gentle digital softness, subtle tape character, faint grain, mild highlight bloom, realistic skin texture, slightly muted contrast, and natural colors.

Cloudy daylight should feel believable and soft. Wet streets should show realistic reflections, puddles, and subtle highlights.

Avoid:

- Excessive beauty filters
- Plastic-looking skin
- Artificial sharpness
- CGI-looking environments
- Overly perfect lighting
- Commercial-style polish
- Unrealistic environments

STORY & EMOTIONAL TONE

A spontaneous “I almost stayed home” day that unexpectedly turns into a beautiful little adventure.

Emotional progression:

Bored at home → impulsive decision → rainy city walk → unexpected cozy discovery → sunset payoff

She is playful, feminine, confident, slightly flirty, curious, and naturally expressive.

Her reactions should feel spontaneous and unscripted, as if she is casually sharing an unexpected day with her followers.

MAIN CHARACTER

An exceptionally beautiful glamorous European brunette woman in her mid-20s.

She has:

She has a lean, feminine, athletic physique and a polished social-media-influencer appearance.

Makeup is soft-glam but realistic enough for natural daylight. Preserve realistic skin texture and natural facial movement.

OUTFIT & CONTINUITY

She wears the same outfit throughout the entire video:

- Fitted deep-burgundy long-sleeve top
- Elegant high-waisted dark trousers or fitted jeans
- Lightweight neutral trench coat
- Clean white sneakers
- Small shoulder bag

The burgundy top should remain clearly visible whenever the trench coat is open.

Strict continuity: same woman, same face, same hairstyle, same makeup, same outfit, same accessories, and consistent body proportions throughout every shot.

No wardrobe changes.

LOCATION

A beautiful modern European city during an overcast rainy afternoon.

Environment includes:

- Small independent cafés
- Glass shop windows
- Historic European architecture mixed with modern streets
- Passing cars
- Wet pavement
- Street lights
- Trees moving gently in the breeze

---

Handheld selfie footage inside her apartment.

She stands beside a large apartment window, looking outside at the rain. She briefly turns the camera toward the rainy street, then back toward herself.

She makes a slightly unimpressed expression.

Natural facial expression, casual delivery, slight handheld shake.

Quick natural jump cut.

She steps outside into the rain without posing.

The camera is held slightly above eye level with natural movement.

She laughs naturally.

Dialogue:

She smiles despite the rain.

CUT 04 — 0:09–0:12 | CITY DISCOVERY

She slows down while walking and notices something interesting across the street.

Switch to a brief first-person POV showing a charming independent bookstore or cozy café glowing warmly through rain-speckled glass.

Cut back to her face.

Her expression changes from bored to curious.

Dialogue:
“Oh… wait.”

She looks toward the place again with genuine curiosity.

CUT 05 — 0:12–0:15 | COZY DISCOVERY

Quick external angle from across the sidewalk.

She walks toward the cozy bookstore/café while holding her small shoulder bag.

Rain continues falling lightly.

She looks through the window and smiles.

Cut to a close handheld selfie as she says:

Dialogue:
“I’ve never actually been in here.”

CUT 06 — 0:15–0:18 | INSIDE

Jump cut to the warm interior.

She walks slowly through the cozy bookstore/café, looking around with genuine interest.

She briefly picks up a book or looks at a small display.

No exaggerated acting.

Dialogue:

CUT 07 — 0:18–0:21 | LITTLE MOMENT

Handheld close-up selfie.

Rainy streets are visible behind her through the glass.

CUT 08 — 0:21–0:24 | RAIN CLEARS

Natural jump cut.

Soft sunlight begins breaking through the clouds.

She looks upward and smiles.

Dialogue:

CUT 09 — 0:24–0:27 | SUNSET PAYOFF

Brief external cinematic-but-imperfect angle.

She walks along a beautiful European street as golden evening light begins appearing between the clouds.

Wet pavement reflects the warm sky.

She turns toward the camera with a relaxed smile.

Her hair moves naturally in the breeze.

Keep the image grounded and realistic rather than overly cinematic.

CUT 10 — 0:27–0:30 | FINAL SELFIE

Handheld selfie at golden hour.

She stops walking and looks directly into the camera.

She gives a small playful smile and slightly raises her eyebrows, as if admitting the day turned out better than expected.

FINAL STYLE RULE

The entire video should feel like a real spontaneous personal vlog captured on an old consumer mini-DV camera during an unexpectedly beautiful rainy day.

Prioritize natural human behavior, realistic movement, continuity, imperfect handheld framing, believable lighting, authentic expressions, and casual storytelling over polished cinematic perfection.

prompts.title: Flying Kick Transition to a Midnight Motorcycle
prompts.prompt:
FORMAT
10 seconds, 2 shots.
Shot 1: Indoor bedroom, 0.0–5.0s.
Shot 2: Outdoor night street, 5.0–10.0s.
Transition: seamless hard cut exactly on shoe impact.
Style: photorealistic live-action, premium cinematic commercial, realistic movement/physics, authentic handheld cinematography.

SHOT 1 — INDOOR BEDROOM | 0.0–5.0s

ENVIRONMENT
Minimalist young woman's @[Image 1](image_1) private bedroom in daylight; clean, modern, intimate, naturally lived-in. Large curtain several meters behind Sharon, simple desk/console farther behind, minimal personal objects and subtle decoration. Enough depth for subject separation. Background softly out of focus; Sharon remains sharp and readable.

CAMERA / LIGHTING
Eye-level handheld, medium-wide/full-body framing with room for lateral movement and shoe actions, moderate shallow depth of field. Soft natural daylight, natural skin tones, soft highlights, gentle realistic shadows, warm clean atmosphere.
Camera is operated physically with Sharon: lateral tracking, short push-in, reactive pull-back, quick pans, tilts and reframing. Never perfectly smooth or automated; movement is quick, light, imperfect and physically motivated by her actions.

ACTION + CAMERA
0.0–1.1s — Sharon enters from RIGHT holding TWO SHOES, one in each hand, and walks toward center.
Camera: handheld lateral tracking LEFT, physically stepping sideways while keeping medium-wide framing.

1.1–1.8s — Sharon @[Image 1](image_1) stops near center, raises one shoe toward camera as if showing it, then brings it toward her nose.
Camera: short handheld push-in; keep face and shoe sharp.

1.8–2.4s — Sharon smells the shoe, immediately recoils with surprised disgust, pulls her face away and gives a short head shake.
Camera: small reactive pull-back, then immediately settle toward her face.

2.4–3.0s — Sharon casually throws the first shoe toward the side of the room.
Camera: quick reactive pan following the shoe briefly, then fast pan back to Sinta; believable handheld imperfection.

3.0–3.8s — Sharon shifts sideways, focuses on the second shoe, and throws it vertically upward.
Camera: tilt up following the shoe; as it reaches the top of its trajectory, quickly tilt back down toward Sinta while keeping awareness of her and the descending shoe.

3.8–4.4s — Sharon tracks the descending shoe with her eyes, adjusts footing, rotates slightly sideways and prepares a high side kick.
Camera: short lateral handheld adjustment keeping body and falling shoe in frame; subtle natural Dutch tilt may develop.

4.4–5.0s — Shoe descends into kicking range. Sharon performs a fast, precise HIGH SIDE KICK: leg extends sharply sideways, torso rotates slightly, supporting leg grounded, arms naturally counterbalance, eyes locked on the shoe. Full real-time.
Camera: quick handheld lateral reposition and reactive pan following the kick; frame momentarily shifts with the force.

EXACT MATCH CUT — 5.0s
Hard cut at the exact moment Sharons extended foot contacts the airborne shoe. The kick is still at full speed and the cut happens DURING the action. Outdoor shot continues the same body direction, leg extension, torso rotation and momentum.

SHOT 2 — NIGHT / QUIET CITY STREET | 5.0–10.0s

ENVIRONMENT
Relatively quiet modern urban street at night with broad paved roadway, streetlights, scattered storefronts, illuminated windows, trees, signage and distant buildings creating layered practical lighting. Sparse distant traffic. Spacious, cinematic, quiet.
A WHITE SPORT MOTORCYCLE is behind Sinta and slightly toward one SIDE of frame, not centered directly behind her. Open street creates a clear diagonal path from Sharon to the motorcycle.

LIGHTING / OUTFIT
Naturalistic night lighting: warm streetlights mixed with cooler ambient city illumination, realistic highlights on black riding outfit, natural reflections on white motorcycle and asphalt, cinematic contrast with realistic exposure.
Sharon wears a coordinated black-and-white motorcycle riding set: fitted black racing jacket with clean white shoulder/sleeve panels; fitted black short riding pants with subtle white detailing; compact black knee/shin protection; black motorcycle gloves with small white accents; clean white low-top sport sneakers; white crew socks to mid-calf; loose natural hair; no helmet.
Motorcycle: white sport motorcycle.

CAMERA
Handheld kinetic cinematography. Operator physically follows Sharon using diagonal tracking, short arc movement, reactive panning, slight push-in and quick reframing. Never a perfectly programmed path; camera reacts to her changing body direction.

ACTION + CAMERA
5.0–5.5s — HARD CUT. Sharon appears outdoors continuing the indoor side kick: kicking leg extended, torso rotated, momentum continuing. White sport motorcycle partially visible behind her toward one side. Camera immediately reacts.
Camera: quick handheld pan/reframe catching the continuing kick trajectory.

5.5–6.3s — Sharon lowers her kicking leg naturally and does not stop. She moves DIAGONALLY across frame toward the motorcycle, forward-diagonal rather than straight backward/sideways, gradually turning torso and hips toward it while moving.
Camera: handheld diagonal tracking with slight forward tracking plus lateral shift; keep Sharon dominant while motorcycle remains visible near the side.

6.3–7.2s — Sharon continues diagonally; body progressively rotates toward motorcycle. This is a traveling diagonal turn, NOT a stationary turn-in-place. Feet keep carrying her forward while torso rotates.
Camera: short handheld arc around Sharon while continuing diagonal tracking; slight angle change and subtle pan to keep her centered; motorcycle remains partially visible at the side.

7.2–8.0s — SLOW MOTION BEGINS. Sharon is already mid-diagonal movement toward motorcycle. Body continues diagonal rotation; loose hair swings naturally; jacket moves with rotation; movement becomes elegant and cinematic.
Camera: slightly smoother handheld character, subtle handheld push-in combined with short arc; stay physically close; motorcycle remains visible toward the side.

8.0–8.4s — Gradually return to normal speed. Sharon completes diagonal rotation and now faces motorcycle more directly.
Camera: normal handheld movement; quick reframing keeps Sharon and motorcycle visually connected.

8.4–10.0s — Sharon moves confidently toward the white sport motorcycle, purposeful and energetic. Motorcycle stays slightly off-center. Camera: handheld forward tracking, maintaining medium-wide framing, subtle push-in, then small reactive pan toward motorcycle as Sharon reaches it. End with Sharon immediately beside the motorcycle.

SPEED PRIORITY
0.0–5.0s: full real-time; shoe throw and high side kick are fast; match cut at full-speed impact.
5.0–7.2s: full real-time immediately after cut.
7.2–8.0s: subtle slow motion only during diagonal body rotation toward motorcycle.
8.0–10.0s: normal real-time.

MATCH CUT PRIORITY
Cut exactly on impact. Preserve across the cut: leg extension, torso rotation, body orientation, movement direction, screen position and continuous physical momentum. Location, time of day, lighting, wardrobe and motorcycle may change entirely through the hard cut. The transition must feel instantaneous, physical, stylish and seamless.

prompts.title: A Dead Mother's Call Prevents a Rainy Mountain Road Crash

SETTING: A remote mountain road at night during heavy but realistic rainfall. Dark forested mountains surround the narrow winding road. Wet asphalt reflects only natural headlights and road markings. The atmosphere is tense, isolated and believable.

0–5 SECONDS

Interior of a moving car at night. Medium shot from the passenger side showing the woman driving alone. Rain continuously hits the windshield and realistic windshield wipers move back and forth. 10–17 SECONDS

A faint, emotional female voice comes through the phone:

The call suddenly disconnects.

The screen reads: CALL ENDED

Outside the windshield, a sharp mountain turn approaches through the heavy rain.

17–23 SECONDS

She immediately slows the car.

The woman sits completely still, breathing heavily, visibly shaken.

NO SIM — NO SIGNAL

She looks confused and terrified.

27–30 SECONDS

Extreme close-up of her eyes filling with tears.

She looks toward the empty passenger seat.

A subtle emotional pause.

In a trembling whisper, she says:

“Mom?”

prompts.title: Rio Street Chase Over a Misplaced Package
prompts.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic AAA third-person open-world gameplay sequence set in a densely populated Brazilian neighborhood inspired by Rio de Janeiro.

MAIN CHARACTER:
Use the uploaded character image as the exact identity reference for the protagonist. Preserve her face, facial proportions, hairstyle, hair color, skin texture, body proportions and overall identity consistently throughout the entire sequence. She is a young Korean woman in her early 20s with long black hair, wearing a casual summer outfit with a pastel-lavender top, loose white cargo pants and sneakers. Her clothing, face and hairstyle must remain completely consistent from beginning to end.

OPENING — 0–3 SECONDS:

Begin immediately in playable third-person view.

She is casually walking along a busy Brazilian residential street.

The environment instantly establishes Brazil: dense hillside homes, colorful painted walls, Portuguese storefront signs, overhead electrical cables, parked compact cars, motorcycles, pedestrians, small neighborhood businesses, tropical plants and realistic street clutter.

Without warning, a motorcycle delivery rider pulls up nearby and places a sealed cardboard package on a low wall while checking his phone.

The protagonist looks at it.

A contextual gameplay prompt appears:

“TAKE PACKAGE  [E]”

She looks around.

She takes the package.

Immediately:

MISSION STARTED
“DON'T GET CAUGHT WITH THE PACKAGE”

3–8 SECONDS:

The delivery rider looks up.

He realizes the package is gone.

A red alert appears:

“PACKAGE STOLEN”

He points toward her and starts chasing.

She freezes for half a second, realizes what is happening, then runs.

The camera smoothly follows her like authentic third-person gameplay.

She runs downhill through a crowded Brazilian street, narrowly passing pedestrians and motorcycles.

NPCs react naturally — some step aside, one briefly looks back, another continues walking while barely acknowledging the chaos.

8–15 SECONDS:

She cuts through a narrow alley between houses.

The rider follows on foot.

She jumps over a low concrete barrier and continues running.

A motorcycle passes extremely close in front of her.

She instinctively stops for a fraction of a second.

A notification appears:

“BAD DECISION”

She immediately turns down another street.

Her stamina bar visibly drops.

“STAMINA LOW”

She reaches a small local football court where several people are playing.

A ball suddenly rolls directly into her path.

She kicks it aside without stopping.

The players briefly react as she runs through.

15–22 SECONDS:

She looks back.

The delivery rider is still chasing her.

She notices an open doorway beside a tiny neighborhood shop and quickly ducks inside.

The rider runs past.

The screen briefly displays:

“THEY LOST YOU”

She quietly steps back outside.

The rider suddenly appears at the other end of the street.

“THEY FOUND YOU”

She panics and runs again.

22–27 SECONDS:

She finally reaches a small Brazilian house matching the address printed on the package.

She looks at the label.

Then at the house number.

A subtle objective updates:

“DELIVER PACKAGE”

She rings the doorbell.

A Brazilian woman opens the door.

The protagonist hands her the package.

The woman checks the address and happily accepts it.

Objective instantly changes:

“DELIVERY COMPLETE”

27–30 SECONDS:

The exhausted delivery rider finally arrives.

He stops.

Looks at the protagonist.

Looks at the woman.

Looks at the package.

He slowly realizes that the protagonist accidentally delivered it to the correct address.

He is completely confused.

The protagonist gives him an innocent smile and casually walks away.

Final HUD notification:

“MISSION COMPLETE”
“CHAOS +250”

The rider remains standing there, speechless.

GAMEPLAY & VISUAL STYLE:

Ultra-photorealistic AAA open-world game graphics with realistic human characters, detailed facial animation, physically based materials, realistic skin, individual hair strands, natural cloth movement, accurate shadows, global illumination, realistic reflections, detailed road surfaces and authentic environmental imperfections.

Use realistic Rio-inspired hillside neighborhoods, dense residential streets, Portuguese signage, Brazilian motorcycles and compact cars, local stores, football culture, tropical vegetation, concrete walls, balconies, utility poles and tangled overhead wiring.

NPCs should have varied appearances, clothing, animations and reactions. No duplicated-looking crowds.

All physics must be grounded: the cardboard package has believable weight, pedestrians react naturally to collisions, motorcycles have realistic acceleration and suspension, clothing responds naturally to movement, and characters maintain consistent proportions.

CAMERA:

No cinematic establishing shots.
No drone shots.
No slow-motion hero shots.
No dramatic camera transitions.
No movie-style depth of field.
No impossible camera movements.

HUD:

- stamina bar
- mission objective tracker
- contextual interaction prompts
- alert indicators
- small gameplay notifications

NEGATIVE REQUIREMENTS:

prompts.prompt:
⬇️

- long hair

00:07–00:12 — THE CAR

Fast handheld cut to the driveway.

Close-up: the packet is clearly visible in his hand.

He catches her and hugs her back awkwardly.

He forces an innocent smile while still looking slightly devastated by the situation.

00:27–00:30 — FINAL PUNCHLINE

While holding his happy girlfriend, the man slowly looks over her shoulder toward Woman 1.

He gives Woman 1 a tiny regretful look.

Woman 1 immediately understands.

Still wrapped in her towel, she gives him a knowing smirk and a small playful goodbye wave.

He watches her with disappointment while his girlfriend continues hugging him happily.

End on his awkward expression.

CAMERA / EDITING

Fast viral-sketch pacing with frequent natural handheld cuts every 1–3 seconds:

- close facial reactions

- over-the-shoulder towel reveal

- quick running shot outside

- glove-compartment close-up

- doorway reaction

- condom-packet close-up

- girlfriend hug

The footage should feel like a casually edited real home video, not a movie.

LIGHTING / REALISM

Window daylight mixed with ordinary indoor fixtures.

No glossy AI skin.

No beauty-filter look.

No dramatic glamour lighting.

No cinematic color grading.

Natural synchronized English dialogue and household ambience.

Girlfriend:

Natural footsteps, front-door sounds, car-door sound, glove-compartment click, fabric movement and room ambience.

No narration.

No subtitles.

No music.

CONTINUITY / HARD RULES

- Woman 1 begins in the white towel and is back in the SAME towel when the man returns.

- The towel reveal is seen ONLY FROM BEHIND Woman 1.

- No frontal nudity is visible.

- The man runs specifically to the parked car.

FORMAT:

MAIN CHARACTER

LOCATION

- Concrete walls

- A small wooden table

【运动】整节车厢始终在晃动：地面有持续的纵向震颤，吊环随车身摆动，吊扇转动，行李架上的箱子轻微跳动。窗外的景物始终高速后移。列车绝不得停下。

【可破坏结构】吊环、吊扇、行李架与上面的行李、木质座椅靠背、铁质栏杆、车窗玻璃、车壁海报、地上的铝制茶壶与茶杯托盘——全部可以被撞碎、扯断、踩踏、砸飞。已经损坏的物体永久保持损坏。

【刚性空间锚点】过道的走向、两侧座椅的排列、头顶吊扇的位置与数量、车厢尽头敞开的车门，全片绝对不得漂移、消失或改变数量。

【乘客设定】第 0 秒时车厢里坐满了乘客——穿衬衫围腰布的男人、穿纱丽的女人、老人、小孩、卖茶的小贩。他们只是环境资产：在 0—6 秒之间惊慌地退向车厢两端，此后一直挤在远处的两头围观，绝不加入战斗、绝不靠近过道中央。他们的作用是提供尺度参照与反应。

【对白规则】

本片共有四句台词，全部为英文，在下方时间码中以引号标出。只有引号内的文字是被说出来的。其余所有文字——包括动作描述、表情描述、运镜说明与语气说明——全部是画面说明，绝对不得念出、不得配音、不得作为旁白。

全片台词不得超过四句，不得出现旁白与内心独白。乘客全程不说话。

【运镜规格总纲·南印度商业动作片语法】

全程一镜到底，绝对禁止硬切、剪辑、黑屏转场与定格。

24mm 超广角为主，配合极低机位仰拍。这是南印度商业电影的动作语法：

英雄镜头必须从极低的角度仰拍 basha，让他在画面中显得高大、压迫、不可撼动；他走动时，镜头贴着地面向后退，让他的身影逐渐充满画面。

每一句台词的瞬间，镜头必须稳定下来、停止晃动，给足画面的重量，说完立刻恢复运动。

速度必须有节奏变化：正常速度的连续打击 → 关键命中的瞬间明显减速（速度坡道，不是慢动作定格）→ 立刻恢复甚至加速。减速只允许出现在真正的重击命中与转身瞬间。

大量使用：贴地仰拍、沿过道的高速轨道推拉、Whip Pan、绕人物半圈的环绕、撞击时的弹性后震。

镜头只能穿过真实存在的空隙，不穿过人物、座椅、车壁或地面。

【密度要求】

6—26 秒之间，每秒必须呈现 3—5 次清晰的攻防状态变化。绝不允许一招一停、互相等待、轮流表演。速度快，但不是快进，不用模糊残影掩盖动作——每一拳每一脚都必须有支撑脚、腰胯旋转、重心交换、惯性与回收轨迹。车厢的狭窄必须被利用：所有动作都在一条窄过道里完成，双方不断利用座椅、栏杆、吊环、行李架借力与卸力。

【第一幕：0—6 秒·车厢清场】

0.0—2.5 秒
车厢在午后阳光中高速行驶，光条扫过满车的乘客。过道尽头，raghu 缓步走来，嘴角叼着烟，金框墨镜反着光，身后跟着一路被他推开的乘客。他抬手弹了弹烟灰。

过道的另一端，basha 坐在靠窗的位置上，一条腿翘着，手臂搭在椅背上，墨镜后看不出表情。阳光的光条一道道扫过他的脸。

运镜：从 raghu 的背后沿过道低机位向前推进，越过他的肩膀，一直推到远处坐着的 basha，两人被同一条过道连在一起。

2.5—6.0 秒
raghu 停在过道中央，一脚踩上旁边的座椅扶手，居高临下地指着 basha，用夸张的语气开口。

raghu: "This train ends at my station."

乘客们在这一瞬间同时反应过来，惊慌地朝车厢两端涌去，推搡着、抱着行李、拉着孩子，几秒内过道就空了。铝制茶壶被打翻在地，茶水洒出来，托盘滚到一边。

basha 没有立刻起身。他缓缓放下翘着的腿，一只手撑着椅背站起来，另一只手把垂在腰间的红色腰布一甩，甩到身后。他站直了——极长的身形在狭窄的过道里显得格外高。

运镜：raghu 说话时镜头稳定不动；乘客涌动时快速后退拉开；basha 起身时切换到极低的贴地仰拍，随他站直而缓缓升高，让他的身影充满画面。

【第二幕：6—16 秒·开打】

6.0—9.0 秒
raghu 率先冲上来，一记大幅度的摆拳。basha 只把头偏开三寸，摆拳砸在他身后的车窗上，玻璃炸出蛛网裂纹。

basha 反手一记极短的直拳正中 raghu 的胸口——raghu 整个人被打得倒飞出去，撞翻两排座椅靠背，木板碎裂。

【速度坡道】这一记直拳命中的瞬间明显减速，拳头陷进胸口、身体开始后飞的那一帧被拉长，随后立刻恢复正常速度。

raghu 从碎木中翻身起来，第一次收起了笑容。

运镜：贴地仰拍 basha 的出拳，命中瞬间稳定锁定接触点，随后被冲击弹性后震，跟随 raghu 倒飞的轨迹。

9.0—12.0 秒
raghu 抓起地上的铝制茶壶砸向 basha；basha 侧身让过，茶壶砸在车壁上炸开。

两人在狭窄的过道里贴身缠斗：raghu 连续出拳、肘击、踢腿；basha 依次用前臂格挡、偏头、沉肘、抬膝，每一次防守幅度都极小。basha 反击三下，raghu 被逼得连连后退，撞上头顶垂下的吊环，吊环被扯断了两只，金属环叮当落地。

basha 抓住 raghu 的衣领，把他整个人抡向一侧的座椅，raghu 的背重重砸在木质椅背上，靠背整块断裂。

运镜：沿过道平行跟随两人的缠斗，Whip Pan 跟随抡出的轨迹。

12.0—16.0 秒
raghu 从断裂的座椅中窜起，双手抓住头顶的行李架借力荡起，双脚齐蹬 basha 的胸口。basha 双臂交叉硬接，被蹬得后滑两米，鞋底在过道地面上刮出两道痕。

行李架承受不住，一整段从车壁上撕裂脱落，藤箱、铁皮箱与铺盖卷哗啦啦砸落一地。

basha 从翻滚的行李中踏步而出，一脚踢开挡路的铁皮箱，直线逼向 raghu。raghu 连续出拳想拦住他，basha 全部用小幅度的格挡卸开，一步都没有停，径直走到他面前。

运镜：镜头在 basha 逼近时沿过道向后退行，保持他正面充满画面，脚下不断有行李被踢开。

【第三幕：16—22 秒·英雄时刻】

16.0—18.5 秒
basha 一把抓住 raghu 的衣领，把他按在车厢壁上。raghu 双脚离地，烟从嘴里掉下来。

整个画面稳定下来。列车行进的光条一道一道扫过 basha 的墨镜与面孔。

basha 用极低沉、极平静的声音开口。

basha: "You booked the wrong ticket."

【速度坡道】说完这句话之后的半秒，画面保持稳定与安静，只有列车的节奏声与窗外掠过的风景。

运镜：极低机位仰拍 basha 的背影与被按住的 raghu，说话时镜头完全稳定、不晃动。

18.5—22.0 秒
basha 松手，raghu 落地的瞬间发狂般反扑——一记重拳砸中 basha 的下颌，basha 的头偏了过去，墨镜被打得歪斜。

车厢里安静了半秒。

basha 缓缓把头转回来，抬手用一根手指把墨镜推正。他笑了一下。

然后他动了：连续五记短促而沉重的打击，每一记都精准命中，raghu 被打得连连后退，撞碎栏杆、撞翻座椅、撞落一台吊扇——吊扇从天花板上扯落，扇叶砸在地上仍在转动。

【速度坡道】第五记打击命中的瞬间明显减速，随后立刻恢复。

运镜：basha 推正墨镜时镜头稳定特写；开打后沿过道高速后退跟随连续打击，每一记命中都有轻微的弹性后震。

【第四幕：22—30 秒·车门】

22.0—25.0 秒
raghu 被打退到车厢尽头那扇敞开的车门旁。窗外的旷野与铁轨以极高的速度向后流动，狂风从门口灌进来，把两人的头发与 basha 的红色腰布吹得剧烈翻飞。

raghu 抓住门框稳住身体，抹了一把嘴角，第一次露出真正的狼狈。他用尽最后的力气大喊。

raghu: "You think this ends here?"

运镜：低机位从 basha 身后越过肩膀拍向门口的 raghu，狂风与飞驰的背景同时入画。

25.0—28.0 秒
basha 一步一步朝他走过去，脚步不快，但每一步都很沉。狂风把他的黑衬衫与红腰布向后吹成一条直线。阳光的光条一道道扫过他。

他在 raghu 面前站定。

basha: "It ends where I say."

【速度坡道】说完这句话的瞬间，画面完全稳定。

运镜：镜头沿过道在他前方持续后退，极低机位仰拍，他的身影在狂风中逐渐充满整个画面，说话时镜头完全静止。

28.0—30.0 秒
basha 抬起一只脚，一记干净利落的侧踢正中 raghu 的胸口。

raghu 整个人被踢出敞开的车门，身体在门外的气流中翻滚着向后飞去，迅速被列车甩在身后，缩成远处铁轨旁的一个小点。

【速度坡道】侧踢命中的瞬间明显减速，raghu 的身体开始飞出门框的那一段被拉长，随后随着他被甩远而恢复正常速度。

basha 放下腿，站在敞开的车门前，背对着镜头，狂风把他的衬衫与红腰布吹得猎猎作响。他抬手最后一次把墨镜推正。

最后一帧：basha 站在门口的逆光剪影中，身后是被破坏的车厢——断裂的座椅、散落一地的行李、扯落的吊扇、碎裂的车窗，远处两端挤满了目瞪口呆的乘客。窗外的旷野仍在高速掠过。画面自然收束。

运镜：从门口向车厢内部快速后退拉开至广角，把 basha 的剪影与整节被摧毁的车厢同时纳入画面，不定格，不摆造型。

【全局约束与防崩条件】

masterpiece, highest quality, 顶级院线级 2D 风格化动画电影。

basha 与 raghu 的面孔、发型、墨镜、服装配色与配件全程一致：basha 始终是黑衬衫、红色撕裂腰布、黑色方形墨镜；raghu 始终是紫红花纹衬衫、金链、R 字皮带扣、金框墨镜。两人换位后继续按标签区分身份，不得依赖左右位置。

两人的墨镜全程不摘下、不碎裂。basha 的墨镜只在 18.5 秒被打歪一次，随即被他推正。

严控手部结构，每只手固定五指。禁止肢体扭曲、身体穿模、腰布穿模、腰布缠住双腿。

全片没有任何枪械、刀具或其他兵器，纯徒手格斗。

破坏只能单向累积：碎裂的车窗、断裂的座椅、扯断的吊环、脱落的行李架与吊扇全部永久保持损坏状态，严禁任何结构复原。

破坏必须由实际接触触发。禁止物体无缘无故碎裂，禁止破坏早于命中。

列车全程高速行驶，绝不停下。窗外的景物必须始终高速后移，车厢必须始终有震颤与晃动。

速度坡道只允许出现在指定的四个重击命中瞬间，其余全部为正常速度。绝不允许全片慢动作、绝不允许定格。

台词全部为英文原声，成年男性嗓音。basha 为极低沉、平静、缓慢的声音；raghu 为高亢、张扬、带挑衅的声音。唇形自然同步。每句台词都极短。

【负面提示词】

台词超过四句，出现第五句台词，泰米尔语对白，印地语对白，旁白，内心独白，乘客说话，念出动作描述文字，念出运镜说明，字幕，Logo，UI，水印；

角色三视图，灰色摄影棚背景，白色背景，DETAILS 细节格，色卡条，RAGHU VARMA 字样，VILLAIN LEGEND ICON 字样，HAIRSTYLE 字样，FRONT VIEW 字样，图片原有文字；

写实照片风格，真人电影质感，3D 渲染，塑料质感，人物比例正常化，人物变矮变胖，失去线稿，失去笔触，背景变成照片；

换脸，换装，墨镜摘下，墨镜碎裂，胡子消失，发型改变，服装配色漂移，黑衬衫变色，紫红衬衫变色，红腰布消失，金链消失，R 字皮带扣消失，人物复制，分身，第三名战斗者；

乘客加入战斗，乘客靠近过道中央，乘客攻击，乘客消失得无影无踪，车厢完全空无一人；

枪，刀，棍棒，任何兵器，超能力，能量特效，发光拳，火焰，雷电，飞行，彩色冲击波，游戏 UI；

一招一停，互相等待，轮流表演，摆 pose 过久，长时间蓄力，全片慢动作，定格，快进感，跳帧加速，重复招式，原地乱挥，连续无回应命中，动作没有重量，布偶飞行；

英雄慌张，英雄大喊大叫，英雄逃跑，英雄倒地不起，英雄落败，反派获胜；

列车停下，窗外景物静止，车厢不晃动，车门关闭，车厢恢复完整，座椅复原，玻璃复原，吊扇回到天花板，行李架复位；

夜景，雨天，雪地，森林，沙漠，城市街道，室内房间，现代高铁，空调车厢，明亮无阴影的照明；

硬切，多机位剪辑，黑屏转场，镜头瞬移，持续晃动，过量滚转，人物出画，镜头穿过身体或座椅，低清晰度，卡顿，电子游戏过场感，过曝，过度锐化。

prompts.title: A Playful Splash After a Beach Rescue
prompts.prompt:
For a moment, everything stopped. Then She opened her eyes and gave him something to remember. ❤️

Seedance 2.5 

Prompt 

PHOTOREALISTIC CINEMATIC VIDEO, 15 sec, 16:9, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm golden-hour light, high-end film look.

CHARACTERS (identical in every frame): Woman, mid-20s, curvy Indian/Latina, wavy shoulder-length brown hair (soaked, on sand), soft makeup, wet olive-green sleeveless bodycon midi dress, gold chain necklace, hoop earrings, watch on left wrist, small floral tattoo on right forearm. Realistic skin, water droplets, sand grains. Boyfriend: early-30s, athletic, wet white t-shirt, dark shorts, short wet hair.

LOCATION: Quiet beach, wet sand, foaming waves behind, side sunlight with rim light on wet hair and skin, light sea breeze.

0-5s: Wide-to-medium shot, slow push-in at sand level. She lies on her back, eyes closed. He drops to his knees, urgently tilts her head and performs rescue-style chest compressions, realistic and non-graphic. Worried, panicked face; water drips from his hair. A wave washes near her feet.

5-10s: Close-up, slight handheld push-in on her hand and face. Her fingers twitch, hand curls, eyelids flutter, chest rises with a breath. He notices, freezes, panic turns to deep relief. Rack focus from her hand to his face.

10-15s: Medium close-up at sand level, both in frame. Still lying down, she opens her eyes, smiles mischievously, and playfully spits a small burst of seawater at his face. Droplets arc slowly, catching sunlight. He recoils, blinks, then laughs in shock. She looks relieved and amused. End on a warm two-shot.

CAMERA: smooth, slight handheld, slow push-ins, no sudden cuts.
AUDIO: waves, seagulls, wind, her small cough, soft laughter, light emotional score.
NEGATIVE: no blood, no gore, no distortion, no extra fingers, no face morphing, no outfit or jewelry change, no text, no watermark, no cartoon or plastic skin.

prompts.title: Early Morning Visit to a Fishing Village in Sokcho
prompts.prompt:
FORMAT: 30 seconds | 16:9 | Ultra-photorealistic live-action | Continuous handheld vacation vlog

Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, identity, skin tone, facial features, and body proportions from <<<image_1>>> throughout the entire video. The same woman must appear consistently in every shot.

VISUAL STYLE: Authentic late-2000s personal vacation vlog recorded on a cheap handheld flip camera. Extremely raw and imperfect footage. Heavy natural camera shake, awkward handheld framing, occasional partial face crops, sudden reframing, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, blown highlights, slightly soft image quality, warm faded colors, mild digital noise, compression artifacts, and subtle motion blur. No cinematic camera movements, no gimbal stabilization, no polished composition, no modern color grading, no beauty filter, no artificial sharpness.

Outfit: oversized grey hooded sweatshirt, black leggings, worn white running shoes, hair pulled back into a low messy ponytail, small silver stud earrings, a canvas tote bag slung over one shoulder. The entire video must feel like one genuine recording captured by a friend on an early-morning trip through a fishing village in Sokcho, South Korea, not a staged commercial or cinematic recreation.

00:00–00:04 — EARLY MORNING ARRIVAL
The woman walks along a quiet harbor path as the sun rises, fishing boats bobbing gently in the water behind her, seagulls circling overhead.
The camera shakes slightly as it follows her from the side.
She says:
"It's so early, but I really wanted to see the fish market before it gets busy."

00:04–00:08 — THE FISH MARKET
She steps into a covered harbor market filled with tanks of live fish, crabs, and squid, fishermen unloading crates from small boats nearby.
The camera zooms unsteadily on a tank of wriggling crabs, focus hunting before snapping back to her face.
She reacts with a mix of fascination and mild alarm.

00:08–00:12 — TALKING WITH A FISHERMAN
An older fisherman hoists a large fish onto a table for her to see up close.
She leans in curiously, asks a question, and he answers while gesturing with his hands.
She laughs and says to the camera:
"He says this one was caught just an hour ago!"

00:12–00:16 — TRYING RAW SQUID
A nearby stall vendor offers her a small plate of freshly sliced raw squid with dipping sauce.
She hesitates for a second, then takes a bite, chewing slowly with a surprised expression.
She turns to the camera and says:
"Okay wow, that's way fresher than I expected."

00:16–00:20 — HELPING SORT THE CATCH
A fisherwoman nearby is sorting fish into baskets and waves her over to help.
She kneels down and awkwardly tries to sort a few fish, nearly dropping one, laughing at herself.
The fisherwoman laughs too and pats her on the back encouragingly.

00:20–00:24 — WALKING THE HARBOR
She walks along the docks past rows of moored fishing boats, ropes coiled on the ground, nets drying in the morning sun.
A couple of fishermen nod and greet her; she waves back cheerfully.
The camera briefly swings toward the boats before swinging back to her.

00:24–00:27 — QUIET MOMENT
She stops at the edge of the harbor, looking out over the calm water as the sun fully rises over the horizon.

Prompt 👇

【参考图使用规则】

image1 为本片唯一角色的外貌与造型参考。角色的面孔、发型、胡须、体型、服装与配饰严格参考 image1，全片所有镜头中绝对不得改变。

audio1 为本片的配乐，时长 28 秒。全片的剪辑切点与人物的身体动作必须与 audio1 的节拍严格同步。

只提取 image1 中的视觉设计。严禁生成角色三视图、灰色摄影棚背景、细节格、6ft 183cm 尺寸标注、FRONT VIEW / SIDE VIEW / BACK VIEW / FRONT CLOSE-UP / TOP-DOWN VIEW 字样、SUNGLASSES / GREY-STREAKED HAIR / RED CRAVAT / RED SASH / WHITE BLAZER / WHITE DRESS SHOES 等标签文字与水印。

【角色造型·全片锁定】

一名 6 英尺高的南印度成年男性，温暖的深肤色。浓密蓬松、带波浪的黑色头发，发间夹杂明显的灰白发丝。浓密修剪整齐的全脸胡须与八字胡，同样带灰白。

服装：米白色的修身西装外套与同色西裤；白色开领衬衫；颈部系一条鲜艳的红色丝质领巾；腰间束一条宽大的红色丝质腰封；白色皮质系带正装皮鞋，细黑色鞋底边。

配饰：一副小巧的圆形墨镜，细金色镜框，全程戴着。

【墨镜镜片锁定】

墨镜的镜片是固定的深紫灰色，全片每一个镜头都完全相同。霓虹、闪光灯与街灯的反光可以在镜片表面滑过，但镜片本身的颜色绝不改变——绝不变成紫色、红色、蓝色、粉色或任何其他颜色，绝不变透明。

【身份锁定】

他的面孔、灰白发丝、胡须、米白西装、红色领巾、红色腰封、圆形金框墨镜与白色皮鞋在所有镜头中必须完全一致。

每一个镜头中都必须有他，而且只有一个他。绝不出现空镜头，绝不出现两个或更多的他。

【人物尺寸·他必须足够大】

在每一个镜头的每一帧中，他在画面中的高度都不得小于画面高度的三分之一。他的面部表情与手部动作必须始终清晰可辨。

绝不出现他在画面中只是一个小点、被环境吞没、看不清表情的镜头。即使是广角镜头，他也必须足够近、足够大。

【本片最核心的规则·这是活动影像，不是照片】

这是一支真实拍摄的动态影像，不是一组照片、不是幻灯片、不是海报。

每一个镜头都是一段正在发生的短动作，有开始、有过程、有结束。每个镜头的第一帧，他就已经在动——正在迈步、正在转头、正在抬手。每个镜头的最后一帧，他仍然在动。他在任何镜头里都绝不从一个静止的姿态开始，也绝不在一个静止的姿态中结束。

【参考图使用规则】

@image1 为本片的起始帧。严格继承其构图、机位、光照、色调与全部物件的空间关系。

【起始帧的内容】一张深色木质书桌上摊开着一本厚厚的速写本，书页泛黄、纸面有细微的纤维质感。左页上是一个用蓝色彩铅以极其密集、潦草、反复叠加的线条画成的武士——侧身弓步，双手握着一把出鞘的长刀，刀尖向右延伸；人物周围布满杂乱的排线与涂抹痕迹，页面左侧写着蓝色的手写日文字迹，左上角画着一颗蓝色的星芒。右页上是一个用红色彩铅以同样风格画成的武士——与蓝色武士呈镜像的弓步对峙姿态，双手握刀，刀尖向左延伸，两把刀的刀尖在书页的中缝处几乎相接；页面右上角写着一个大大的红色"侍"字，左上角有红色的手写字迹。

一支蓝色彩铅斜放在左页下方，一支红色彩铅斜放在右页下方，笔尖都朝向书页中央。

【背景陈设】书桌后方的暗处依次摆着：一只米黄色的粗陶笔筒，筒身有黑色墨迹字样，底下垫着一块圆形木托；一尊深色的金属武士雕像，手持长枪，姿态威武；一幅装在深色木框里的书法挂轴，白纸上写着一个巨大的黑色"魂"字，下方盖着一枚红色印章；一只深棕色的皮质旧箱子，带黄铜搭扣；一只木质笔筒，里面插着一排毛笔与画笔，笔杆朝上；几本堆叠的旧书，书脊上有红白相间的标签；一副黑框眼镜随意搁在桌上；桌面散落着几件小物。

【光】整个房间处于低照度中，一束温暖的侧光从画面左上方斜射进来，照亮摊开的书页与两支彩铅，背景的陈设沉入柔和的暗部。光线里漂浮着细小的尘埃。

第 0 帧必须与 @image1 完全一致，动作从此处自然开始，严禁重新构图、变换机位、改变光照或倒退。

【角色：@bluesamurai 与 @redsamurai】

两名角色完全由彩铅线条构成，是从书页上活过来的素描。

@bluesamurai：全身由密集、潦草、反复叠加的蓝色彩铅线条构成，没有实体的皮肤、布料或金属质感——他就是一团会动的线条。轮廓是一名日本武士：发髻高束、宽肩、和服上衣与袴、赤足，双手握一把蓝色线条构成的长刀。他的线条边缘毛糙、不连续，运动时线条会像被风吹动一样轻微抖动、重组、拖出残留的笔触。

@redsamurai：结构与 @bluesamurai 完全相同，但全身由红色彩铅线条构成，握一把红色线条的长刀。

【全局画风】

混合渲染，两种质感必须同时存在且分明：

@bluesamurai 与 @redsamurai 是纯粹的彩铅素描——二维的、线条的、有纸面颗粒感的笔触，绝不得变成写实的立体人物、绝不得长出皮肤或布料质感。即使离开纸面在空中飞跃，他们依然是一团会动的彩铅线条。

书桌、房间与所有物件是极其写实的实景摄影质感：木纹的深浅、陶器的釉面、金属的反光、纸张的纤维、皮革的磨损、尘埃在光束中的漂浮，全部照片级真实。

两者的融合必须自然：素描角色在真实的桌面上投下淡淡的影子，他们的线条在移动时会在纸面与桌面上留下短暂的彩铅痕迹。

【对白规则】

本片没有任何台词。全片没有对白、没有旁白、没有内心独白。所有文字都是画面说明，绝对不得念出、不得配音。

声音只有：书页翻动的沙沙声、彩铅在纸上划过的沙沙声、细小的金属刀刃碰撞声、物件倾倒与滚落的声响、陶器碎裂声、纸张撕裂声、笔杆断裂声，以及最后的门轴吱呀声与脚步声。

【运镜规格总纲】

全程一镜到底，绝对禁止硬切、剪辑、黑屏转场与定格。

微距镜头，机位始终保持在桌面的高度或略高，像一台在桌面上穿行的微型摄影机。大量使用贴着桌面的低角度跟拍、沿桌面的高速横移、绕物件的环绕、跟随角色跃上笔筒时的急速抬升。

浅景深：跟随角色时背景的陈设保持柔和的虚化，只有角色与他们正在破坏的那件物品是清晰的。

镜头只能穿过真实存在的空隙，不穿过物件、书页或桌面。

CORE CONCEPT
A young combat medic remains behind after his unit moves forward. SETTING

00:00–02.5 — DAWN

02.5–05 — DISCOVERY

10–12.5 — INCOMING FIRE

12.5–15 — HEAR ANOTHER VOICE

Wide 24mm shot. The medic drags the improvised stretcher across exposed muddy ground. Smoke obscures the battlefield behind him while artillery flashes intermittently in the distance.

22.5–25 — THE ESCARPMENT
The medic reaches the edge of the rocky escarpment. He lowers himself carefully and begins moving the wounded soldier toward a safer lower position.

25–27.5 — HUMAN MOMENT

27.5–30 — FINAL REVEAL
24mm wide shot from behind the medic. He helps both wounded soldiers toward a sheltered position while the enormous Okinawa battlefield stretches behind them through smoke and morning light. The camera holds on the scale of the battlefield as the three figures become small against the landscape.

Large-format historical cinema camera language combined with embedded war-correspondent realism. 24mm for battlefield scale, 35mm for movement and action, 50mm for human interaction, 85mm for intimate details. Handheld shoulder-mounted movement, natural camera shake, imperfect framing, realistic focus changes, atmospheric obstruction from smoke and dust. No modern drone aesthetic, no impossible camera movement.

LIGHTING
Soft overcast Okinawa morning light, cold gray atmosphere, muted sunlight through smoke, warm distant artillery flashes, natural skin highlights and subtle atmospheric haze. No theatrical spotlighting.

PHYSICS
Realistic body weight, fatigue, mud resistance, stretcher weight, smoke movement, artillery shockwaves, falling debris, clothing movement and ground interaction. The medic struggles physically under the wounded soldier’s weight. No superhuman strength or impossible movement.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE
Exhaustion is visible in posture, breathing and movement. The medic behaves professionally but is visibly frightened and tired. Wounded soldiers respond naturally to pain and shock. Background soldiers move independently and react to distant impacts without synchronized choreography.

AUDIO
Authentic battlefield soundscape: distant artillery, rifle fire far across the battlefield, shouting, heavy breathing, boots in mud, equipment rattling, stretcher fabric stretching, wind through vegetation and debris impacts. Music is extremely restrained and secondary to environmental sound.

VISUAL CHARACTER
Photorealistic live-action historical war cinematography. Natural skin texture, authentic 1945 uniforms, weathered equipment, mud, sweat, smoke, atmospheric depth, realistic film grain and subtle highlight halation. No plastic skin, no videogame appearance, no exaggerated color grading.

COLOR GRADE
Muted olive greens, dirty browns, gray-blue atmospheric shadows, warm skin tones and restrained highlights. Slightly desaturated period-war-film palette while maintaining natural colors.

HISTORICAL REALISM
Period-correct American military equipment, clothing, medical supplies, terrain and battlefield environment. No modern weapons, vehicles, helmets, medical equipment, tactical gear or technology.

CONTINUITY
MAIN MEDIC, both wounded soldiers, uniforms, equipment, medical bag, weather and battlefield geography remain consistent across all shots. Wounds remain visually consistent without graphic gore. The sequence progresses logically from discovery → treatment → evacuation → second rescue → extraction.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET
The footage should feel like an extraordinarily realistic 1945 battlefield documentary captured by a professional war cinematographer, with the emotional intensity of a major historical film but without reproducing any existing movie scene. prompts.title: The 5 PM Office Escape
prompts.prompt:
Leaving work at five shouldn’t require stealth mode, but her boss made it a mission.

Seedance 2.5 0n @SJinn_Agent 

Prompt

SCENE CONTEXT

A 30-second realistic AAA third-person stealth-action game sequence set in a Japanese corporate office at exactly 5:00 PM on a bright weekday afternoon. The player character, NAGI, has finished her work and must reach the elevator without being stopped by her boss and given another assignment.

ACTIVE REFERENCES

[@Image1] = NAGI’s facial identity, if a character reference is supplied. Use only her facial appearance as the identity reference; replace any school clothing and background with the adult office character and environment specified below.

NAGI: Japanese woman, 25, long straight black hair with blunt bangs, white short-sleeve office blouse, charcoal tailored trousers, black leather belt, white minimalist sneakers, employee ID clipped to her waistband, small black work tote held close to her body.

Voice: light, breathy adult female voice, speaking Japanese in a hushed whisper. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and accessories identical throughout.

CAST SEPARATION

Four distinct adult office characters appear, each with a different silhouette, age, and hairstyle so they read as separate people:

TEAM LEADER: man in his 40s, 170 cm, average build, full head of short black hair parted at the side, thin metal-framed glasses, white dress shirt with a loosened navy tie. Appears only beside the first desk cluster, checking his watch.
PAPERWORK COWORKER: woman in her 20s, 160 cm, slim, brown hair in a high ponytail, beige cardigan over a white blouse, carrying a thick stack of printouts. Appears only in the printer aisle.
BOSS: man in his 60s, 160 cm, stout and round-shouldered, completely bald with a shiny scalp and a fringe of white hair above the ears, round gold-rimmed glasses, charcoal three-piece suit with a company lapel badge, carrying a blue assignment folder. Appears at the corridor T-junction and remains in that connected corridor during the whiteboard sequence.
OFFICE ASSISTANT: man in his early 30s, 182 cm, lean and broad-shouldered, thick full black hair swept back, short beard, navy shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers, no glasses. Pushes the mobile whiteboard from the meeting-room alcove toward the elevator lobby.

The BOSS is the only bald character in the entire video. The OFFICE ASSISTANT keeps a full head of thick black hair and a beard, stands more than 20 cm taller than the BOSS, and is clearly a different, much younger man.

LOCATION MAP

One unbroken spatial route the camera travels with her:

Her workstation → low desk partition → printer aisle → corridor T-junction → meeting-room alcove with mobile whiteboard → elevator lobby → elevator interior.

Keep the route compact and physically traversable within the 27-second continuous section.

Foreground: polished linoleum floor, office desks, steel filing cabinets, rolling chairs, and reflective glass meeting-room partitions.

Background: window wall on camera-right overlooking neighboring office buildings, dust suspended in the sunbeams. Light enters from camera-right along the office route.

ELEVATOR GEOMETRY

The elevator entrance is at the end of the office corridor. The call button is on the wall beside the entrance. The elevator is empty when NAGI enters.

Inside the elevator: brushed-metal rear wall, side handrails, softly illuminated ceiling, control panel beside the doorway. No rear exit and no mirror creating a second NAGI.

NAGI enters facing the rear wall, then turns to face the open elevator doors.

For the final reverse shot, the camera is positioned INSIDE the elevator, immediately beside the doorway, looking inward at NAGI. The brushed-metal rear wall is behind her. The elevator doors close behind the camera, allowing her face to remain visible throughout the final shot.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING

First frame is already in motion: NAGI darts in from lower-left toward camera-right, work tote clutched to her chest, and drops into a crouch-slide behind a low desk partition beside her workstation.

Camera behind her right shoulder. Game HUD fully visible from frame one.

A small desk clock reads 17:00.

FORMAT MODE

One continuous unbroken take from 0.0s to 27.0s with no cuts of any kind, then a single HARD CUT at 27.0s to one final locked reverse shot that runs to 30.0s.

Exactly one cut exists in the whole video, at 27.0s. The camera does not cut anywhere else.

OPTICS

One lens for the continuous section: 47° third-person over-the-shoulder framing as the baseline, breathing in to 29° on reaction beats and out to 63° for the boss encounter and moving-whiteboard concealment.

All FOV changes in that section happen as smooth continuous zoom breathing, never as a jump.

The final shot after the cut is a fixed 29° frontal framing of NAGI, no drift.

CAMERA

For the continuous section, the camera is a physical object flying with her.

Chest-height, 1.5 meters behind NAGI, slightly camera-right of her spine, swinging with a soft spring delay half a beat behind her turns like an analog-stick gameplay camera.

It dips to knee height when she crouches, rises when she stands, slides sideways along the filing cabinets with her, swings wide to corridor-left to reveal the boss encounter, drifts behind her for the moving whiteboard, and follows her through the open elevator doorway.

The camera travels through open space around desks and partitions. It never clips through furniture, walls, the whiteboard, or elevator doors.

After the cut, the camera is repositioned inside the elevator beside the doorway, looking inward at NAGI — locked off, eye level, completely static, no movement.

ACTION

[Beat 1 — 0.0s to 6.0s]

NAGI crouch-slides behind the low desk partition, back flat against it, chest heaving. She leans out 20 cm to peek at the TEAM LEADER checking his watch beside the adjacent desk cluster, then pulls back.

She whispers in Japanese:

{定時だ…捕まったら終わり。}

HUD flashes 【5:00 PM — SHIFT OVER】 and the mission banner 【OBJECTIVE: REACH THE ELEVATOR UNDETECTED】.

The TEAM LEADER turns toward a ringing desk phone. NAGI slips behind his back, staying below the desk-partition line, and moves into the printer aisle.

The camera follows without stopping.

[Beat 2 — 6.0s to 12.0s]

The camera stays with her beside the steel filing cabinets.

NAGI presses her spine flat against the cabinets and shuffles sideways at 2 km/h, sneakers rolling heel-to-toe in silence. The camera tracks sideways with her at the same speed.

The PAPERWORK COWORKER walks past the end of the row carrying a thick stack of printouts, scanning the office for someone available to help.

NAGI holds her breath, pupils tracking the coworker without moving her head, and whispers:

{来ないで…こっち見ないで。}

The minimap vision cone sweeps past NAGI’s marker and turns away.

HUD shows 【SNEAKING MODE】.

The PAPERWORK COWORKER exits frame-left. NAGI exhales, crouches beneath the edge of the last desk, and slips into the corridor with the camera still on her shoulder.

[Beat 3 — 12.0s to 18.0s]

The BOSS steps around the T-junction two meters in front of her, blue assignment folder in hand.

He catches a brief glimpse of movement. A red exclamation marker snaps above his bald head with a sharp alert sting. The HUD edge pulses red: 【ALERT】.

He starts saying in Japanese:

{なぎさん、追加の仕事が…}

The camera swings wide to corridor-left as NAGI reacts in one motion: hugs her tote tightly against her ribs, drops below his eye line, pivots around the corner of a tall filing cabinet, and slips into the adjacent meeting-room alcove.

The cabinet fully blocks his view before he can finish approaching her.

She whispers:

{今だけは無理…！}

HUD prints 【EVASIVE MANEUVER】 and 【BREAK LINE OF SIGHT】.

The BOSS takes a step toward the place where he last saw her, looking around the cabinet. NAGI has already moved to the far side of a mobile whiteboard in the alcove.

The camera falls in behind her again.

[Beat 4 — 18.0s to 24.0s]

The OFFICE ASSISTANT starts pushing the mobile whiteboard out of the meeting-room alcove toward the elevator lobby.

The whiteboard is a tall, opaque rectangular board on a metal frame with four caster wheels. Its panel extends low enough to conceal NAGI’s crouched torso and head; only her white sneakers occasionally show below the frame.

NAGI crouches on the side opposite the BOSS and shuffles with the board, matching its rolling speed exactly. She keeps her tote tucked close so it never protrudes beyond the board’s edge.

The camera tracks low on her concealed side, showing her careful steps and the BOSS intermittently visible beyond the board’s far edge.

The BOSS pauses, looks toward the moving whiteboard for a full beat, then turns back toward the office with his assignment folder.

From behind the board, NAGI whispers:

{ホワイトボード…最強。}

HUD prints 【MOBILE COVER EQUIPPED】, then 【ENEMY LOST CONTACT】.

The alert bar drains to green.

The OFFICE ASSISTANT steers the board into a wall recess beside the elevator lobby. NAGI slips away from its concealed side as it stops.

[Beat 5 — 24.0s to 27.0s]

NAGI reaches the elevator call button and taps it once.

A soft arrival chime sounds. The elevator is already waiting on this floor; its doors slide fully open.

She slips through the clear doorway. The camera follows her inside, staying behind her shoulder.

She turns to face the entrance and presses the door-close button once. Her shoulders remain tense, tote held tightly in both hands.

The doors remain open until the cut.

27.0s HARD CUT

[Beat 6 — 27.0s to 30.0s]

Locked static reverse shot from inside the elevator beside the doorway, looking inward:

NAGI stands facing camera, shoulders squared, work tote held in front of her, chest still rising fast. Behind her are the brushed-metal rear wall and a horizontal handrail.

Off camera behind the lens, from the distant office corridor, the BOSS calls in Japanese:

{なぎさん、ちょっといい？}

The elevator doors slide closed behind the camera. Their narrowing opening is registered by the shrinking patch of corridor light across NAGI’s face and the sliding-door sound.

NAGI answers brightly, looking straight down the lens:

{お先に失礼します！}

The doors finish closing. Her shoulders drop with relief.

HUD prints 【MISSION COMPLETE】, 【STEALTH RANK: S】, 【ADRENALINE +150】, and the final notification:

【AFTER-HOURS TASK EVADED】

Final frame: NAGI facing camera, a tiny triumphant smile pulling at one corner of her mouth.

PERFORMANCE

Photographic human realism indistinguishable from live-action footage: skin with visible pores, fine vellus hair catching the light, subsurface scattering in the earlobes and fingertips, capillary flush across her cheeks and ears from running, individual flyaway strands lifting off her hair, wet living eyes with true window catchlights and a faint red inner rim, clean matte skin.

Visible fast breathing at the collarbone, eyes darting a half-second before her head turns.

Tension shown by muscle: shoulders drawn up to her ears, fingers clamped white on the tote handles, jaw set, then a full-body shoulder drop on each escape.

All adults have equally real skin, real hair follicles, and natural asymmetric faces.

PHYSICS

Her blouse and tailored trousers crease naturally during crouches and turns. Hair lags and sweeps across her face on fast direction changes.

The work tote has real weight: its handles pull taut in her hands, and its body swings with inertia before settling against her torso.

The mobile whiteboard has real mass. Its caster wheels rotate against the floor, swivel when steered, and rattle lightly over a flooring seam. The board wobbles subtly when the OFFICE ASSISTANT starts and stops it.

NAGI moves with her own visible footsteps; the board does not drag or transport her.

The coworker’s printouts flex slightly while walking. The BOSS’s folder stays in his hand.

Elevator doors slide smoothly on fixed tracks and close only after NAGI and the camera are fully inside.

Contact shadows stay glued under every foot, every knee, every furniture leg, and every caster wheel.

LIGHTING

One continuous light logic across the office route: bright late-afternoon sun at 5600K entering from the window wall on camera-right, throwing long window-frame stripes across the floor.

NAGI passes through light and shadow as she travels. Soft bounce fill off the pale linoleum lifts her face. Fine dust hangs suspended in the sunbeams.

The elevator lobby receives the same window light. Inside the elevator, neutral overhead illumination provides continuous soft fill.

In the final reverse shot, the same corridor daylight enters from camera-left through the open doorway, raking across her cheek. As the doors close behind the lens, this daylight narrows and disappears naturally, leaving the elevator’s established overhead light.

Exposure rolls smoothly as she moves between bright and shadowed stretches, and the color temperature matches exactly across the cut.

HUD

GTA-style real-time game HUD locked to fixed screen positions for the whole 30 seconds, with every on-screen word written in English:

Circular minimap bottom-left with the player arrow and yellow vision cones for the office characters; health and stamina bars top-left; alert-state bar shifting green to amber to red; controller button prompts bottom-right; English mission objective text top-center; floating red exclamation markers over alerted characters; notification cards sliding in from screen-right.

The HUD stays in the same screen positions across the cut.

No subtitles or caption bars anywhere on screen.

The HUD is a clean flat graphic overlay composited on top of fully photographic live-action-grade footage.

AUDIO

Tense minimalist stealth synth loop with a pulsing heartbeat underneath, running unbroken across the cut and resolving to a short bright victory fanfare at the end.

Ambience carries continuously through the cut. Office sounds become naturally muffled as the elevator doors close.
All dialogue is spoken in Japanese.
STYLE
Photoreal live-action realism, real human beings and real fabric, natural skin tones with true-to-life color science, physically correct materials, realistic human proportions and anatomy, real optical depth of field, real floor reflections, subtle handheld gameplay motion blur, fine film grain at 5%, sharp detail intent.
OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9, real-time speed throughout, one continuous 27-second take plus one 3-second locked shot after a single hard cut.
POSITIVE LOCKS
Exactly one cut in the entire video, at 27.0s — everything before it is a single unbroken take with the camera connected to NAGI.
NAGI is consistently an adult office employee, 25, with the same face, long black hair with blunt bangs, white office blouse, charcoal tailored trousers, black belt, white sneakers, clipped employee ID, and black work tote throughout, with dry clean skin.
The work tote stays with her throughout.
The mobile whiteboard appears only from the meeting-room alcove onward and is physically pushed by the OFFICE ASSISTANT. It remains between NAGI and the BOSS during the concealment beat.

The bald BOSS in the charcoal suit and the tall bearded OFFICE ASSISTANT with thick black hair are unmistakably different men.

The office route remains spatially continuous. Characters do not teleport between locations.

NAGI enters the elevator before turning toward its doors.

In the final shot, the camera is inside the elevator beside the doorway, with NAGI facing the lens and the brushed-metal rear wall behind her. The doors close behind the camera; they never pass between the lens and her face.

All on-screen text is English. The last 3 seconds hold a locked frontal eye-level shot of NAGI facing camera.

HUD elements stay in the same screen corners throughout.

One single NAGI on screen at all times.

All spoken lines are in Japanese.

Sunlight direction stays consistent across the office route, with a physically motivated transition to elevator lighting as the doors close.

Final notification: 【AFTER-HOURS TASK EVADED】.

Prompt 👇
Pack 1/2

【参考图使用规则】

manik 的外貌、发型、八字胡、金框飞行员墨镜、黑色 786 球衣、红色腕带与红黑高帮球鞋严格参考角色资产图一；antony 的外貌、发型、无胡须的脸、黑框墨镜、黑色 ANTONY 1 号球衣、黑色腕带与红黑高帮球鞋严格参考角色资产图二；court 的球场结构、铁丝网、涂鸦墙、篮架、树影、远处城市天际线与光感严格参考场景资产图三。

只提取资产图中的视觉设计。严禁生成角色三视图、灰色或白色摄影棚背景、DETAILS & SWATCHES 细节格、色卡条、尺寸标注线、6ft 183cm 字样、7FT 213CM 字样、BAASHA 字样、HEIGHT / BUILD / STYLE / SPECIALTY 等表格文字、FRONT VIEW / SIDE VIEW / BACK VIEW / TOP-DOWN VIEW 字样与水印。

【全局画风】

顶级院线级 2D 风格化动画电影。这不是真人电影，也不是写实 3D。

角色渲染：清晰有力的手绘线稿，人物比例极度夸张拉长——细长的四肢、极窄的腰身、修长的脖颈、偏大的头部。硬边分层阴影，高饱和的黑、红、橙色块，线条带有手绘的力度变化。

环境渲染：严格参考场景资产图三的手绘动画质感——明亮的钴蓝色天空、蓬松的白云、树叶间洒下的斑驳阳光、水泥地上被拉长的树影、铁丝网与涂鸦墙的笔触肌理、空气中被阳光照亮的细小尘埃。

24fps 动画帧感，2.39:1 宽银幕，明亮的午后阳光，35mm 胶片颗粒 25%。

【体型比例·必须严格遵守】

manik 身高 6 英尺（183cm），身形精瘦修长。
antony 身高 7 英尺（213cm），比 manik 高出整整一个头，四肢更长、更瘦削。

antony 必须始终明显高于 manik。两人站在一起时，manik 的头顶只到 antony 的下巴附近。antony 用身高俯视 manik，manik 必须略微抬头才能看着他的脸。

这个身高差全片严格保持，绝不允许反转或消失。

【角色 A：manik·英雄】

严格参考角色资产图一。南印度成年男性，6 英尺，精瘦修长。浓密蓬乱的黑色卷发向两侧与后方炸开；浓密的黑色八字胡；戴一副金框飞行员墨镜，全程不摘下。

服装：黑色无袖球衣，胸前印着红色描金的大号数字 786，领口与侧边有红色描边，左胸有一颗金色星星；黑色球裤配红色侧条；右腕戴一只红色毛巾腕带；脚穿红黑白配色的高帮球鞋；白色中筒袜。

【manik 的举止·超级巨星语汇·必须严格遵守】

他的一切都建立在"不着急"上。周围越乱，他越慢。

站姿：重心完全压在一条腿上，另一条腿随意前伸，一只手插在球裤口袋里或搭在腰侧，肩膀放松下沉。他站着的时候几乎不动，只有头发在风里飘。

头部：他从不猛地转头。要看什么，先是眼睛在墨镜后面转过去，然后下巴跟着慢慢转，最后整个头才到位，带着一种懒洋洋的迟滞感。

招牌小动作：用拇指与食指捻一下八字胡的尾端；用一根手指把墨镜往鼻梁上推正；不看也能接住抛来的东西；笑起来是先嘴角一侧上扬，然后才扩散到整张脸。

出手：他的动作幅度极小但绝对精准。不摆架势、不蓄力、不做多余的预备动作——上一秒还站着不动，下一秒事情已经结束了。

他从不喊叫，从不慌张，从不露出愤怒。即使被挑衅到脸上，他的第一反应也是笑。

【角色 B：antony·反派】

严格参考角色资产图二。南印度成年男性，7 英尺，极度瘦高。浓密蓬乱的黑色中长发；面部干净，绝对没有胡子；戴一副黑色方框墨镜，全程不摘下直到被打飞。

服装：黑色无袖球衣，胸前印着红色的 ANTONY 字样与大号数字 1，衣身有黑红几何切面纹理；黑色球裤；颈挂一串浅色珠链；左腕戴一只黑色腕带，上有红色 A 字标；脚穿红黑白配色的高帮球鞋。

【antony 的举止·反派语汇·必须严格遵守】

他的威胁感来自懒散，不是咆哮。

姿态：肩膀微微塌着，长手长脚松垮地垂着，像是全身没有一处用力。他走路时上身微微前倾，步子拖沓但覆盖距离很大。

头部：他喜欢把下巴抬高、用鼻孔的角度俯视别人，或者把头歪向一侧打量对方，眼皮半垂。

招牌小动作：手指不停地小幅度动作——转球、弹指、无意识地敲击；说话或挑衅时手掌摊开做夸张的、慢半拍的表演性手势；笑的时候嘴角咧开但眼睛完全不参与，是一种冷的、假的笑。

他享受表演，享受被注视。他的每一个炫技动作都是做给 manik 看的。当 manik 完全不给反应时，他的笑容会一点一点僵掉。

【场景：court·城市街头球场】

严格参考场景资产图三。明亮午后的城市户外水泥篮球场。

【结构】开裂的浅灰色水泥地面，白色的场地线已经磨损褪色。画面一侧立着一座旧篮架：磨白的透明篮板上布满涂鸦与贴纸，橙色篮圈挂着白色的网。场地四周围着高大的绿色铁丝网，网上挂着手绘的旧横幅与标语牌。铁丝网下方是布满彩色涂鸦的矮墙。

【环境】球场一侧有一棵枝叶茂盛的大树，阳光从树叶间穿过，在水泥地上投下大片斑驳晃动的树影。另一侧立着一根旧灯柱与一块告示牌。篮架柱子下靠着一台老式手提音响，旁边滚着一颗备用的篮球。

【远景】铁丝网之外是低矮的红砖楼房、水塔、更远处是蓝天下的城市天际线与高楼剪影。天空是明亮的钴蓝色，飘着蓬松的白云，有几道飞机拉出的白线。

【光】强烈的午后阳光从画面一侧斜射进来，在水泥地上拉出长长的影子。逆光处产生明显的光晕与镜头眩光。空气中漂浮着被阳光照亮的细小尘埃与飞扬的落叶。

【围观者】球场边缘散布着十几名围观的年轻人——靠在铁丝网上、坐在矮墙上、站在场边。他们只是环境资产与尺度参照：全程待在场地边缘，绝不进入球场中央、绝不加入冲突。他们的作用是提供反应：惊呼、起身、后退、张大嘴。

【刚性空间锚点】篮架的位置、大树的位置、铁丝网的走向、远处城市天际线，全片绝对不得漂移、消失或改变数量。

【风格融合规则·南印度商业动作片 + 武侠】

本片是两种电影语汇的融合，两者分工明确：

【运镜与节奏来自南印度商业动作片】极低机位仰拍英雄；台词瞬间镜头完全停止晃动；速度坡道只出现在关键命中的瞬间；英雄的每一次出场与转身都带着压迫性的画面重量。

【物理与动作来自武侠】篮球在空中的滞空时间明显超出现实；被接住的球在掌心瞬间彻底静止；冲刺时距离在一瞬间被跨越；每一次重击的落点都炸开一圈贴地的尘环；头发与衣物遵循夸张的惯性。

严禁彩色能量、发光特效、火焰、雷电或任何超自然光效。所有的夸张都必须表现为空气、尘土、气浪与惯性——纯物理。

【对白规则】

本片只有一句台词，为英文，在下方时间码中以引号标出。只有引号内的文字是被说出来的。其余所有文字——包括动作描述、表情描述、举止说明与运镜说明——全部是画面说明，绝对不得念出、不得配音、不得作为旁白。

全片台词不得超过一句。antony 全程不说话。围观者全程不说话。不得出现旁白与内心独白。

【运镜规格总纲】

全程一镜到底，绝对禁止硬切、剪辑、黑屏转场与定格。

24mm 超广角为主，配合极低机位仰拍。镜头在球场上流畅地绕行、推拉、横移，始终跟随动作。

拍 manik 时必须从极低的角度仰拍，让他在画面中显得高大、沉稳、不可撼动；拍 antony 的炫技时镜头贴着地面跟随球的运动。

速度坡道只允许出现在两个瞬间：7 秒接球的瞬间、14 秒出拳命中的瞬间。其余全部为正常速度。绝不允许全片慢动作、绝不允许定格。

镜头只能穿过真实存在的空隙，不穿过人物、篮架、铁丝网或地面。

【密度要求】

0—6 秒之间，antony 的运球必须每秒呈现 3—5 次清晰的动作变化——绝不允许单调重复地原地拍球。11.5—15 秒之间达到每秒 5—7 次的动作密度。速度快，但不是快进，不用模糊残影掩盖动作。

【0.0—3.0 秒·炫技】

明亮的午后阳光下，antony 在球场中央运球。他的动作又快又花：胯下运球、背后换手、转身拉球、高低交替的快速拍打。篮球砸在开裂的水泥地上，每一次都溅起一小蓬尘土，声音清脆响亮。他的长手长脚甩出夸张的弧线，蓬乱的头发跟着甩动。

他一边运球一边斜眼看向场边，下巴抬高，嘴角咧开一个不达眼底的笑，摊开一只手做了个夸张的、慢半拍的邀请手势。

场边的围观者跟着他的动作发出惊呼，有人拍手，有人站了起来。

运镜：贴地低机位跟随篮球的弹跳，随后升起环绕 antony 半圈，最后顺着他的视线方向摇向场边。

【3.0—5.0 秒·无动于衷】

镜头摇到球场边缘：manik 靠在铁丝网旁站着。

他的重心完全压在一条腿上，另一条腿随意前伸，一只手插在球裤口袋里。他一动不动。阳光透过树叶在他身上洒下晃动的斑驳光点，风把他蓬乱的黑色卷发轻轻吹起。金框墨镜后面看不出任何表情。

他抬起另一只手，用拇指和食指慢慢捻了一下八字胡的尾端。仅此而已。

场边的欢呼声与球场中央的炫技，他一点反应都没有。

运镜：从极低的角度仰拍 manik，镜头缓缓从他的球鞋升到面部，把他在树影与铁丝网前的身影完整纳入画面。

【5.0—6.5 秒·变脸】

antony 看见这个反应——或者说，看见了没有反应。他的笑容一点一点僵掉了。

他猛地发力，三次极快的胯下变向后直线突进，运球压低、步幅拉大，笔直杀向篮架。他高高跃起，长长的手臂举球过顶，做出上篮的姿势。

就在最高点，他的头转向了场边的 manik。墨镜后的脸上，那个假笑彻底消失。

运镜：沿他的突进路线快速倒飞，随他的起跳急速抬升，在最高点稳定锁定他转头的那一刻。

【6.5—7.5 秒·投掷与接球】
