prompts.title: A First Attempt with Unexpected Motion
prompts.prompt:
## Concept
AQUARELLE No.7 — an avant-garde haute couture film where watercolor becomes a living medium.

15-second cinematic sequence.

The rhythm controls the visual world:
0–4s: restrained silence and negative space
4–8s: gradual density buildup
8s: drop moment, expanding into fluid long-form motion
12–15s: transition into a final fashion poster composition

## Character Identity Lock

Maintain the exact same female character throughout the entire video.

Identity:
- Young woman
- Long black hair
- Calm and refined facial features
- White high-neck pigment dress
- Black wide belt
- Pigment heels

Strict consistency:
- Same face
- Same hairstyle
- Same age
- Same body proportions
- Same garment structure

Any new colors must only appear through watercolor gradually absorbing into the fabric.

Core concept:
Her fingertips can extract transparent watercolor ribbons from the air.

These watercolor ribbons can:
- Pull the camera through space
- Transform the environment
- Shape physical typography
- Interact with depth and materials

The world follows real cinematic physics:
water, paper, fabric, light, shadows, and depth of field must feel physically believable.

## Camera Direction

Strict one-take shot.
No cuts.
No teleportation.
No hidden transitions.

Camera journey:

Macro shot of a floating water droplet →
watercolor ribbon emerges →
camera pulls back to reveal the woman →
camera circles around her →
enters a paper art gallery →
passes through dimensional typography →
rises into a final overhead fashion poster.

## Typography

Only allow these words:

LET SILENCE BLOOM

AQUARELLE No.7

WEAR THE UNSEEN

Typography is not a flat overlay.

Letters must have:
- Physical depth
- Wet watercolor reflections
- Paper fiber edges
- Shadows
- Occlusion
- Material interaction

## Visual Style

Avant-garde fashion editorial.

Inspired by:
- Museum catalog composition
- Handmade ivory paper
- Sculptural negative space
- Elegant Didone serif typography
- Translucent watercolor calligraphy

Color palette:
- Pale cyan
- Crimson lake
- Smoky violet
- Ink black

## Motion Language

Every movement follows the music:

Kick:
Camera movement and paper folding.

Wooden snare:
Paper structures physically fold and transform.

Sub-bass:
Changes the perception of spatial scale.

##  Storyboard

30 beats, 0.5 seconds each.

01 0.0–0.5
Macro shot: A transparent water droplet floats in the air, reflecting a blurred silhouette of a black-haired woman.

02 0.5–1.0
The droplet stretches with the breath-like vocal, becoming a pale cyan watercolor thread.

03 1.0–1.5
Camera travels backward along the thread as paper fibers slowly emerge into focus.

04 1.5–2.0
The thread wraps around the lens. Focus shifts to her raised fingertip.

05 2.0–3.0
Camera continues pulling back, revealing her face and white high-neck dress.

06 3.0–4.0
She moves her wrist. The watercolor thread guides a smooth camera arc.

07 4.0–8.0
Additional watercolor colors emerge from her movement.
Paper folds, typography begins forming, and the phrase "LET SILENCE BLOOM" appears as a physical object.

08 8.0–12.0
The camera passes through a transparent paper flower structure.
The environment expands into an endless ivory paper gallery.

Her dress absorbs watercolor naturally.
The ribbons create sculptural forms around her body.

09 12.0–15.0
Camera cranes upward.

The composition transforms into a luxury fashion advertisement poster.

Typography appears:

AQUARELLE No.7

WEAR THE UNSEEN

Final frame:
A museum-level fashion editorial poster.
The woman remains centered, calm, and elegant.
A final watercolor droplet remains suspended in the air.

## Negative Prompt

No:
- Cuts
- Scene changes
- Identity change
- Face swap
- Extra limbs
- Deformed hands
- Random costume changes
- Explosive paint effects without physical cause
- Incorrect typography
- Chinese characters
- Extra subtitles
- Extra logos
- Watermarks

prompts.title: A High-Fashion Commercial in One Shot
prompts.prompt:
Prompts: 
[Core Concept]
15s, 160 BPM, 4/4, 40 beats. Industrial Hyperpop × Deconstructed Club: hard kicks, metallic snares, glitch hi-hats, distorted bass, sliced vocals. A timeline-based reality where rhythm controls space and motion.

[Character Identity]
Single androgynous dancer with short black hair, silver eyebrow mark, asymmetric black jacket, wide pants, red stitching. Maintain identical face, body, hairstyle and outfit. Multiple figures are only past-frame projections.

[World Logic]
Each kick compresses the timeline toward the dancer. Each snare duplicates previous movements into adjacent frames. Moving against the timeline transforms the 2D interface into a foldable 3D structure. The dancer escapes the repetition loop.

[Visual Language]
Black, cold white, warning red. Glass timelines, metal rails, glowing frame lines, scanning grids. Extreme wide-angle, low angles, top-down shots, Dutch angles, dolly moves, impossible perspective. 3D words COPY, SAME, TREND, OUTSIDE exist as physical architecture, not subtitles.

[Motion Rules]
Use anticipation → attack → overshoot → settle. Kick drives spatial compression, snare breaks frames, hi-hats animate cursors and fragments, bass bends time. Build with glitch cuts, then explode into an impossible continuous long take during the drop.

[Restrictions]
No character changes, extra people, random text, subtitles, logos, outfit changes, bad anatomy, flat camera angles, or meaningless flashes.

A wide low-angle shot in a wrecked living room at dusk: a shattered window, an overturned wooden chair, a smashed vase with white petals scattered across the floor, broken glass everywhere and dust hanging in the low amber light. A 25-year-old woman with cool fair skin, dark almond eyes, long straight black hair and a plain charcoal slip dress stands motionless in the centre of the wreckage, arms at her sides, looking straight into the lens. The camera performs an Arc Shot with small amplitude at slow speed, circling her from left to right for the whole shot and never changing direction. At 00:03.000 the destruction begins to run backwards: every object except the woman moves as if the footage were playing in reverse, while she stays in normal forward time and does not move at all. Broken glass lifts off the floor, rises through the air and knits itself back into the window pane from the outside in. The white petals float upward, gather and fold back into a whole vase that lands upright on the table. The overturned chair swings up onto its legs. Dust and small fragments are drawn inward from every corner of the room, and a pool of water on the floor pulls back up into an intact drinking glass. At 00:09.000 the last few fragments converge on the window. At 00:11.000 the final shard slots into place and the room is completely whole and undamaged, warm evening light now falling through clean glass.

[Shot 2] At 00:11.500, the camera cuts to a chest-up close-up, Static Shot at eye level, of the same woman in the now-perfect room, her appearance, hair and charcoal dress unchanged. She is still motionless. She blinks once, the only human movement in the film, and the frame holds on her face until the end. No on-screen text or subtitles at any point.

overall_soundscape: Deep silence in the wrecked room, broken only by the woman's slow breathing. As the reversal starts, glass shards tick and chime upward through the air and wood scrapes as the chair rights itself, under a long inward rushing sound that draws the dust back from the edges of the room. The final shard clicks into the window and everything stops into complete silence.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photorealistic with true fine pores and real skin texture, no beauty filter. A full-body side-on wide shot of a 25-year-old woman with cool fair skin, dark almond eyes and long straight black hair, walking steadily from left to right along a colonnade of stone columns on a city street. Her face is identical in every era of the film; only her clothing, her hair styling and the world behind her change. Her stride never changes speed and she never looks at the camera until the final moment. The camera trucks right with large amplitude at slow speed, travelling alongside her for the entire film with no other camera movement and no change of direction. Foreground columns sweep across the lens as the camera moves, and each time a column wipes the frame the world behind her changes to the next era.

The film opens in the 1920s: low-saturation sepia light, gas lamps, a horse-drawn carriage, a beaded drop-waist dress and a cloche hat. At 00:03.000 a column wipes past and the world becomes the 1950s: warm amber light, a pastel car at the kerb, a chrome diner sign, a full-skirted dress and red lipstick. At 00:06.000 the next column wipes past and the world becomes the 1980s: dense pink and cyan neon reflecting off wet asphalt, a padded-shoulder jacket, heavy dark night air. At 00:09.000 the next column wipes past and the world becomes the present day: cool white daylight, glass office towers, passers-by lit by phone screens, an oversized wool coat. At 00:12.000 the last column wipes past and the world becomes the near future: pale blue light, floating holographic advertisements drifting between the columns, a sleek structured coat with a faint luminous seam.

At 00:14.000 she stops walking. The camera comes to rest with her. She turns her head and looks straight into the lens for the final beat, holding still until the end. No on-screen text or subtitles at any point.

Behind her the street swaps out at each era: horse hooves and a distant bell, then car horns and chattering pedestrians, then heavy rain on asphalt and a low traffic drone, then a modern city hum, then an almost silent electric whirr. Each column wipe is marked by a short dry rush of air across the lens.

non_diegetic_music: A steady four-beat pulse at a constant tempo runs from the first frame to the last, gaining one new instrument at every era change: a lone bass drum, then upright bass, then analogue synth, then layered electronic percussion, then a wide sustained synth chord. It reaches full volume as she stops and cuts off on her final look.

prompts.title: A Visual Manifesto for the Open-Weight Era
prompts.prompt: Create an approximately 15-second, 16:9 grounded street-racing action-film scene. All dialogue is spoken naturally in English.  Late at night inside a private custom garage in an industrial area of Los Angeles, Roman and Tej sit shoulder to shoulder on the front bumper of a black high-performance muscle car. Each holds an ordinary paper coffee cup.  Several heavily modified street-racing cars surround them. Their bodywork reflects cool blue work lights and warm tungsten fixtures. A hydraulic vehicle lift slowly descends in the background. Tools occasionally clink in the distance while an engine produces a steady, low idling rumble.  The scene has the grounded texture of a street-racing action movie: dark metallic tones, a faint layer of garage haze, an oil-stained concrete floor, realistic automotive reflections, and restrained shoulder-mounted camerawork. The image should feel physical and substantial, not like a polished car commercial.  Keep the camera at chest height and begin with a steady medium two-shot. Use only subtle human-operated movement and natural breathing in the frame. There are no chases, explosions, or exaggerated actions. The humor comes entirely from the serious performances, eye contact, and pauses.  Roman turns toward Tej with a completely sincere and genuinely concerned expression. There is no irony in his performance, and he does not realize that the question might be funny. He treats it as a serious concern about the future of the entire team.  ROMAN, speaking with complete sincerity: “Do you think AI is gonna replace us?”  Tej slowly raises his eyes from his coffee cup. The camera makes an almost imperceptible push toward him. He pauses and looks directly into Roman’s eyes. Tej appears tired but composed, answering with extremely restrained deadpan delivery.  TEJ: “Roman, AI can’t replace you. Nothing can replace you.”  Roman slowly nods. His shoulders relax, and he is visibly relieved. He looks down and seriously processes the statement. He then looks back at Tej and carefully asks for confirmation.  ROMAN: “Because I’m that good?”  Tej stares at Roman without moving.  Hold a long, quiet, uncomfortable pause. Do not use music or editing to emphasize the joke. During the silence, the idling engine in the background gives a small mechanical cough before returning to its steady rumble.  Tej slowly looks down at his coffee as though searching for an escape from the conversation. He takes a small breath, then raises his eyes back to Roman.  TEJ, with an extremely flat and exhausted delivery: “...Sure. Let’s go with that.”  Roman nods with satisfaction, fully accepting the answer. Looking reassured, he takes a sip of coffee.  The camera does not follow Roman. Instead, it slowly pushes closer to Tej’s face. After his final line, hold on Tej’s expressionless face for one full beat. He looks straight ahead, his eyes communicating exhaustion, resignation, and a brief reconsideration of every life choice that brought him here.  Cut directly to black.  Performance requirements: Roman remains completely earnest and serious throughout. He never smirks, winks, looks into the camera, or recognizes the joke. Tej’s humor comes only from restrained eye movement, flat vocal delivery, and precisely timed pauses. He never rolls his eyes, makes an exaggerated expression, or visibly performs the comedy.  Audio requirements: All dialogue is delivered in natural, clear American English with accurate lip synchronization. Preserve the subtle rustle of the paper cups, the garage’s spatial reverb, distant tool sounds, and the low engine rumble. Maintain the specified pauses between lines. No background music, laugh track, narration, or subtitles.  Continuity requirements: Roman and Tej remain seated in the same positions throughout. Each coffee cup stays in its owner’s hand, with realistic wrist movement, weight, inertia, and liquid behavior. Preserve the characters’ faces, body types, clothing, hairstyles, background vehicles, lighting direction, and camera axis.  Negative prompt: exaggerated comedy acting, changing identities or faces, distorted fingers or coffee cups, rapid action editing, explosions or car chases, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.title: Learning the Days of the Week
prompts.prompt:

Target audience: children ages 3 to 6.
Visual style: Same premium-cute aesthetic — pastel tones, rounded 3D icons, soft lighting, off-white background, unique glow per day, clean bold typography, gentle calendar-page-flip style transitions.
0:00–0:01 Intro: Mascot bounces onto a soft floating calendar page, text "Let's learn the days!", tap flips to reveal Monday.

▪️0:01–0:04 | Monday — School Day: Calendar page shows "Monday" in big rounded text. Narrator: "Monday. Time for school!" A tiny backpack icon bounces onto the page and wiggles happily. Word "MONDAY" highlighted in soft blue.

▪️0:04–0:07 | Tuesday — Park Day: Page flips gently to Tuesday. Narrator: "Tuesday. Time to play!" A small swing icon appears and swings back and forth once. Word "TUESDAY" highlighted in soft orange.

▪️0:07–0:10 | Wednesday — Art Day: Page flips to Wednesday. Narrator: "Wednesday. Time to paint!" A tiny paintbrush icon appears and draws one curved rainbow line. Word "WEDNESDAY" highlighted in soft purple.

prompts.title: The Letter B Becomes a Butterfly
prompts.prompt: Create a 15-second cute, funny, educational creative animation video for kids ages 3 to 7.  Concept: Teach the letter B using the word “Butterfly” with two major visual highlights:  1. a slow, satisfying, highly engaging transformation from the word “Butterfly” into a cute butterfly 2. a slow, magical transformation from the stylized animated world into a fully realistic natural scene with a realistic butterfly  The video should feel beautiful, colorful, charming, educational, and visually mesmerizing. The transformations must not feel rushed. They should be the centerpiece of the video and should unfold clearly enough for children to enjoy and understand.  Main learning message: “B is for Butterfly.”  Visual style at the beginning: Use a premium kid-friendly animated style with soft pastel skies, rounded shapes, bright happy colors, smooth motion, clean composition, playful details, expressive design, and a light sense of humor. The early part should feel like a beautiful storybook mixed with polished modern animation.  Animation priorities: The word-to-animal transformation must be gradual, elegant, readable, and creatively staged. Children should be able to see how the letters slowly become parts of the butterfly. The stylized-to-realistic transformation must also happen gradually and beautifully, as if the animated world is blooming into real life.  Timing and scene flow:  0:00–0:02 Open on a soft dreamy pastel background with floating flowers, tiny sparkles, and gentle clouds. A large uppercase “B” appears in the center with a smaller lowercase “b” beside it. Both letters bounce softly into place with a cheerful and friendly feeling. The narrator says slowly and clearly: “B is for Butterfly.”  Hold the letters long enough for recognition.  0:02–0:04 The word “BUTTERFLY” writes itself slowly across the screen in large rounded colorful letters. Each letter fills with a different beautiful pattern, such as gradients, dots, stripes, floral shapes, and soft wing-like textures. Keep the word fully readable and centered. Let the audience admire the full word before the transformation begins.  0:04–0:09 This is the main highlight. The word “BUTTERFLY” transforms slowly and satisfyingly into the butterfly.  The transformation must be gradual, staged, and visually delicious to watch: The “B” gently opens outward and unfolds into the top wings. The “U” stretches and curves into one lower wing. The first “T” and second “T” slim down and merge into the butterfly’s long body. The “E” softens and reshapes into decorative wing markings. The “R” curls upward into one antenna. The “F” reshapes into the second antenna with a playful wobble. The “L” and “Y” arc outward and become the final wing edges and tail details.  Important: Do not transform everything at once. Let each part morph one after another in a smooth chain reaction. The letters should bend, curl, unfurl, rotate, stretch, and softly glide into their new forms. The child should still sense the original word during the transformation. Use sparkling trails, flowing color transfer, and soft elastic motion to make it deeply satisfying. The morph should feel magical, clear, and creatively intelligent.  0:09–0:11 The butterfly is now a fully formed cute stylized cartoon butterfly. It has lovely colorful wings, a tiny smiling face, big friendly eyes, and soft funny charm. It flutters gently in a playful little loop, hovers above a flower, almost sneezes from pollen in a cute funny moment, then recovers and smiles. Show the word “Butterfly” below it briefly for reinforcement. The narrator repeats: “Butterfly.”  0:11–0:14 This is the second major highlight. The entire animated scene slowly transforms into a realistic world.  The butterfly flaps its wings in slow motion. With each flap, realism increases gradually: its wing textures become more detailed the colors gain natural variation the body becomes more lifelike the flowers gain realistic petals and depth the background softens into a real sunlit garden the lighting becomes natural and golden the air gains subtle movement and realistic depth of field  This transformation should feel breathtaking, seamless, and immersive. Do not cut abruptly from cartoon to realistic. Instead, let the animated world gently bloom into reality in layers. The viewer should feel they are witnessing imagination turn into nature.  0:14–0:15 End on a beautiful realistic butterfly resting on a real flower in warm sunlight. Display the text: “B is for Butterfly” The narrator says warmly: “B is for Butterfly.” The butterfly gently flutters once, then lifts off lightly.  Style and quality requirements: Keep the letter B and the word “BUTTERFLY” clearly readable before and during transformation. Make the word-to-animal morph slow, rich, and visually rewarding. Make the stylized-to-realistic transformation equally slow, smooth, and magical. Use polished motion design, soft easing, beautiful color transitions, gentle humor, and strong visual clarity. Maintain a child-friendly tone throughout. Use clean typography, stable spelling, and seamless morphing.  Audio direction: Use cheerful, soft, magical music. Add delicate sparkles, soft pops, flutter sounds, a tiny comedic sniffle or sneeze, and a gentle emotional swell during the realism transition. Voiceover should be warm, clear, slow, and easy for children to follow.  Avoid: rushed transformations, unreadable letters, clutter, hard cuts, scary expressions, excessive camera motion, chaotic effects, or anything visually confusing for children.

prompts.title: A Game Teaser in the City of Starflowers
prompts.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。

作品ジャンルは、プレミアム3Dトゥーン／セルルックで描くダークファンタジー探索ゲームの魔法ミステリー・タイトルシークエンス。黒いネガティブスペース、非対称分割、細い銀青フレーム、硬い幾何学マスクで構成する。恐怖や悲劇ではなく、冷静で上品な緊張感。主人公は全編で一人だけ。顔演技は、目、眉、まぶた、口元、視線の順に小さく変化させる。

参照役割を厳密に分離する。Image1は顔参照であり、顔とキャラクター同一性の最優先参照。Image2は衣装参照であり、衣装・装飾・全身デザイン・体格・刀と装備の参照。優先順位は、顔立ち、目、虹彩色、眉、口元、髪型、髪色、前髪、顔まわりの色はImage1、衣装構造、身体シルエット、装飾、装備はImage2。参照内容が食い違う場合もこの優先順位を守る。Image2内の文字、レイアウト、背景、ポーズ見本、表情一覧、小さな顔バリエーションは参照しない。

キャラクター固定：全カットで同一人物。小さく繊細な卵形の顔、柔らかな顎線、淡い肌、透明感のある大きなサファイアブルーの瞳、奥行きのある多層虹彩、左右それぞれの小さな複数キャッチライト、細い上まつ毛、自然な下まつ毛を維持する。白銀にごく淡い青紫を含む長い髪、柔らかな薄い前髪、顔沿いの細い横髪、腰まで流れる豊かなウェーブを維持する。頭の左側には、青い薔薇と黒青の蝶翅、青い雫飾りが一体になった髪飾り一組だけを固定し、飛び去らせず、実在の蝶へ変えず、複製しない。

Image2の黒紺を基調にした高密度ゴシック衣装を維持する。繊細な黒レースのハイネックと透け袖、青い胸元宝石、銀の細鎖、青いサテンリボン、非対称の多層スカート、黒いブーツ、細身で小柄な約7.5頭身のシルエットを固定する。全カットで顔、目、髪、衣装、体格、装飾、固有配色を変えない。変化してよいのは、表情、視線、呼吸、歩行姿勢、髪・レース・リボンの自然な遅れだけ。特徴混合、顔の平均化、衣装交換、別人化、分身、クローン、余計な人物を生じさせない。

能動装備として主人公が所有する刀は全編で刀一本だけ。開始時から左腰の鞘へ完全に納まり、黒紺の鞘、鍔、柄、銀の鎖飾り、青い房を一続きの同じ構造で保つ。開始時、右手は柄のすぐ横で開いている。途中で黒い手袋の右手が柄だけへ静かに触れ、鍔が手と鞘側を明確に分離したまま指を締める。刀身は一度も抜かず、最終画でも刀一本のまま完全に納刀され、右手は柄に静止する。二刀流、刀の複製、柄・鍔・鞘の分離、刃を握る手を出さない。

レンダリング固定：全編で3Dトゥーン／セルルックの一系統だけ。細く制御された濃紺とチャコールの色線、二段から三段の明快なトゥーン影と透明な中間グラデーション、白銀・深紺・ロイヤルブルー・銀を主役にした澄んだ高彩度パレットを維持する。瞳と髪には多層ハイライト、金属と青い結晶には局所的で鋭い反射を置く。肌は柔らかなマット、髪は絹、レースは繊細な半透明、サテンは抑えた光沢、革は低光沢、銀金属は硬質、結晶は多面反射、濡れた石床は深い鏡面として描き分ける。顔、髪飾り、衣装、刀、建築まで高密度。キーライトと影色はキャラクター固有色を優先し、青い環境光は補助に限定し、背景は主役より抑えた低彩度の青黒にする。太い輪郭、平坦な単層セル影、汎用3D美少女顔、滑らかなプラスチックCG、低密度背景、半写実、写実、くすんだ人物色、画風混合にしない。

舞台は月光の差す青黒いゴシック書庫回廊。奥に閉じた一枚の高いアーチ扉、床に磨かれた黒い石、側面に青いステンドグラス光、石のリブと書架の細部が続く。建築は石、木、ガラスだけで成立させ、キャラクター固有の薔薇、宝石、鎖、蝶飾りを柱や壁へ複製しない。唯一の異常は、現実の扉が閉じたままなのに、床の鏡面反射の中だけ同じ扉が青い奥行きへ開いていること。カメラは狭い顔極近景から回廊の広い中景へスケールを変え、胸上近景へ戻る。各移動の目的は、扉と反射の食い違い、右手と刀の状態、回廊の奥行き、表情の理解、タイトル余白を順に読ませること。終端空間は同じ回廊の閉じた扉前で、別の場所へ移らない。

黒から一度だけ硬く切り替える。大きな主パネルでは、カメラは少女の左斜め前、目線の高さ、顔の極近景。両目、鼻筋、口元、輪郭、髪飾りを一続きに見せ、顔へ枠線を重ねない。画面右下の細い副パネルでは、正面の閉じたアーチ扉と、その真下で既に開いている床反射を同時に見せ、異常を一目で比較できる。少女の瞳が静かに下へ動き、反射の異常を捉える。反射内のアーチ輪郭が硬い円弧マスクへ拡大し、次の画へ切り替える。

高い斜め上から濡れた黒石床へ寄り、上側に現実の閉じた扉、下側に開いた反射扉を同じ奥行き軸で保つ。反射の青い縁から一本の細い光線が床を走り、胸元の青い宝石の輪郭へ連続する。その円弧を境に細いタイルが非対称に組み替わり、宝石の近景、右手と柄の近景、鞘の青い象嵌を順に見せる。各タイルの縁は顔を横切らない。右手が柄へ触れた瞬間だけ黒革の小さな擦れ、銀鎖の短い硬質な触れ音、レースの微かな衣擦れを同期させる。刀は完全に鞘の中へ残す。

鞘の長い直線を硬いラインスライスとして、回廊の中景へ切り替える。カメラは少女の後方左、胸の高さから斜め前へ追従し、少女を中景以上に保ちながら、書架と石柱の背景消失軸を奥の閉じた扉へ集める。少女が閉じた扉へ一歩ずつ進むたび、濡れた石床へ乾いた靴音が一回ずつ響き、開いた反射扉だけが視線の先を滑る。足元につながった一つの長い影が床を横切り、その影の端を硬いワイプとして次へ渡す。影を別人や分身にしない。

影ワイプの後、扉の縦辺を硬いマスクにして、少女の右斜め前、目線よりわずかに低い胸上近景へ戻る。カメラは短く静かに寄り、表情を、目が異常を認識する、眉がごくわずかに締まる、まぶたが静かに細くなる、口元が冷静な決意へ整う、視線が現実の閉じた扉へ上がる、の順で読ませる。無表情の人形顔、恐怖、パニックにせず、瞳の層と小さなキャッチライトを保つ。右手は柄を握るが抜刀せず、青い鞘の縁が一度だけ画面を横切る硬いラインマスクになる。

重要な禁止：顔を分断する太い格子、顔中央の光点や光線、巨大な蝶の接写、実在昆虫のマクロ、軟らかいディゾルブ、流体モーフ、ホラー、流血、重複タイトル、誤字、擬似文字、字幕、透かし。

音楽は既存曲を模倣しない完全オリジナル。低いドローンと張り詰めた細いハイハットから始め、低いキック、断片的なウォーキングベース、短いバリトンサックスと切ったブラスへ冷静に展開する。終盤は緊張和音とドラム一打だけに絞り、その低い残響をタイトル保持へ残す。反射扉が開いて見える瞬間には透明な結晶エネルギーの短い共鳴、歩行には濡れた石床へ接するブーツの乾いた靴音、右手を柄に置く瞬間には黒革の軋み、銀鎖が一度だけ小さく鳴る音、布擦れをそれぞれ同期する。現実の木扉は動かないので開閉音を出さない。台詞、ナレーション、歌唱なし。

最終画は静かな余韻とモチーフ回帰。カメラは正面より少し左、目線の高さの胸上構図。少女を画面左へ置き、反対側の余白をタイトル専用にする。右手は柄に静止し、刀一本は左腰で完全に納刀、現実の扉は閉じたまま、床反射の扉だけが開いた青い奥行きで停止する。少女は閉じた扉の方向へ視線を固定し、呼吸と毛先とレースだけがごく小さく動く。右側へ正確に「MOONLIT BLUE BUTTERFLY」を一度だけ表示し、その下へ「COMING SOON」を一度だけ表示する。完成したタイトルプレートを固定して保持し、新しい人物、蝶、小物、文字を入れない。緊張和音とドラム一打の低い残響が完全に消える正確なフレームで黒へハードカットする。

prompts.title: A Fantasy Journey Through Ancient Egypt
prompts.prompt:
15 seconds | 16:9 | live-action historical construction drama
Fictional dramatization. Documentary-style visual realism.

SETTING

Ancient Egypt along the Nile during sunrise beside the Great Pyramids.

The uploaded reference image is the exact opening frame.

Maintain the identical traveler, boats, pyramids, moon, river, shoreline, lighting and composition.

Construction activity gradually becomes visible deeper into the environment while preserving the original scene.

Warm desert atmosphere.
Morning mist.
Light dust drifting across the valley.

WORKFORCE

A master builder overseeing the day's construction.

Hundreds of Egyptian laborers, stone masons, engineers, rope teams, carpenters and transport crews gradually become active throughout the distant construction zone.

Maintain historically accurate clothing, tools, wooden machinery and consistent character identities.

Human behaviour remains disciplined, coordinated and believable.

---

STORY

00–04s — ESTABLISHING

The traveler stands silently at the riverbank exactly as shown in the reference image.

The camera slowly pushes forward from behind.

Feluccas drift naturally.

Palm trees sway gently.

Birds fly across the sunrise.

Workers begin appearing in the distant background carrying ropes, wooden beams and stone tools toward the pyramid complex.

Construction slowly awakens with the rising sun.

---

04–08s — OPERATION

The traveler picks up the clay vessel and begins walking along the shoreline.

The camera follows naturally behind him.

Across the river, dozens of workers unload massive limestone blocks from transport boats.

Oxen pull wooden sledges.

Long rope teams drag heavy stones toward enormous earthen ramps.

Wooden cranes rotate slowly as supervisors organize the workforce.

Dust rises naturally beneath hundreds of moving feet.

---

08–12s — CONSTRUCTION

The traveler reaches an elevated viewpoint overlooking the worksite.

The camera gently reveals the enormous construction operation.

Hundreds of synchronized workers pull a gigantic limestone block upward using thick ropes and wooden rollers.

Stone masons shape blocks with copper chisels.

Carpenters assemble scaffolding.

Engineers inspect alignment while foremen direct the operation with calm hand signals.

The environment feels immense, alive and historically authentic.

---

12–15s — LEGACY

The camera slowly cranes upward into a breathtaking wide reveal.

The traveler stands watching history unfold before him.

Thousands of workers continue building across the vast construction site.

Feluccas constantly arrive carrying fresh limestone.

Dust drifts through golden sunrise light.

The pyramids dominate the horizon as one final massive stone settles perfectly into position.

End with the feeling that humanity's greatest engineering achievement is being built before our eyes.

---

CAMERA

Grounded historical-documentary cinematography.

Mix:

Wide environmental establishing shots.

Medium handheld following shots.

Brief observational close-ups.

Slow cinematic dolly movement.

Natural handheld instability.

Realistic operator movement.

Gentle crane rise for the final reveal.

No impossible drone transitions.

---

LIGHTING

Natural sunrise illumination.

Warm golden desert light.

Soft atmospheric haze.

Realistic exposure adaptation.

Natural shadows.

Detailed limestone texture.

Physically accurate reflections across the Nile.

No artificial rim lighting.

---

PHYSICS

Real gravity.

Authentic weight of limestone blocks.

Natural rope tension.

Workers visibly strain under heavy loads.

Dust reacts to footsteps.

Boats move naturally with river currents.

Water responds realistically.

Everything follows believable engineering principles.

---

HUMAN PERFORMANCE

Restrained, believable teamwork.

Heavy breathing.

Natural communication.

Simple hand signals.

Realistic lifting mechanics.

Measured walking.

Visible physical effort.

No exaggerated cinematic acting.

---

AUDIO

Morning wind.

Flowing Nile water.

Boat hulls creaking.

Workers shouting coordinated commands.

Stone scraping.

Hammer and chisel impacts.

Heavy rope tension.

Footsteps on sand.

Distant oxen.

Natural historical ambience.

No oversized Hollywood trailer effects.

---

VISUAL CHARACTER

Photorealistic live-action footage.

Historical documentary realism.

Museum-quality reconstruction.

Natural skin texture.

Authentic linen garments.

Weathered limestone.

Subtle sensor noise.

Natural motion blur.

Avoid:

Fantasy elements.

Magic.

CGI appearance.

Oversaturated HDR.

Modern machinery.

prompts.title: An Anime Conversation at a Sunset Rooftop Pool
prompts.prompt:
現代の都市を舞台にした青春アニメ映画のワンシーン。劇場クオリティのセルルック作画。
BGMなし、セリフは全て日本語、環境音あり。
フルサイズ換算24mm F1.4の広角レンズで撮ったような浅い被写界深度とボケ感。
手前の前ボケは大きく柔らかく、背景は自然に溶ける。

# 制約
全カットPOV（主観視点）で固定。カメラ＝視聴者の目線。カメラは常に低い位置から彼女を見上げる。
カメラには常に呼吸のようなごくわずかな手持ちの揺れがある。
彼女は視聴者（カメラ）に向かって話しかける。

# 登場人物
## ミナ ￼
黒髪ショートボブの若い女性。切れ長の目、すらりとした体型。黒のビキニ姿。

# 情景
￼を情景のリファレンスとしても使用。
夕暮れの高層ビル屋上のインフィニティプール。プールサイドを彼女が歩き回り、カメラ（視聴者）は水面近くの低い位置から彼女を見上げている。
照明：日没直前の低いオレンジの太陽光が彼女の輪郭と髪をリムライトとして縁取る。空はティールからオレンジへのグラデーション。プールの水面が空の色を反射して揺れる。
奥行き構成：前景に大きくボケたプールの水面のきらめき、中景に彼女、遠景に夕暮れの都市のシルエットと点り始めた街の灯り。

# シーン
彼女が視聴者（カメラ）に説教をしながらプールサイドを歩き回る。しかし視聴者の視線が下へ逸れてしまい、それに気づいた彼女が詰め寄り、最後は水を蹴りかけてくる。

cut1:
POVローアングル・ミディアムショット。彼女が腕組みを解き、両手を大きく動かして身振りを交えながら、プールサイドを画面右から左へ歩く。カメラがパンで彼女を追う。
ミナ：「ねえ、ちょっと。私の話、ちゃんと聞いてる？」
環境音：素足がプールサイドの濡れたタイルを踏むペタペタという足音、水面の波音、風。

cut2:
POVのまま。彼女が呆れたように両手を上げてくるりと背を向け、歩き出す。カメラがゆっくりティルトダウンし、夕陽に縁取られた後ろ姿のシルエットの輪郭に沿って視線が水面近くまで滑り落ちていく。画面外から彼女の声が続いている。
ミナ：「だいたいあなたはいつも返事だけで、全然…」
環境音：足音が止まり、彼女の声も途中でぴたりと止まる。

cut3:
POVのまま、カメラが慌てたように素早くティルトアップ。彼女が肩越しに振り返ってじっとこちらを見ている。そのまま大股でずんずん近づいてきて、カメラの目の前にしゃがみ込み、顔を近づける。半目でじっとりと見つめるクローズアップ。長い間。
ミナ：「……ねえ。どこ見てんの？」
環境音：近づく足音のあと、完全な沈黙。風の音だけ。

cut4:
POVローアングル。彼女が勢いよく立ち上がりざまに、足元のプールの水をカメラに向かって蹴り上げる。水しぶきが画面いっぱいに広がり、レンズに大粒の水滴が付いて視界が歪み、白くぼやけて何も見えなくなる。
環境音：水を蹴る音、水しぶきがレンズを叩く音、彼女の小さなため息。

prompts.title: Pangu Splits the World in Lacquer and Mother-of-Pearl
prompts.prompt:
️
【核心创意】

15 秒，16:9 横屏，东方传统漆画与螺钿镶嵌动画风格。混沌世界如一枚封闭的黑色巨卵，盘古从沉睡中苏醒，挥动巨斧劈开混沌，清气升为天空，浊气沉为大地。

画面以黑漆、朱漆、暗金和螺钿蓝绿色为主，具有深邃漆面光泽、金箔裂纹、手工髹漆层次和贝壳镶嵌反光。人物与场景像一幅会动的古代漆画，保持平面装饰性，同时具有厚重空间层次。无对白。

盘古是一名体型巨大的上古神人，浓密黑色长发与胡须，赤裸上身，肌肉强壮，腰间围深红色兽皮短裙，双腕缠有粗麻护腕，双手握一柄黑木长柄、暗金斧刃的开天巨斧。全片保持造型一致。

【画面过程说明】

0–3 秒｜极大全景：
黑色漆面般的混沌空间中，一枚巨大的椭圆形混沌之卵悬浮在中央。卵壳表面布满暗金裂纹和蓝绿色螺钿星点，黑红色云气在周围缓慢旋转。镜头穿过云气，向混沌之卵推进。

3–6 秒｜中近景：
普通切镜。混沌之卵内部，盘古缓缓睁开双眼，金色微光照亮他的脸和肩膀。他伸手握住身旁的开天巨斧，双脚踏稳，身体由蜷缩状态缓慢站起。卵壳因他的动作发出低沉震动。

6–9 秒｜低机位中景：
盘古双手举起巨斧，斧刃划过黑暗，表面的金箔纹路依次亮起。他扭转腰身蓄力，黑色长发向后扬起。镜头从盘古左侧 truck right + pan left，强调巨人和斧头的力量。

9–12 秒｜动作大全景：
盘古将巨斧向前劈下。暗金色斧刃沿明确轨迹击中混沌之卵，卵壳从中央裂开。金色光芒从裂缝中喷涌而出，但不产生现代爆炸。上下两层漆画空间缓慢分离：轻盈的金色与螺钿云气向上升起，厚重的朱黑色山石向下沉降。

12–15 秒｜极大全景：
上升的清气形成深蓝天空、星辰和金色太阳；下沉的浊气形成朱黑山脉、河流和大地。盘古站在天地中央，双手向上托住天空，双脚稳稳踏住大地。镜头缓慢拉远，山河纹样沿画面两侧展开，最终形成一幅完整壮丽的漆画长卷。

声音：开头使用深沉环境低频、云气流动声和缓慢鼓点；盘古起身时加入木石摩擦声；举斧时突出金属低鸣和呼吸声；劈开混沌时使用厚重撞击声、漆面开裂声和持续轰鸣；结尾加入风声、流水声与庄严编钟。无对白、无旁白。

不想要：写实真人、普通3D动画、西方油画、西方维京人造型、现代武器、雷电魔法、爆炸火球、多人角色、盘古脸部变化、衣服变化、斧头变形、天地分开后再次闭合、字幕、Logo、乱码文字、黑屏转场、镜头抖动。

必须保持：全片为东方漆画和螺钿镶嵌风格；黑漆、朱漆、金箔裂纹与贝壳反光清晰可见；盘古的黑色长发、胡须、深红兽皮短裙、麻布护腕和开天巨斧全程一致；清气向上、浊气向下；结尾明确形成天空与大地。

prompts.title: A Battery Icon Clocks Out Early
prompts.prompt:
15 seconds, 16:9 landscape video. Blend authentic handheld live-action footage of a cluttered bedroom workspace with rough frame-by-frame 2D crayon, colored-pencil, marker, and torn-paper animation. The concept is cute, absurd, relatable, and emotionally healing: a nearly empty computer battery icon refuses to keep working, escapes from the laptop, and takes a tiny “recharge vacation” through the real room before returning fully energized.

The real environment is a slightly messy bedroom office at late afternoon. Visible objects include a real laptop, wireless mouse, charging cable, ceramic mug, notebook, pencils, desk lamp, small potted plant, rolling desk chair, window, curtains, bed, pillow, and a wall outlet. Warm natural window light mixes imperfectly with the laptop screen and desk lamp.

Shoot entirely from the protagonist’s first-person perspective. Only real hands and occasional forearms are visible. The live-action footage must feel accidentally captured on a smartphone: mild hand shake, delayed reframing, imperfect autofocus, visible low-light grain, auto-exposure breathing, rolling-shutter wobble during quick pans, uneven horizon, and natural motion blur. The camera is always slightly late, reacting to the animation rather than predicting it. Do not make the scene feel like a commercial, music video, or polished visual-effects demo.

[Animated Character Identity]

The main animated character originates from the laptop’s red low-battery icon.

Its consistent identity markers are:

a rounded rectangular battery-shaped body
rough white hand-drawn outline
red interior fill when tired
two tiny black dot eyes
one short charging-port tail
a small sky-blue vacation cap
a yellow lightning-bolt patch on its side

Every transformation must preserve at least three clear identity markers: the white outline, sky-blue cap, yellow lightning patch, battery shape, or charging-port tail.

All additional figures must be temporary doodles created by the battery character. Do not introduce unrelated characters.

[0.0–3.0 seconds — The Battery Quits]

First-person close-up of the real laptop on the desk. The protagonist’s right hand types slowly while the other hand rests near the mouse. The laptop screen displays a plain, generic work page with no readable text, no logos, and no recognizable interface branding.

A small red low-battery icon blinks in the screen corner. The protagonist reaches for the charging cable, but before the cable connects, the icon turns toward the camera and shakes its body “no.”

The red battery icon peels away from the screen like a rough paper sticker. Its edges curl visibly as it climbs over the real laptop bezel and drops onto the keyboard. During the fall, two tiny crayon legs redraw beneath it, followed by dot eyes, a sky-blue cap, and a yellow lightning patch.

It lands on a real key, compresses flat like a paper accordion, springs back up, wipes imaginary sweat from its forehead, and pulls out a tiny hand-drawn cardboard sign reading only “BREAK.” The word exists physically on the sign and is not an overlay.

The protagonist points at the charging cable in confusion. The battery pushes the cable plug away with both tiny hands, places its cap firmly on its head, and runs across the keyboard.

Camera: initially static and tired, then a delayed handheld pan follows the battery after it has already begun running.

Sound: real keyboard taps, laptop fan, cable brushing against the desk, tiny paper footfalls, one soft comedic spring squeak.

Transition: the running battery leaps from the keyboard toward the notebook.

[3.0–6.0 seconds — The Desk Becomes a Vacation Route]

The battery lands on the protagonist’s real open notebook. At each footstep, quick turquoise crayon waves appear across the paper. The notebook page transforms only visually through hand-drawn overlays into a tiny seaside map while remaining physically real.

The battery removes its sky-blue cap, flips it upside down, and the cap rapidly redraws into a miniature blue rowboat. The battery hops inside. Two yellow pencil-line oars grow from its sides.

It rows across the notebook’s hand-drawn turquoise waves. Small white paper fish leap from one page fold to another. A real pencil lying across the notebook becomes a bridge through animated interaction only; it remains a real pencil.

The battery boat passes beneath the pencil bridge, then reaches the notebook’s edge. The drawn water pours over the edge like a flat crayon waterfall without wetting the real desk.

Mid-fall, the blue rowboat folds into a paper parachute. The battery dangles beneath it by two rough red marker strings and floats toward the ceramic mug.

Camera: overhead handheld view of the notebook, then a slightly late tilt downward following the parachuting battery. Focus briefly hunts between the real pencil and the animated character.

Sound: tiny pencil-scratch rowing, paper-water swishes, soft fish pops, page flutter, gentle parachute rustle.

Transition: the battery swings around the mug handle and disappears behind the mug for a moment.

[6.0–9.5 seconds — The Plant Recharging Spa]

The protagonist quickly moves the camera around the mug. The battery swings from the real mug handle using one red marker string, releases, and lands inside the leaves of the real potted plant.

The plant remains completely real. Hand-drawn lime-green veins begin glowing softly across only the leaf beneath the battery. The battery removes its cap, lies back comfortably on the leaf, and unfolds into a tiny battery-shaped deck chair while keeping its face and lightning patch.

A hand-drawn yellow sunbeam squeezes through the real window blinds as a wobbly ribbon. It travels across the desk, climbs the plant stem, and connects gently to the battery’s charging-port tail.

The battery’s red interior begins filling gradually from bottom to top:

red → orange → yellow → bright green.

As the charge increases, tiny colored-pencil flowers pop into existence around the plant pot. Each flower has a simple face and stretches toward the sunbeam. One flower offers the battery a tiny doodled drink made from a blue paint droplet with a bendy straw.

The battery sits upright, takes one sip, and instantly overcharges for a comedic beat. Its body expands like a puffy paper balloon, its cap spins, and small yellow lightning doodles orbit its head. It exhales, settles back to normal size, and now glows healthy green.

Camera: gentle push toward the plant, but with imperfect handheld micro-shakes and a small exposure adjustment as the window enters frame.

Sound: real room ambience, curtain movement, leaf rustle, soft electrical hum, colored-pencil scribbles, liquid sip, tiny cheerful charging “bloop,” subtle paper balloon squeak.

Transition: the fully charged battery spots the laptop across the room and snaps its cap back on.

[9.5–12.5 seconds — The Ride Back to Work]

The battery jumps from the plant. While falling, its body stretches horizontally and redraws into a tiny green hand-drawn scooter. The sky-blue cap becomes a small front windscreen, the charging-port tail becomes an exhaust pipe, and the yellow lightning patch remains on the side.

The scooter lands on the real charging cable running across the desk. Two rough white wheels grip the cable as though it were a raised road.

The battery character’s face appears on the scooter’s front panel. It races along the cable, leaning dramatically around the mug and pencils. Small yellow lightning-shaped road signs grow briefly from the desk surface, bend as the scooter passes, then erase themselves stroke by stroke.

At the desk edge, the cable descends toward the real wall outlet. The scooter speeds down it like a roller coaster. The protagonist moves quickly to follow, bumping the rolling chair slightly. The camera dips, shakes, and briefly loses the battery behind the chair leg.

The battery-scooter emerges from behind the chair, drives up the real charging plug, and launches toward the laptop in an exaggerated slow arc. Midair, the scooter folds inward through visibly redrawn lines, becoming the original green battery character again.

Camera: delayed chase movement, quick pan, slight motion blur, momentary occlusion by the real chair, then a rough push back toward the laptop.

Sound: tiny scooter motor buzz made from mouth-like doodle noises, cable vibration, miniature bell ring, chair wheel squeak, air whoosh, paper-folding flaps.

Transition: the battery reaches the laptop screen and presses itself flat against it.

[12.5–15.0 seconds — A Healthier Return]

The battery character sticks to the laptop screen like a paper decal, then slowly sinks through the glass surface while waving at the protagonist.

It returns to its original screen position as a fully green battery icon, but the sky-blue cap and tiny yellow lightning patch remain visible for one playful beat before tucking inside the icon.

The protagonist moves their hand back toward the keyboard. Before typing resumes, the battery icon extends one thin white doodle arm from the screen and gently lowers the laptop lid halfway, refusing immediate overwork.

A second white doodle arm emerges and points toward the real window. Rough colored-pencil lines rapidly sketch a small glowing sunset, two birds, and a cup of tea across the wall beside the desk.

The protagonist pauses, removes both hands from the keyboard, picks up the real ceramic mug, and leans back.

The battery icon gives a satisfied green blink. A tiny paper blanket unfolds inside the screen corner. It pulls the blanket over itself, places the sky-blue cap beneath its head as a pillow, and closes its eyes.

The laptop screen dims naturally but does not shut off completely. The hand-drawn sunset lines remain softly glowing on the wall while the real curtain moves in the breeze.

Final image: imperfect handheld framing of the quiet desk, half-closed laptop, warm mug in the protagonist’s hand, real plant beside it, and the tiny sleeping green battery visible through the dim screen.

Camera: slow unplanned pull-back, slight tilt, natural focus shift from the sleeping icon to the plant and window.

Sound: laptop hinge movement, ceramic mug lift, curtain rustle, distant outdoor birds, computer hum becoming quieter, one tiny sleepy electronic sigh.

Fade out naturally with no music.

[Real-World and 2D Integration Style]

The animated elements must look physically handmade and imperfect:

rough frame-by-frame redraws
visible line boil
uneven crayon pressure
chalk grain
colored-pencil crosshatching
marker bleed
torn-paper edges
occasional erased construction lines
subtle frame-to-frame shape variation
soft glow halo without illuminating the entire room

Do not use smooth vector animation, glossy motion graphics, polished CGI morphing, perfect geometric curves, or clean digital icon animation.

Every transformation must happen through visible handmade processes:

paper folding
line stretching
scribble accumulation
erased and redrawn limbs
crayon strokes connecting
shapes compressing like accordion paper
outlines scattering and rebuilding
paper corners curling
marker fills changing color stroke by stroke

The battery must interact accurately with real objects and obey convincing foreground and background occlusion:

climbing over the laptop bezel
standing on individual keyboard keys
passing beneath the real pencil
moving behind the ceramic mug
resting on real plant leaves
following the physical charging cable
disappearing behind the chair leg
entering the laptop screen

Real props must remain live-action objects and must never transform into 3D cartoon versions.

[Camera Rules]

The handheld camera is always approximately half a beat behind the animated character.

The battery moves first; the camera reacts afterward through delayed:

pans
tilts
reframing
short forward steps
imperfect pull-backs
focus corrections

Preserve smartphone imperfections:

mild hand shake
exposure fluctuation near the window
autofocus hesitation
dark-area noise
natural motion blur
occasional partial cropping
slight rolling-shutter distortion during fast movement

Do not use stabilized gimbal movement, drone shots, perfect tracking, impossible live-action camera paths, highly cinematic lens flares, or overly shallow depth of field.

[Color Language]

Real room: warm beige, muted brown, dusty green, dim amber, screen blue.

Hand-drawn animation:

tired red
vacation sky blue
soft turquoise
sunflower yellow
orange
fully charged green
rough white outlines

Colors must remain vibrant but soft, with visible crayon and paper texture. Avoid neon cyberpunk lighting.

[Sound Design]

No background music.

Use only synchronized natural and hand-drawn sounds:

laptop fan and computer hum
real keyboard and mouse clicks
charging-cable movement
notebook pages
pencil scratches
ceramic mug contact
plant and curtain rustles
tiny paper footsteps
crayon-wave swishes
miniature rowing sounds
paper parachute flutter
soft electrical charging hum
playful charging bloops
scooter buzz
tiny bicycle-style bell
paper folding
laptop hinge sound
ceramic mug lift
distant birds
one sleepy electronic sigh

All animated sound effects must be gentle, cute, tactile, and comical. No dramatic impacts, loud bass, jump-scare sounds, or cinematic trailer effects.

[Negative Constraints]

No readable laptop text, no subtitles, no title cards, no logos, no brand interfaces, no watermarks, no extra humans, no visible protagonist face, no character identity changes, no missing blue cap, no missing lightning patch, no unrelated animated characters, no scary expressions, no monsters, no attacks, no fangs, no body horror, no threatening electricity, no dangerous fire, no violent impacts, no grotesque stretching, no hyperreal cartoon creature, no 3D animated props, no smooth CG morphing, no clean vector graphics, no overly polished compositing, no commercial lighting, no symmetrical advertisement composition, no perfectly stabilized camera, no background music, and no animation floating incorrectly in front of objects that should occlude it.

prompts.title: A Parting-Sea Story in Lacquer and Shell-Inlay Style
prompts.prompt:
【核心创意】

15 秒，16:9 横屏视频。东方传统漆画与螺钿镶嵌动画风格。红海、沙漠、天空和人物像一幅厚重的东方漆画浮雕，由黑漆、朱漆、沙金色、深蓝色漆面和蓝绿色螺钿组成。海浪具有贝壳镶嵌的反光纹理，山脉带有金色雕刻线和漆面开片。无对白。

摩西是一名年长男性，灰白色长胡须，穿米色长袍和深棕色披肩，手持木杖。全片保持脸部轮廓、胡须、服装和比例一致。

【画面过程说明】

0–3 秒｜极大全景：
朱红色漆面天空下，逃亡人群来到深蓝色漆海前。海浪由层叠的蓝绿色螺钿浮雕构成，像两面高大的墙挡住道路。摩西站在人群前方，举起木杖。

3–6 秒｜中景：
摩西将木杖指向海面。两侧蓝色漆面海浪开始向左右分开，金色雕刻线从海底中央向前延伸，逐渐形成一条沙金色道路。

6–9 秒｜俯拍：
红海完全分开，两面深蓝色螺钿水墙高高立起。人群沿中央道路向前行走，人物以简洁的漆器浮雕剪影表现，动作清晰有节奏。

9–12 秒｜侧面跟拍：
镜头沿金色道路向前移动，前景的螺钿水墙产生层叠反光和空间变化。摩西最后走入道路中央，回头确认人群已经通过。

12–15 秒｜大全景：
人群抵达远方沙金色岸边。摩西放下木杖，两侧漆面海浪缓慢向中央合拢，金色雕刻线逐渐消失，海面恢复平静。镜头拉远，金色阳光照亮摩西和人群。

声音：木杖触地声、漆面震动声、螺钿水纹碰撞声、风声、脚步声、低沉鼓点和庄严弦乐。海水合拢后转为平静流水声。无对白、无旁白。

不想要：纸张、剪纸、真实流体模拟、普通3D海水、现代服装、现代船只、人物飞行、海水爆炸、漆面融化、螺钿碎裂、字幕、Logo、乱码文字、黑屏转场。

必须保持：全片为东方传统漆画与螺钿镶嵌动画；摩西始终穿米色长袍、深棕披肩并手持木杖；红海必须从中央向左右两侧分开；结尾海水重新合拢，但摩西和人群安全抵达岸边。

prompts.title: A Milk-Tea Dialogue Workflow Demo
prompts.prompt:
真人实拍，清新唯美质感，温暖秋日氛围，5秒。
全程无背景音乐，无BGM，无配乐，无环境声，无风声无鸟鸣。
只有人物发出的声音：吸吮声、吞咽声、呼吸声、说话声。
参考图中的人物（手持蜜雪冰城红杯，正在用吸管喝饮料的美女）。
0—1秒，她正含着吸管小口吸吮（有轻微清晰吸吮声），眼神直视镜头，目光明亮且带满足笑意。发丝在秋日光晕下轻柔拂过脸颊。
1—2秒，她松开吸管，嘴唇合拢，喉间有清晰吞咽动作（吞咽声），随后轻吸一口气（微弱吸气声）。嘴角上扬，绽放甜美笑容。
2—3.8秒，她注视镜头，双唇清晰开合，柔声说道：<d>[中文]"这是秋天的第一杯奶茶，好甜呀~你也要喝吗？"</d>——声音清晰，语气娇俏，尾音微扬。
3.8—5秒，话音刚落，她眼角的笑意更浓，双手捧着奶茶的杯子，伸直手臂直接将杯子递向镜头，带有吸管的那一侧几乎怼到屏幕正前方（仿佛真的要喂给屏幕外的人喝），头轻轻向一侧歪了一下。长发随着动作微微晃动，最后画面定格在她将奶茶完全递到镜头前的瞬间。
【环境声】无。没有风声与杂音。
【背景音乐】无。全程无任何BGM与配乐。
【声音控制】仅包含人物发出的声音：吸吮声、吞咽声、吸气声、说话声。人物仅说"这是秋天的第一杯奶茶，好甜呀~你也要喝吗？"。
【表情控制】情绪温暖甜美，避免夸张大笑，说话时唇动明显，声音清晰，眼神和动作充满强烈的互动喂食感。

prompts.title: A First-Person Fantasy Battle Face-Off
prompts.prompt:
Strict first-person POV, male hero, face never visible. Visible only the hero’s hands, fingers, and forearms when needed for casting, dodging balance, and the final magnetic strike. Broad male hands, pronounced knuckles, short nails, pale or cool-toned skin, dark gray or black sleeves, thin geometric magic lines glowing cold white with a faint blue tint across the skin and wrists. The hands move with force, precision, and short controlled gestures, never soft or decorative. One continuous shot, no cuts, vertical cinematic dark fantasy, realistic body-driven camera motion, professional action cinematography with physical momentum and readable combat beats.

In a vast abandoned stone quarry under a gray overcast sky, high rock walls, two dark mine tunnel arches in the background, old metal rails cutting through wet red-brown mud, overturned mine carts, scattered stones, chains, broken timber, iron scrap, discarded armor, and bodies of fallen guards. The space feels cold, damp, heavy, and dusty, with a steel-gray, dirty brown, graphite, and cold white palette. A squad of dark armored quarry guards charges first across the rails and muddy ground, helmets closed, carrying short spears, shields, and hammers. Behind them, emerging from the shadow of the mine arch, comes the boss: a giant one-eyed heavy warrior, 4 to 5 meters tall, rough gray-pink skin, one large round eye in the center of the face, partial metal armor and leather straps across the chest, a massive shoulder plate on one side, thick legs, immense weight, and a huge heavy battle axe carried with brutal momentum.

The hero briefly raises one hand holding a smooth semi-transparent magnetic orb, tennis-ball sized, silver-white with a pale blue core, a dense metallic vortex inside, thin rings of light rotating around it. The orb already exists when first shown and does not appear from nowhere. As the smaller guards rush in, the hero crushes the orb. A cold magnetic pulse flashes through both forearms and into the ground. Weapons rip out of the charging soldiers’ hands, shields twist sideways, bolts, chains, rail spikes, loose armor plates, and metal fragments shudder and begin lifting from the quarry floor. Some smaller enemies are violently disarmed and thrown off balance immediately.

The boss accelerates forward through the chaos and swings the giant axe in a heavy horizontal attack. The hero performs a fast professional sidestep and body lean at the last instant; the blade tears across the foreground with dangerous proximity, kicking mud and dust past the camera. The boss recovers with heavy inertia, plants a foot, and launches a second brutal overhead strike. The hero ducks and slips under it in a sharp Hollywood-style evasive motion, the axe crashing into the ground and rails with a shower of dirt, sparks, and metal shock. The camera reacts like a real head-and-torso dodge: fast lateral movement, recoil, breath, then immediate refocus on the boss.

Now the magnetic field fully takes hold. The hero spreads both hands outward. Metal rises from every direction in a controlled field, not chaotic: torn rails, chains, bolts, iron rings, armor plates, mine cart fragments, shield metal. The pieces lift, align, and begin orbiting the giant in three clear rotating bands: a lower ring around the knees, a middle ring around the waist and abdomen, and a top ring around the chest and shoulders. The boss tries to wrench the axe free and charge again, but the orbit tightens around him. Tight center framing, with strong tracking drift and a low-angle hold to emphasize mass and danger.

The hero then sharply pulls both hands inward. All three magnetic rings slam tighter at once. Chains snap taut, rails bend into crushing arcs, armor plates collide and lock, metal fragments hammer into the boss’s torso and arms. The giant loses balance, staggers, and is forced down, the axe slipping and dropping into the mud. The metal cocoon constricts harder with brutal industrial weight and magnetic pressure, locking his body in place. Dust rises in waves, small rocks skitter, chains strain, and the one eye flares with panic and rage.

The hero thrusts both hands forward for the finisher. A narrow concentrated magnetic impulse forms between the palms, not fire, but a dense electromagnetic strike with a bright white core and pale blue edges. Brief micro push-in to the center of the boss’s chest. The pulse hits. Every piece of metal bound around the giant clamps inward simultaneously with one final crushing lock. The boss drops fully to his knees, torso compressed under chained rails and armored fragments, while a deep metallic shock ripples through the quarry and a wave of dust spreads across the ground.

End on the giant kneeling and trapped in a brutal iron cocoon, chains stretched tight, rails embedded across the torso, the fallen axe half-buried in mud, drifting dust, and a few small metal fragments still hovering and spinning before they finally drop.

Lighting: cold gray cloud light, faint wet reflections on stone, mud, and rails, cold silver-white illumination from the orb and the hero’s magic lines, sharp cold highlights on airborne metal during orbit, and a final white-blue flash from the magnetic impulse. Cinematic dark fantasy, anamorphic look, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field on hands and nearby metal, strong physical inertia, realistic heavy enemy movement, rails resisting as they tear from the ground, chains tightening with believable tension, mud displacement, rolling debris, and controlled magnetic motion that feels like a field, not random telekinesis. Sound design: low wind in the quarry, distant metal groans, armor rattle from the charging guards, tight compression sound as the orb is crushed, deep low-frequency magnetic hum, metal shrieking free from the ground, heavy boss footsteps, axe whooshes with real mass, impact crashes into mud and rails, chain strain, rail collisions, a sharp electromagnetic finisher, then a massive iron-lock resonance and fading dust-heavy rumble.

No third-person view, no visible hero face, no constant hands in frame, no random floating metal chaos, no weak enemy scale, no weightless boss, no fire magic look, no glowing fantasy laser beam, no cartoon physics, no soft combat, no low-detail quarry, no tiny axe, no silly enemy behavior, no zombie movement.

prompts.title: Living-Room Character Shots for Frame Extraction
prompts.prompt:
Photorealistic live-action.

The same young man is always inside the same modern living room.

The living room itself remains consistent throughout:
same sofa, same coffee table, same curtains, same walls, same general furniture layout.

This video is intentionally designed as a rapid collection of different still-photo variations for frame extraction.

Every 0.2-0.4 seconds, abruptly switch to a completely different shot.

Instant jump cuts.
No transitions.
No smooth camera movement between shots.
No morphing.
Continuity between shots is NOT required.

Keep exactly the same person, facial identity, age, body proportions and general hairstyle throughout.

Rapidly alternate between different camera angles and distances:

- front-facing medium shot sitting on the sofa
- three-quarter angle from the left
- three-quarter angle from the right
- profile shot from the side
- slightly high-angle shot looking down at him
- subtle low-angle shot from near the coffee table
- close-up portrait from the sofa
- chest-up shot
- waist-up shot
- wider shot showing most of the living room
- shot from behind the sofa looking toward him
- shot across the coffee table
- camera positioned near the television
- camera positioned near the window
- candid side angle as if photographed by another person in the room
- close shot from slightly below eye level
- slightly distant candid photograph

His position and pose also change instantly:

- sitting upright on the sofa
- leaning back casually
- resting one arm on the sofa
- leaning forward with elbows near knees
- sitting sideways
- looking directly into camera
- looking away from camera
- looking toward the window
- looking down at his smartphone
- holding a glass of water
- empty hands
- touching his hair
- one hand behind his head
- relaxed hands on his lap
- standing beside the sofa
- sitting on the floor leaning against the sofa

Create subtle appearance variations between shots:

- white T-shirt
- black T-shirt
- gray T-shirt
- navy T-shirt
- slightly oversized white T-shirt
- thin black-framed glasses
- no glasses
- slightly messy bangs
- bangs falling slightly across the forehead
- neatly arranged bangs
- slightly tousled bed hair
- neutral expression
- sleepy expression
- subtle gentle smile
- faint amused smile

Do not dramatically change the hairstyle.
Only subtle natural differences in hair arrangement.

Lighting can vary very slightly between shots while still feeling like the same home:
soft daylight,
slightly cloudy daylight,
warm indoor light,
window light on one side of the face.

Each composition should remain visible for approximately 0.2-0.4 seconds before instantly switching to another variation.

Prioritize:
sharp facial details,
natural skin texture,
realistic hair strands,
clean eyes,
natural hands,
photographic realism,
usable individual still frames.

Avoid motion blur.
Avoid distorted transition frames.
Avoid exaggerated body movement.
Avoid dramatic action.
Avoid changing the room.
Avoid changing facial identity.

The final result should feel like dozens of different casual lifestyle photographs taken in the same living room and rapidly edited together.
The video itself does not need to have natural continuity.
Individual frames are more important than temporal consistency.

prompts.title: The Office Welcomes an AI Employee
prompts.prompt:
"The Office (US) mockumentary style. Dunder Mifflin bullpen, mid-afternoon, harsh fluorescent office lighting, beige cubicles, cluttered desks, printers humming in the background. Handheld documentary camera with subtle shake, imperfect framing, sudden snap zooms during reactions, quick reframes as if a real documentary crew is trying to keep up. Muted office color palette, soft consumer-camera look.
Michael Scott proudly stands beside an empty desk with a laptop open. Dwight Schrute stands nearby, suspicious and visibly offended. Only Michael Scott and Dwight Schrute appear in the scene. The laptop represents an AI assistant named "Claude" but no third person appears.
DIALOGUE (≈15 seconds):
MICHAEL (excited):
"Dwight, I'd like you to meet our newest employee... Claude."
Dwight squints at the laptop.
DWIGHT:
"That's a computer."
Snap zoom to Michael.
MICHAEL (grinning):
"It's AI. It works faster... and it doesn't ask for vacation."
Beat.
DWIGHT (confident):
"It also cannot harvest beets."
Michael nods thoughtfully.
MICHAEL:
"...Fair point."
Beat.
Michael suddenly smiles again.
MICHAEL:
"But it can replace you."
Snap zoom to Dwight.
DWIGHT (dead serious):
"Then it's my enemy."
Dwight slowly closes the laptop lid as Michael stares into the documentary camera.
STYLE: Single-camera mockumentary, natural performances, dry deadpan humor, subtle handheld movement, documentary snap zooms, awkward pauses, realistic office ambience, no laugh track, with only Michael Scott and Dwight Schrute appearing in the scene."

prompts.title: A Garden Tragedy Across Two Models
prompts.prompt:
15秒古装电影写实剧情，花海庭园氛围，镜头丝滑自然推进，情绪反转强烈，人物表演细腻真实，有明显的“悠闲惬意 -> 突闻噩耗 -> 身体先崩 -> 情绪失控前的不可置信”递进。女人一开始站在花丛中悠闲赏景，手中轻轻摇着团扇，神情放松，眼神柔和，肩膀、手腕和呼吸都是松弛的，衣袖、发饰和流苏在微风里轻轻晃动，整个人毫无防备。画外突然传来带着慌乱和哭腔的女声：“夫人！老爷被斩首了！”

0-3秒：镜头穿过前景花丛丝滑推近到女人半身，女人悠闲地轻轻扇着团扇，神情安静惬意，嘴角甚至有一丝若有若无的闲适笑意，正在轻松看风景。

3-6秒：画外音猛地刺入：“夫人！老爷被斩首了！”女人的扇风动作瞬间断掉，手腕僵在半空，眼神猛地定住，呼吸像被一下掐断，头极轻地偏过去一点，像不敢相信自己听到了什么，脸上的放松感瞬间消失。

6-10秒：她猛地往后退一步，肩膀本能一缩，后背绷紧，脚下发软，差点站不稳跌倒，另一只手下意识抬起想抓住什么稳住自己却落空。与此同时，拿扇子的手因惊吓脱力，团扇从指间滑落，掉进脚边花丛里。她眼睛失神般睁大，嘴唇微张，想说话却几乎发不出声，只能失神低语：“你……说什么？”

10-15秒：镜头迅速压近到脸和上半身。她勉强站住，但整个人像魂被抽空，胸口呼吸乱掉，眼眶迅速泛红，泪意猛地涌上来。她不是立刻大哭，而是先陷入更狠的不可置信崩塌状态，表情从空白到震惊再到痛得不敢承认，嘴唇发抖，眼神溃散，像下一秒就要彻底撑不住。

音效与配乐：前半段是柔和古风环境音与轻微风声、衣袖与花叶摩擦声；噩耗传来的一瞬间配乐骤停半拍，再压入低沉悲音和压迫弦乐；团扇掉进花丛要有清晰轻响；整体情绪要像中国古装电影中的突变悲剧时刻。

负面限制：不要夸张嚎哭，不要立刻瘫倒，不要卡通化表演，不要慢动作，不要过多甩头动作，不要让团扇乱飞太远，不要字幕。

prompts.title: An 1890s Bird Plate Draws Itself
prompts.prompt:
@ Image1 is the sole visual authority for the folio spread, the wren, the hazel twig, the egg study, the foot sketch, the handwriting, the printed type, the paper, the foxing, the lighting, the palette, the layout and the horizontal composition. 

Animate this exact page without redesigning it. Preserve every existing mark, letter and colour in its final state.  

[Goal] Create a 15-second sequence in which this plate makes itself, and then the bird inside it comes quietly alive. One continuous, locked, straight-on overhead composition. No camera movement, no cuts, no cropping, no perspective change, no page turning.  

[Sequence]  0-2.4 seconds: Begin on blank aged ivory paper — the empty spread, correct in paper texture, chain lines, foxing and lighting, but carrying no image, no writing and no type. A faint graphite underdrawing appears across the right page in light searching strokes, finding the wren's posture and the line of the twig. 
A few construction marks overshoot and are left uncorrected.  

2.4-6 seconds: Engraved ink linework draws itself over the pencil, following the exact contours of the finished plate — outline first, then hatching building the shadow under the wing, the barring of the tail, the texture of the twig. The rectangular plate mark presses into the paper around the image with a soft physical impression, lifting the paper very slightly at its edge.  

6-10.5 seconds: Watercolour floods in. Washes enter the printed outlines and settle into them, warm russet across the back, buff along the eyebrow stripe, muted olive on the twig, each wash landing exactly within the shapes of the finished plate and overrunning the line in the same few places the reference does. 

The colour blooms wet and then visibly dries, darkening slightly at the edges. On the left page, the sepia handwriting writes itself line by line from the top, in a period cursive hand that is elegant, cramped and only partly legible. The small egg study fills with colour and the pencil foot sketch appears faintly beside it.  
10.5-13 seconds: The printed type impresses into the right page — TROGLODYTES TROGLODYTES, then The Common Wren beneath it, then PLATE XVII in the top right corner. Foxing spots deepen. The last details resolve: the highlight in the bird's eye, the fine barring on the flank. The page settles. Everything on the spread is now exactly as in @[ref img].  13-15 seconds: The page stays completely still and completely flat 

— it is paper and it behaves like paper. But the printed bird begins to breathe. Its flank rises and falls very slightly. It blinks once. It turns its head a few degrees and holds, alert, looking past the viewer at something outside the page. The cocked tail gives one small twitch. It does not fly, it does not leave the plate, it does not become three-dimensional, and it does not look at the viewer. Settle into a living idle: the bird breathing, one more slow blink, the paper still.  Render as photoreal archival photography of a real object under warm north-window light. Keep the printed page flat and matte with no glow, no emission, no glint and no digital sheen. 

Keep the two motion layers distinct: the page is a made thing being made, the bird is alive. Keep all type, handwriting, marks and geometry fixed once they appear.  Do not introduce any new text, letters, numerals, marks, birds, objects, hands, tools, logos, captions, borders, watermarks or page numbers. Do not turn or lift the page. Do not move, rotate or scale the camera. Do not zoom. Do not add glow, neon, coloured light, lens flare, bokeh or shallow-focus racking. 

Do not make the bird photoreal or three-dimensional — it must remain a hand-coloured engraving that happens to be alive. Do not have it fly, hop, open its beak wide, or leave the plate.  

Audio: fine graphite scratching on rough paper; the dry precise scrape of a steel nib; the deep soft compression of a plate press; a sable brush loaded with water moving across paper; paper fibres settling; the quiet room tone of a study with a slow long-case clock ticking somewhere behind. 
At 13 seconds, one Eurasian wren song — sudden, intricate and far louder than anything that small should produce — then the room tone returns and the clock keeps going. No music, no dialogue, no narration, no electronic tones.

VISUAL DIRECTION

CAMERA

ENVIRONMENT

【目标】  制作一支15秒、9:16竖版的厦门漆线雕非遗工艺短片。  主题：  “一根线，走完三百年的手艺。”  影片完整呈现：  备料 → 舂打漆线土 → 搓线 → 盘线成纹 → 安金 → 贴金 → 清理完成 → 包装 → 上架  快速剪辑， 字幕驱动， 即使完全静音观看也能理解整个制作过程。  视觉采用真实高端人文纪录广告摄影：  35毫米胶片电影质感， 细腻颗粒， 浅景深， 大量微距， 自然手持， 运动非常克制， 不做旅游宣传片， 不做华丽国潮特效， 不做博物馆宣传片。  重点永远是：  手， 线， 漆， 金箔， 纹样， 时间。

【金色就是时间】  整支影片必须存在一条不可逆的视觉变化：  画面中的“金色”从无到有，并越来越多。  影片开始：  只有黑、 深褐、 砖灰、 暗红， 几乎看不到金色。  漆线开始盘绕以后， 画面出现第一点暖金。  贴金以后， 金色迅速扩大。  作品完成时， 精细金色纹样覆盖主体。  最后上架时， 整个作品被温暖自然光照亮。  每一个镜头都必须比前一个镜头拥有更多的金色。  这个变化不能倒退。  金色就是这支影片的时间。

【固定字幕牌】  整个影片始终只有一个字幕牌。  位置：  画面下方三分之一， 水平居中， 所有镜头完全相同的位置。  造型：  非常克制的小型圆角矩形， 深朱砂红底， 暖米白文字。  两行文字：  第一行： 较细字体， 显示“工序”。  第二行： 粗体， 显示一句极短的动作描述。  字幕牌：  不移动， 不放大， 不缩小， 不淡入淡出， 不跳动。  只在指定剪辑点瞬间更换文字。  字体必须清楚、正确。

【镜头序列】
 0—1.7秒  主镜头。  深夜般昏暗的传统工作台。  一盏暖色工作灯只照亮双手。  桌面上可以看到：  陈年砖粉质感的细粉、 深色大漆材料、 正在被反复捶打揉合的深褐色漆线土。  工匠双手将材料反复捶、压、揉， 逐渐形成柔软、富有韧性的泥团。  周围环境全部沉入黑暗。  没有金色。  字幕：  “第一道” “捶土成线”
1.7—3.3秒  极端微距。  一小块漆线土放在传统搓线板之间。  工匠双手稳定向前推动搓板。  原本粗厚的泥条逐渐被搓成长而均匀的细线。  摄影机贴得非常近。  能够清楚看到：  漆线轻微湿润的表面， 细小纹理， 手指压力， 线条被不断拉细。  背景完全虚化。  字幕保持：  “第一道” “捶土成线”
 3.3—5.0秒  主镜头。  朱红漆面的器物坯体第一次出现。  工匠用极细工具， 将刚刚搓好的柔软漆线轻轻落在器物表面。  第一根漆线贴上去。  只有一根。  然后第二根。  线条开始形成第一个小小的卷云纹。  画面第一次出现非常微弱的暖色高光。  字幕：  “第二道” “一线起纹”
 5.0—6.8秒  微距插入镜头。  镜头几乎贴着器物表面横向观察。  工匠用竹制细工具推动漆线：  盘， 绕， 结， 堆。  几根不足毫米级视觉尺度的柔软漆线， 逐渐形成具有明显高度差的浮凸纹样。  线条之间非常紧密。  卷云、缠枝、如意形态逐渐出现。  重点展示：  线并不是画上去的，  而是真正一根一根盘出来的。  字幕保持：  “第二道” “一线起纹”
6.8—8.6秒  主镜头。  器物已经完成大部分漆线纹样。  摄影机非常缓慢地向前推近。  工匠旋转器物。  光线擦过密集漆线表面。  能够看到：  高低起伏， 盘绕结构， 层层叠叠的线性浮雕。  这时依然没有真正的金箔。  只有漆线自身的暖棕色。  字幕：  “第三道” “盘线成雕”
8.6—10.2秒  全片最重要的声音与视觉高潮。  极端微距。  一张极薄金箔悬在空气里轻微颤动。  几乎没有重量。  工匠屏住动作， 用传统工具将金箔缓缓落向已经完成的漆线纹样。  金箔接触表面的瞬间，  贴住。  镜头保持。  不要快速切走。  细小金箔自然贴合漆线的高低起伏， 金色第一次大面积出现。  字幕：  “第四道” “一片金落下”
10.2—11.7秒  微距。  柔软毛刷轻轻扫过作品表面。  多余金箔碎屑被一点点扫开。  随着刷毛经过，  清晰、 锐利、 细密的金色漆线纹样从杂乱金箔中显现。  这是第二个视觉高潮。  镜头必须清楚表现：  杂乱金箔  变成  精确金色纹样。  字幕：  “第五道” “金纹醒来”
11.7—12.8秒  主镜头。  完成后的作品放在深色木质工作台上。  工匠用双手缓慢旋转检查。  没有任何戏剧表演。  只检查：  纹样， 漆面， 金箔， 边缘， 细节。  自然光已经明显进入工作室。  金色纹样被晨光照亮。  字幕：  “第六道” “最后一眼”
12.8—13.8秒  插入镜头。  作品被轻轻放入定制包装盒。  暖米色软布包裹器物。  盒盖缓慢合上。  手将包装盒推向画面前方。  纸张、 布料、 木盒均保持真实触感。  不要奢侈品浮夸包装。  字幕：  “第七道” “入盒”
13.8—15秒  最终镜头。  切到极简现代非遗精品店。  温暖自然晨光。  深色木制陈列架。  一只手将完成的漆线雕作品从画面侧面轻轻放到展示台中央。  手退出画面。  作品保持完全静止。  金色漆线在自然光中形成极精细的浮雕反光。  背景虚化。  最后0.6秒不再运动。  字幕：  “第八道” “上架”  画面中央仅允许出现一句极小的中文：  “厦门漆线雕”  下面更小：  “一线成雕”  最终画面必须像高端工艺品牌的静态产品摄影。  绝对不要继续运动。

【色彩】  整支影片限制在以下颜色：  陈年砖粉灰， 生漆深褐， 木质黑褐， 朱砂红， 暖米白， 金箔金。  影片前半段：  黑褐色占主导。  中段：  朱红逐渐出现。  后半段：  金色逐渐占据视觉中心。  禁止：  青蓝科技色， 霓虹， 紫色， 赛博朋克， 高饱和国潮配色。  金色必须来自真实金箔和真实光线。  不能使用发光特效制造金色。

【摄影】  全片使用真实人文纪录摄影语言。  大量：  100毫米微距镜头， 近距离手部特写， 极浅景深， 35毫米胶片颗粒。  摄影机运动非常少。  允许：  轻微呼吸感手持， 一次非常缓慢的轴向推进， 极细微的跟随动作。  禁止：  无人机， 环绕运镜， 快速推拉， 旋转镜头， 甩镜， 变焦冲击， 慢动作， 速度渐变， 镜头炫技。  镜头永远尊重手艺本身。

【声音】  全片没有任何音乐。  没有旁白。  没有人物对白。  没有广告配音。  只使用现场真实声音。
 0—3.3秒：  凌晨安静工作室。  远处非常轻的环境底噪。  漆线土落在木板上的闷响。  手掌揉压材料的湿润摩擦声。  搓板来回运动产生细密摩擦声。   3.3—8.6秒：  整体声音进一步降低。  细工具轻碰器物表面的声音。  手指移动。  漆线被放下时极轻微的黏连声音。  器物缓慢旋转时木架产生细小摩擦声。   8.6—10.2秒：  这是整支影片最重要的声音时刻。  其他环境声音全部压低。  只留下：  金箔极薄的纸张颤动声， 轻微呼吸， 工具触碰金箔的细小声音。  金箔落到漆线表面的瞬间，  接近安静。  让观众感觉自己离这张金箔只有几厘米。   10.2—12.8秒：  软毛刷扫过金箔。  细碎金箔摩擦。  器物在木架上轻轻旋转。   12.8—15秒：  包装纸折叠。  布料摩擦。  盒盖轻轻合上。  随后进入店铺：  作品底座接触木质展台，  “嗒”。  最后接近完全安静。  只保留非常微弱的室内环境声。

【核心视觉原则】  不要把它拍成：  “传统文化宣传片”。  要把它拍成：  “世界顶级手工艺品牌新品诞生纪录”。  传统来自材料和工艺，  高级感来自摄影、节奏和克制。

【禁止项】  不得出现任何与产品无关的文字。  不得出现旅游宣传标语。  不得出现：  “匠心传承” “非遗之美” “千年文化” “东方美学” 等泛化宣传口号。  不得出现不存在的历史年代。  不得出现虚假的皇宫或寺庙场景。  不得增加和尚、古装人物、舞狮、灯笼等所谓中国元素。  不得把漆线雕表现成木雕、石雕或刀刻。  重点必须明确表现：  搓线， 放线， 盘线， 绕线， 堆线， 贴金。  不得用三维特效让纹样自动生长。  不得让漆线自行移动。  所有纹样必须由人的手完成。  不得使用魔法粒子。  不得让金箔发光。  不得使用人工光晕。  不得使用慢动作。  不得加入速度渐变。  不得加入转场音效。  不得使用呼啸声。  不得出现手机界面。  不得出现电商界面。  不得出现价格。  不得出现二维码。  不得出现网站。  不得出现社交媒体账号。  不得出现水印。  不得增加第十个镜头。  最终画面完全静止。

prompts.title: Two Glaciologists Enter a Blue-Ice Cave
prompts.prompt:
EXPEDITION:
Two glaciologists enter a newly formed ice cave to document its internal structure before seasonal melting changes it.
EXPLORERS: Two researchers, both wearing crampons, helmets and headlamps, carrying compact measurement equipment.
SHOOT WINDOW: 7:05 AM – 7:20 AM Early morning outside. Overcast sky. Cold blue daylight enters through the cave entrance.
LOCATION: Glacial valley, massive blue ice formation, narrow cave entrance, translucent walls, frozen water flowing beneath the surface.
RECORDING STYLE: First-person expedition footage mixed with a second camera operator. Headlamps create moving pools of light across the ice. Natural breathing and footsteps remain prominent.
15-SECOND EXPLORATION:
00:00–00:03 → Researchers squeeze through the narrow entrance.
00:03–00:06 → Camera reveals deep blue translucent ice walls surrounding them.
00:06–00:09 → One researcher notices water suddenly moving beneath a transparent ice floor.
00:09–00:12 → Both carefully step backward and examine the changing surface.
00:12–00:15 → They mark the location and begin retreating toward daylight.
AUDIO: Boots scraping ice, dripping water, distant cracking, breathing, muffled voices.
REALISM DIRECTIVE: Ice must behave like real compressed glacier ice, not glass. Light scatters through the walls naturally. No fantasy formations, supernatural elements or impossible cave geometry.

prompts.title: A Cybernetic Operative Appears on a Stat Panel
prompts.prompt:

Animate this exact screen without redesigning it. Preserve every existing label, stat value, diagnostic value, icon, panel boundary, and final UI position.

[GOAL]
Create a polished 15-second futuristic cyber-operative character dossier opening. The feeling is elite black-ops intelligence software coming online and identifying an extremely dangerous enhanced operative.

Use one continuous locked straight-on full-screen composition. No camera movement, cuts, reframing, cropping, zooming, rotation, or perspective distortion.

[SEQUENCE]

0–2.2 seconds:
Begin from near-black charcoal with only extremely faint cyan interface traces visible.

A thin horizontal biometric scanner travels downward through the screen, gradually revealing ZENITH’s silhouette and the outer dossier frame.

Fine digital particles, tiny grid points, circuit traces, and subtle cyan data noise activate progressively.

ZENITH remains almost motionless in shadow.

His cybernetic arm gives one extremely subtle mechanical initialization twitch as internal joints power on.

2.2–5.5 seconds:
The OPERATIVE DOSSIER header, FILE ID: ZN-7X-00, ZENITH nameplate, CYBERNETIC OPERATIVE subtitle, PROFILE panel, portrait frame, biometric panel, and THREAT LEVEL panel resolve through precise line-draw and scanning animations.

Reveal the existing profile information exactly:

HEIGHT: 6’2” / 188 cm
BUILD: Lean / Athletic
AFFILIATION: Unknown

The THREAT LEVEL display resolves into:
EXTREME

ZENITH emerges completely from darkness into the exact referenced standing pose.

He takes one controlled breath, subtly raises his chest and shoulders, then settles.

His stern gaze sharpens toward the viewer.

Maintain his exact angular face, slick black hairstyle, lean proportions, black fitted suit, cyan circuitry, and single exposed cybernetic arm.

Thin cyan suit lines illuminate progressively from the upper torso toward the legs and cybernetic arm.

5.5–10.8 seconds:

Each bar fills smoothly left-to-right and lands precisely on the existing final value:

AGILITY — 96

ENDURANCE — 88

Simultaneously, the biometric body scan draws vertically through the miniature human silhouette.

Small waveform and graph elements activate with subtle believable data movement.

The CYBERNETIC ARM DIAGNOSTICS section powers online from shoulder to fingertips.

Callout lines trace toward the mechanical joints while the existing diagnostic values resolve exactly:

MOTOR UNITS — 100%
STRENGTH OUTPUT — 132%
RESPONSE TIME — 0.008s
SENSOR SUITE — ONLINE
GRIP FORCE — 2,400 N
SYSTEM INTEGRITY — 100% / OPTIMAL

The circular SYSTEM INTEGRITY indicator completes one clean clockwise sweep and locks at 100%.

ZENITH’s mechanical fingers make one tiny natural calibration movement before returning to the exact referenced resting position.

10.8–13.3 seconds:

Existing specialization icons receive brief controlled cyan illumination:
STEALTH INFILTRATION
CQC EXPERT
CYBERNETIC ENHANCEMENT
INTEL GATHERING

Existing equipment cards resolve cleanly:
SHADOW BLADE
EMP SHARD
SMOKE DISPERSER
DATA SPIKE

Do not physically place these weapons or tools into ZENITH’s hands. They remain UI inventory graphics only.

A subtle electronic current travels through the cyan circuitry across ZENITH’s suit and into the cybernetic arm.

The mechanical shoulder, elbow, wrist, and finger joints produce extremely restrained servo adjustments.

ZENITH tightens his organic fist slightly.

He gives one natural blink while maintaining his intimidating expression and exact stance.

13.3–15 seconds:
The lower dossier statement and STATUS: ACTIVE indicator reach full brightness.

A controlled cyan system pulse travels once around the outer interface frame and converges briefly behind ZENITH.

His cybernetic arm emits a restrained internal energy glow through existing cyan seams—no new effects or weapons.

The pulse settles immediately.

Hold the fully assembled screen matching @[ref img] exactly.

ZENITH continues subtle breathing.
Tiny cybernetic servos remain alive.
Cyan suit circuitry gives a gentle idle pulse.
Biometric waveforms move minimally.
Small particles shimmer.
All text, numbers, icons, diagnostic values, stat bars, and UI geometry remain completely stable and readable.

[CHARACTER MOTION]
ZENITH is disciplined and nearly motionless.

Movement must remain minimal and believable:
controlled breathing,
one blink,
small shoulder adjustment,
slight organic fist tightening,
tiny cybernetic finger calibration,
subtle mechanical joint settling.

Do not turn his body away from the referenced pose.
Do not change his facial structure, hairstyle, costume, proportions, cybernetic-arm design, or expression language.

[UI MOTION]
Premium classified-military sci-fi HUD animation.

Use:
precise line drawing,
scanner sweeps,
data ticks,
segmented stat fills,
restrained cyan confirmation pulses,
biometric scan lines,
mechanical diagnostic tracing,
very subtle particles,
clean system boot transitions.

Keep every panel, icon, label, number, and geometric boundary fixed once revealed.

No floating panels.
No rearranging the interface.
No unnecessary glitching.
No aggressive flicker.
No holographic elements crossing over readable text.

[VISUAL STYLE]
Crisp premium futuristic game UI.
Clean stylized 2D animation matching the reference.
Dark charcoal-black interface with cyan/teal illumination and white typography.
Sharp angular graphic character rendering.
Subtle depth separation between ZENITH and the HUD while preserving the exact flat front-facing composition.
High readability throughout.

[STRICT PRESERVATION]
Do not introduce:

new numbers,
new stats,
new icons,
extra cybernetic limbs,
additional weapons,
extra characters,
new logos,
captions,
environment scenery,
camera motion,
screen shake,

new panels,
or additional objects.

Short restrained confirmation tones as each metric locks.
Quiet mechanical servo clicks from the cybernetic arm.

prompts.title: A Miniature Highway Hidden Inside the Fridge
prompts.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description

Shot 1 A realistic suburban kitchen at night. A man casually walks to the refrigerator and opens the door. The camera starts just behind his shoulder and slowly pushes closer as bright refrigerator light illuminates his confused face.
Inside the refrigerator is an incredibly detailed miniature highway network integrated naturally between the food. Several lanes of tiny moving cars weave between milk cartons, jars, leftovers, vegetables, and drink bottles. Tiny headlights and brake lights glow realistically.
The camera moves closer into the refrigerator interior as if entering this tiny world.

A miniature traffic jam forms beside a tipped container leaking orange juice across one lane like a flooded roadway. Tiny construction vehicles arrive. Small workers in reflective clothing place cones and redirect traffic around the spill.

A tiny tow truck pulls a stalled car away. Another vehicle honks impatiently. Cars merge aggressively around a yogurt container.

The man slowly reaches one hand toward the highway. Several tiny cars immediately slam on their brakes. A miniature police officer begins angrily waving at his enormous finger to move away.

The man freezes, completely baffled.

The camera finishes extremely close to the refrigerator highway as traffic starts moving again around his stationary finger.

overall_soundscape

Quiet kitchen ambience, refrigerator hum, refrigerator door opening, tiny engines, miniature car horns, distant tiny sirens, construction equipment, subtle liquid splashing from the orange juice spill.

non_diegetic_music

None.

prompts.title: A Morning Begins from Bed to a Seaside Terrace
prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic lifestyle vlog video, vertical 9:16, featuring the same young woman throughout the entire video. Preserve her facial identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, skin tone and overall appearance consistently in every shot. She wears the same outfit throughout: fitted white V-neck T-shirt with a small subtle logo, blue denim jeans, natural makeup, long softly wavy brown hair.

0:00–0:01 — Wake-up:
Close-up inside a beautiful bright bedroom. The woman is lying comfortably on the bed, slowly wakes up, stretches naturally and opens her eyes. She is NOT filming a vlog yet and does not hold a phone or camera. Soft morning sunlight enters through the curtains.

0:01–0:02 — Gets up:
Medium shot. She sits up on the bed, smiles softly, fixes her hair and gets ready to start her morning. Natural, effortless movement.

0:02–0:03 — Walks to window:
She walks toward the large glass balcony door/window. Camera follows her naturally from behind/side.

0:03–0:04 — Seaside reveal:
She opens the curtains/door and looks outside. Reveal a breathtaking blue ocean, coastal hills, flowers, balcony and beautiful morning sunlight. She smiles happily while taking in the view.

0:04–0:05 — Steps outside:
She walks out onto the seaside terrace. Gentle ocean breeze moves her hair naturally. Wide cinematic shot showing the beautiful surroundings.

0:05–0:06 — VLOG START:
Only now she starts filming herself in handheld selfie-vlog style. She looks into the camera with a bright natural smile and says:
“Good morning!”

0:06–0:07 — Show the view:
She turns the camera away from herself and slowly pans across the stunning ocean, coastal mountains, flowers and terrace. Smooth handheld vlog movement.

0:07–0:08 — Back to selfie:
Selfie shot. She looks into the camera and happily says:
“This place is just perfect!”

0:08–0:09 — Location reveal:
Wide cinematic shot of the cozy seaside terrace with wooden table, chairs, plants and flowers overlooking the ocean.

0:09–0:10 — Walk to table:
Medium tracking shot as she walks toward the table, enjoying the view. Her hair and T-shirt move gently in the sea breeze.

0:10–0:11 — Sit and relax:
She sits at the seaside table, smiling peacefully and enjoying the ocean view. A refreshing orange-colored juice is placed on the table.

0:11–0:12 — Juice close-up:
Cinematic close-up of her hand picking up the glass of fresh orange juice. Beautiful ocean bokeh in the background, natural sunlight reflecting through the glass.

0:12–0:13 — Vlog toast:
Selfie shot. She raises the juice toward the camera with a cheerful smile and says:
“Cheers to good days!”

0:13–0:14 — Happy close-up:
Beautiful close-up of her smiling naturally at the camera, ocean and warm sunlight softly blurred behind her.

0:14–0:15 — Ending:

prompts.title: A Pilot beside a Destroyed Mecha

从 Image 1 的准确瞬间开始。地面高度的中广角构图，损毁的巨大机械头占据左侧大部分画面，成年女性飞行员跪在右下方泥水中，额头紧压机械下颌，双手撑住冰冷装甲。远处荒原、残骸和低矮山脊保持模糊。镜头以极慢、稳定的贴地推进逐渐靠近她，不绕行、不升高、不切镜头，不把机械头完整展示成英雄镜头。
