00:03.20至00:06.20：她突然停止呼吸，像是听见了极微弱的东西。她只将头抬离装甲几厘米，把左耳贴向机械面部靠近眼部的位置。不要完全站起，不要转向镜头。她的眼睛因为恐惧而睁大，嘴唇微微张开，但声音卡在喉咙里。机械眼内部出现一次极弱、断续的暗橙色电流，亮不到半秒，随即熄灭。内部传出一个破损继电器尝试接通的声音，然后彻底停止。机械本体绝不复活，不转头，不眨眼，不主动移动。

00:06.20至00:09.30：她终于理解没有回应。下颌先绷紧，鼻翼颤动，眼泪与雨水混在一起。她把右手握成拳，只重重击打机械下颌一次。撞击来自肩部和躯干的真实发力，拳头接触金属后立即失去力量，沿泥湿装甲滑下。她没有连续捶打，也没有夸张甩头。她贴近机械面部，用成年女性低哑、断裂、几乎无法完整呼吸的英语说：

每个词之间都有无法控制的吸气，最后一个“please”很轻，不要喊叫，不要演成舞台式哭泣。

00:09.30至00:12.60：最后一个词结束后停留0.4秒。机械内部没有任何回应。她再次尝试吸气，但胸口只完成一半动作，喉咙发出短促、压抑的失败声音。她用双手抓住装甲边缘，试图把自己的身体拉近，仿佛可以用身体重量迫使它醒来。双臂短暂绷紧，然后力量彻底消失。她的脊柱向内折叠，额头重新撞回机械下颌，肩膀开始不对称地剧烈颤抖。一声无法压住的低沉哭声从胸腔逸出，但不形成第二句台词。

prompts.title: Multiplication Tables with Fish Pairs
prompts.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Adorable rounded 3D animation for preschool children, soft studio lighting, subtle contact shadows, smooth gradients, and a calm uncluttered vertical composition on a clean off-white background with a very soft pale-blue glow behind the center. Use a restrained palette of off-white, warm orange, cream, turquoise blue, and dark gray: orange is the cat, turquoise is the fish and every correct answer, dark gray is the equation. The camera is a Static Shot for the entire film. A small smiling cat mascot bounces gently into the upper area: a big rounded head on a short chubby body, warm orange fur, a cream muzzle, cream belly and cream paw tips, two small rounded triangle ears with pale pink inner lining, round full cheeks, simple black dot eyes, tiny whiskers, and a thick rounded tail. It lands with a soft squash-and-stretch, its tail curls up once behind it, and it taps the air with one front paw, creating a spreading circular pale-blue water ripple. The ripple opens outward and reveals a three-by-three grid of nine small empty pale-blue water pools in the lower half of the frame, with a clear empty space for one large equation above them. A warm young Japanese female narrator with a bright, soft voice (S1) chants in a steady rhythmic sing-song counting cadence, one line per beat, and begins: <d>[Japanese] にのだん!</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:01.200, one large thick rounded dark-gray equation appears in the upper space and is rewritten twice in place, holding each state clearly on its own beat: first "2 × 1 = 2", then "2 × 2 = 4", then "2 × 3 = 6". On each new equation, exactly one matching pair of two plump turquoise-blue fish drops together into the next empty water pool with a small splash. The two fish of a pair are identical, side by side, both facing right and slightly offset so both are clearly countable, each with a cream belly, a triangular tail, and one round black eye. The pairs fill the top row from left to right, and the answer numeral turns turquoise as each pair lands. At the end of this shot exactly three pools in the top row are filled, each holding exactly two fish, for six fish in total; six pools remain empty. (S1) chants on the beat: <d>[Japanese] にいちがに。ににんがし。にさんがろく。</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:04.700, a soft pale-blue water ripple wipes across the frame and the same large equation continues to be rewritten in place on each beat: "2 × 4 = 8", then "2 × 5 = 10", then "2 × 6 = 12". One matching pair of two fish drops into the next empty pool on each new equation, filling the middle row from left to right, and the answer numeral turns turquoise as each pair lands. Two-digit answers stay large, correctly formed, and fully readable. The three pairs already in the top row stay exactly where they are and do not move, change, or multiply. At the end of this shot exactly six pools are filled, each holding exactly two fish, for twelve fish in total; three pools remain empty. (S1) chants on the beat: <d>[Japanese] にしがはち。にごじゅう。にろくじゅうに。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:08.100, a soft pale-blue water ripple wipes across the frame and the large equation is rewritten in place on each beat for the last time: "2 × 7 = 14", then "2 × 8 = 16", then "2 × 9 = 18". One matching pair of two fish drops into the next empty pool on each new equation, filling the bottom row from left to right, and the answer numeral turns turquoise as each pair lands. The six pairs already placed stay exactly where they are and do not move, change, or multiply. At the end of this shot all nine pools are filled, each holding exactly two fish, for eighteen fish in total. (S1) chants on the beat: <d>[Japanese] にしちじゅうし。にはちじゅうろく。にくじゅうはち。</d>

[Shot 5] At 00:12.100, the final equation "2 × 9 = 18" stays in the upper space and its turquoise answer numeral "18" gently enlarges once and settles. Below it, the nine pairs of fish gain small friendly smiles and their tails flick once, in a quick wave from the top-left pool to the bottom-right pool, each pair flicking together as one. The same warm-orange cat mascot from [Shot 1], unchanged in every detail, bounces in at the lower edge beside the grid and points up toward it with one front paw while its tail curls once and small pale-blue sparkles rise around it. Exactly nine pools remain, each still holding exactly two fish, and no new objects enter. (S1) says: <d>[Japanese] よく できました!</d> Hold the complete grid, the equation, and the cat clearly and without further motion until the film ends exactly at 00:15.000.

Throughout the entire film, keep the camera a Static Shot, keep the off-white background clean and empty, keep the single equation large, thick, rounded, correctly shaped, and centered in the upper space, and keep the fish design identical in every shot. Every filled pool always holds exactly two fish - never one, never three - and the two fish of a pair always arrive together, land together, and stay together as one unit. The cat must look exactly the same in [Shot 1] and [Shot 5], identical in fur color, head and body shape, ears, eyes, and tail, and it never appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], or [Shot 4]. Only one cat is ever on screen, it stays beside or above the grid, and it never stands on, reaches into, covers, or eats any fish. Only one equation is ever visible at a time. Display only numerals and the symbols × and =. Do not generate any hiragana, katakana, kanji, Latin words, or any other written characters anywhere on screen. Fish only ever accumulate, never disappear, never leave their pool once placed, and never overlap; the number of filled pools must exactly match the multiplier of the current equation, and the total fish count must exactly match the answer numeral, reaching exactly eighteen fish in nine pools at the end. Avoid fast camera movement, sudden cuts, cluttered backgrounds, tiny typography, warped or duplicated numerals, reversed two-digit numbers, wrong counts, extra or missing fish, unpaired single fish, fish appearing before their equation, fish swimming freely around the frame, realistic or scaly fish anatomy, scary expressions, harsh colors, heavy motion blur, and loud or distracting sound effects.

overall_soundscape: A soft double water plop sounds each time a pair of fish drops into a pool. A light padded paw tap sounds when the cat touches the air, and one single soft kitten meow occurs as the cat first bounces into frame. Gentle spreading water ripples mark the two transitions, and a small confirmation chime sounds each time an answer numeral turns turquoise. Tiny shimmer sparkles occur around the cat at the end.

non_diegetic_music: A light nursery jingle at a steady moderate tempo using marimba, soft celesta, and gently plucked strings, with a clear repeating beat that the chant lands on. Begin with a single marimba figure, add one instrument at each row of the grid, and thin back out for the final line. Resolve with a clean rising three-note chime landing at 15.000 seconds.

prompts.title: A Korean Performance Test of Tears and Anger
prompts.prompt:
REFERENCE / 角色参考表绑定
Image 1（7格参考图）：作为本场生成唯一的面容骨骼、发型、妆造与表情形变基准。
基础外观：提取20岁出头东亚女性特征，微湿凌乱深色发丝、烟灰色大圆领棉质T恤、修长颈部与锁骨。完全忽略多格画板排版与灰色底色，场景中只生成单人。

表情形态映射：
00:00–00:05 严格对应参考图【左下：张嘴咆哮痛哭态】；
00:05–00:10 严格对应参考图【中下：死死抿嘴下巴皱缩态】；
00:10–00:15 严格对应参考图【右下/顶部：双眼通红泛泪空洞注视态】。
CORE SPECIFICATIONS & 16:9 FRAMING / 核心规格与构图
画幅与时长：15.00秒无缝单镜头（长镜头），16:9宽银幕电影画幅，24fps自然运动模糊。
镜头与机位：85mm T1.4电影人像定焦镜头，固定机位平视过肩紧凑特写（Tight MCU），极浅景深。
构图锚定：女主角面部位于画面中央偏左三分之二区域，双眼严格定位于画面上方三分之一水平线。画面右侧前景保留小面积（15%–20%）虚焦深色肩膀剪影，建立极度逼仄的面对面对峙纵深。

LIGHTING, TEXTURE & TEAR PHYSICS / 光影与生理写实
电影级高反差布光：前方3000K暖色主光照亮面部泪痕与咬肌起伏，后方锐利琥珀金轮廓光勾勒发丝边缘与颈部线条，将主体从深沉暗色背景中剥离。
眼球与表皮细节：眼白布满充血红血丝，下眼睑水肿泛红，双眼瞳孔内反射出锐利明亮的眼神光。
泪腺与液体物理：大量泪水在眼眶内剧烈震颤，连续湿润的泪痕顺着鼻唇沟、下颌线向下流淌，在颈部汇聚并滑入锁骨窝，高光反射清晰。

15-SECOND CONTINUOUS BEATS & RUTHLESS KOREAN DIALOGUE / 动作与恶毒台词
BEAT 1 | 00:00.000–00:05.200 | 暴怒撕裂与恶毒咆哮（对应左下张嘴爆哭）
肌肉力学：下颌猛烈向下脱臼般张开，完全露出上下牙齿与舌面；胸锁乳突肌剧烈暴起；胸口急促起伏。眉头深锁成倒V形，下眼睑对抗泪水剧烈抽搐。
动作：头部在发音瞬间伴随向前压迫的攻击性微震颤，眼神充满杀气与怨恨。
对白： [Korean, adult female voice; venomous and explosive acoustic scream, high-pitch vocal fry, breath cracking on curse words] "야, 이 씨발놈아! 지랄 떨지 말고 처음부터 꺼지든가! 이제 와서 개수작이야?!"
BEAT 2 | 00:05.200–00:10.500 | 刻薄讥笑与下巴死死皱缩（对应中下抿嘴压抑）
肌肉力学：双唇瞬间死死咬合闭紧。颏肌（mentalis）极度收缩，下巴呈现紧绷的凹凸褶皱。咬肌剧烈凸起；嘴角向上抽动一瞬，露出极度刻薄、看垃圾般的冷酷冷笑。
动作：眼神像刀子一样剜向对方，伴随急促不屑的鼻腔冷哼，极度尖酸刻薄。
对白： [Korean, sharp, mocking and aggressive rasp; sneering through clenched teeth, heavy breathing] "내가 병신 같냐? 어? ...존나 가소로워서 눈물도 안 나오네. 넌 진짜 끝까지 역겨워."
BEAT 3 | 00:10.500–00:15.000 | 喉结吞咽与冰冷死咒（对应右下空洞冰冷）
肌肉力学：喉部完成一次深沉明显的吞咽，下巴肌肉紧绷感退去。下唇无力轻颤，眼眶中的泪水彻底漫出滑落颈部。眼神从愤怒骤降为彻底的冰冷与蔑视。
动作：头部极其微弱地下沉，双唇在说出最后一个字后保持微张，冰冷的呼气消散在空气中。
对白： [Korean, cold, dry, venomous whisper; breath trailing off with utter contempt] "…평생 그렇게 비겁하게 썩어 문드러져, 개새끼야."
DIEGETIC SOUNDSCAPE & VOCAL CAPTURE / 声音规则
极高动态范围的同期声直录，清晰捕捉咬字摩擦音、爆破辅音（씨/발/개/지/랄）、急促喘息声与喉音吞咽。
嘶吼高音处保留自然的声带破裂与毛边，严禁音频削波失真。
严禁任何背景音乐、弦乐、钢琴或电子音效，保持极度压抑的现场真实感。
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS / 负向规避
严禁任何镜头推拉晃动、严禁横屏上下黑边裁切、严禁切镜头。
严禁温和/委屈/示弱的哭戏、严禁假哭、严禁面无表情。
严禁磨皮美白塑料脸、严禁中文字幕压屏、严禁音画不同步。

Create a 15-second photorealistic product-fashion video using the uploaded reference video as the primary visual, character, product, and performance reference.

Character & Appearance
Recreate the same woman from the reference video. Keep her facial identity, long dark brown hair with soft bangs, natural glamorous makeup, white fitted sleeveless top, light blue high-waisted jeans, delicate jewelry, bracelets, and rings consistent throughout the video.

Scene & Action

0–3s:
She sits casually on a neatly made bed in a modern luxury bedroom with warm sunlight coming through the windows. She looks directly at the camera and speaks naturally in English while using subtle hand gestures. The exact black sunglasses case from the reference video is beside her.

3–6s:
She picks up the sunglasses case and opens it while continuing to speak. Show a clean close-up of the case and the sunglasses inside.

6–9s:
She removes the black rectangular sunglasses from the case. Show a detailed close-up of the sunglasses, preserving the exact shape, frame design, color, proportions, lenses, and material from the reference video.

9–12s:
She puts the sunglasses on and adjusts them naturally with both hands while continuing to speak directly to the camera. Maintain natural facial expressions and confident fashion-influencer energy.

12–15s:
She moves toward the large mirror and checks her look while wearing the sunglasses. Show both her and her reflection. She makes a final adjustment, then looks confidently toward the camera.

Voice & Lip Sync
The woman must speak naturally in English throughout the video. Use the reference audio as the exact speech reference. Preserve the original words, pronunciation, pacing, pauses, emotion, and conversational tone.

Her speech must be perfectly lip-synced. Match her mouth movements, jaw movement, facial expressions, blinking, eye movement, and subtle head gestures naturally to every spoken word.

Camera
Begin with a medium shot, gradually move closer during the product reveal, use cinematic close-ups for the sunglasses and hands, then transition naturally to a mirror shot. Smooth handheld movement, realistic focus changes, shallow depth of field.

Lighting & Environment
Warm golden-hour sunlight, modern luxury bedroom, white bedding, dark bedside furniture, soft natural shadows, realistic mirror reflections, detailed skin and hair texture.

Style
Photorealistic luxury fashion commercial, realistic human movement, natural influencer-style performance, cinematic composition, premium product detail, realistic hands and fingers, consistent character identity, realistic physics.

Audio
Clear natural female English speech with accurate lip sync, subtle room ambience, and realistic clothing/product sounds. No robotic voice, narrator, subtitles, extra dialogue, or overpowering music.

Important
Follow the reference video's overall visual storytelling, character performance, product appearance, and timing while keeping the final result polished, realistic, and natural.

prompts.title: A Fashion Day on Milan Streets
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic cinematic fashion-lifestyle video, approximately 15 seconds total, using the reference image as the identity reference for the same woman throughout.

She is a striking young woman with sun-kissed skin, voluminous blonde hair, and a confident, elevated editorial presence.

Dress her in a polished contemporary Milan Fashion Week street-style look: a strong, fashion-forward outfit with a clean silhouette, such as tailored trousers, a fitted top, a structured oversized coat, refined boots or heels, and a sleek designer-style bag. Keep the styling sophisticated, modern, and expensive-looking. No wardrobe changes.

No morphing. Keep her face, hair, body, and overall identity consistent in every shot.

Make it fast, stylish, highly realistic storytelling with mostly 0.8 to 1.8 second scenes, plus one slightly longer 2 to 3 second hero moment at the end. Camera work should feel premium and dynamic, with smooth gimbal movement, lateral tracking, rear-follow, subtle orbiting, and elegant push-ins.

The tone is elevated, fashion-insider, and candid, like she is moving through Milan Fashion Week between moments rather than posing for a campaign.

She should feel self-possessed, magnetic, and naturally cool. No stiff posing, no plastic skin, no uncanny behavior, no scene instability, and no sudden changes in lighting, location logic, or outfit.

Sequence: Open with her leaving a beautiful Milan hotel or fashion apartment building and stepping onto the street with purpose, the camera moving with her as if catching her in motion.

Cut to her crossing a stylish Milan street while photographers and fashion people move in the background.

For the third scene, cut to a very intimate close-up of her face, neck, and the top of her shoulders only. She looks directly into the camera with calm intensity, creating an immediate personal and emotional connection with the viewer. Keep this moment extremely beautiful, confident, and natural, with subtle movement in her hair and a shallow depth of field.

Then cut to her walking past a cluster of photographers or guests outside a fashion venue, not stopping to pose, just moving through the energy.

Cut to a quick espresso moment at a standing café bar or outside a polished café, where she glances sideways and then back into motion.

Cut to a candid social beat where she greets two stylish friends outside a venue or on a narrow Milan street, with a quick cheek kiss, smile, or touch on the arm, making it feel like she belongs in this world.

End with a dramatic hero shot, slightly longer than the other scenes, showing her from the waist up. She stands or slowly walks in a striking Milan setting, such as outside a fashion venue, beneath elegant architecture, or in a softly glowing evening street scene. The camera performs a subtle, graceful move while she looks directly into the lens again, creating a second intimate emotional connection with the viewer.

She should look powerful, beautiful, and unforgettable.Make Milan feel specific through elegant streets, fashion-week crowds, refined architecture, luxury vehicles, soft European daylight or golden-hour light, and the understated chaos of the fashion world.

The result should feel like an insider Milan Fashion Week street-style film, not a runway video, not a tourist video, and not a posed ad. It should feel spontaneous, cinematic, fashion-forward, and emotionally engaging.

prompts.title: A White Cat Summer Calendar Animation
prompts.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 15秒間の一続きの映像。「白猫の6日間の夏休み」を描く、可愛い水彩絵本風の日めくりカレンダー。 夏の午後の日差しが入る、涼しげな日本家屋。木製の机の中央に、二つの小さな金属リングで綴じた卓上型の日めくりカレンダーが置かれている。 窓辺には透明な青い風鈴。背景には緑の葉と眩しい夏空が柔らかくぼけて見える。机の端には青紫色の朝顔を一輪だけ置く。カレンダーを遮る物は置かない。 カメラはカレンダーを真正面から撮影したまま固定する。カメラ位置、焦点距離、カレンダーの位置、金属リング、紙の寸法を最後まで変えない。 カレンダーは少しざらついた生成り色の厚紙。全ページで書体、文字サイズ、日付位置、曜日位置、余白を完全に統一する。 今回存在するページは次の6枚だけ。 1枚目：「2026年8月 13 木」 2枚目：「2026年8月 14 金」 3枚目：「2026年8月 15 土」 4枚目：「2026年8月 16 日」 5枚目：「2026年8月 17 月」 6枚目：「2026年8月 18 火」 必ず、 「13 木」→「14 金」→「15 土」→「16 日」→「17 月」→「18 火」 の順番で一枚ずつ進める。 日付を飛ばさない。順番を変えない。逆戻りしない。同じ日付を二度表示しない。存在しない日付を追加しない。数字を別の数字へ変形させない。 各日付は、それぞれ別の紙の表面へ最初から印刷されている。日付は物理的なページめくりによってのみ切り替わる。 紙の裏面は、文字も絵も印刷されていない完全な生成り色の無地。めくられている紙の裏側へ、日付、曜日、数字、絵、鏡文字、反転文字を表示しない。 prompts.title: An AI Creativity Ad in a Futuristic Studio
prompts.prompt:
A stylish young South Asian woman with long dark hair, natural glamorous makeup and an elegant modern outfit. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit and appearance consistent throughout the entire video.

Scene 1 — 0–4s:
She sits at a sleek modern workstation in a futuristic studio. She looks directly into the camera and says naturally:

“What if you could turn your ideas into reality in just a few clicks?”

Natural facial expressions and hand gestures. Slow cinematic camera push-in. Perfect lip-sync.

Scene 2 — 4–7s:
She turns to her computer and opens WeryAI. She types a creative idea and says:

“That’s exactly what I love about WeryAI.”

The interface responds with elegant AI processing animations and glowing digital effects.

Scene 3 — 7–11s:
Her simple idea transforms into stunning AI-generated visuals: a fashion scene, futuristic city, cinematic character, premium product advertisement and social-media video.

She looks impressed and says:

“Give it an idea, and watch it come to life.”

Use smooth cinematic transitions and dynamic camera movement.

Scene 4 — 11–15s:
She turns back toward the camera with a confident smile and says:

“WeryAI. Your imagination, powered by AI.”

The camera slowly pulls back as the WeryAI brand reveal appears with a clean futuristic glow.

Audio:
Natural confident female voice, warm energetic delivery, subtle futuristic background music and soft cinematic sound effects. Keep dialogue clear and prominent.

Lip-sync:
The woman must visibly speak every line with accurate lip synchronization, natural mouth movement, blinking and facial expressions.

Visual quality:
Photorealistic, cinematic 4K, realistic skin, smooth camera movement, premium lighting, shallow depth of field, consistent character.

No subtitles, no distorted face, no warped hands, no extra fingers, no flickering, no random text, no watermark.

prompts.title: An Anime AI Video School Concept Ad
prompts.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the anime girl in <Picture 1>: Japanese TV-anime style, late teens, long vivid
red hair with loose flowing strands, large emerald-green eyes, white hoodie over a white top.
<Subject 2> is the graphic style in <Picture 1>: crisp flat 2D vector overlays on white -
cyan-turquoise and magenta-pink triangles, dot grids, diagonal speed shards, glowing UI
panels, thin rounded icons.
<Subject 3> is the school wordmark in <Picture 1>: the Japanese logotype "デジラク" in a heavy
rounded gothic face, teal-green with a soft drop shadow.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second Japanese commercial for an online AI-video creator school,
drawn as clean anime-style 2D animation over fast smooth motion graphics with animated
Japanese type, carried by a female voiceover. <Subject 1> discovers AI video, learns, and
invites the viewer to start. <Picture 1> is a storyboard contact sheet used only for casting
and style.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 5], [Shot 8] and [Shot 10]):
partially_preserved - her red hair, emerald-green eyes, face and white hoodie stay identical;
only pose and expression change.
<Subject 2> (appears in every shot): weak_reference - only the white palette, flat vector feel
and speed-shard energy carry over; the storyboard's grid, borders and numbers are not
reproduced.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 9]): fully_preserved - the letterforms, teal-green color and
proportions are kept exactly.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Clean Japanese TV-anime 2D animation over crisp flat vector motion graphics with
animated Japanese type, cut like a fast bright commercial. On a white field <Subject 1> runs
in from the right toward camera, hair streaming, as cyan and magenta shards burst past her.
Charcoal type slides in line by line on the left reading "AIで、アイデアが動き出す！",
"動き出す" snapping to double size in cyan. A bright Japanese woman in her early twenties with
a light buoyant friendly voice (S1) says off-screen:
<d>[Japanese] AIで、アイデアが動き出す。</d> Push In, small amplitude, fast speed.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, a cyan shard wipes across. A dozen glowing video panels fly through
deep blue space in one curved stream, each holding a different anime, cityscape or fantasy
scene. White type assembles in two stages at the lower left reading
"こんな動画も…". (S1): <d>[Japanese] こんな動画も。</d> Truck Right, large amplitude, fast
speed.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, a white field wipes in. Close on <Subject 1>, hands clasped at her
chest, eyes widening into a sparkle as four-point stars pop in around her. Bold type
scales up hard on the left reading "私にも 作れるかも！", "私" landing in magenta-pink.
<Subject 1>, a younger softer close-mic voice (S2), says quietly to herself:
<d>[Japanese] 私にも、作れるかも。</d> Push In, small amplitude, slow speed.
[Shot 4] At 00:04.500, a clean white field wipes in. Charcoal type draws itself across the top
reading "デジラクで学べること". Three thin rounded icons then pop in one at a time across the
middle - a laptop, an AI chip, a lightbulb - each with a label rising
beneath: "AI動画の基礎", "最新AIツール", "アイデアの発想法". No voice here. Static Shot.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.000, a cyan shard wipes in. <Subject 1> sits at a wide monitor, typing, as
glowing UI panels, timelines and waveform bars snap into place around the screen. A teal
banner sweeps in from the left with white type reading "ゼロからでも大丈夫！". (S1):
<d>[Japanese] ゼロからでも、大丈夫。</d> Truck Left, small amplitude, slow speed.
[Shot 6] At 00:07.500, diagonal cyan and magenta bands sweep across a white field. Huge
charcoal type slams in from both sides and collides at center reading
"プロの現場の技術が身につく！", "プロの現場" in cyan with a thick underline drawing itself as
light shards scatter. (S1): <d>[Japanese] プロの技術が、身につく。</d> Static Shot.
[Shot 7] At 00:09.000, the frame splits along one steep diagonal: a dull gray unfinished panel
on the left slides toward a bright finished anime artwork on the right as a glowing arrow
pushes between them. White type streaks in along the diagonal in two stages reading
"あなたの作品が、" then "ここから変わる。". (S1): <d>[Japanese] あなたの作品が、変わる。</d>
Push In, small amplitude, fast speed.
[Shot 8] At 00:10.500, a bright sky-blue field with radiating light wipes in. <Subject 1>
reaches one hand straight toward camera, smiling wide, as cyan and magenta shards streak past
her. Bold white type assembles in two stages on the right reading "一緒に、" then "つくろう！".
(S2), now bright and open: <d>[Japanese] 一緒に、つくろう！</d> Pull Out, small amplitude,
fast speed.
[Shot 9] At 00:12.000, a clean white field wipes in. Small charcoal type fades up across the
top reading "AI動画クリエイター育成スクール". Scattered letters then fly in and lock together
into <Subject 3> at center, a light sweep passing over it. Three thin rounded
icons pop in one at a time across the lower third - a document, a person, a group - with
labels beneath: "実践課題", "プロが指導", "コミュニティ". (S1):
<d>[Japanese] AI動画スクール、デジラク。</d> Static Shot.
[Shot 10] At 00:13.500, a white field with cyan and magenta shards wipes in. <Subject 1>
stands on the right pointing forward toward camera with a bright smile. Bold charcoal type
scales up on the left reading "今すぐ無料体験へ！", and a rounded teal button assembles beneath
reading "公式サイトはこちら", pulsing once. (S1), a half step warmer and more forward:
<d>[Japanese] 今すぐ、無料体験へ。</d> The frame holds still until exactly 15.000 seconds.
Static Shot.
Throughout: keep one clean Japanese TV-anime style with crisp linework, soft cel shading and
bright color - never photorealistic, never 3D-rendered. Only (S1) and (S2) speak, exactly the
lines above and nothing else: no ad-libs, no extra narration, no singing, no lip sync except
in [Shot 3] and [Shot 8]. Every on-screen line is bold rounded Japanese gothic type that
builds as animated shapes - never a movie subtitle, caption strip, letterboxed caption, footer
text or romaji. No storyboard grid, borders, numbers or contact-sheet layout, and no split
screen except the diagonal in [Shot 7]. Keep <Subject 1>'s red hair and emerald-green eyes
identical, cut sharp with no dissolves, keep motion smooth, and hold the palette to
crisp white, cyan-turquoise, magenta-pink, sky blue and charcoal.

overall_soundscape:
Bright airy whooshes carry the shards and flying panels, and soft digital clicks mark each
icon and UI element as it snaps into place. A rising sparkle lifts as her eyes widen, a solid
impact lands when the type collides, and keyboard taps run under the editing shot. A
clean chime rings once on the button at the end.

non_diegetic_music:
An original 15-second bright uplifting Japanese commercial track at a fast tempo: plucked
synth lead, four-on-the-floor kick, tight claps, airy pads, bells, mixed low under the voiceover. It opens at full drive, drops the drums for one bar at 00:03.000 leaving
only a sparkling bell, snaps back at 00:04.500 and builds, lifts into a rising sweep at
00:10.500, opens widest at 00:12.000, then lands on one bright sustained chord that decays
cleanly at 15.000 seconds.

prompts.title: A Green Energy Box Captures a Desert Scorpion
prompts.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:

<Image 1> is the CHARACTER APPEARANCE REFERENCE.

<Image 0> background reference

Use <Image 1> to preserve the man's exact facial identity, age, dark hair with gray temples, rugged stubble, body proportions, green-and-black tactical suit, illuminated chest emblem, and power-ring design.

CRITICAL RIGHT-HAND CONTINUITY:
The power ring is worn ONLY on the man's anatomical RIGHT HAND throughout the entire video.
NEVER place the ring on his left hand.
Do not mirror or swap hands when the camera angle changes.
His LEFT HAND remains completely ringless throughout the entire sequence.
Every green energy projection originates directly from the ring on his RIGHT HAND.

Photorealistic live-action cinematic realism.

Environment: vast isolated American desert-like prairie, dry golden grass, dusty earth, scattered low scrub, distant low hills, huge open sky. Warm late-afternoon sunlight. No buildings, vehicles, roads, or other people visible.

[00:00–00:01.5]

Wide cinematic tracking shot.

The man from <Image 1> walks casually through the open landscape.

His arms swing naturally as he walks.

He suddenly notices something near his feet, slows, stops, and looks down.

Camera subtly moves closer and tilts downward with his gaze.

[00:01.5–00:02.5]

Cut to a low close shot near the ground.

A small realistic BLACK SCORPION crawls slowly across the dusty ground approximately two feet in front of his boots.

Cut back to a medium shot as he looks down at it with mild curiosity rather than fear.

He raises his anatomical RIGHT HAND and points the ring toward the scorpion.

His left hand remains relaxed and completely ringless.

[00:02.5–00:03.5]

Medium close-up favoring his RIGHT hand.

The ring activates with concentrated emerald-green light.

A narrow, clearly defined GREEN ENERGY BEAM shoots directly from the ring on his RIGHT HAND toward the scorpion.

The beam strikes the ground immediately around the scorpion.

Glowing green construct lines rapidly form around it: bottom edges → four vertical corners → horizontal edges → top edges.

Within moments, these lines complete a small transparent emerald-green ENERGY CAGE surrounding the scorpion.

The scorpion remains unharmed and clearly visible inside.

CRITICAL:
From this moment until the END OF THE VIDEO, the green energy beam remains visibly and continuously connected from the ring on his RIGHT HAND directly to the green cage.
The beam NEVER disconnects, disappears, switches hands, or originates anywhere else.

[00:03.5–00:05.0]

Low close-up of the cage.

Still connected to the continuous beam, the completed green construct cage gently rises from the dusty ground.

The scorpion remains standing on the glowing construct floor inside the cage.

Camera tilts upward with it.

The cage floats smoothly to approximately chest height in front of the man.

The beam remains clearly visible between his RIGHT-HAND ring and the floating cage throughout the lift.

[00:05.0–00:08.0]

Cut to a medium close-up framing the man's face, his extended RIGHT hand, and the floating cage.

The cage hovers roughly two feet in front of him at chest level.

His RIGHT arm remains comfortably extended toward it.

The glowing ring is clearly visible on his RIGHT HAND.

The continuous green beam remains visibly connected:
RIGHT-HAND RING → GREEN BEAM → FLOATING CAGE.

The little black scorpion moves slightly inside the cage.

The man studies it for a moment, gives a small friendly amused smile, and speaks casually to the scorpion.

(S1) <d>[EN]How you doing there, little fella?</d>

Hold briefly on his smile and the floating scorpion cage.

The cage remains stable.
The scorpion remains safely inside.
The beam remains connected through the FINAL FRAME.

No attack.
No explosion.
No additional constructs.
No additional characters.

overall_soundscape:

Natural open-land ambience with gentle dry wind moving through grass, subtle footsteps on dusty earth at the beginning, extremely faint scorpion movement during close shots, and a clean low emerald-energy hum when the ring activates.

The construct produces a subtle crystalline energy-building sound as the cage forms.

Once formed, the cage and continuous connecting beam produce a quiet sustained energy hum through the final frame.

(S1)'s dialogue is natural, relaxed, friendly, and slightly amused.

non_diegetic_music:

None.

prompts.title: An Origami Figure with Folding Type
prompts.prompt:
【REFERENCE】
参照画像なし。参照動画なし。

【CONDITION DEFINITION】
15秒、1:1スクエア。高品質な3Dペーパースカルプチャー表現によるオリジナルMV。
芸術的な人型折り紙彫刻、リリックモーション、モーショングラフィックの三要素を同格の主役として融合する。折り紙だけを常に前景へ固定せず、リリック、折り紙、MGの視覚的な優先順位を場面ごとに切り替え、一つの完成した紙の造形世界を作る。
折り紙人物は、背が高く細身で中性的な人型ペーパースカルプチャー。小さな頭部、細い腰、長い脚、左右非対称の肩面、鋭い折り面、腰や背中から伸びる紙帯、背中の扇状構造を持つ。顔も折り面で構成し、目鼻口は最小限の記号表現。身体そのものをアヴァンギャルドなオートクチュール彫刻として見せる。
素材はアイボリー、ディープクリムゾン、マットブラック、メタリックゴールドを中心に、少量のターコイズと半透明紙を使用。折り目、紙のエッジ、重なり、厚み、素材差を明確に見せる。
背景とMGも同じ紙素材の造形言語で統一し、巨大紙面、切り抜いた円、紙帯、折り線、グリッド、幾何形状、紙の影、タイポグラフィで構成する。
使用する歌唱フレーズと画面文字は以下の3つだけ。
「FOLD THE LIGHT」
「SHAPE THE SILENCE」
「BECOME ART」
各フレーズは、最初に文字全体を遮蔽せず明瞭に読める状態で歌唱と同期して提示する。その後、文字を分割、折り、スライド、拡大し、紙帯や幾何形状へ変換してMGへ融合する。歌唱後の単語断片はMG素材として再利用できる。
人物は激しく踊らない。わずかな向き変化、片腕を開く、一歩進む程度に留める。

【SHOT / FLOW】
0.00-3.00｜BIRTH

**02 | 1.0–2.0s**
The O becomes a circular frame showing an extreme close-up of AO’s crimson eye and glossy lips. She gives a teasing side glance. RGB flash. Circle bursts into red-and-white fragments.
**03 | 2.0–3.1s**
Black background, huge white **AO**. AO enters fast, turns sharply and power-slides beneath the typography. Red speed streaks trail behind her. Whip-pan out.

Three red/white/black vertical panels. AO appears in three poses: hip turn, hair touch, over-shoulder stare. Huge vertical **FULL SPEED** moves behind her.
**05 | 4.0–5.1s**
AO jumps through a rotating typography ring reading **NO BRAKES / ALL EYES ON ME**. One clean mid-air spin. Snap zoom into her confident face.
**06 | 5.1–6.0s**
White editorial frame. Huge black **HOT** with a red slash. AO crosses the frame with a runway-like step, one hand at her waist. Typography compresses and rebounds.
**07 | 6.0–7.0s**
Bright red field with black diagonal stripe. AO performs one smooth fast turn. Three ghosted freeze positions trace the movement. Giant outlined **TURN** rotates behind her.
**08 | 7.0–8.0s**
Words hit one per beat:
**HOT / FAST / WILD / RED**
AO changes pose with each word: direct stare, hair toss, hip shift, confident forward lean.
**09 | 8.0–9.0s**
Black frame with manga perspective lines and a graphic grid. AO steps forward and freezes in a strong hero pose. Red circular target graphics lock around her.
**10 | 9.0–10.1s**
AO moves toward camera through three red-and-white graphic panels. Each panel shatters as she passes. Large **A O** fragments appear behind her. Finish with a hair or leg foreground wipe.
**11 | 10.1–11.1s**
Rapid poster montage: four frames of the same AO — close-up stare, walking, side pose, hands at waist. Add **01–04**, barcodes, halftone dots and sharp Japanese poster graphics.
**12 | 11.1–13.0s**
Hero moment on a clean white background. AO lands in a powerful fashion pose: one leg forward, one hand at her waist, chin lifted, direct eye contact. Huge red shockwave rings explode behind her. Typography fragments and speed lines burst outward. Hold an iconic confident freeze.
**13 | 13.0–15.0s**
Final identity card. Huge black **AO** on a bright white field. AO stands relaxed and alluring in front of the letters. Red circles, halftone, technical arcs and sharp speed accents surround her. Final red pulse flashes through the frame and ends on a hard stinger.
## ANIME STYLE
Premium modern Japanese anime rendering:

* clean cel shading
* sharp linework
* polished highlights
* cinematic close-ups
* dynamic perspective
* fashion-editorial full-body framing
* smooth hair and fabric motion
AO must look like a **stylish adult anime heroine**, not chibi and not childish.
## AUDIO

Hard-hitting **electro / future bass / anime-opening style music**.
Use:
heavy drums, bass hits, risers, glitch fills, synth stabs, typography slams, whooshes and shutter impacts.

Build continuously.
Peak at Beat 12.
End with a sharp electronic stinger.
## PRIORITIES
1. AO identity consistency
2. sexy adult anime character design
3. red-black-white outfit consistency
4. maximum visual impact
5. readable typography
6. premium anime rendering
7. fast beat-synced editing

Avoid:
childlike proportions, chibi style, blue clothing, face changes, outfit changes, extra characters, unreadable typography, weak motion, dull compositions or generic schoolgirl styling.
Final result: **explosive, sexy, red-hot, premium, graphic-driven and visually unforgettable.**

prompts.title: A Career Ad through Giant Typographic Obstacles
prompts.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
2D-animated flat vector motion graphics in a vertical 9:16 composition, exactly 14 shots at
24fps. Flat anime rendering, thick clean outlines, two-tone cel shading, no gradients, no
photorealism, no 3D. Giant Japanese typography is physical architecture: solid black slabs the
size of buildings that crush, block, fall and can be climbed. It is high summer and the first half is hot, stale and windless, with heat
haze in the air. Palette: black, washed-out greyish white, deep navy and vivid cyan. Cyan first appears as a
single point in Shot 6, then spreads further in each following shot until it fills the frame at
Shot 13; it never appears before Shot 6.

The recurring character is a Japanese office worker: a woman with a long black ponytail and
sharp determined eyes, in a white short-sleeve blouse under a light grey lightweight blazer,
deep navy tapered trousers, low-heeled black pumps and a plain blank ID badge on a lanyard,
with a light sheen of sweat at her temples. Preserve her exact face, hairstyle, outfit and
colors throughout; never redesign her. Her blazer is the mechanism: buttoned closed and flat
grey until Shot 7, then it blows open and its vivid cyan lining flashes out, flaring wider in
every following shot.

She is also the narrator (S1), an inner monologue in a low voice, tired and flat at first and
firmer later, always in off-screen voiceover with her lips closed. Every Japanese word on
screen stays fully readable and is never covered by her.

[Shot 1] Looking up from the bottom of a canyon of giant black Japanese character slabs. She
stands small at the base, then tilts her head back to look up, then a bead of sweat runs down
her temple as the air shimmers with heat. The narrator (S1) says in a tired, flat
tone in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Japanese] ずっと、ここで止まってた。</d> while her lips
remain completely closed. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed. <scenetrans>

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, <scenetrans> the narrator's sentence continues seamlessly across
the cut. A colossal slab drops from above, then lands across her shoulders, then her
knees buckle under it. The slab reads "タスク" in huge off-white type. The camera shakes
slightly with small amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.000, two slabs slide in from left and right, then she braces both arms
against them, then they press closer and she loses ground. The slabs read "会議" in huge
off-white type. Static shot.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.000, slabs stack at her feet, then she climbs two of them, then she slips
and slides back down. The slabs read "給料" in huge off-white type. The camera pedestals up with
small amplitude at slow speed.

[Shot 5] At 00:04.000, the slabs swing closed into a sealed box around her, then she sits down,
then all movement in the air stops completely. No text. The camera pushes in
with small amplitude at slow speed.

[Shot 6] At 00:05.000, everything freezes and holds still, nearly monochrome, with no text at
all. One small cyan point of light glows at her feet, then a single sheet of paper lifts
slightly off the ground and hangs there. The narrator does not speak at all during this shot.
Static shot.

[Shot 7] At 00:05.800, wind arrives. Her ponytail streams sideways, then she lifts her head and
her eyes sharpen, then her blazer blows open and the cyan lining flashes out for the first
time. No text. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 8] At 00:06.800, she grips the wall of slabs with both hands, then hauls it over so it
topples away, then wind rushes through the opening. No text. The camera trucks right with large
amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 9] At 00:08.000, the fallen slabs lock into a staircase rising to the upper right, then a
wide cyan color field wipes across the frame, then each step edge lights from bottom to top. No text. The camera tilts up with small amplitude
at fast speed.

[Shot 10] At 00:09.000, she runs up the staircase of characters. Each slab lights cyan as she
leaves it, then her ponytail and blazer stream hard in the wind, then she takes the next flight
two steps at a time. The narrator (S1) says in a firmer, lighter tone
in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Japanese] 変えたのは、環境だけ。</d> The camera tracks her with
large amplitude at fast speed. <scenetrans>

[Shot 11] At 00:10.200, <scenetrans> the narrator's line continues seamlessly across
the cut and finishes. She leaps high off the staircase, then spins once in mid-air, then her
blazer flares fully open so its lining forms a ring of cyan around her. No text. The
camera arcs with large amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 12] At 00:11.400, she lands at the top, then turns to look back with wind in her hair,
then the word "月曜" slams in huge in off-white beside her with a thick underline sweeping in
beneath it. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

[Shot 13] At 00:12.600, the entire frame bursts into vivid cyan, then concentric rings blast
outward from her feet, then shattered fragments of the black slabs fly away. No text. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Japanese] 相談は無料。
</d> <scenetrans> The camera pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 14] At 00:13.800, <scenetrans> the narrator continues without a break: <d>[Japanese]
Nexta。</d> A clean white color field wipes across and clears everything away, then a cyan mark
of three ascending steps rising to the right assembles at the center and its top step extends
into an arrowhead, then the wordmark "Nexta" — spelled N-e-x-t-a, only the N
capitalized — resolves in deep navy beside it with "相談は無料" below. Hold the
lockup until exactly 15.000 seconds. Static shot.

Overall: the first half is hot, heavy and windless; the second half is fast, airy and cool. No
shot is fully still except Shot 6. Every shot must feel compositionally different, and the
staircase in Shots 9 to 12 is built from the same slabs that crushed her earlier. The only
words allowed on screen anywhere are "タスク", "会議", "給料",
"月曜", "Nexta" and "相談は無料". No other text, numbers, subtitles, captions or watermark.

overall_soundscape:
Massive stone slabs drop and grind with deep booming impacts while an air conditioner drones
and distant cicadas buzz through stale, motionless air. Everything falls silent at 00:05.000
until a soft gust of wind rises at 00:05.800. Wind then builds, cloth snaps and flutters,
footsteps climb and speed up, and a wide airy boom opens at 00:12.600.

non_diegetic_music:
A low sustained synth drone holds alone at a slow pulse and thickens under the falling slabs.
It cuts out completely at 00:05.000 and stays absent until 00:05.800, when a light arpeggiated
synth and a four-on-the-floor kick enter and build through the climb. Wide chords and a snare
roll open at 00:12.600 and resolve on one sustained chord at 15.000 seconds.

prompts.title: A Sunglasses Fashion Ad in a Warm Interior
prompts.prompt:
Use the attached girl as the exact character reference. Preserve her facial identity, facial features, eye color, long wavy brown hairstyle, makeup, skin tone, body proportions, jewelry, and overall appearance consistently across every shot.

Use the attached sunglasses as the exact locked product reference. Preserve the black oval-shaped frames, dark lenses, gold detailing at the temples, hinge structure, proportions, materials, and finish exactly. The sunglasses must remain identical in every frame.

Create an ultra-realistic luxury UGC creator review filmed entirely in an elegant modern lounge area, not a bedroom. The lounge should feel sophisticated, warm, expensive, and naturally lived-in: cream boucle sofa, marble or stone coffee table, soft neutral cushions, elegant floor lamp, subtle gold accents, large windows, tasteful décor, and warm late-afternoon sunlight entering from the side.

The woman wears the same cream/white knit sweater, beige trousers, gold hoop earrings, delicate pendant necklace, and rings from the reference image.

STORYBOARD — 15 SECONDS

SHOT 1 — 0–2 sec | Casual introduction
Medium handheld smartphone shot. The woman sits comfortably on the cream sofa in the lounge with the sunglasses box and leather carrying case placed naturally on the coffee table beside her. She looks directly into the camera with a genuine smile and says:

“Okay, these are way nicer than I expected.”

Natural creator energy, relaxed posture, subtle handheld movement.

SHOT 2 — 2–4 sec | Picking up the packaging
She leans toward the coffee table and picks up the luxury sunglasses box. Camera moves slightly closer as she turns the box toward the lens. She opens it naturally.

Capture realistic packaging texture and believable hand movements.

She says:

“Even the little details feel so well done.”

SHOT 3 — 4–6 sec | Case reveal
Close-up from slightly above her hands as she reveals the leather sunglasses case inside the box. She lifts the case out and opens it.

Warm sunlight creates soft highlights on the leather and gold hardware.

SHOT 4 — 6–8 sec | Sunglasses reveal
She carefully removes the sunglasses from the case. Cut to a beautiful macro product shot as she holds them between her fingers.

Slowly rotate the sunglasses so the camera clearly sees the front frame, dark lenses, gold temple detail, side profile, and hinges.

She says:

“And they’re ridiculously light.”

SHOT 5 — 8–10 sec | Putting them on
Return to a medium shot. She smiles, lifts the sunglasses toward her face, and puts them on naturally.

She adjusts the temples with both hands, then gives a subtle confident smile toward the camera.

SHOT 6 — 10–12 sec | Lounge sunlight test
She stands beside the large lounge window wearing the sunglasses. Camera follows her with smooth handheld movement.

She turns slightly toward the sunlight, then angles her face left and right so the lenses catch realistic reflections.

She says:

“They actually feel this good on.”

SHOT 7 — 12–14 sec | Lifestyle moment
She walks back toward the sofa, casually removes the sunglasses, and places them beside the leather case and box on the coffee table.

Camera briefly focuses on the sunglasses before shifting focus back to her.

SHOT 8 — 14–15 sec | Final product close-up
She picks the sunglasses back up and holds them beside her face while looking directly into the camera.

Warm smile.

She says:

“Yeah… these are staying in my rotation.”

Finish with a subtle camera push-in toward the sunglasses in her hand, with the lounge softly blurred behind her.

VISUAL STYLE

Photorealistic luxury lifestyle UGC, authentic smartphone creator footage, elegant lounge interior, warm golden-hour sunlight, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, subtle handheld camera movement, cinematic autofocus, shallow depth of field, neutral color palette, 4K HDR, 16:9, 24fps.

prompts.title: An Anime Character Promo with Giant Type
prompts.prompt:
## 参照キャラクター指定

* ** Image1**：ピンク髪の少女。冒頭と終盤のメイン。作品の顔。

* ** Image2**：ダーク衣装の銀髪少女。影・異質感・変質表現担当。

* ** Image3**：白銀ショートヘアの少女。`KNIGHT` / `RIFT` 担当。

* ** Image4**：金髪の白衣装の少女。収束・静けさ・終盤象徴カット担当。

## 全体指示

**15秒、16:9、横長。**

白・黒・赤を基調にした、極太の縦長サンセリフタイポグラフィと4人のファンタジー系アニメキャラクターを組み合わせた高密度グラフィックPV。

文字は字幕ではなく、**空間レイヤー、遮蔽、トンネル、マスク、画面構造そのもの**として機能する。

アニメ調の細線キャラクター、フラット寄りの陰影、強いグリッチ、横走査線、赤い円形UI、色収差、短いフラッシュ切り替え。

全体は、

**静かな人物提示 → タイポ変形 → キャラクター切り替え → レイピアによる空間切断 → 圧縮空間 → 崩壊 → 収束 → 冒頭回帰**

の流れ。

テンポを落とさず、**0.5秒ごとに画面構造・人物・文字・動きのいずれかを必ず変化させる。**

## 使用文字

* **`FANTASY`**

* **`KNIGHT`**

* **`SIGIL`**

* **`FACE`**

* **`LINE`**

* **`RIFT`**

---

## 0.0–0.5秒

白背景。

巨大な **`FANTASY`** が画面いっぱいに並ぶ。

右上に ** Image1** の横顔が少しだけ見切れる。

薄い水平グリッチ。

---

## 0.5–1.0秒

**`FANTASY`** が左へ高速スライド。

Image1 は一度消え、白地と巨大な黒文字だけになる。

文字の一部が画面外にはみ出す。

---

## 1.0–1.5秒

**`FANTASY`** の文字の隙間から ** Image1** 現れる。うつむき気味で目を閉じている。文字が人物の前後を通り、身体の一部を遮蔽する。---## 1.5–2.0秒 Image1 がわずかに顔を上げて目を開く。顔の輪郭と瞳が明瞭になる。同時に **`FANTASY`** が横方向へ圧縮され始める。---## 2.0–2.5秒短い白フラッシュ。巨大な **`FACE`** に切り替わる。人物は消え、中央に赤黒の同心円UI。強い水平グリッチと色収差。---## 2.5–3.0秒**`KNIGHT`** が巨大に出現。その文字の隙間から ** Imag3** が正面寄りに現れる。白銀の髪と青緑系衣装を明確に見せる。---## 3.0–3.5秒 Image3 が右向きの横顔になる。**`KNIGHT`** が人物の前後を横切りながら右へ流れる。赤い細線UIが一瞬走る。---## 3.5–4.0秒**`KNIGHT LINE`** に切り替わる。人物はいったん消える。白黒で画面を大胆に分割し、赤を一点だけ強く使う。---## 4.0–4.5秒巨大な **`LINE`** が横方向へ引き伸ばされる。文字の一部が極端に細くなり、一部は太く圧縮される。画面に強い横方向の張力を作る。---## 4.5–5.0秒背景が黒寄りへ反転。細いアウトラインの **`SIGIL`**。中央に ** Image2**。背後または隣に、** Image1の薄いピンク色のシルエット**が背中合わせ気味に重なる。---## 5.0–5.5秒 Image2 と  Image1 のシルエット位置がわずかにずれる。多重露光のような残像。**`SIGIL`** も複数レイヤーへ分離する。---## 5.5–6.0秒 Image1 のシルエットが消える。** Image2** が画面中央へ集約。背後に淡い赤色の円形UI。次のアクションへ向けて一瞬静止。---## 6.0–6.5秒高速フラッシュで **`RIFT`** に切り替わる。** Image3** が細身のレイピアを構える。白背景、青い斜めライン、赤い円形UI。文字は人物の前後に食い込んでいる。---## 6.5–7.0秒 Image3がレイピアを鋭く横薙ぎする。剣先の軌跡に沿って、**画面空間そのものが切り裂かれる。**白い斬撃線と赤い発光。**`RIFT`** の中央も切断される。---## 7.0–7.5秒 Image3が一歩踏み込み、二撃目。レイピアを裂け目へ突き込む。切断された **`RIFT`** の文字が上下または前後にずれる。青いラインも同時に切断される。---## 7.5–8.0秒レイピアの軌跡から黒い亀裂が一気に拡大。**`RIFT`** が歪み、文字としての形を失い始める。赤いデジタルノイズと色収差が急増する。---## 8.0–8.5秒破断した画面が一気に暗部へ吸い込まれる。ほぼ暗転。わずかな赤い残光と水平ノイズだけを残す。---## 8.5–9.0秒暗闇の中央に細い縦スリット。その中に ** Image2** prompts.title: Metal Letterforms Build a Visual Dialogue
prompts.prompt:
【CONDITION DEFINITION】
15秒、1:1スクエア、参照画像なし。高品質なシネマティック混合表現。主役は立体モーショングラフィックス、空間タイポグラフィ、サウンド。人物、顔、口、手、身体、人影を一切出さない。文字とMGは厚い半透明の鉱物ｍガラス外殻、内部の濃い墨色層、精密な金属骨格を持つ同一の立体物質。側面、内側、空洞、断面、接合部、研磨跡、微細な傷、濃い接触影、透過光、落影を明瞭に描く。全時間で形状、厚み、材質、断面、空洞、前後関係、遮蔽、可読性、役割のいずれかを更新し、同じ運動を反復しない。全CUTを明るい鉱物床、床上の黒い積層基壇、床へ固定された人間寸法の細い手すりと目地が連続する一つの建築空間で描く。文字の光、影、反射を床と積層基壇へ一致させ、背景を切り替えない。

【SHOT / FLOW】
CUT1（0.00–2.30秒）：開始から巨大な立体“NOW?”が前景・中景・遠景を貫く斜め構図で完全可読。Oの空洞の奥に同じ床と細い固定手すりが小さく見える。最初の衝突で厚い外殻が断面を見せて裂け、墨色層と金属骨格が別々の奥行きへ伸び、N、O、W、?が質量を交換する。
CUT2（2.30–4.75秒）：真上から見た文字の立体地形。2.30秒、“DO YOU SEE ME NOW?”全文が段状の奥行きで初めて完全可読になる瞬間に、女性が同じ英文を一度だけ短く自然に話し始める。直後に各語の外殻、内部層、空洞が別方向へ開き、前CUTから受け取った質量で新しい高低差と接触影を作る。巨大文字が同じ床の目地をまたいで前後を通り、全文を保持しない。
CUT3（4.75–7.20秒）：文字断面の極端なマクロ。ガラス外殻の傷、墨色層、金属骨格、空洞を同時に見せる。摩擦音で厚い層が横滑りし、内部骨格が噛み合い、可読だった質問を奥行き方向の別構文へ組み替える。断面の空洞が同じ床、積層基壇、細い固定手すりを含む次CUTを露出する。
CUT4（7.20–9.75秒）：文字の空洞越しに同じ床と人間寸法の細い固定手すりを識別できる斜め中景。巨大文字がその前後を通り、落影と透過光が手すりと床へ移る。外殻、墨色層、骨格、空洞は質問から返答へ向かう同じ組替えを続け、固定建築要素を単独で見せない。
CUT5（9.75–12.35秒）：低い横位置。全文の立体部品が三つの奥行きで同時に噛み合う。外殻が骨格へ質量を渡し、空洞が閉じる場所と別の語が開く場所を同時に作る。同じ床が巨大接合部の下まで連続する。11.20秒、同じ部品が“I SEE YOU.”として初めて完全可読になる瞬間に、男性が同じ英文を一度だけ短く自然に話し始める。
CUT6（12.35–15.00秒）：前CUTで成立した返答を同じ文字建築のまま引き継ぐ。Iは内部骨格を手前へ伸ばし、SEEは外殻と墨色層を左右へ交換し、YOUはOの空洞を同じ床の奥まで開き、前景と遠景へ質量を分けて再結合する。質問全文の残存部品、床の落影、空間反響を同時更新し、15.00秒まで可読と変形を両立する。

【CAMERA / EDITING】
斜め深度構図、真俯瞰、断面マクロ、空洞越し中景、低い横位置、正面寄り深度構図へ毎CUT交代。文字の厚みと前後遮蔽を常に見せる。接続は外殻の断面、受け渡す質量、文字の空洞、噛み合う骨格によるマッチカットとハードカット。固定手すりや目地を中央、最大要素、単独被写体にしない。全CUTを開始フレームから同じ建築空間に属する異なる完成画面と変形中のクライマックスにする。

【SOUND】
歌唱なし。開始から完成した現代的インストBGMを通す。女性は2.30秒、男性は11.20秒にだけ対応英文を自然に話し始め、二人の声を重ねない。乾いた打音、深い低音、石とガラスの衝突、金属骨格の共鳴、摩擦、空気圧、近距離音と遠距離反響で時間軸を作る。各CUTへ固有の音響事件を与え、材質、重量、距離、変形を音で確定する。声を編集テンポにせず、最終CUTだけへ強度を温存しない。

【NEGATIVE】
人物、顔、口、手、身体、人影、シルエット、実写人物、低品質な3D人物を禁止。黒い無背景、孤立ロゴ、商品撮影台、商品写真、可動する小道具、台車、球、ピンを禁止。フラットベクター、薄い平面文字、正面字幕、輪郭線だけの文字、表面の色替えだけの変化、色面、矩形、クロップ窓、リボン、線、円弧、光帯、反射軸、UI、ネオン、粒子を主役にしない。安価なプラスチック文字、均一なクローム、汎用ベベル、既製ロゴアニメを禁止。歌、コーラス、母音伸ばし、文字の単純な出消し・拡大・クロップ、同一運動のループ、全文保持、フェード、完全停止を禁止。

prompts.prompt:
# 【ここだけ変更】

文字列A = 「MiniMax H3」
文字列B = 「AI STUDIO ONEROOM」

※使用時に変更するのは上の2行だけ。
※以下の本文は変更しない。
※映像内には、上で設定した文字列A・文字列B以外の文字を表示しない。

---

提供された参照画像を主人公の基準として使用する。
キャラクターの同一性、顔、髪型、衣装のシルエット、ファッション性、全体的な印象をできる限り維持する。

15秒、16:9横長のハイテンポなファッションMV。

映像の中心は常に主人公。

主人公の身体の動きとダイナミックなカメラワークを最優先し、その動きに反応して、冒頭で設定した文字列A・文字列Bが追従する。

基本的な演出構造は、

主人公が動く
→ カメラが大きく反応する
→ 文字がその動きに引っ張られる

という順番。

カメラは空間を大きく使い、急速なドリーイン／ドリーアウト、横方向の高速通過、ローアングル、オービット、ウィップパン、スナップズームを組み合わせる。

高速運動と完全静止の差を強く作り、バレットタイムを最大の見せ場にする。

## タイポグラフィ

使用する文字は、冒頭で設定した文字列A・文字列Bのみ。
文字はフラットでシャープな2Dタイポグラフィ。
厚みのある3D文字にはしない。
基本色は白。
アクセントとして赤とオレンジを使用する。
色はグラデーションではなく、ビートに同期した瞬間的な切り替えを中心にする。
文字は主人公の身体動作に連動する。
主人公が手を横へ払えば文字も高速で横へ飛ぶ。
主人公が引き寄せれば文字も集まる。
主人公が回転すれば文字もその回転に引っ張られる。
主人公が手をカメラ方向へ押し出せば文字も前景へ急接近する。
主人公が停止すれば文字も停止する。
文字だけが勝手にランダムに動かない。
モーショングラフィックスは短いアクセントとして使用する。
文字の高速移動中に一瞬だけ字間が広がる。
文字が停止した瞬間に白から赤、またはオレンジへ切り替わる。
高速移動直後に短く分解され、即座に再整列する。
一文字ずつ数フレーム遅れて追従する動きを短時間だけ使用する。
文字内部の複雑な変形を長時間見せない。

## 奥行き

文字自体を3D化せず、配置とカメラワークによって空間的な立体感を作る。
文字を、
カメラのすぐ近く
主人公より手前
主人公の背後
など異なる距離へ配置する。
カメラ移動によって強いパララックスを発生させる。
近い文字ほど大きく高速に流れ、遠い文字ほど小さくゆっくり動く。
文字が主人公の身体の背後へ隠れたり、腕や身体の手前を横切ったりする自然な前後関係を維持する。

---

## Shot 1 | .0–00:00.8

ワイド。
主人公が中央に立つ。
前景に大きな白い文字列A。
主人公の背後に小さめの文字列B。
強いビートと同時にカメラが前景文字の隙間を高速で通過しながら主人公へドリーイン。
文字、主人公、背景の距離差によって強いパララックスを発生させる。
通過した瞬間、文字列Aの一部分だけ赤へ変化。

## Shot 2 | .8–00:01.6

顔のクローズアップへスナップズーム。
主人公が鋭く横を見る。
視線に引っ張られるように文字列Bが横方向へ高速移動。
カメラも同じ方向へ短くスライド。
文字は顔を隠さない。

## Shot 3 | .6–00:02.5

全身ローアングル。
主人公が一歩前へ出ながら片手を強く横へ払う。
その手の軌道に合わせて文字列Aが主人公の背後から横を通過し、カメラ直前まで高速で飛ぶ。
移動中だけ字間が大きく広がる。
カメラは低い位置から高速ティルトアップ。

## Shot 4 | .5–00:03.4

ミディアム。
主人公が両手を軽く引き寄せる。
分離していた文字列Bの文字が左右から主人公の周囲へ高速で集まり、正しい文字列として再構成される。
完成した瞬間、一部分だけオレンジへ変化。
主人公が手を止めると文字も完全停止。

## Shot 5 | .4–00:04.2

主人公が身体を鋭くターン。
同時にカメラは主人公とは逆方向へ高速オービット。
文字列Aが主人公の回転に引っ張られるように大きな円弧を描いて移動する。
身体とカメラの大きな運動を最優先する。

## Shot 6 | .2–00:05.7

第一のバレットタイム。

主人公がターン途中で完全停止。
身体、髪、衣装も完全停止。
文字列A・文字列Bも完全停止。
カメラだけが主人公の周囲を約180度高速オービットする。
文字列Aは主人公より手前。
文字列Bは主人公の背後。
文字はフラットな2Dのまま。
カメラだけが移動することで、主人公と文字の間に強烈なパララックスと前後関係を生み出す。
カメラ角度によって文字の一部が主人公の身体の背後へ自然に隠れる。
バレットタイム中は文字を動かさない。

## Shot 7 | .7–00:06.5

時間が一気に再始動。
主人公がターンを完成させ、その勢いのまま片手を前へ押し出す。
同時に文字列Aがカメラ方向へ猛烈に加速。
文字列Aの一部分だけ赤へ変化。
文字がカメラ直前まで巨大化して画面を横切り、その動きで次のショットへハードトランジション。

## Shot 8 | .5–00:07.4

ワイド。
カメラが高速で後退。
主人公はカメラへ向かって前進。
主人公の背後に大きな白い文字列B。
主人公の歩行に合わせて文字も前方向へ少し移動する。
人物とカメラが逆方向に動くことで空間の広さを強調。

## Shot 9 | .4–00:08.3

サイドアングル。
カメラが主人公の横を高速で通過。
主人公が片手を下から上へ大きく振る。
その軌道に引っ張られて文字列Aが画面下から上へ飛び上がる。
文字は主人公の背後から始まり、途中で身体の手前へ出る。
最後の瞬間だけ文字の一部分がオレンジへ変化。

## Shot 10 | .3–00:09.2

クローズアップ。
主人公がカメラへ手を伸ばす。
主人公の背後に小さく存在していた文字列Bが、手に引き寄せられるようにカメラ方向へ急接近。
カメラも同時に主人公へ高速ドリーイン。
手、顔、文字の三段階の距離差を強調する。

## Shot 11 | .2–00:10.3

第二のバレットタイム。
主人公が腕を振る途中で完全停止。
文字列Aも完全停止。
カメラだけが主人公の斜め下から上方向へ回り込む。
文字は動かさない。
カメラ移動だけで主人公と文字の距離、重なり、前後関係が大きく変化して見える。
時間再開直前、一部分だけ赤へ変化。

## Shot 12 | .3–00:11.5

時間再開。
主人公が腕を振り切る。
文字列Aがその勢いのまま画面を高速横断。
逆方向から文字列Bが主人公の背後を通過。
二つの文字列が主人公を中心として前後ですれ違う。
カメラも横方向へ高速トラッキング。

## Shot 13 | .5–00:12.8

高速クライマックス。
顔アップ。
全身。
極端なローアングル。
横顔。
手元。
短いハードカットで連続切り替え。
すべてのカットで人物のスケール、カメラ位置、角度を変える。
文字列A・文字列Bは主人公の身体動作に追従する。
高速移動。
瞬間的な字間変化。
短い分解と再整列。
白から赤またはオレンジへの瞬間的な色変更。
これらを短いアクセントとして使用する。
文字のモーションよりも主人公とカメラの速度感を優先する。

## Shot 14 | .8–00:15.0

最終ヒーローショット。
主人公の斜め側面近くから開始。
カメラが主人公の周囲を大きく高速オービットしながら正面へ回り込む。
途中、文字列Aが主人公の背後から手前へ移動。
文字列Bが前景側から主人公の背後へ抜ける。
カメラが二つの文字列の間を高速で通り抜けながら主人公正面へ到達。
主人公が両手を軽く動かす。
その動きに引き寄せられるように文字列A・文字列Bが左右から集まる。
二つの文字列が主人公の周囲へ正しく整列。
整列直前だけ字間が大きく広がる。
最後のビートで一気に正しい間隔へ戻る。
主人公が手を止める。
文字も完全停止。
最後の約0.4秒だけ安定した強いヒーロー構図を保持する。

## 制約

追加人物を出さない。
キャラクターの顔、髪型、衣装を変更しない。
冒頭で設定した文字列A・文字列B以外の文字を表示しない。
意味不明な文字を生成しない。
字幕を表示しない。
文字を厚みのある3D文字にしない。
同じカメラ構図を繰り返さない。
長時間の静止ショットを作らない。
バレットタイム中は主人公と文字を完全静止させ、カメラだけを動かす。
文字の複雑なモーショングラフィックスを主人公やカメラより優先しない。

## Audio

高速でエッジの効いたスタイリッシュなインストゥルメンタル。
ボーカルなし。
セリフなし。
字幕なし。
主人公の身体動作、カメラ移動、文字の空間移動、カット、時間停止、時間再開を音楽のビートへ同期させる。
バレットタイム直前に音を急激に絞る。
時間停止中は音の空間だけを残す。
時間再開と同時に強いビートを戻す。

## 最重要

主人公の身体の動きを最優先する。
カメラを大きくダイナミックに動かす。
文字は主人公が操っているように動く。
使用文字は冒頭で指定された文字列A・文字列Bのみ。
白を基本に赤とオレンジをアクセントとして使用する。
文字のモーショングラフィックスは短いアクセントに限定する。
文字自体はフラットな2D。
空間の立体感はカメラ、距離、パララックス、前後関係によって表現する。

prompts.prompt:
Style: High-end 3D animated fighting game cinematic, ultra-detailed character design, premium AAA game trailer quality, dynamic anime-inspired realism, cinematic lighting, dramatic neon city atmosphere, fluid martial-arts animation, realistic cloth and hair physics, powerful impact effects, fast camera movement, motion blur, slow-motion hits, energetic hip-hop beat, bold arcade-style typography, polished game-commercial aesthetic, no gore, no blood, no watermark.

Main Character: A fearless young female street fighter with a confident gangster aesthetic — black leather jacket, fitted dark outfit, combat boots, gold accessories, fingerless gloves, stylish sunglasses, long moving hair, sharp expression. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit and identity completely consistent throughout.

0–3s — THE ARRIVAL

Nighttime neon city street surrounded by graffiti-covered walls, glowing signs, parked cars and a crowd of intimidating street fighters.

Low-angle cinematic shot of the girl walking toward camera.

Close-ups: boots hitting pavement → gold chain → gloves tightening → confident eyes.

She removes her sunglasses and looks directly at the opponents.

Typography slams onto screen:

“GAME ON.”

Bass drops.

3–7s — THE FIGHT

Several opponents rush toward her simultaneously.

She launches into fast, stylish martial-arts choreography — ducking under a punch, spinning kick, quick counterattack, dramatic elbow strike and agile evasive movements.

Camera rapidly switches between:

wide action shot → low-angle → 360° orbit → extreme close-up → dynamic overhead shot.

Every impact lands precisely on the hip-hop beat.

Add stylized energy bursts, dust particles, sparks and cinematic impact frames.

Typography flashes:

“NO FEAR.”
“NO MERCY.”

Keep the action intense but non-graphic.

7–11s — POWER MODE

The girl stands surrounded by defeated opponents who are visibly knocked down but unharmed.

The environment darkens.

Neon lights pulse behind her.

She cracks her knuckles and suddenly charges forward.

Use a dramatic slow-motion sequence as she performs a powerful spinning attack through multiple opponents, followed by a rapid speed ramp back to full speed.

Camera rotates around her while animated energy trails follow her movements.

Typography explodes across the frame:

“LEVEL UP.”

11–15s — FINAL BOSS MOMENT

A massive final opponent steps out of the smoke.

The girl smiles confidently.

Extreme close-up of her eyes.

Music suddenly cuts for half a second.

Then the final beat drops.

She launches forward with a spectacular cinematic finishing combo.

Final impact freezes into a stylized game-poster frame.

Huge typography:

“SHE RUNS THE STREETS.”

Small subtitle:

“FIGHT. RISE. DOMINATE.”

End with the girl standing confidently in the neon street as smoke and glowing particles move around her.

Camera: aggressive professional game-trailer cinematography, dynamic tracking, handheld energy, low-angle hero shots, 360° camera rotations, speed ramps, impact zooms and dramatic slow motion.

Animation: fluid body mechanics, believable martial-arts movement, consistent character proportions, realistic hair and clothing physics, detailed facial expressions.

Sound: fast hip-hop/trap instrumental, heavy bass, punchy drums, arcade-style impact sounds, crowd reactions, cinematic risers and a powerful final bass drop.

CRITICAL CONTINUITY: Same female protagonist, same face, same hairstyle, same gangster outfit, same environment and consistent character proportions throughout all 15 seconds. No random character changes, no distorted hands, no extra limbs, no gore.

prompts.title: A Dragon Awakens from Stone
prompts.prompt:
STYLE: Ultra-photorealistic live-action fantasy film, premium Hollywood creature VFX, realistic human performance, natural environmental physics, cinematic HDR lighting, atmospheric scale, practical-looking textures, no cartoon styling.

CHARACTER: Use Image 1 only as the exact facial identity reference for the woman. Preserve her recognizable facial features, hairstyle, skin tone and body proportions consistently. Completely different outfit: deep-olive traveling cloak, fitted cream tunic, dark brown trousers, worn leather ankle boots, small leather satchel.

CREATURE: A gigantic ancient ivory dragon with subtle warm-gold scales, enormous folded wings, weathered horns, scars and natural imperfections. Majestic, ancient and intelligent. No aggressive behavior.

0–3s — THE STRANGE SIGNAL

Aerial shot over a vast alpine valley at dawn. The woman walks alone through tall grass carrying an old brass compass.

Suddenly, the compass needle spins violently.

She stops.

Every sound in the valley disappears — the wind, birds and waterfalls become completely silent.

The woman looks toward a distant mountain.

3–6s — THE MOUNTAIN MOVES

A deep vibration travels through the ground.

The woman looks down.

Tiny stones around her begin sliding toward the mountain as if pulled by an invisible force.

She slowly follows them.

The camera pushes toward a massive cliff face.

A huge ancient eye suddenly opens within what appeared to be solid rock.

The woman freezes.

6–10s — THE IMPOSSIBLE REVEAL

The “mountain” slowly moves.

It is actually the sleeping dragon, almost completely covered by centuries of moss, stone and vegetation.

Its enormous body unfolds from the landscape.

Dust and loose stones fall from its weathered scales.

The woman realizes she has been standing beside a living creature that has been mistaken for part of the mountain for centuries.

10–13s — THE MEMORY

The dragon lowers its enormous head.

Instead of looking at the woman, it looks directly at her brass compass.

The compass suddenly opens by itself.

Inside is a tiny engraved symbol identical to a marking on the dragon's ancient horn.

The woman's expression changes from fear to disbelief.

The dragon gently exhales.

The compass needle stops and points toward the dragon.

13–15s — THE AWAKENING

The dragon suddenly turns its enormous head toward the distant horizon.

Far beyond the valley, another massive dragon-shaped shadow moves behind the clouds.

The woman looks up.

The ancient dragon spreads one enormous wing.

CUT TO BLACK.

FINAL FEELING: The woman has not discovered a dragon — she has accidentally awakened something that has been waiting for a very specific signal for centuries.

CAMERA: Cinematic handheld realism mixed with sweeping aerial shots, dramatic scale changes, shallow depth of field for character moments, subtle lens breathing, realistic motion blur.

LIGHTING: Cold blue dawn gradually interrupted by warm sunlight breaking through clouds.

SOUND: Wind and nature ambience → complete unnatural silence → deep subterranean vibration → enormous wing movement → final low-frequency dragon call.

Reference Images:

image2 

【REFERENCE】
image1 ＝人物三面図。顔、髪型、体型、頭身、全身比率、ユニフォーム、シューズ、2Dアニメ表現の基準。FRONT／SIDE／BACKを同一人物として全編維持する。
image2 ＝固定9パネルSB。左上→右、上段→中段→下段の順でPanel 1〜9として読み、動作順、構図、カメラ距離、ゴールとの位置関係の基準とする。人物は常にimage1 を優先し、SB内の顔、髪型、性別表現、体型、衣装色は継承しない。シート本体、3×3分割、枠、静止画表現は映像に出さず、9パネルを自然な中間動作でつないだ1本の連続アクションへ変換する。

【CONDITION】
15秒。日本の漫画・アニメ調による、ミニマルでシネマティックなロンググライド・ダンク。白基調の明るいシームレス空間に、同一選手1人、ボール1個、ゴール1基、薄い接地影、背景タイポグラフィ、最下層の薄い背景MGのみ。マッチ・オン・アクションで動作、ボール、身体、速度、ゴールとの距離を自然につなぎ、踏み切りからダンク完了まで保持手を変えない。
タイポはDRIVE / RISE / DUNKのみ。人物・ボール・ゴールの後方、画面上部の固定レイアウトに上から順に蓄積し、カメラ移動の影響を受けない。DRIVE＝明るいシアン、RISE＝明るいライムグリーン、DUNK＝鮮やかなバイオレット。
背景の最下層にのみ、薄いモーショングラフィックを追加する。細い速度線、細い軌道線、薄いリング、控えめな幾何学ライン程度に限定し、低密度で、人物・ボール・ゴールより後方、タイポグラフィより下のレイヤーで動かす。背景MGはタイポグラフィの位置、固定状態、見え方に影響を与えない。
背景全体は常に白基調のハイキー空間を維持する。開始時はほぼ純白。DRIVE後はごく薄いシアン寄りの白、RISE後はごく薄いミント〜ライム寄りの白、DUNK後はごく薄いバイオレット〜マゼンタ寄りの白へ穏やかに変化する。背景色は淡く明るいまま変化し、濃いグレー、黒、暗いグラデーション、急な暗転へ移行しない。

【SHOT FLOW】
0.0〜1.0秒｜Panel 1｜START
中距離全身3/4。ボールを持つ静かな開始姿勢。ゴールはまだ見せない。背景はほぼ純白。巨大でごく薄いDRIVEを背景に一部だけ見せる。まだ発音しない。背景MGは最小限。
1.0〜2.5秒｜Panel 2｜MOVE
片手ドリブルを明確に行いながら前進。ボールが手→床→手へ戻る動作を見せる。前側3/4で追従。DRIVEが左から入り、上部1段目へ固定。固定した瞬間、画面外から“Drive.”。最下層では薄い速度線MGが進行方向へ流れ、背景はごく薄いシアン寄りの白へ変化する。
2.5〜3.8秒｜Panel 3｜ACCELERATION
前側3/4で片手ドリブルを維持し、歩幅、ボール上下動、速度を強調。DRIVEは固定。背景MGは低密度の細線として後方へ流れる。追加発話なし。
3.8〜5.3秒｜Panel 4｜FINAL APPROACH
側面寄り3/4。最後のドリブルから同じ手で滑らかにボールをすくい上げ、踏み切り準備へ連続移行。両手で抱えて停止しない。ゴールが前方に現れ、動作軸を越えない。背景MGは進行方向へ収束する。
5.3〜8.6秒｜Panel 5｜LONG GLIDE / RISE
遠い位置から片足で離陸し、全身を横へ伸ばして長く滑空。やや引いた見上げ3/4で選手とゴールの距離を同一画面に見せる。RISEが右側から入り、DRIVEの下へ固定。固定した瞬間、画面外から“Rise.”。背景MGは薄いリングと軌道線を追加し、背景は淡いミント〜ライム寄りの白へ穏やかに変化する。
8.6〜10.4秒｜Panel 6｜RIM APPROACH
同じジャンプ・同じ保持手でリムへ接近。Panel 5と同じ側からカメラを近づけ、顔、腕、ボール、リムを明確に見せる。DRIVE / RISEは固定。背景MGは過密にせず、後方で控えめに流す。
10.4〜11.9秒｜Panel 7｜DUNK

prompts.title: One Golden Thread Weaves a Fantasy World and Emblem
prompts.prompt:
Create an epic fantasy title sequence built around a vast living tapestry. The sequence must feel like an entire world is being born from a single thread.

Begin in near darkness. Only the faint texture of woven fabric is visible. At the very center, one lone thread awakens. It trembles, pulls tight, glows faintly, and begins moving across the surface like a living force. As it races forward, it splits into more threads. Those threads split again, multiplying rapidly into branching strands of gold, crimson, ivory, midnight blue, and ash-gray. Everything in the sequence must originate from this first thread and its descendants. The world should feel as if it is being generated from one living source.

The camera moves dynamically and continuously through the tapestry, never static. It races low across the woven surface, whips past rising embroidered forms, glides along rivers made of flowing thread, dives through deep folds and valleys of cloth, and sweeps between giant raised textile structures. The camera must always remain on the exposed upper surface of the tapestry. It may skim across folds and pass through openings between raised embroidered forms, but it must never travel beneath the fabric.

The world should not simply appear. It must actively weave itself into existence in real time. At every moment, visible threads must remain in motion, constantly splitting, branching, knotting, braiding, tightening, and constructing new terrain, landmarks, symbols, and regions ahead of the camera. The world must never feel complete until the final logo reveal. The strongest visual rule is this: if something appears, it should be because threads are physically making it.

Cities, kingdoms, and landmarks must all be built through textile transformation. Threads knot together into towers, fortresses, ceremonial structures, bridges, and gates. Layers of cloth fold upward into cliffs, walls, and ridges. Roads are sewn rapidly across the land. Banners unfurl from the weave. Forests spread outward stitch by stitch as fibers become roots, trunks, branches, and canopies. Rivers are pulled into place by shimmering strands. Coastlines tighten into shape like stretched cloth under tension. Nothing should materialize passively. Everything must be woven, stitched, tied, pulled, or braided into existence by moving thread.

Each major region should feel like its own construction event. In one kingdom, royal motifs and heraldic embroidery bloom outward in ornate patterns. In another, scorched threads blacken and curl as if marked by war. In a frozen region, pale threads crystallize into icy stitched structures. In a desert realm, sand-colored silk folds into dunes and radiant sun motifs. In a battlefield region, red threads race violently across the surface like spreading conflict. In every case, the region should be visibly built by thread activity, not simply revealed.

Use aggressive but elegant camera choreography: fast push-ins, sweeping arcs, sharp climbs, dramatic pull-backs, overhead reveals, and low-angle passes through giant stitched landmarks and dense moving fibers. Let the camera chase the leading edge of construction. Often follow one strand as it races into empty fabric and begins creating the next formation. The camera should feel as if it is surfing the growth of the world itself.

The tapestry should feel handcrafted, ancient, ceremonial, and mythic. Show rich textile detail everywhere: layered cloth, frayed edges, gold thread, dense embroidery, woven symbols, stitched heraldry, seams, folds, braided cords, hanging fibers, and visible tension in the fabric. If desired, briefly glimpse looms, spools, or unseen weaving forces at the edges of the frame, but keep the main focus on the living tapestry and its self-weaving world.

The pacing should escalate constantly. Start with the mystery of one awakened thread. Then let that thread multiply into many. Then let those many threads begin forming entire regions. Then let multiple regions awaken at once as long strands travel across the tapestry and connect distant kingdoms, roads, battles, and symbols. The sequence should feel as if history, bloodlines, war, and power are all being woven from one original source.

Lighting should be dramatic and cinematic, with warm highlights skimming across thread textures, deep shadows in folds of cloth, soft glow passing through thin fabric, and floating dust in the air. The tone should feel majestic, ancient, noble, immersive, and alive.

Toward the climax, reveal that all kingdoms, roads, battles, and symbols are interconnected through one vast woven design. Long threads travel across the entire tapestry and begin drawing everything toward a central point. Regional patterns, sigils, and story elements align into one unified composition.

If a logo reference image is supplied, use that logo as the exact design authority for the ending. Preserve its silhouette, proportions, and core graphic structure. Do not simply reveal, overlay, or fade in the logo. Instead, the final logo must be physically built in real time from the same thread lineage that created the world. The first awakened thread and all the threads that descended from it should ultimately converge and construct the final emblem. Kingdoms, roads, rivers, banners, heraldic motifs, and regional patterns must unravel back into fibers and feed the final construction. Braided cords define the main silhouette. Dense embroidery fills the interior forms. Fine metallic threads complete the small details. The final logo should feel as if the whole world has transformed into it.

If no logo reference image is supplied, end with an original fantasy crest or title emblem emerging through the same thread-construction logic.

End with the completed logo fully stitched into the tapestry as a monumental embroidered insignia. The surrounding lands continue to ripple subtly with life as a few final strands glide into place, tighten, and lock the design.

Tone: majestic, ancient, dramatic, elegant, immersive, ceremonial, and alive.
Style keywords: living tapestry, single-origin thread, embroidered fantasy world, woven kingdoms, dynamic textile transformation, cinematic title sequence, mythic handcrafted world-building, epic camera motion.
Format: 16:9, highly detailed, no modern elements, no direct copy of any existing franchise.
