prompts.title: An Anime Ensemble in Black-and-Red Collage
prompts.prompt:
15秒、16:9。高品質2DアニメPV / グラフィックMV。

1、 2、 3、 4、 5 の5人を主要キャラクターとして使用する。

6 は終盤に使用する総集ビジュアル参照。

参照画像そのものの構図、背景、ポーズ、カメラ位置をそのまま再現しない。

各参照は人物同一性・顔・衣装・装備・世界観の基準として使用し、映像内では新しいポーズ、新しいアングル、新しい構図へ再構成する。

4はキャラクターと装備のみ参照し、キャラクターシートのレイアウト、図表、文字、説明欄、白背景を映像へ持ち込まない。

6は一枚絵としてそのまま貼り付けず、終盤の総集演出・最終コラージュ・エンドカード演出の参考として使う。

セリフなし。字幕なし。説明文なし。

画面内に存在する文字はすべて映像演出としてのタイポグラフィであり、字幕として配置しない。

全体コンセプト

退廃的で華やかなゴシック・アニメPV。

基本色：

黒 / 赤 / 白

アクセントとして各キャラクター固有色を残す。

画面外周には細密なゴシック装飾フレーム。

背景には、

黒い虚空

赤く発光する床

白黒格子

ゴシック建築の抽象シルエット

万華鏡

赤い円環

巨大な手

鎖

幾何学模様

を使用する。

全体を一つの現実空間として描く必要はない。

アニメPV、漫画PV、ファッション映像、タイトルシークエンス、コラージュMVを融合した映像空間として構成する。

テンポは非常に速い。

0.5秒ごとに、人物・構図・タイポグラフィ・背景・カメラ・ポーズのいずれかを必ず大きく変化させる。

タイポグラフィ

使用する単語：

ENVY

PRIDE

WRATH

GREED

LUST

GLUTTONY

SLOTH

中心語は ENVY。

文字は極太の縦長サンセリフ。

文字を単純に読ませるのではなく、

巨大な壁

人物を遮る前景

背景建築

仮面

額縁

トンネル

床

万華鏡の断片

シルエット内部

キャラクター同士の境界

画面を分断する板

崩壊する空間構造

として扱う。

文字が人物の前と後ろの両方を通る。

文字の一部が顔、腕、身体を隠してよい。

文字には必要に応じて、

薄い水平グリッチ、走査線、色収差、赤い発光、短いフラッシュ、残像

を使用する。

ただしサイバーパンクにはしない。

あくまでゴシック × 退廃 × ファッション × タイポグラフィを維持する。

タイムライン

0.0–0.5秒

5。

黒背景。

中央に静かに立つ 5を、左右から現れる巨大な赤い手が囲む。

背後には巨大な白文字 ENVY。

文字の背後に赤黒い万華鏡が高速回転。

カメラがわずかに前進。

0.5–1.0秒

高速フラッシュ。

3を左右反転した二重像として配置。

同一人物を鏡像化した疑似双子構図。

巨大な PRIDE が前景を横切り、二人の顔を交互に遮る。

背景は白黒格子の万華鏡。

1.0–1.5秒

3の顔アップ。

手を顔の前で合わせる。

手前に巨大な手のシルエット。

PRIDE の文字が左右へ開き、その隙間から瞳が現れる。

急速なズームイン。

1.5–2.0秒

3が手を交差。

カメラを少し傾ける。

白黒幾何学背景。

細長く引き伸ばされた LUST が人物の前後を蛇行する。

2.0–2.5秒

赤背景へ瞬間切替。

2を完全な黒いシルエットとして後ろ姿から見せる。

フードと衣装の輪郭だけ残す。

巨大な SLOTH が背景の建築物のように垂直に立つ。

髪と衣装だけがゆっくり揺れる。

2.5–3.0秒

1と 2。

二人をわずかに重ねたコラージュ。

片方は正面、片方は横顔。

ピンク、紫、黒の万華鏡。

中央を巨大な ENVY が通過し、二人を分断する。

3.0–3.5秒

2。

ローアングル。

カメラへ向かって手を伸ばす。

巨大な GREED が奥からカメラ方向へ高速で迫る。

文字と人物が同一遠近空間に存在する。

3.5–4.0秒

赤一色の背景。

4と 5を黒いシルエット化。

左右から向き合う。

5が手を伸ばす。

二人の間を WRATH が斜めに横断。

文字中央に亀裂が走る。

4.0–4.5秒

3を二重化した鏡像構図。

二人が背中合わせで低く屈む。

黒背景。

赤く光るひし形ステージ。

床面に巨大な PRIDE が反射している。

4.5–5.0秒

鏡像 3が向き合う。

中央で片手を合わせる。

左右に分割された ENVY が中央で接続する。

完全な左右対称構図。

5.0–5.5秒

鏡像 3。

極端な顔寄り。

二人が背中合わせ。

カメラが高速で周囲を約30度回り込む。

PRIDE / ENVY の巨大文字が多重露光のように前後へずれる。

5.5–6.0秒

1と 5。

背中合わせで立つ。

黒い虚空。

足元だけ赤いひし形ステージ。

背景奥へ GREED が何層も連続し、巨大な文字トンネルを作る。

6.0–6.5秒

1が前方へ回り込む。

身体を低く落とす。

カメラも同時に下降。

巨大な GLUTTONY が横方向へ圧縮され、画面全体を押し潰す。

6.5–7.0秒

1が膝をつく。

その背後に 5。

5がカメラへ手を伸ばす。

背後の巨大な ENVY が縦長の祭壇のように立つ。

7.0–7.5秒

3と 4。

赤いひし形ステージ上。

二人とも低い姿勢。

カメラは低い位置から急接近。

周囲を SLOTH の巨大文字が壁のように囲む。

7.5–8.0秒

さらに二人が沈み込む。

背景が完全な黒へ。

人物だけに細い赤と白のリムライト。

SLOTH の輪郭文字が暗闇へ沈む。

音楽も一瞬だけ音数を減らす。

8.0–8.5秒

高速横ワイプ。

画面を複数の水平帯へ分割。

それぞれの帯に、

1、 2、 3、 4、 5 の目元、手元、横顔、装備、シルエットを一瞬ずつ表示。

同時に、

ENVY / WRATH / PRIDE / GREED の文字断片が万華鏡のように回転。

8.5–9.0秒

3。

真正面。

手を顔の前で合わせる。

巨大な ENVY が顔の前に存在し、文字そのものが仮面になる。

9.0–9.5秒

@3が手を開く。

同時に ENVY が左右へ裂ける。

文字の隙間から顔が現れる。

カメラへ高速ズーム。

白黒格子も放射状に広がる。

9.5–10.0秒

3の手が下へスライド。

巨大な黒い PRIDE が上から落下。

人物の大部分を覆う。

薄い赤グリッチ。

完全暗転する直前で切替。

10.0–10.5秒

5。

冒頭構図へ回帰。

巨大な赤い手。

黒背景。

巨大な ENVY。

今回は文字をより前景へ配置し、 5の身体の一部まで遮る。

10.5–11.0秒

1と 2。

二人を重ねる。

背景はピンク・赤・黒の万華鏡。

細長い ENVY が二人の周囲をリボンのように旋回する。

11.0–11.5秒

2。

カメラへ急接近。

片手を前へ。

巨大な GREED も同時にカメラへ迫り、文字が画面いっぱいになる。

11.5–12.0秒

赤背景。

4のシルエット。

衣装と装備の輪郭を強調。

髪と布が横風になびく。

一方の手を伸ばす。

巨大な WRATH がその手の方向から裂ける。

12.0–12.5秒

3を再び鏡像二重化。

暗い円形ステージで二人が膝をつく。

周囲に巨大な円環状 SLOTH / PRIDE 文字がゴシックの祭壇のように回転。

12.5–13.0秒

鏡像 3が中央で手を合わせる。

左右から ENVY が扉のように閉じる。

閉じる直前、二人の顔だけが文字の隙間に残る。

13.0–13.5秒

1と 5。

再び背中合わせ。

赤い床が一気に点灯。

背景奥へ GREED / GLUTTONY / GREED / GLUTTONY が交互に連続。

文字トンネルが高速で奥へ後退する。

13.5–14.0秒

1が低く身をかがめる。

5はその背後からカメラへ手を伸ばす。

画面全体の文字、フレーム、格子が砕け始める。

破片が万華鏡へ吸い込まれる。

14.0–14.5秒

高速モンタージュ。

1、 2、 3、 4、 5 を0.1秒前後ずつ断続的に切り替える。

顔アップ、手、目、横顔、全身シルエット。

周囲に七つの単語が断片化して飛散。

飛散した破片が一点へ収束し、 6の構図へ向かう予兆を作る。

14.5–15.0秒

6を基準にした総集コラージュ・エンドカード。

ここで初めて、5人すべてを一つの画面に集約する。

ただし@6をそのまま静止画として貼らず、動く最終ビジュアルとして再構成する。

中央に 5、背後に巨大な ENVY。

周囲に 1、 2、 3、 4 をバランス良く配置。

左右から巨大な赤い手。

外周にはゴシック装飾フレーム。

周辺に PRIDE / WRATH / GREED / LUST / GLUTTONY / SLOTH をコラージュ配置。

小さな揺れ、髪のなびき、文字の脈動、微細なズーム、赤いグリッチ、万華鏡の回転を入れて、完全静止にはしない。

最終瞬間、

中央の ENVY がわずかに明滅し、

赤い水平グリッチを一発だけ走らせて、

黒へ落として終了。

カメラ・編集ルール

0.5秒以上、同一構図を固定しない。

静止画を順番に並べたスライドショーにしない。

キャラクター自身も、手、髪、身体、視線、姿勢を継続的に動かす。

顔アップ → 全身 → 横顔 → ローアングル → シルエット → 対称構図を激しく切り替える。

同一人物でも毎回異なる構図を使用する。

参照画像をそのまま画面へ貼らない。

1〜 5を融合させない。

別キャラクターの顔、髪、衣装、装備を混ぜない。

鏡像演出では同じ人物を明確に複製し、別人物との融合にしない。

巨大文字は必ず3D的な奥行き、遮蔽、前後関係を持たせる。

ゴシック装飾フレームは存在するが、映像を窮屈にしすぎない。

グリッチは切替補助として短く使用し、映像全体を常時壊さない。

6は終盤の総集演出専用。中盤以前では直接再現しない。

ラストの パートも「静止ポスター化」ではなく、PVとしての動きと奥行きを持たせる。音速いジャズ・スウィング。ブラス、ウッドベース、ブラシドラムを中心にする。電子EDMにはしない。文字の出現には短い打楽器アクセント。画面切替にはブラシ、シンバル、ブラスヒットを同期。8秒付近だけ一瞬音数を減らす。8.5秒から再加速。14秒以降は急激に密度を上げる。14.5秒以降、 6の総集エンドカードでは主旋律を最も強くまとめる。15.0秒で短く明確に終了する。

prompts.title: Snowboarding across Mountain Slopes
prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic cinematic winter sports video of a young female snowboarder at a breathtaking high-altitude snowy mountain resort. She wears a bright blue ski jacket, black snow pants, black gloves, and a white helmet with reflective ski goggles.

Start with a close-up as she adjusts her goggles and smiles confidently at the camera, surrounded by vast snow-covered mountains under a crystal-clear blue sky. Transition into dynamic action shots of her snowboarding rapidly down a pristine slope, carving smoothly through fresh powder and leaving a dramatic trail of snow behind her. Follow her from behind and from low-angle tracking shots as she approaches a large snow ramp, launches into the air, performs a stylish snowboard trick, and lands smoothly.

Use realistic snow physics, natural body movement, detailed mountain textures, crisp sunlight, cinematic camera movement, slight motion blur, dramatic wide-angle aerial shots, and an energetic luxury sports-commercial aesthetic. Vertical 9:16, ultra-realistic, high detail, smooth transitions, natural lighting, 4K cinematic quality.

prompts.title: From Market Snacks to a Rainy Alley
prompts.prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic cinematic 15-second Korean lifestyle film following a young Korean woman with long dark hair in a low ponytail, wearing a cream T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans, white sneakers, and carrying a beige reusable shopping bag. Maintain consistent face, hairstyle, clothing, proportions, and accessories throughout.

She enters a lively traditional Korean market, walking naturally between crowded stalls while vendors call to customers and shoppers move around her. She stops at a produce stall, gently inspects peaches and tomatoes, selects fresh produce, and places them into her reusable bag. The bag swings naturally with her movement and becomes slightly heavier.

She approaches a hot-food stall where a vendor stirs sizzling food in a metal pan. Steam rises naturally from the heat. The vendor offers her a small sample on a wooden pick. She tastes it and reacts with a subtle, genuine smile.

She then pays the vendor with several coins, creating a soft metallic sound, secures her shopping bag, and walks toward the market exit.

Transition into a narrow traditional Korean residential alley. As she walks beneath tiled rooftops, light rain begins to fall. The pavement gradually becomes wet, small ripples form in shallow puddles, and subtle reflections appear on the ground. She looks upward, smiles, pulls the shopping bag closer, and continues walking as the rain gently increases.

End with a cinematic rear tracking shot as she disappears deeper into the peaceful rainy alley.

100% photorealistic live-action, authentic Korean market atmosphere, natural human acting, realistic food preparation, physically accurate object interaction, believable gravity, momentum, friction, weight, steam convection, rain dynamics, wet pavement, natural hair and clothing movement, documentary-style handheld camera, realistic skin texture, cinematic depth of field, natural lighting, restrained color grading, smooth transitions, authentic ambient market and street sounds.

No CGI look, no artificial faces, no robotic movement, no teleportation, no floating objects, no duplicated people, no changing face, clothing, or hairstyle, no unrealistic steam or rain, no weightless shopping bag, no fantasy physics, no excessive camera shake, no slow motion, no text, subtitles, logos, or watermark.

prompts.title: Secretly Feeding a Dog on Old Film
prompts.prompt:
ULTRA REALISTIC 15 SECOND HOME MOVIE. 1080p render of early 1950s 16mm Kodachrome film footage. 4:3 frame. Single continuous handheld take, no cuts. Title: WOH KUTTA.

CONCEPT
1953. A young woman is secretly feeding a street dog at the back door of the family house. She has been told not to. Her cousin is filming her doing it, which means there is now evidence. The dog behaves like it already lives there.

SUBJECT LOCK
Indian woman, early twenties, warm medium brown skin, realistic pores, no modern makeup, small bindi. Hair centre parted, pulled back into a low bun with strands loose at the temples. Cream hand knit cardigan with stretched cuffs over a plain cotton saree, thin gold bangles, simple leather sandals. Same face, hair and outfit for the full 15 seconds. Crouched on her heels, one hand shielding a steel bowl, glancing over her shoulder at the house.

ANIMAL LOCK
Medium sized Indian street dog, short tan coat, one ear folded, ribs faintly visible, completely at ease. Sits before it is asked to. Eats fast, then leans its whole weight against her knee.

SETTING
Back doorstep of an older family house, early 1950s, late afternoon. Lime washed wall, a drain channel, a stack of firewood, a hand pump, wet patches on the stone, a neem tree throwing broken shade. Period accurate, no modern objects anywhere in frame. No visible brands, no logos, no readable signage.

CAMERA
Early 1950s handheld 16mm spring wound movie camera at chest height, inexperienced operator. Framing too low, cutting off her head at the top of frame for two seconds before correcting. Fixed focus so the dog is sharp and her face is soft. Hand set exposure, sunlit wall blown to white, the shaded doorstep crushed to black. One jerk downward when the operator laughs. No zoom, no stabilization, no gimbal.

FILM STOCK AND ARTEFACTS
Early Kodachrome, heavy warm saturation in reds and yellows, weak blues, green cast in shadow. Gate weave, frame breathing side to side. Dust and hair on the gate, one vertical scratch, one splice jump. Halation glow on highlights. Heavy grain. Undercranked 16 frames per second played at 24, so movement is slightly too fast and jerky. Rounded soft corners, mild vignette. No digital sharpness.

BEATS
0:00 to 0:04 She is crouched with the bowl, dog already eating, her attention entirely on the doorway behind her.
0:04 to 0:08 She notices the camera, freezes for half a second, then keeps feeding it anyway and speaks the first line.
0:08 to 0:12 Dead air. The dog finishes and leans into her leg. She scratches its folded ear and says nothing. Camera holds too long.
0:12 to 0:15 A door sound from inside the house. She stands fast, hides the bowl behind her back, the dog does not move at all, and the spring runs down.

DIALOGUE AND SOUND TREATMENT
Camera records no sound. Audio is a thin separate wild track, mono, band limited, hissy, one to two frames out of sync with the lips.
0:06 She says Kisi ko mat batana, samjhe
0:13 She says Ye mera nahi hai, sach mein
Spoken language locked to Hindi. Mouth movement roughly matches but never locks precisely. No other speech, no narration, no voiceover.

AUDIO
Diegetic only. Steel bowl scraping stone, the dog eating, crows, a hand pump handle, water on stone, a bicycle bell in the lane, a door latch inside the house, the mechanical whirr of the spring wound camera. Thin, mono, slightly hissy. No music, no score, no added ambience beds.

STYLE RULES
Nothing dramatic happens on purpose. No posing, no exaggerated reactions, no hero framing, no sentimental animal close ups. The dog is treated as a person she is covering for. Realism comes from the guilty glance, the low framing and the dead air nobody bothered to cut. If she performs for the lens the illusion breaks.

NEGATIVE
No music. No subtitles. No captions. No watermark. No timestamp. No slow motion. No colour grading. No lens flare. No shallow depth of field. No modern clothing. No modern objects. No brand logos. No readable text.

LAST FRAME
Her standing with the bowl hidden behind her back, dog still sitting at her feet, frame weaving and underexposed, image fading as the spring winds down, then hard cut to black. Absolutely no on screen text, no title card, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no signage of any kind in the final frame.

prompts.title: Bread and Flowers on a Seoul Morning
prompts.prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic cinematic 15-second Korean lifestyle film following a young Korean woman with long dark hair in a low ponytail, wearing a fitted cream T-shirt, relaxed light-blue jeans, white sneakers, and carrying a natural canvas tote bag. Maintain consistent face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and accessories throughout.

She leaves her apartment and walks through a quiet Korean residential alley in soft morning sunlight. She locks the door, adjusts her tote, and continues naturally toward a cozy neighborhood bakery.

Inside the bakery, she chooses a fresh loaf and small pastry. The baker places them into a paper bag, she pays, takes the bag, and carefully places it inside her tote. The added weight subtly changes the tote's position and swing.

She continues to a tiny flower shop, briefly touches a colorful bouquet as flowers move gently in the breeze, smiles at the shopkeeper, and walks on.

She reaches a small wooden bench, sits naturally, places her tote beside her, unwraps the pastry, and takes a bite. Two bicycles pass naturally in the background as she briefly watches them.

Thin clouds soften the sunlight while a gentle breeze moves her ponytail and nearby tree leaves. End on a warm close-up of her relaxed natural smile, with the Korean residential alley softly blurred behind her.

prompts.title: Chocolate Pours into a Drink Ad
prompts.prompt:
A 15-second 2D flat motion-graphics commercial in a clean, rich chocolate-drink style. Soft warm beige / pale cream paper-textured background. Limited palette: deep cocoa brown, creamy off-white, milk-chocolate amber, gold sparkle accents, and thin warm-cream highlight lines. Smooth, weighty liquid animation, glossy pours, and soft squash-and-stretch. No photorealism — bold graphic shapes with slight paper grain.
0.0–1.2s
Scattered glossy dark-brown chocolate droplets of different sizes float and drift slowly across the empty cream background, each with a small cream highlight.

1.2–2.5s
The droplets gather and pour downward in a thick, ribbon-like stream, forming a white-outlined short tumbler glass. Rich brown liquid fills it from the top and overflows in a rounded, velvety splash.
2.5–4.0s
A second graphic can tilts in from the top-right and pours a continuous chocolate stream into the glass. The liquid fills completely; cream-colored circular swirls rise inside. Small gold sparkles appear around the rim and splash.

4.0–6.0s
The finished drink: short white-outlined glass of glossy chocolate, condensation dots as simple white circles, “Cokoa” lettering on the glass. A standing can appears beside it. Graphic chocolate chunks and a cocoa-powder pile slide in at the bottom-left. Blue-cream curved splash lines and gold four-pointed stars pop around the scene. The camera eases slightly closer; the pour feels thick, creamy, and alive.
6.0–8.5s
The drink and splash dissolve into large, bold, condensed cream typography that reads THE PERFECT POUR. The letters first appear as if they are filled with the same flowing chocolate and cream swirls, then the liquid drains away leaving solid cream lettering sitting on a wide, organic dark-brown splash / wave shape that looks like overflowing chocolate.

8.5–15s
The title stays locked on screen. Small brown droplets continue to bounce on and around the letters. Supporting text types on underneath in a clean condensed cream font: first CREAMY. then expanding to the short product line Indulge in the rich and creamy goodness of Cokoa.
A tiny logo lockup appears at the bottom center: the word Cokoa plus a miniature standing can. Subtle swirl, droplet, and sparkle animation continues until the end.
Mood: rich, satisfying, slightly luxurious everyday chocolate treat. Timing should feel snappy and weighty — liquids have body, cream is soft, pours have momentum, text has a juicy “splash” reveal. Keep everything graphic, flat, and highly readable.

prompts.title: Changing Outfits with Clothing Icons
prompts.prompt:
互动点击变装提示词

时长：15秒
比例：9:16
人物参考：图片1
语言：无对白
音频：轻快时尚音乐、鼠标点击声、短促换装音效
屏幕文字：仅允许标题“你选哪一套”

人物参考规则：
仅参考 📷图片1 图片1锁定成年女主的五官、脸型、肤色、发型和人物身份。全程必须是同一个人，服装变化时脸部、身材、发型与妆容保持一致。

场景：

现代高档公寓客厅，奶油色大理石地面、深色胡桃木墙板、暖白隐藏灯带、落地窗、远处城市夜景、浅色设计师沙发和金属落地灯。空间整洁、宽敞、高级，暖色电影灯光，真实手机时尚穿搭视频质感。
Camera：

竖屏固定机位，全身构图，镜头略低于胸口，女主站在画面中央。全程不推拉、不摇移、不切换背景。
标题设计：

画面顶部中央固定显示准确中文：
“你选哪一套”

高级香槟金中文字体，轻微立体浮雕与柔和发光，下方有一条纤细金色手绘弧线。标题从开头淡入后保持不动，不能变字、错字或重复出现。
贴纸菜单：

画面左右边缘固定排列六枚穿搭贴纸，每枚贴纸都是女主对应服装的全身剪影，带白色模切描边和轻微阴影，像时尚手账贴纸。贴纸不能遮挡女主面部和身体。

一枚清晰的白色鼠标箭头带深灰描边，在贴纸之间移动。每次鼠标按下时：

1. 鼠标尖端必须准确落在对应贴纸上；
2. 出现一圈小型点击波纹；

3. 被点击贴纸快速放大至108%，再弹回原位；

4. 同一瞬间主角服装匹配剪辑切换；
5. 人物身体、手势、站位和背景完全不动；
6. 伴随清脆“咔哒”声和短促“唰”声。
SHOT 1（00:00-00:02.00）初始造型
女主穿第一套黑色时尚造型站在公寓中央：黑色修身吊带短裙，外搭黑色透明薄纱长袖上衣，银色细项链，黑色高跟鞋。
她双手在腰前轻轻交叠，微笑看向镜头。六枚穿搭贴纸从画面边缘依次弹入，顶部标题“你选哪一套”淡入。

00:01.50，鼠标移动至左上方浅绿色贴纸并点击。

SHOT 2（00:02.00-00:04.00）浅绿色礼裙

点击瞬间，服装切换为浅鼠尾草绿色单肩修身短裙：立体花朵肩饰、不对称斜领、褶皱束腰、雕花蕾丝拼接裙身、同色细高跟鞋。

女主保持原站位，右手轻轻托起裙侧，身体向左转约20度，展示腰线后重新面对镜头。

00:03.50，鼠标移动至左侧中部灰色贴纸并点击。

SHOT 3（00:04.00-00:06.00）银灰色修身裙

服装瞬间切换为高级银灰色挂脖修身短裙：不对称胸前剪裁、腰侧小面积镂空、侧边褶皱、银灰细高跟鞋。

女主左手抱在腰前，右手指尖轻触下巴，神情冷艳自信。人物切换前后头部角度和双腿位置必须一致。

00:05.50，鼠标点击右侧中部牛仔贴纸。

SHOT 4（00:06.00-00:08.00）高级牛仔套装

服装切换为深蓝短款牛仔夹克、象牙白修身背心、高腰深蓝牛仔短裤、金属腰链和白色高跟短靴。

女主一手叉腰，另一只手做轻微展示动作，肩膀随音乐小幅摆动，表情自然俏皮。

00:07.50，鼠标点击右上方紫色贴纸。

SHOT 5（00:08.00-00:10.00）淡紫色层叠套装

服装切换为淡紫色结构感挂脖上衣：立体收腰、不对称尖角下摆；搭配白色双层荷叶边短裙、淡紫色细高跟鞋。

女主双手在脸侧短暂张开，随后一只手托在腰侧，裙摆因转身轻轻摆动。

00:09.50，鼠标点击右侧下方黑白贴纸。

SHOT 6（00:10.00-00:12.00）黑白名媛套装

服装切换为黑色修身针织短开衫、白色包边与珍珠纽扣、白色内搭、黑白蕾丝层叠短裙、黑色高跟鞋。

女主轻轻整理开衫下摆，侧身展示裙子的黑白蕾丝层次，再回头看向镜头微笑。

00:11.50，鼠标移动至左下方紫色长裙贴纸并点击。

SHOT 7（00:12.00-00:15.00）紫色压轴造型

服装切换为白底紫色花卉露肩束身上衣，搭配高级深紫色高腰修身长裙和银色高跟鞋。长裙线条利落，面料带轻微丝绒光泽。

00:12.00-00:13.50，女主双手沿上衣轮廓做简洁展示，然后右手叉腰，身体转向侧面约30度。

00:13.50-00:15.00，鼠标箭头快速划过六枚贴纸，每枚贴纸依次轻微发光。女主回到正面，左手摊开指向贴纸菜单，右手叉腰，歪头看向镜头，露出询问式微笑。

顶部“你选哪一套”微微增亮，所有贴纸保持清楚，画面定格结束。

变装约束：

每次换装只能由鼠标点击贴纸触发。不能在鼠标到达前换装；不能点击错误贴纸；主角穿上的服装必须与被点击贴纸完全对应。转场使用1—2帧匹配硬切加轻微白色轮廓闪光，不使用烟雾、爆炸、遮挡或身体融化。

Negative：

鼠标消失，多个鼠标，鼠标点空白处，点击位置错误，贴纸与服装不对应，未点击提前换装，自动连续换装，人物姿势跳变，人物位移，背景变化，镜头切换，服装融化，身体变形，脸部变化，发型变化，贴纸位置漂移，贴纸遮挡面部，重复贴纸，乱码贴纸，错误中文，标题变成其他文字，额外字幕，英文文字，服装串套，裙装变裤装，衣料穿模，多余手臂，多余手指，手指粘连，脚底滑动，塑料皮肤，动漫感，过度磨皮，低档出租屋，杂乱背景，水印，Logo

prompts.title: Cream Swirls into Dessert Typography
prompts.prompt:
A 15-second 2D flat motion-graphics commercial in a clean, minimal kawaii dessert style. Soft warm beige studio background with a faint paper grain. Limited palette: milk-chocolate brown, blush pink, lavender purple, cream white, cherry-blossom pink, pale yellow-green leaves, and glossy black. Smooth, bouncy frosting animation, soft squash-and-stretch, and gentle sparkle pops. No photorealism — bold graphic cake shapes with clean piped-line texture.
0.0–1.0s

Tiny pastel frosting flowers (pink, lavender, white) and small chocolate-brown piping dots drift and spin slowly across the empty beige background, each with a tiny white highlight.
1.0–2.0s

The pieces gather and stack downward, forming a round cake on a simple white scalloped glass stand. Soft lavender-pink frosting swirls around the sides in even horizontal ridges. A twisted lavender rope of frosting coils around the base.
2.0–3.5s

A smooth cream-white disc drops onto the top as the face. Chocolate-brown frosting combs itself into neat bangs, then two long braids grow down the sides with a soft bounce. Small fondant flowers and green leaves tuck themselves into the hair.
3.5–5.5s

The finished cake: round kawaii girl face with big glossy black eyes, tiny white sparkles, short eyelashes, round pink blush circles, and a simple curved smile. Purple heart “earrings” sit at the ends of the braids. A crown of piped lavender stars lines the top of the hair. Soft yellow sparkles and tiny frosting petals pop around the cake. The camera eases slightly closer; the braids sway once.
5.5–7.5s

The cake dissolves into large, bold, rounded white typography that reads CUTIE GIRL CAKE. The letters first appear as if they are piped from the same chocolate and pink frosting, then the frosting settles away leaving solid cream-white lettering sitting on a wide, organic lavender splash that looks like overflowing buttercream.
7.5–15s

The title stays locked on screen. Small flowers and chocolate droplets continue to bounce on and around the letters. A short tagline types on underneath in a friendly rounded pastel font: first “sweet & smiling,” then expanding to “sweet & smiling, a little celebration.”

A tiny logo appears at the bottom center: a miniature version of the same girl cake plus the words Aaliya Motion Graphics. Subtle sparkle and frosting-dot animation continues until the end.
Mood: cute, gentle, birthday-party kawaii. Timing should feel snappy and satisfying — frosting has weight, braids bounce, flowers land softly, text has a creamy “pipe-on” reveal. Keep everything graphic, flat, and highly readable.

prompts.title: A Lucky Character among Clover Leaves
prompts.prompt:
Locked character (do not redesign): chibi proportions, black wavy hair + messy bangs + twin tails, white lace bonnet, huge glossy dark eyes, rosy cheeks, cream puff-sleeve dress with lace hem, chunky yellow rain boots, giant four-leaf clover on a green stem. Palette: leaf green, gold, cream, white, charcoal, yellow.
Rejected on purpose: cobalt slam-circle, eye-in-the-O porthole, cobalt/white/ice triptych, wall-run on a 3D grid, four action posters 01–04.

13-cut board (16:9, 24fps, ~15s)
CUT 01 | 0.00–1.00

Cream field. Four heart-leaflets slam in one-by-one and lock into a giant four-leaf mark. Gold micro-ticks + a luck “barcode” flicker. Letters L · U · C · K punch in with bounce-shake.
CUT 02 | 1.00–2.00

The clover becomes a spinning charm-window: her face peeks through the center gap, smiling, stem in both hands. Leaflets peel off as flat green shards. Gold RGB tick, no eye-macro.
CUT 03 | 2.00–3.10

Huge green word FOUR on cream. She skip-hops in from the right, swinging the clover like a parasol; leaf confetti + gold pollen kick up from the yellow boots. Whip-pan off her kick.
CUT 04 | 3.10–4.00

One giant clover used as a 4-leaflet layout (not a split-screen triptych). Each leaflet holds a tiny different beat: hop / peek / twirl / boot-kick. A ribbon of type LUCKY threads down the stem.
CUT 05 | 4.00–5.10

She jumps through a slow-rotating type ring FIND YOUR LUCK. Mid-air she spins the clover overhead like a pinwheel. Letters scatter as leaves. Snap-zoom on the smile, not a parkour face-lock.
CUT 06 | 5.10–6.00

White editorial card. Giant black CHARM with a single green slash. She pole-vaults using the clover stem, palm on the C; the word compresses like a spring and rebounds. No “JUMP” vault.
CUT 07 | 6.00–7.00

Soft green field, gold diagonal path. She cartwheels along it in three ghost frames (cream / leaf / gold). Outlined type SPIN rotates 180° with her. No backflip-on-stripe streetwear read.
CUT 08 | 7.00–8.00

Type barrage on beat: SOFT / WILD / LUCKY / GREEN. She skip-slides on the yellow boots in the foreground, dress flaring, clover leaves fluttering, pollen burst from the soles. Jacket-flare language replaced by dress + bonnet flutter.
CUT 09 | 8.00–9.00

Cream void. A flat paper clover unfolds in 3D (not a wireframe city grid). She balances on one leaflet like a tiny raft, pose freezes. A gold seal stamps around her with luck-% ticks and a 4-leaf bracket. No wall-run.
CUT 10 | 9.00–10.10

Freeze breaks. She leans toward camera through layered translucent green panes that shatter like pressed leaves, each pane revealing a bigger letter L-U-C-K. Foreground wipe is the yellow boot + clover tip.
CUT 11 | 10.10–11.10

Not posters. A slot-machine / stamp barrage: giant clover icons spin and lock 4-up, overlaid numbers 4 · 7 · 4 · 7, barcodes, gold slashes. She is only a repeating silhouette spinning the stem inside the lock-up. Hard cuts, no 01–04 pose posters.
CUT 12 | 11.10–13.00

White cyclorama. She lands a playful spin, plants the clover like a standard, and a shockwave of concentric green rings + leaf shards + gold dust blows out. Brief freeze, faint smile, overexpose to cream-white.
CUT 13 | 13.00–15.00

Identity card: enormous charcoal 4 (or LUCK) on pale cream, translucent green rings, halftone pollen, rough circular emblem with ghosted four-leaf + barcode. She stands relaxed overlapping the letter, wind in dress and bonnet. One green pulse through the type, frost-ring replaced by a gold pollen-ring flash.
Edit language: hard cuts on the beat, graphic matches (leaflet → window → type), whip pans, snap zooms, 3-frame ghosts, foreground leaf/boot wipes, shutter flashes, impact shakes. Type always readable before she overlaps it. Energy = luck, wind, leaves, glass-leaf shatter, spring — no weapons, no combat, no fire.
BGM: bright future-bass with mallet hits and clover-leaf whooshes instead of industrial subs; still lock slams to every cut; peak at CUT 12; cold lucky-charm stinger on CUT 13.

prompts.title: A Blue-Haired Character at Night
prompts.prompt:
夜の部屋を舞台にした、センシュアルなムードフィルム。
日本のアニメ作画。手描きの繊細な線、平坦なセル塗り、フルカラー。
浅い被写界深度、フルサイズ換算24〜85mmのズーム感。
60 BPM。BGMあり、セリフなし、環境音のみ。

# 制約
@[char ref] は彼女の顔立ち・髪型・体型・衣装・アクセサリー・アニメの作画様式を定義する。
参照画像の背景と構図は使わない。アクセサリーを新たに足さない。
出力には常に彼女ひとりだけを映す。他の人物・手・撮影者・カメラ機材は一切映さない。
彼女の同一性、解剖、髪型、衣装、アクセサリー、アニメの作画様式は全カットで完全に同一に保つ。
場所の固定：全編が同じひとつの部屋の中である。家具はソファとベッドの二つだけで、
どちらも同じ部屋にある。窓は常に画面奥にある。部屋の外へは一度も出ない。
煙草の定義：火のついた煙草は [A] と [B] にだけ存在し、常に一本だけである。
[A] の終わりに彼女が灰皿の縁へ置き、[B] ではその一本が灰皿で燃え続けている。
[C] 以降、彼女の手に煙草はなく、口へ運ぶ動作も、新しく火をつける動作も一切映さない。
[C] 以降、煙は画面のどこにも漂っていない。
靴の定義：彼女は [A] と [C] ではヒールを履いている。[F] で片方が脱げ、
[E] では両足とも素足である。ヒールは一足だけであり、増えない。
小物の定義：室内にあるのは、吸い殻が二本入った灰皿、火のついた煙草、サテンのシーツ、
薄いカーテン、彼女のヒール、これだけである。
ロゴ・文字・数字・ラベルは画面のどこにも存在しない。
編集のリズム：長く回し続けるロングテイクが主体であり、そのあいだに二度だけ、
極端に短いカットの連打が割り込む。均等な尺のカット割りにしない。
ロングテイクの中でカメラは一度も止まらず動き続ける。

# 情景
夜の部屋。天井灯は消えており、光源は低い位置の暖かいテーブルランプがひとつだけ。
窓には薄いカーテンが引かれ、その向こうから街灯の弱い光が拡散して入る。
床とサテンのシーツだけが艶を持ち、暖かい光を鈍く映す。
誰にも見られていない、静かで親密な深夜。
光と影が肌の輪郭をやわらかく浮き上がらせる。
奥行きは前景・中景・遠景を明確に分離する。中景に彼女、遠景にカーテンと窓。

# シーン

[A] 0:00-0:03.6 ロングテイク。カメラは止まらずに動き続ける。
画面は前景に漂う煙草の煙で埋まっている。カメラが抑えたプッシュインで煙を抜けると、
ソファに深く沈んで座る彼女の正面ミディアムクローズアップが現れる。
彼女は指のあいだに火のついた煙草を持っており、それを唇へ運び、ゆっくり吸い込む。
先端の火が暗がりで赤く強くなり、彼女の顔の下半分だけを一瞬照らす。
下唇が煙草から離れるとき、唇が歯に一度引っかかってから滑り落ちる。
カメラはそのまま速い弧を描いて下降し、顎が持ち上がって喉の線がぴんと張るところで、
喉が一度だけゆっくり動いて嚥下する。
彼女の指が煙草をわずかに傾け、灰が音もなく落ちる。
そのまま手が伸びて、煙草を灰皿の縁へ静かに置く。
指の力が抜け、手首がソファの肘掛けの上へゆっくり倒れていく。

[B] 0:03.6-0:04.6 短いカットの連打。2カット、各0.5秒。ハードカット。
b1: 灰皿の極寄り。縁に置かれた一本の煙草の先が赤く燃え、細い煙が立ち上っている。
その隣に吸い殻が二本あり、片方の先に口紅がついている。
b2: 唇の極寄り。細く長い煙が唇のあいだからゆっくり押し出される。

[C] 0:04.6-0:08.4 ロングテイク。カメラは止まらずに動き続ける。
同じソファ。彼女は浅く腰かけ直して背筋を立て、上体をまっすぐ起こしている。
空気から煙は完全に消えている。左の横顔。両手は何も持っていない。
舌先が口角をゆっくり湿らせる。
カメラは頬のすぐ横をホイップして通過し、鎖骨の高さまで寄って回り込む。
彼女の指先が喉のくぼみに触れ、そこから鎖骨のラインを辿り、
胸元の布の縁までゆっくりと滑り降りて、そこで止まる。
指先が布の縁の上で一度だけ押し当てられ、生地がわずかに沈む。
指が通ったあとを、横からの鋭いリムライトが追う。
カメラは胸元のクローズアップまで寄り、鎖骨から胸にかけてのラインが
呼吸で浅く上下しているところを捉える。
続けて彼女が脚を組み替え、生地が擦れて張り、
カメラは腰のラインを横へ高速でスライドしながら、その動きを追い越す。

[F] 0:08.4-0:09.9 短いカットの連打。3カット、各0.5秒。ハードカット。
f1: 真後ろからのクローズアップ。薄い生地の下で肩甲骨が動く。
f2: 睫毛が触れ合ったまま留まるスローブリンクの極寄り。
f3: 足元のクローズアップ。爪先が床を押さえ、踵がヒールから抜けていき、
素足が完全に離れて、空になったヒールが床の上に横倒しに残る。

[E] 0:09.9-0:15.0 ロングテイク。カメラは止まらずに動き続ける。
ベッドの上。カメラは床スレスレの高さからサテンのシーツの上を前進していく。
彼女は素足でシーツへ身を沈め、片膝を立てる。
サテンがふくらはぎの下で滑って皺を作る。
片手がシーツを深く握り込み、布が指のあいだで束になって引き寄せられ、
指の関節が白くなってから、ゆっくり力が抜けて開く。
カメラは胴体の高さへダイブし、そのまま上昇して顔の近くを通過し、
彼女が口をレンズのほうへ向けて肩越しに振り返るところで速度を落とす。
そのままカメラは彼女の周囲をタイトに周回する。
彼女は背中を反らせて長く上へ伸び、布が肋骨の上で張り、
両手が髪を下から掬い上げてうなじから離す。
カメラは肩から顔へ連続してスキムし、前景のカーテンの襞と背景の窓に強い視差が生まれる。
彼女は顎の線とうなじが同じランプの光を受ける角度まで、わずかに振り返る。
指先が自分の首筋の脈に当てられる。
最後に彼女が細く長い息をゆっくり吐き、唇がわずかに開いたまま留まり、
レンズを見下ろす姿勢で静止する。
カメラは外へ弧を描きながら下降して引き、部屋の全体が暖かい光の中に開く。
その引きの構図のまま完全に静止して終わる。

# 音
部屋の低い静寂、遠い車の走行音がかすかに続く。
冒頭では煙草の紙が燃える微かな音、息を吸い込む音、煙を吐く音が入る。
全編を通して、唇が離れる小さな音、髪が動く音、布が擦れる音がある。
ヒールが脱げる場面では、革が踵を離れる短い音と、
ヒールが床に落ちて一度だけ鳴る乾いた音が入る。
ベッドではサテンが滑る音、シーツが握り込まれる音、静かな呼吸だけになる。
台詞と歌は一切ない。

prompts.title: A Hong Kong-Inspired Look in Burgundy
prompts.prompt:
时长：15秒
比例：9:16
人物参考：@图片1

复古港风长卷黑发，偏分发型，发丝蓬松自然；细长眉、黑色眼线、哑光酒红唇妆。佩戴一对华丽复古金色雕花耳坠。

穿深酒红色丝绒修身吊带长裙，心形领口、贴合腰线、长度至小腿，裙摆后方小开衩；搭配黑色尖头细高跟鞋。裙子颜色全程保持深酒红，不变成鲜红或紫色。

真实港风酒店随拍Vlog，复古电影质感，暖金高光、墨绿阴影、轻微胶片颗粒、柔焦辉光、自然皮肤纹理。人物冷艳、自信、松弛，不持续微笑，不做网红式夸张动作。

00:02.40-00:03.50，她嘴角出现很轻的笑意，手掌继续托着下巴，保持眼神交流。

SHOT 2（00:03.50-00:07.20）浴室门口走出

女主站在酒店浴室门口，背后是大理石洗手台、复古镜框和两盏黄铜壁灯。

Action：
00:03.50-00:04.60，动作匹配切到全身。女主双臂轻轻交叉，背靠门框，冷静看向镜头。

00:04.60-00:06.00，她放下双手，从浴室向镜头缓慢走出两步。酒红裙摆随步伐轻微摆动，高跟鞋落地稳定。

00:06.00-00:07.20，她停下，一只手扶腰，身体转向侧面约30度，展示裙子的腰线；随后回头看向镜头。

Camera：
固定全身景别，略低机位。人物靠近时镜头轻微后退，保持头顶和高跟鞋完整入画。

Performance：
步伐从容，不扭腰过度；表情冷艳，回眸时眉眼稍微放松。

SHOT 3（00:07.20-00:11.20）百叶窗光影

Subject：
女主站在黑色木质百叶窗旁，落日光线横向划过面部和肩颈。

Action：
00:07.20-00:08.50，胸像侧面特写。女主抬头看向窗外，阳光从鼻梁缓慢移动到眼睛，发丝边缘出现金色轮廓光。

00:09.80-00:11.20，她放下手，缓慢转头直视镜头。神情由疏离转为自信，嘴角仅轻微上扬。

Camera：
85mm侧脸特写，缓慢横移，从纯侧脸移动到四分之三正脸。背景虚化，耳坠和眼睛保持清晰。

00:11.20-00:12.40，女主走到墨绿色丝绒沙发旁，一只手轻轻扶住沙发靠背，身体向后倚靠，长发自然落在肩后。

Camera：
先以中景跟随她走向沙发，再用动作匹配切回门口全身镜头。最后缓慢后退，展示完整酒店套房。

Audio：

prompts.title: A Duo Reveal in Pink Graphics
prompts.prompt:
Create an elegant motion-graphics-driven romantic duo reveal trailer in 16:9, exactly 13 distinct cuts, 24fps.  
Sole visual reference is the attached image. Preserve both characters exactly: the boy with soft messy chestnut-brown hair, large warm brown eyes, gentle smile, white button-up shirt with sleeves rolled, dark trousers, white sneakers, silver necklace and wristwatch; the girl with long wavy chestnut-brown hair, large pink satin bow, tiny heart clips, huge glossy brown eyes, rosy cheeks, soft smile, pink off-shoulder ruffled mini dress, small pink heart-clasp bag, white socks with pink bows, pink-and-white sneakers. Never redesign faces, proportions, outfits, materials or colors.  

Film is 80% bold yet soft graphic design in motion and 20% gentle character performance. Giant kinetic typography, hard-edged pastel shapes, split-screens, flat color fields, floating heart motifs, petal bursts, soft shutter flashes and elegant speed lines.  
Palette: soft pink, lavender mist, blush rose, pure white, warm cream, light gold.  
Style: premium AAA motion-graphics title sequence × dreamy lifestyle campaign. Every graphic moves with graceful momentum and snaps cleanly on the beat. Cozy elements (pink roses, heart balloons, wooden railing, string lights, floating petals, teddy silhouette, gift box) appear only as abstract graphic layers or soft atmosphere.

CUT 01 | 0.00-1.00s  
Pure graphics: massive soft-pink circle blooms on white field, two translucent lavender bars wipe across, floating heart particles sparkle; elegant letters punch in one after another with gentle impact shake.

CUT 02 | 1.00-2.00s  
Final letter becomes soft circular frame: extreme close-up of the girl’s warm brown eye inside it, lashes fluttering; soft chromatic flash, circle dissolves into drifting pink and lavender petals.

CUT 03 | 2.00-3.10s  
White frame with enormous soft-pink typography; the couple steps lightly in from frame left and glides across the baseline of the letters, delicate speed lines and rose-petal trails following, letter fragments lifting like confetti. Soft whip-pan out.

CUT 04 | 3.10-4.00s  
Split-screen triptych of flat soft-pink / white / lavender panels; in each panel their silhouettes perform different gentle poses in soft stroboscopic freeze: soft turn, hair flip, shared smile. Huge vertical text DREAMY scrolls slowly behind.

CUT 05 | 4.00-5.10s  
They rise together through a giant slowly rotating ring of typography reading SWEET MOMENTS; camera tracks their mid-air twirl in gentle slow motion as letters scatter like petals, then soft snap-zoom on their confident smiling faces.

CUT 06 | 5.10-6.00s  
Hard cut: white editorial card, huge black HEART with soft-pink slash; the girl floats over the word, fingertips touching the letter, dress and hair flowing while the boy supports her; the word gently compresses and rebounds with a soft bounce.

CUT 07 | 6.00-7.00s  
Lavender field with soft diagonal rose stripe; they perform a light graceful spin along the stripe in three soft ghost frames, each tinted a different pastel; giant outlined text TWIRL rotates 180 degrees in perfect sync.

CUT 08 | 7.00-8.00s  
Kinetic type barrage: the words SOFT / BRIGHT / WARM / LOVE appear one per beat with soft shutter flashes and light camera sway, while they glide across the foreground, clothes fluttering, tiny petal particles bursting from their sneakers.

CUT 09 | 8.00-9.00s  
Soft black frame, giant white wireframe heart grid tilting gently in 3D; they step lightly up the grid, push off and hang suspended as everything freezes; a soft-pink circle stamps around their frozen pose with delicate bracket accents and floating heart ticks.

CUT 10 | 9.00-10.10s  
Freeze releases into a soft burst: they drift toward camera through layered flat-color panes that dissolve one by one like silk, each pane revealing a bigger letter of a romantic motif; foreground wipe with sneakers and a swirl of petals.

CUT 11 | 10.10-11.10s  
Rapid-fire poster montage: four full-screen graphic posters of the couple in different elegant poses (mid-twirl, soft slide, landing smile, gentle embrace) snap past with clean cuts, each with bold yet soft layout, oversized numbers 01–04, rose motifs and gentle diagonal lines.

CUT 12 | 11.10-13.00s  
Hero moment on clean white cyclorama: they land a final soft spin dead center in slow motion, straighten into a close embrace with gentle smiles, and a shockwave of concentric soft-pink rings, wind streaks and shattered pastel typography blooms outward; brief iconic freeze, then soft overexpose to white.

CUT 13 | 13.00-15.00s  
Final identity card: enormous soft-pink word dominates pale white field with translucent lavender rings, delicate arcs, soft halftone and a rough circular emblem containing a ghosted rose/heart motif; the couple stands relaxed overlapping the letters, soft breeze rippling their clothes and hair; one last soft-pink pulse sweeps through the typography and a delicate petal-ring flash ends the film.

Editing: extremely rhythmic yet elegant — clean hard cuts on every beat, graphic matches, soft whip pans, gentle snap zooms, soft stroboscopic freezes, foreground petal wipes, light chromatic flashes, impact shakes and subtle speed ramps. Every cut compositionally different; typography always fully readable before characters overlap it.  
No weapons, combat or harsh elements; energy comes from motion design, soft wind, petals, light dissolves and their graceful lifestyle movement.

BGM: catchy upbeat electronic / future-pop with bright melodic hooks, punchy drums, attractive drops, risers and sparkling fills locked to every cut. Sneaker steps, soft whooshes, petal bursts and typography impacts are rhythmic sound-design elements. Peak energy at CUT 12, close with a bright memorable electronic logo stinger.  

Premium AAA quality, anime-inspired cinematic rendering, stylish and luminous, strong graphic-design identity, consistent character design, exactly 13 cuts.

prompts.title: A Superhero Set Built on Forced Perspective
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly realistic viral behind-the-scenes superhero filmmaking video inspired by the kind of practical forced-perspective stunt videos that go viral on TikTok, Instagram, and X — but make the concept, staging, characters, and visual execution original.

The superhero is an original Superman-inspired flying superhero: a handsome adult male superhero wearing a premium blue-and-red superhero suit with a flowing red cape, but do NOT reproduce any exact movie costume, logo, emblem, actor likeness, or copyrighted Superman design.

The entire sequence is filmed from a very high overhead camera looking almost straight down at a huge outdoor film set.

At first glance, the scene appears to show the superhero climbing vertically up the side of an enormous skyscraper. The illusion is created by a gigantic forced-perspective city set laid completely flat on the ground. The “skyscraper” is actually a highly detailed printed/constructed city facade positioned on the road, with perspective lines making it look vertical from the camera angle.

Show the complete filmmaking environment:

- the superhero lying/positioned on the fake building surface
- multiple film cameras
- camera operators
- director
- assistant directors
- lighting equipment
- cables
- crew members
- stunt coordinators
- production assistants
- spectators watching the unusual shoot
- equipment cases and production vehicles around the perimeter

The director is actively directing the superhero, gesturing toward different positions and calling out instructions. Crew members move around the set naturally, making the scene feel like genuine behind-the-scenes footage from a massive movie production.

The superhero performs a dramatic “vertical climb” across the fake skyscraper. From the overhead perspective, the illusion looks incredibly convincing.

Then create the viral reveal:

The camera slowly pulls even farther upward, revealing the full scale of the setup and making it obvious that the entire skyscraper is actually lying flat on the ground.

After the reveal, transition seamlessly from the overhead BTS shot into the “finished movie shot.” Suddenly the perspective changes and the same setup looks like an enormous vertical skyscraper, with the superhero appearing to climb the side of the building hundreds of feet above the city.

Make the final cinematic shot look completely believable: dramatic sunlight, realistic atmospheric haze, detailed glass skyscrapers, physically accurate shadows, realistic cape movement, cinematic depth of field, subtle camera shake, premium blockbuster cinematography.

The contrast between the ridiculous real-world setup and the spectacular final shot should be the main comedic hook.

Style: ultra-realistic live-action, documentary BTS footage mixed with blockbuster superhero cinematography, natural human movement, realistic production equipment, physically believable lighting, detailed environments, authentic camera operators and crew.

Camera progression:

1. Extreme overhead establishing shot.
2. Slow controlled aerial push-in.
3. Medium overhead shot showing the superhero and crew.
4. Wider reveal exposing the entire fake skyscraper.
5. Dramatic transition into the finished cinematic superhero shot.
6. Final heroic shot of the superhero climbing/flying beside the enormous skyscraper.

No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks, no recognizable actors, no exact recreation of an existing movie scene.

prompts.prompt:
[0–3s] — THE RIDE
Low cinematic tracking shot from behind. The girl rides her red bicycle along a quiet coastal road, guardrails beside her and the endless blue ocean beyond. Her skirt and loose strands of hair move naturally in the wind. Sunlight flickers across the road as she passes.

[3–5s] — SOMETHING BEAUTIFUL
Side shot as she suddenly notices a flock of white birds sweeping dramatically across the ocean. She slows down, smiles softly, and reaches into her backpack for a small instant camera.

[5–8s] — THE PHOTOGRAPH
She stops beside the overlook and raises the camera toward the ocean. As she takes the picture, the male character quietly walks into the far edge of the frame, completely unaware that he has just been captured in her photograph.

[8–10s] — THE SURPRISE
Extreme close-up of the photograph developing in her hands. The ocean appears first… then she notices the mysterious guy standing in the background of the photo. Her expression changes from peaceful curiosity to surprised amusement.

[10–12s] — LOOK UP
She slowly looks up from the photograph. Cut to the man a few meters away, standing by the guardrail with his backpack, looking directly at her. Wind moves his hair. He gives a subtle, almost playful smile.

[12–15s] — THE LITTLE TWIST
He walks toward her and gently points at the photograph, realizing he's in it. She laughs quietly. He gestures toward the road ahead as if asking, “Going this way?” She smiles, gets back on her bicycle, and he starts walking beside her.

Final wide shot: They move together along the coastal road while the ocean stretches endlessly behind them. The little photograph remains visible in her hand as the camera slowly pulls back into the glowing blue-and-gold horizon.

MOOD: spontaneous, beautiful, slightly mysterious, innocent romance, cinematic fate, natural chemistry.
 IMPORTANT: No exaggerated acting, no cheesy romance, no text, no logos, realistic physics and natural human movement.

prompts.title: Escaping a Manga Book, Meeting Another Self
prompts.prompt:
【REFERENCE】
Image1 `01 / SCENE_TRAPPED`：本の中に閉じ込められた第一場面、巨大本、室内、人物の位置とポーズ。
Image2 `02 / SCENE_BREAKTHROUGH`：ページを押し破る第二場面、動作、紙の亀裂。
Image3 `03 / SCENE_EMERGENCE`：現実へ出た第三場面、破れ穴、着地位置。
Image4 `04 / SCENE_ENCOUNTER`：本の中の自分と対面する第四場面の左右、指差し、巨大本。
Image5 `05 / WOMAN_MASTER`：利用者が差し替える女性全身アンカー。顔、髪、年齢感、肌、体型、全身比率、衣装、素材、配色、靴の唯一の正本。
`06 / MANGA_SELF`：05を同じ人物・衣装のままモノクロ漫画化した状態。
`07 / REAL_SELF`：05を正確に維持した実写状態。
`08 / BOOK_ROOM`：01～04共通の巨大な見開き本、木製床、寝具、カーテン、植物、暖かな昼光の寝室。

各ショットはIDだけで参照する。01～04の女性からは位置、ポーズ、動作だけを使い、外見は使わない。人物同一性は05を最優先し、06と07を同一人物の二状態とする。女性アンカーの差し替えごとに05から読み直す。場面アンカーの吹き出し、印刷文字、コマ枠、白い分割余白は使わない。

【CONDITION DEFINITION】
15秒、1:1。シネマティック実写と精密なモノクロ漫画の融合。実写は自然な肌、布、髪、暖かな立体光、漫画は紙目、網点、インク線を明瞭に分ける。4パネルは物語アンカーで、カット数は4つに限定しない。前半は真剣な脱出劇、最後は「自分が本の中に残る」不条理を驚きとパロディーへ転換。表情は困惑→恐怖→決意→安堵→違和感→強い驚き。顔を変形させず眉、瞳、口、顎、肩、呼吸を連動する。0.0～4.6秒は全身を本の印刷面内に閉じ込めた平面モノクロ漫画とし、紙の内側から現実側へ押す。肌色、実写衣装、立体化、身体突出、床への接地は4.6秒から。

【SHOT / FLOW】
0.0～1.0秒【参照：01、06、08】巨大本を低い広角で見せ、本の中へ高速プッシュイン。MANGA_SELFは困惑して見回し、眉が寄り呼吸が浅くなる。
1.0～3.3秒【参照：01、06】顔、境界を探る手、紙を押す横顔をハードカット。目が泳ぎ口元が震える。紙越しに「ここは……どこ？　出られない……」。継ぎ目を見つけ、恐怖から決意へ。
3.3～4.6秒【参照：02、06、08】低い斜め前方。踏ん張る靴、紙へ食い込む指、歯を食いしばる顔を三連続で切る。「あいて……！」。集中線と黒インクの圧力リングが手から広がる。
4.6～6.8秒【参照：02、05、06、07、08】紙が現実側へ膨らみ、手、顔、上半身、脚の順に平面のインクと紙繊維が07の肌、髪、衣装へ連続変換。境界で網点が色粒子へ変わる。カメラは裂け目を半周し、立体化に合わせ被写界深度を浅くする。破裂時、手描きの`バリッ！`が手前へ飛び、黒インク片へ砕け0.35秒以内に消える。女性は一人のまま05を維持する。
6.8～8.4秒【参照：03、05、07、08】REAL_SELFが紙片と床へ着地し少しよろける。低い追従から顔へ寄る。両手と参照衣装を確認し、驚きが安堵と小さな笑みへ。「出られた……？」。
8.4～10.3秒【参照：05、07、08】乾いたページ音。BGMに合わせ笑みが止まり、口角が落ち、眉が上がり、瞳だけ本へ動く。つばを飲み恐る恐る振り向く。顔から本へ高速ホイップパンし、肩越しのまま10.3秒の04へ接続。安堵が違和感へ変わる。
10.3～11.2秒【参照：04、05、06、07、08】左右が読める中広角。左のREAL_SELFと本の中央のMANGA_SELFが同時に指を差し、終端で短くヒットストップ。BGMはレコードスクラッチで急停止。
11.2～12.8秒【参照：04、05、06】MANGA_SELFへスマッシュズーム。目と口を大きく開き、頬のハッチングが増える。紙越しに「まさか……本当に出てきた！？」。背後に放射状の漫画線。
12.8～14.0秒【参照：04、05、07】85mm相当でREAL_SELFの顔へスマッシュズーム。05の顔比率を保ち、眉が跳ね、瞳孔が縮み、口が開き、肩が引ける。短い間の後、室内音声で「あなた……誰？」。
14.0～15.0秒【参照：04、05、07】85mmのまま一段近い驚き顔。顔と衣装はカラー、背景だけ白黒ハーフトーンと集中線へ変わり、巨大な`！？`が頭の後ろから出て一度弾む。本、カメラ、本の順に二度見し、コミカルな一音で終了。

【CAMERA / EDITING】
広角、顔、手元、低角度、短い回り込み、ホイップパン、交互スマッシュズームを使い、同じ中広角を続けない。動作か表情変化で切り、長い静止、スロー、無目的な360度回転、フェードなし。最終4.7秒は対面、交互リアクション、驚き顔アップの順に加速。

【MOTION GRAPHICS / TYPOGRAPHY】
集中線、ハーフトーン、インクの圧力リング、短いヒットストップ、紙片の奥行きを使う。`バリッ！`は黒インク、`！？`は白文字に赤いずれ影。わずかにオーバーシュートし、顔を隠さない。表示文字はこの二つだけで字幕や吹き出しにしない。

【SOUND】
overall_soundscape:
紙越しと室内の声は同じ基礎声質で距離感だけ変える。紙の張り、破裂、紙片、着地、衣擦れ、ページ音を画面へステレオ同期。台詞を重ねず、追加の声や笑い声なし。
non_diegetic_music:
0.2秒の演出無音を除き全編に約90 BPMのミステリーコメディーBGMを連続使用。ピチカート弦、バスクラリネット、チェレスタ、軽い打楽器。脱出まで上昇し、破裂で低音と打楽器を同期、着地後は一瞬明るくする。10.3秒でレコードスクラッチ後0.2秒だけ無音、以後は低いピチカート、最後は乾いた一音。台詞中はダッキング。

【NEGATIVE】
場面アンカーの吹き出し、縦書き文字、複数コマ、白い分割余白を出さない。許可した`バリッ！`と`！？`以外の文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしなし。第三の女性、同一状態の重複、01～04の人物外見流用、別人化、05の人物・衣装・配色の逸脱、広角による顔変形、4.6秒前の肌色・実写化・立体化・身体突出・床接地、解剖学的変形、無表情、10.3秒以降の長い同一構図、指定0.2秒以外のBGM欠落、イベント順の変更を避ける。

Create a fast-paced, high-energy cinematic sports commercial featuring a professional female tennis player competing on a blue hard court.

- Transition into low-angle tracking shots capturing her fast footwork and movement across the court.
- Use intense close-ups of her focused face, hands, racket, and ball impact.
- End with a dramatic golden-hour silhouette as she strikes the ball.

Photorealistic, premium sports-commercial aesthetic, bright natural sunlight, subtle lens flares, crisp focus, realistic motion blur, dynamic camera movement, cinematic composition, 8K detail, 35mm film look, subtle film grain.

Performance:
Natural athletic movement, realistic tennis technique, accurate racket and ball physics, powerful swings, quick footwork, confident expressions, and believable body mechanics.

Audio:
Realistic tennis-court ambience, racket impacts, ball bounces, quick footsteps, and subtle cinematic sports sound design. No dialogue.

Negative Prompt:

prompts.title: A Warm Modern Home, Inside and Out
prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic luxury real-estate house tour, using the provided reference image as the visual style reference.

IMPORTANT:
Maintain a consistent architectural design, materials, furniture style, warm color palette, and premium luxury aesthetic throughout the entire video. The house must feel like one real, connected property. No random architectural changes.

VIDEO FORMAT:
Vertical 9:16
Duration: exactly 15 seconds
Ultra-realistic 4K
Professional luxury real-estate cinematography
Smooth stabilized camera movement
Natural lighting
Realistic reflections and shadows
Premium editorial look
No people
No text
No logos
No watermark

SCENE 1 — 0-2 SECONDS — EXTERIOR REVEAL
Start with a cinematic wide establishing shot of the complete luxury modern house during golden hour.
Show the elegant multi-level architecture, large floor-to-ceiling windows, stone exterior walls, warm interior lights, landscaped garden, clean driveway and premium entrance.
Camera slowly pushes forward toward the house like a professional real-estate drone/gimbal shot.

TRANSITION:
Smooth forward movement transitioning naturally toward the main entrance.

SCENE 2 — 2-4 SECONDS — MAIN ENTRANCE & FOYER
Camera smoothly enters through the large front door into a sophisticated luxury foyer.
Show polished flooring, warm wooden staircase, elegant wall decoration, large round mirror, designer console table and soft ambient lighting.
Camera moves forward slowly and naturally, revealing the open-plan interior.

SCENE 3 — 4-6 SECONDS — LUXURY LIVING ROOM
Transition into the main living room shown in the reference image.
Show the large caramel-brown leather sectional sofa, cream upholstered lounge chairs, round wooden coffee table, patterned rug, decorative plants, wooden furniture and the central modern fireplace with gray stone/tile surround.
Large windows bring in beautiful natural daylight.
Camera makes a smooth cinematic side-to-side movement, showcasing the entire living space.

SCENE 4 — 6-8 SECONDS — OPEN KITCHEN & DINING
Camera smoothly pans from the living room into the open-plan luxury kitchen and dining area.
Show a large premium kitchen island, elegant cabinetry, modern appliances, sophisticated pendant lights, marble/stone surfaces and a stylish dining area.
Keep the same warm neutral color palette and architectural style.
Camera slowly glides past the island for a high-end property-tour feeling.

SCENE 5 — 8-10 SECONDS — MASTER BEDROOM
Smooth transition into a spacious luxury master bedroom.
Show a large elegant bed with premium neutral bedding, soft textured fabrics, wooden accents, designer bedside tables and large windows overlooking greenery.
Warm natural sunlight enters through the windows.
Camera slowly moves toward the bed and then gently pans across the room.

SCENE 6 — 10-12 SECONDS — LUXURY MARBLE BATHROOM
Camera transitions into a high-end master bathroom.
Show large marble surfaces, a freestanding modern bathtub, spacious glass shower, elegant vanity, large mirror and warm hidden LED lighting.
Use a slow cinematic camera sweep to reveal the luxurious finishes.
Everything should look realistic and physically accurate.

SCENE 7 — 12-15 SECONDS — BACKYARD & FINAL HERO SHOT
Camera smoothly exits toward the backyard/patio.
Reveal a beautiful landscaped outdoor lounge area with comfortable designer seating, greenery, warm architectural lighting and a premium swimming pool.
End with a cinematic wide hero shot of the entire property glowing during sunset.
Camera slowly pulls back and rises slightly, creating a premium luxury-real-estate commercial ending.

prompts.title: REVEAL: A Graphic Fashion Editorial
prompts.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps Korean high-fashion motion graphics film with EXACTLY 13 CUTS.
STYLE:
Premium AAA motion graphics × Korean fashion editorial × experimental graphic design × distressed print campaign.
Core concept: CALM CHARACTER + EXPLOSIVE GRAPHIC WORLD.
The woman stays elegant, restrained and almost still while giant typography, rings, ink strokes, graphic blocks, film strips, scan lines and speed trails move aggressively around her.
CHARACTER LOCK:
ONE young Korean woman only, age 20–23. Narrow oval face, dark-brown eyes, long wavy black hair, wispy bangs, realistic skin texture, subtle smoky makeup, nude brown-red lips.
Keep EXACTLY the same face, hair, makeup, body proportions, outfit and accessories in all cuts.
OUTFIT:
Black asymmetric cropped blazer, charcoal thin-strap top, loose black tailored trousers, black belt, thin choker, minimal silver jewelry. High-fashion, sophisticated, NOT gothic or nightclub.
PALETTE:
Deep black, charcoal, burnt orange, rust red, dark olive, aged cream. Warm orange rim light + soft cream key light.
NO blue, purple, pink or cyberpunk neon.
CUTS:
01 Graphic opening: giant “RE”, ink strokes, expanding olive ring.
02 Extreme eye macro with orange scanning ring.
03 Woman emerges behind giant vertical “REVEAL”.
04 Four asymmetric editorial panels showing face, profile, outfit and eye details.
05 Rotating rings around her, giant “FOCUS” behind, snap zoom.
06 Aged-cream background, huge “BURN”, black ink slashes.
07 Giant “MOVE”; subtle transparent motion trails from her head turn.
08 Fast typography barrage: WILD / SOFT / DEEP / REAL.
09 Seated portrait with editorial targeting circles and graphic marks.
10 Extreme face close-up through transparent printed-film layers.
11 Fast horizontal film-strip montage with four restrained poses.
12 CLIMAX: graphics disappear briefly, she stands perfectly still. On the beat drop, huge 2D shockwave of cream brush strokes, rust-red ink, olive blocks, orange rings, typography fragments and speed lines explodes behind her. NO real explosion or magic.
13 Final hero frame: giant “REVEAL” typography, woman seated in right third, olive ring and orange lines behind. She slowly looks into camera. Final light sweep, one impact vibration, hard cut to black.
CAMERA / EDIT:
Hard cuts, graphic match cuts, snap zooms, foreground wipes, typography stretch, film strips, speed ramps and restrained impact shake.
Her movement stays minimal and controlled. She does NOT dance. The graphics carry the energy.
MUSIC:
Hard electronic fashion beat, industrial pop, heavy percussion, sub-bass, metallic hits, typography slams and paper snaps.
CUT12 is the biggest visual and musical climax.
NEGATIVE:
No character changes, duplicate people, outfit changes, blonde hair, Western facial features, cute idol styling, lingerie, gothic cosplay, pink/purple/blue neon, cyberpunk, weapons, fire, real explosions, fantasy magic, unreadable typography or excessive beauty smoothing.
FINAL LOOK:
Korean high-fashion model × black designer fashion × burnt orange / rust red / dark olive / aged cream × giant typography × aggressive editorial motion graphics.

prompts.title: Building a Character Bust from Scratch
prompts.prompt: A cinematic creation film follows one maker reconstructing the main subject shown in the referenced image completely from scratch. The referenced image defines the finished subject’s complete visible appearance, proportions, structure, materials, colors, clothing or surface details, and distinctive features; ignore its background, framing, lighting, and unrelated elements.  Begin directly on an empty, clean virtual workbench. Use a stable front three-quarter overhead view that keeps the developing subject readable. There is one maker throughout, represented by the same consistent left and right hands and forearms. Show no more than two hands at once.  From 0 to 14 seconds, the entire creation unfolds as a clearly accelerated timelapse with rapid, purposeful hand movement and restrained motion blur. Short jump cuts compress repetitive manual work only after each action has visibly completed. Every cut inherits the exact form and progress left by the previous action.  0-2 seconds: One hand enters already holding the first foundation material, armature, or base element appropriate to the referenced subject and places it at the center. この世界では重力方向そのものが統制装置である。重力変化によって上下関係、床と壁、建築層、群衆の進行方向が再定義される。ただし変形途中を長く滑らかに見せない。連続モーフィング、流体的な補間、長い回転運動を避ける。強い完成画を短く成立させた直後、瞬間断裁、スナップ移動、ハードカット、急激な画角変更によって次の完成状態へ飛ぶ。静止に近い強い構図と瞬間的な高速変化を交互に置き、緩急を作る。
タイポグラフィとエディトリアルMGは積極的に使用するが主役にはしない。特定の単語を各SHOTの発動スイッチとして割り当てない。短い英単語、部分文字、巨大なクロップ文字、画面端で切れた文字形、細いライン、面、グリッド断片が建築と同時に現れ、断裁、圧縮、レイヤーずれ、構図変更へ参加する。文字は一瞬だけ可読でもよく、常に全文を読ませる必要はない。タイポ単独の画面、中央固定タイトル、説明UI、カード、HUDにはしない。
カメラは超広角、強い正面構図、垂直構図、高俯瞰、極端な建築ディテールへの瞬間的な寄り、スナップズームを交差させる。長いパン、長い回転、滑らかな連続追従を主体にしない。画面が常に動き続けるのではなく、「完成画→瞬間変化→完成画」という断続的なリズムを15秒全体で維持する。
人物中心の芝居、単一の可動建築デモ、大量の可読文字、タイポだけの抽象映像、同じ転換の反復、爆発や瓦礫による通常の都市破壊、ネオン主体のサイバーパンク、実写、写実的3DCGは避ける。

[Shot 1]
巨大な白い都市の完成画から即開始。多層公共空間、遠景まで続く建築群、複数階に流れる民衆を超広角で強く見せる。約1秒は完成された都市として成立させる。突然、遠景の建築層だけが斜め下へ瞬間的に落ち、前景との上下関係が破断する。巨大な部分文字と建築エッジが同時に画面を切断し、一度強くスナップして、全く異なる垂直都市の完成画へ切り替わる。

[Shot 2] At 00:02.100,
極端に深い垂直都市峡谷の完成画。巨大壁面、細い空中通路、複数高さの民衆を短く見せる。カメラが急上昇した直後に一瞬止まり、次の瞬間だけ重力方向が90度変化。壁面と床の関係が一発で入れ替わる。タイポ断片、窓列、構造線が一瞬だけ3層へずれ、ハードカットで巨大内部空間へ飛ぶ。

[Shot 3] At 00:04.100,
巨大な明るい内部空間。円環状の床、巨大梁、複数高さを横切る民衆を強い対称構図で見せる。約0.7秒後、建築ディテールへ極端なスナップズーム。巨大梁と部分文字が画面いっぱいを横切る瞬間にハードカットし、その梁の形状を次の外部都市の地平線へマッチさせる。直後に円環構造が一瞬だけ縦位置へ跳び、新しい巨大外壁として完成する。変形過程ではなく、状態Aと状態Bの差を強く見せる。

[Shot 4] At 00:06.200,
ここから編集密度を上げる。高層テラス都市の完成画を短く見せる→瞬間断裁→巨大アーチ都市の完成画→ハードカット→垂直回廊都市の完成画。各完成画は0.6〜1.0秒程度でも一度明確に成立させる。前画面の主要な建築形状を次画面へ引き継ぎ、同じ構造が別用途・別方向の建築へ瞬時に再構築される。高層テラスの水平層は次画面の巨大アーチへ、アーチの反復形状は次の垂直回廊群へ接続する。タイポ、MG、建築面の線がカット境界と同期し、前画面の形状を利用して次の構図を瞬間的に作る。ワイド、極端な寄り、俯瞰を高速で切り替え、同じカメラ運動を続けない。

[Shot 5] At 00:09.100,
最大密度。巨大都市の超広角完成画→一瞬の高俯瞰→建築ディテールの極端な寄り→再び超広角を短いハードカットで交差させる。その間に都市全域の重力軸が破断し、巨大な建築層が一斉に異なる方向へ落下する。ただし落下を長く追わず、落下開始の瞬間、途中の強い断片、再構築後の完成状態をスナップするように切り替える。巨大な部分文字とMGも建築層と同時に断裂・圧縮され、次の構図に断片だけ残る。複数の完成都市画が短く連打された後、全建築層が一瞬で別の上下関係へロックされ、新しい巨大都市の完成画になる。

[Shot 6] At 00:13.100,
再構築された巨大都市をワイドで強く見せる。旧壁面を民衆が床として歩き、旧階段や橋は全く別の方向へ接続されている。終盤は流れるような大変形を続けず、完成した新秩序を見せる。遠景の一つの巨大建築層だけが最後に短くスナップして最終位置へロック。タイポとMGはほぼ消え、最後の0.5秒は建築と群衆の小さな動きだけを残し、世界そのものの強いキービジュアルで終了する。

overall_soundscape:
台詞なし、ナレーションなし。遠い群衆音、巨大空間の反響、低い重力圧、建築層の摩擦、乾いた断裁音、短く重いロック音を使用する。連続した流体音ではなく、短い静けさと瞬間的な衝撃音を交互に置く。ハードカット、スナップズーム、瞬間断裁、再構築のタイミングへ音を鋭く同期させる。

non_diegetic_music:
BGMあり。低い弦、乾いた低音打楽器、短い金属打楽器を主体とした暗く緊張感のある劇伴。一定に流れ続ける音楽にせず、短い間、アクセント、急激な密度変化を使って編集の断続性を強調する。00:06.200以降で密度を上げ、00:09.100〜13.100で最大密度。終端は急速に収束し、低い弦の余韻だけを残す。電子シンセ主体のダンスビートにはしない。

prompts.title: Two Hands Draw a Woman at Her Vanity from Blank Paper
prompts.prompt:
A completely blank sheet of smooth white paper fills the frame. Two hands enter from the bottom. The right hand holds a sharpened graphite pencil; the left hand rests lightly at the lower-left corner of the paper to keep it still.
The right hand makes the first mark: a very light, loose oval in the center of the page for the head. Immediately add a faint vertical center line and a horizontal eye-line crossing the middle of the oval. Draw two short marks for the brow line and the base of the nose, then a light curve for the chin. All construction lines stay pale and barely visible.
Next, block in the neck as two simple sloping lines and a shallow U for the shoulders and collarbones. Sketch a rough rectangle for the torso and the square neckline of the top. Still using only the lightest pressure, place a large circle on the left for the round vanity mirror and a few vertical ovals and cylinders across the bottom for bottles and brush handles. Nothing is detailed yet—only placement.
Now the face. Darken the eye-line slightly and draw the almond shapes of both eyes, leaving a small highlight circle in each iris. Add the upper lids, a few lashes, and the gentle arch of the brows. Move to the nose: a soft wedge and two small nostril curves. Then the mouth: a short center dip, the full upper lip, and the slight upward curve of the smile. Keep every stroke inside the original oval.
Shift to the hair. Start at the hairline and draw the high, messy half-up bun with the flower-shaped clip on top and the two small barrettes on the right side. Pull long, wavy strands down the left side of the face and over the right shoulder, using loose, overlapping S-curves. Let a few shorter pieces fall across the forehead.
Refine the clothing: the ribbed texture of the white top, the thin orange trim around the neckline and sleeve, and the tiny bow at the center. Add the thin necklace chain and its small pendant. Darken the contour of the right hand resting against the cheek, fingers relaxed.
Move to the foreground still life. Outline the gold-framed round mirror on the left, then the cluster of bottles—tall toner bottle, perfume with a faceted cap, pump bottles, and the cup of makeup brushes on the right. Keep these objects slightly lighter so they sit in front of the figure without competing.
Begin shading. Hatch soft graphite under the chin, along the left side of the nose, beneath the lower lip, and in the hollow of the neck. Build darker value in the hair where strands overlap and around the clips. Add light cross-hatching on the fabric folds of the top and a faint cast shadow from the hand onto the cheek. Leave the paper white for the brightest highlights on the forehead, nose tip, and lip.
The left hand slides out of frame. The right hand makes a few final tightening strokes on the eyes and the edges of the hair, then rests the pencil at the top of the paper. The finished drawing is a complete graphite sketch of the blonde woman at her vanity, built entirely from the first faint oval to the last shadow, on otherwise empty white paper.
Satisfying, calm, close-up process video. Continuous take, no cuts, no extra motion except the hands and pencil. Soft natural light, visible pencil grain and paper tooth.

Oskar (S1) says in a very small voice, <d>[English] Is this not reception.</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot of a formidable surgeon, a woman in her
sixties, gloved hands held up and clear, mask pulled tight. She looks him up and down once, then
jerks her chin firmly at the empty space beside the table. The surgeon (S2) says in a brisk,
completely certain voice, <d>[English] Finally. Scrub in, we're waiting.</d> Trays rattle.
Everyone shuffles round to make room for him.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the camera cuts to a fast montage of Oskar bluffing at the table, box now
abandoned on a stool behind him — snapping on gloves far too enthusiastically, holding out a flat
palm with enormous authority, then nodding gravely at a monitor he clearly cannot read. A nurse
slaps an instrument into his hand. He holds it up to the light and turns it round twice. Every
staff member responds instantly and correctly to each gesture, working faster and more smoothly
than before he arrived. Oskar's face cycles through panic, disbelief and delight.

scrubs hurries in tying her mask, sees the operation already running, and stops. The whole room

cardboard box, and backs toward the door giving the room a double thumbs up. Oskar (S1) says in a

A thin hand-drawn black route line rapidly travels across the map.

Camera follows the line at high speed.

The map suddenly transforms into a REAL aerial view of Rome using a seamless paper-to-reality transition.

Camera dives toward the Colosseum.

Massive elegant typography appears INSIDE the architecture using realistic depth masking:

“ROMA”

Behind it, enormous translucent Roman numerals:

“MMXXVI”

Tiny editorial text animates around the frame:

“41.9028° N / 12.4964° E”
“ROMA / ITALIA”
“LA CITTÀ ETERNA”

VFX: architectural blueprint lines briefly reconstruct the Colosseum's missing sections, showing it complete for half a second before dissolving back into the present-day ruins.

2.5–7s — ITALIAN LIFE

Beat accelerates.

Camera races beside a classic Vespa through a narrow Roman street.

WHIP PAN →

Espresso pouring into a tiny ceramic cup in extreme macro.

MATCH CUT →

Trevi Fountain water splashes directly toward camera and becomes the transition.

FLASH →

Italian fashion model walks confidently past historic architecture.

FAST PUSH-IN →

Fresh pasta twists around a fork.

SNAP ZOOM →

Pantheon ceiling.

Camera suddenly shoots upward through the opening.

Elegant floating typography locks onto objects:

“ESPRESSO”
“STORIA”
“MODA”
“ROMA”

Thin arrows, handwritten Italian annotations, postage stamps and tiny coordinates appear like an animated luxury travel journal.

7–12s — ROMAN CHAOS

Music DROPS.

Editing becomes extremely aggressive.

COLOSSEUM → VESPA → PASTA → STATUE → ESPRESSO → TREVI → FASHION → STREET → PANTHEON.

Each clip lasts only 0.2–0.35 seconds.

Then FREEZE FRAME.

A Roman statue becomes isolated from the background like a magazine cutout.

Huge typography slides BEHIND the statue:

“2000 YEARS.”

Another frame violently stacks over it:

“STILL ALIVE.”

The screen tears horizontally like ripped magazine paper.

ANCIENT ROME | STREET LIFE | ITALIAN STYLE

Typography rapidly flashes:

“STORIA.”
“PASSIONE.”
“BELLEZZA.”
“ROMA.”

VFX: analog film burns, photographic flash frames, paper textures, subtle dust, handwritten marks, frame numbers, red editorial circles and fast speed ramps.

Golden-hour aerial rises slowly above the Colosseum.

Modern Rome stretches endlessly into the background.

Huge elegant serif typography emerges behind the Colosseum:

IN A DAY.”

A flock of birds crosses frame.

Sunlight catches the lens.

Hard cut to cream paper.

A young Korean woman, early 20s, tired after a long day, oversized coat swallowing her frame, hair escaping a loose braid, stands alone at a rural bus stop long after the sun has set.
Setting: A single flickering streetlamp, an empty road disappearing into darkness, rice paddies barely visible on either side, insects buzzing somewhere in the black.

Sound: Crickets, distant engine growing louder, gravel underfoot, wind.
Mood: Quiet exhaustion giving way to small relief nothing dramatic, just real.

prompts.title: A High-Speed Tundra Cavalry Comparison

subject_definitions:

summary:
An intense, high-speed backward tracking long shot capturing the elven maiden (S1) riding a white warhorse at full gallop across the frozen tundra (S2), framed with naturalistic filmic realism, extreme speed streaks, and raw diegetic soundscape.

detailed_description:

The camera maintains a precise high-speed backward tracking movement 3.5 meters directly in front of the horse, locked in perfect speed synchronization while incorporating organic micro-breathing vibrations and subtle vertical road jostles authentic to naturalistic handheld cinematography. 

The lighting strictly mirrors @Image2: heavy, gloomy overcast clouds cover the sky, casting a soft, cold ambient atmospheric glow that gently rims S1's blonde locks and pointed ears, with shadows subtly lifted with a desaturated cyan-teal tint and authentic 35mm film grain.

Wild wind furiously whips her blonde bangs, fine braided hair, and the horse's white mane straight backward.

overall_soundscape:
Zero non-diegetic background music (NO BGM). None. Complete silence of musical score to maximize raw, cinematic documentary tension.

Actions include diagonal power walk, cross-step, low drop/rebound, pivot freeze, jacket snap/strap swing, push-wall rebound, paper passage, and controlled stair step-down. Include three large actions, two space contacts, one clothing-inertia action, and two design-led still points. Align mouth, jaw, eyes, shoulders, footfalls, breath, type, snare, and 808.

SHOT 1 — 0.0–1.6s, wide low push-in, poster-wall entrance. Performer steps from deep background through torn seam, shoulder first; front foot transfers weight, jacket catches paper, strap trails, camera settles on face. Action: paper passage. Text “CUT IN”, 110% hero. Layer A behind shoulder; B aquamarine jitter; C taped strip crosses torso then peels. Rhythm/Cut: inhale tears paper, kick hard-cuts.
SHOT 2 — 1.6–3.4s, eye-level side track, poster corridor. Diagonal power walk left-to-right, foot on kick, body crosses seam, strap and hem trail, camera jolts. Action: power walk. Text “BREAK”, 70% split by poster columns. A clean by face; B slips on hats; C foreground strip passes arm. Rhythm/Cut: snare halftone and hard cut.
SHOT 3 — 3.4–5.2s, low close-medium backward dolly, copy doorway. Cross-step over floor strip, shoulder-led 90-degree pivot, elbow brushes copier, torso rebounds. Action: cross-step/half-turn. Text “THE GRID”, 90% across copier/body in two irregular panels. A reads; B scans on rhyme; C paper flap slices lower frame and recovers. Rhythm/Cut: triplet jumps, cut on 808.

SHOT 4 — 5.2–7.0s, locked eye-level close-up, copy-room still point. Pivot ends; one collar pull, shoulders freeze, eyes track, jaw releases on breath, strap settles. Action: jacket pull/freeze. Text “HOLD”, 125% behind head with face pocket. A readable; B returns to registration; C tiny monospaced “BREATHE” seam note vanishes. Rhythm/Cut: low end drops, hold, flash-cut on pre-hook end.
SHOT 5 — 7.0–8.9s, wide low orbit, tiled underpass. Hook hit: performer bursts through threshold, forearm contacts pillar, center drops, leg rebounds, jacket opens, camera orbits then snaps back. Action: push-wall rebound. Text “BREAK THE GRID”, 145% in three unequal panels. A reads; B jumps aquamarine on 808; C torn diagonal crosses pillar but reveals face. Rhythm/Cut: hook consonant and kick cut on rebound.
SHOT 6 — 8.9–10.8s, overhead-to-front whip tilt, stairs. Two steps up, axis turns down, controlled short step-down, knees absorb, upright hit. Action: high-low step. Text “MAKE”, 80% vertical along stair diagonal. A reads on rise; B duplicates one character per hat; C railing tape flicks away. Rhythm/Cut: response lands on step-down, photocopy flash restores grayscale.
SHOT 7 — 10.8–13.2s, lateral track into frontal, rooftop billboard. Shoulder parts hanging pasted sheet, torso follows, strap swings once, three-quarter turn, feet lock. Action: paper passage/strap swing/pivot freeze. Text “MAKE IT LIVE”, 115% two-line fold around body. A reads before turn; B aquamarine misregisters on hat roll; C strap briefly occludes lower words, then clear. Rhythm/Cut: beat switch removes kick half-bar, one frame jump at strap apex.
SHOT 8 — 13.2–15.0s, frontal close-up to black type field, rooftop billboard. Feet finish turn, shoulders square, chin lifts, jacket and strap settle late, camera holds, then hard-cuts to black. Action: final stance/release. Text “BREAK THE GRID”, 150%, same type family, paper-white on black with aquamarine offset. A clear; B low-octave visual duplicate; C compresses like tape stop but remains briefly readable. Rhythm/Cut: final bass hit and tag land together, two-frame tape tail, hard cut.

GLOBAL LOCKS: one protagonist only, stable anime identity and outfit integrated into real photographic spaces; connected route, strict three-color system, accurate English, clear face and mouth. Hard cuts, flash frames, paper occlusion, panel splits, misregistration, restrained VHS only. No soft dissolve, fade, generic dance loop, continuous shake, extra characters, face swap, outfit change, duplicate limbs, broken hands, covered eyes/mouth, watermark, logo, fake brand, gibberish, or unreadable text. End decisively.

prompts.title: Pink Seoul Fashion in Graphic Cuts
prompts.prompt:
Create a 15s, 9:16, 24fps high-energy anime fashion commercial for “SOLVÉRA — PINK SEOUL MODE.”
Style: K-pop girl-group MV × Korean Y2K × Pink Cyber × Seoul street fashion × photo-booth aesthetics × cute luxury. Pink, glossy, playful, sexy, stylish, rebellious and premium. Adult fashion only, never childish or schoolgirl.
Character: One fictional adult Korean anime woman in her 20s with refined Korean features, fair luminous skin, long dark-brown hair, glossy lips, slim feminine figure, long legs and confident K-pop idol energy. Keep exactly the same face, hairstyle, age and body proportions in every shot. Outfits may change.
Palette: hot pink, baby pink, blush pink, glossy white, chrome silver, small black accents.
Every shot combines character movement + dynamic camera movement + foreground graphics. Use pink bows, chrome hearts, stickers, rhinestones, plush charms, photo-booth cards, holographic stars and bold Korean typography.
0–1s — HOOK
Extreme close-up. Camera rushes through pink bows and heart charms. She lowers pink sunglasses and looks directly at camera. Text: “PINK!” / “오늘도 핑크.” Giant heart wipes lens.
1–3s — SEOUL STREET
She confidently walks through a neon pink Hongdae street in a fitted pink mini dress, white jacket and silver boots. Low-angle tracking, strong parallax, flying stickers and hearts. Text: “SO CUTE.”
3–5s — Y2K SWITCH
Pink handbag wipes lens. New baby-pink Y2K look. She spins and looks back while camera orbits. Korean photo-booth frames appear around her. Text: “PINK MODE.”
5–7s — K-POP / CYBER
Fast cut to glossy K-pop stage, then futuristic pink Seoul subway. She performs a short dance move and reaches toward lens. Chrome hearts and neon Hangul orbit her. Text: “NO RULES.”
7–9s — GRAPHIC EXPLOSION
Huge pink Korean typography: “핑크는 자유야.” Camera flies through letters, torn paper, glitter, stickers and chrome graphics. Cut to her stepping from a pink elevator in a deep-pink mini dress. Text: “TOO CUTE?”
9–10.5s — MAXIMUM PINK
Rapid pull-back reveals a surreal pink world filled with bows, plush charms, handbags, photo cards, headphones and floating hearts. She raises one eyebrow. Text: “아직 부족해.” Everything suddenly stops.
10.5–12s — SOFT BREAK
Pure blush-pink background. Pale-pink mini dress and oversized white blazer. She walks forward slowly for two steps. Minimal graphics. Only bell and footsteps.
12–15s — FINAL EXPLOSION
Beat returns. Photo-booth cards of previous looks fly around her in a 3D collage. End on hot-pink hero background. She gives a confident cute-sexy pose and small smile.
Huge text hits with beat:
“CUTE”
“IS POWER”
“귀여움은 힘이야.”
“SOLVÉRA — PINK SEOUL — OUT NOW”
Music: K-pop hyperpop × bubblegum bass, ~150 BPM, punchy kick, bright synths, bells, cute vocal chops and camera shutters.
Avoid: face drift, body changes, inconsistent character, chibi, schoolgirl styling, childish proportions, static posing, weak camera motion, unreadable text, generic cute visuals.
Final feel: a premium pink Korean K-pop fashion campaign — cute, sexy, Y2K, energetic, glossy and unforgettable.

prompts.title: A Teasing Conversation by the Starship Window
prompts.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, ultra-realistic. The video starts exactly from <Picture 1>, preserving the warm spacecraft cabin, sofa area, porthole windows, pizza box, old astronaut helmet, candlelight, exposed wall wiring, and the full spatial continuity. The left girl is always A, the right girl is always B. Their identity, face, hairstyle, outfit, voice, and left-right relationship remain unchanged. A stays wrapped in a bathrobe and keeps holding the hot mug throughout. B stays side-lying close to her with both feet lifted behind her. The camera glides low across the pizza box, old helmet, candles, and wall wiring, then settles on both girls and the cat together. A looks down at the steam above the mug, thoughtful and avoiding eye contact; her eyelids are lowered, lips closed, shoulders slightly tucked, breathing shallow and even. B watches A with a restrained smile and softly swaying feet. Stars drift slowly outside, with a faint cool-blue reflection on the planetary curve. Thin steam rises from the mug; candle flames flicker gently without pulsing. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera gently pushes toward B while keeping her swaying calves and feet visible. B tilts her head slightly, hides a smile, then lets it show as she speaks and keeps watching A afterward. B, in a light teasing voice (S1), says, <d>[English] Daydreaming again? Who about?</d> “again” lifts slightly; there is a short pause before “Who about?”, which lands softer and more curious than pressing. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to A in close-up and sinks slightly with her movement. A freezes for a beat, blinks once, raises the mug to shield herself a little, lowers her head, and takes only a small sip. She swallows before speaking, keeping her gaze near the cup; the corner of her mouth almost lifts, then settles. A, in a soft inward voice (S2), says, <d>[English] No one… Don’t guess.</d> “No one” is short and quiet, followed by a brief hesitation; “Don’t guess” is soft, not angry. Drinking and speaking do not overlap. [Shot 4] At 00:06.000, the cat rises between them and the camera follows it naturally back into a medium close two-shot. A lightly strokes the cat’s ear to avoid B’s gaze. B inches closer, her feet still swaying, glances at A’s hands around the mug, then back to A’s face. Her smile deepens gently without exaggeration. B (S1), lowering her voice with playful warmth, says, <d>[English] Why so tight? You’re making the cup blush.</d> The first question is light and quick; “blush” lands with a smile. A begins to lose control of her smile by the end. [Shot 5] At 00:09.000, the camera returns to a slightly front-facing close two-shot favoring A. A lets out a small breathy laugh, shoulders relaxing. Keeping the mug upright in one hand, she lightly taps the back of B’s wrist with the other hand, then gently nudges B with one knee. Her eyes flick briefly toward B’s swinging feet, then toward B’s wrist, still not fully locking eye contact. B’s smile opens a little but she does not overreact. A (S2), smiling now, says, <d>[English] Keep your feet still. You’re flustering me even more.</d> The first sentence is playfully corrective; “even more” softens at the end. [Shot 6] At 00:12.000, the camera follows B in a tiny forward move. B shows a brief victorious smile, then softens; her feet gradually slow instead of stopping abruptly. She strokes the cat without pulling away. A finally raises her eyes and truly looks at her, keeping the faint smile from before and no longer looking away. B (S1) says, <d>[English] Then I’ll stop swinging my feet—and sway you.</d> The first half is light and playful; “sway you” becomes softer and more intimate, expressed only through voice and eyes, with no added pushing or body movement. After the line, the camera slowly pulls back to hold both girls, the cat between them, and the full warm cabin while they maintain eye contact. Dialogue order stays strictly B → A → B → A → B. No extra lines, no swapped roles, no axis crossing, no left-right swap, no cup hand change, no kiss, no hug, no subtitles, no text, no watermark.

overall_soundscape: Low steady spacecraft room tone throughout, with soft fabric movement, subtle sofa friction, faint mug handling, quiet breathing, light cat contact sounds, and gentle foot-sway rustle. Ambient sound stays restrained and never covers the dialogue.
