prompts.title: A Last Handhold on a Blizzard Cliff
prompts.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Photorealistic cinematic survival action, 15 seconds. Lara climbs a steep cliff in a blizzard toward a snow-buried ancient entrance. Lock her identity, hair, clothing, injuries, and equipment. Keep one climbing-tool type, secured when released; maintain the same rope-to-harness connection and upper anchor throughout.

Extreme close tracking begins on her left hand gripping a snowy crack, then tilts rapidly along her arm to her tense profile. Her right hand pulls the rope, knee braces against rock, and she pushes upward half a step. Eyes target the next hold; jaw tightens during effort. Lara (S1), quietly breathless, says, <d>[English] Almost there…</d> Wind drives snow sideways; loosened powder falls and the rope trembles.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut over her shoulder into a slightly wide subjective view. Advance with her head lift, then tilt upward toward the ancient doorway emerging through snow. She judges the route for half a beat and points her climbing tool toward an upper-right hold. No frontal insert or dialogue. A ruined pinnacle appears briefly, valley clouds churn below, and wind sharpens.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, cut to a front-side medium close-up, tracking her lateral traverse. Her right foot loads a thin ice edge and slips. Only then do her eyes widen and breath catch; she checks her foot, tightens her jaw, and searches for another grip. Lara (S1) produces <d>[English] Tsk.</d> as one clipped tongue click, not spoken letters. Snow and stone fragments fall into the ravine.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, track her sudden drop, then arrest sharply as the rope loads through her harness. She swings outward beneath the anchor, left hand gripping rope, right hand reaching for projecting rock; the tool remains secured. Her breath stops, then her eyes lock onto the target. Lara (S1), through clenched teeth, says, <d>[English] Don’t fall now.</d> Finish on one short exhalation, slightly stressing "now." Rope vibration, crumbling rock, and falling snow follow the load.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, cut to a diving angle following her swing toward the new hold, then move rapidly back toward her face. She catches the projection and uses her core and momentum to return against the cliff. Her chest strikes snowy rock; eyes briefly close and breath is knocked out. She immediately looks upward and resumes short breaths without crying out. Impact throws snow outward; wind whips her hair and briefly reveals the ruins.

[Shot 6] At 00:10.000, frame her gripping hand, push toward her eyes, then tilt slightly toward the cliff lip. Two quick climbing movements bring her hand onto a projecting stone edge. As she pulls, it breaks. Alarm follows the fracture: eyes widen, inhalation catches, and her gaze tracks the failing hold. Lara (S1) says, <d>[English] Wait!</d> sharply, once. Rock tumbles, snow dust strikes her face, and wind curls over the lip.

[Shot 7] At 00:12.000, follow a half-torso drop, then stop on her hand catching the solid cliff edge. She brings the other hand up and stabilizes her weight below the lip; the rope remains connected and physically loaded. Only after securing both hands does she exhale. Slowly tilt upward with her gaze to the enormous snow-buried doorway. Her eyelids and jaw ease slightly, retaining exhaustion and vigilance. Lara (S1), low and breathless, says, <d>[English] Found you.</d> A gust clears the entrance, revealing faint cold light through its seam. Leave the doorway visible after the line. End at 15.00 seconds with Lara still braced at the edge, without standing, walking, or opening the door.

Preserve all seven intervals, camera movements, and action causality. Lara is the only speaker; each exact utterance finishes within its assigned interval. Keep one voice, natural lip synchronization, and physically motivated breathing. No extra dialogue, screams, narration, reaction inserts, or performance pauses. Fear follows danger; relief follows a secure grip. Maintain realistic gripping, rope tension, swing direction, impact, and falling debris. No identity drift, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, intersecting hands or ropes, drifting holds, disappearing equipment, unsupported hovering, exaggerated expressions, subtitles, text, or watermarks.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous blizzard wind, clothing friction, exertion breaths, rope loading, cracking rock, and falling debris. Synchronize the rope arrest and muffled chest impact precisely; keep dialogue intelligible beneath the storm.

prompts.title: Pink-and-Cyan Afterimages on a Lemon Stage
prompts.prompt:
15-second experimental anime fashion film. Use @[character reference] for the character’s exact identity, outfit and rendering style. A pristine, uniform lemon-yellow cyclorama with a seamless matte floor. Flat, clean yellow throughout, free of grain, gradients and set dressing. 16:9. No text or logos.

The character performs one fast, unconventional dance phrase: ankles weave while the torso stays suspended, a wrist flick ripples through both elbows into a chest pop, knees fold into a low corkscrew pivot, then a heel swivel unwinds the body into an off-balance editorial pose. Continue through asymmetric shoulder rolls, angular arm threading around the face and a sideways glide with the head counter-rotating toward the lens. Every sharp lock immediately releases into another surprising movement. Convincing weight, precise foot contact and expressive follow-through.

Electric cyan and hot pink dominate the motion effects. Bold, opaque silhouette afterimages peel away from opposite sides of the body, replay the previous gesture a fraction late and slam back into alignment on each pose. Arm sweeps stretch them into broad curved ribbons; crossing steps weave pink and cyan trails around the ankles; rapid turns fan out overlapping screen-print impressions. At the strongest accents, oversized cyan and pink cutouts of the current pose slide across the foreground, briefly masking the lens. Keep the real character crisp and recognizable, with clean yellow visible between effect bursts.

The camera dances in counterpoint: skim backward at ankle height through advancing footwork, whip upward around an outstretched wrist into an extreme face close-up, then use the passing forearm to cut into a rotating overhead view of the low pivot. Dive to a tilted low-angle full-body composition as the character rises. Orbit opposite the sideways glide, exaggerating hands and feet near the wide lens. Accelerate between compositions and brake hard on pose locks.

Finish with a sudden forward lean toward the lens while enormous pink and cyan echoes continue leaning farther, sweeping past both sides of the camera. Snap wide: the character lands a final asymmetric pose as the colored echoes collapse precisely into the silhouette. Hard cut to black.

170 BPM broken beat, syncopated accents, fluid animation and razor-fast camera transitions. No slow motion or prolonged holds.

prompts.title: A 20-Cut Typographic Fashion Rush
prompts.prompt:
# 【ここだけ変更】
参照画像を添付し、以下の「」内とBPMの数値だけを書き換える。
本文も含めて全文をコピーして使用する。このテンプレートは15秒・20カット固定。

## 表示文字
文字列A = 「GPT-6」
文字列B = 「Astra」
文字列C = 「MiniMax H3」
文字列D = 「AI STUDIO」
文字列E = 「ONEROOM」

## 音楽
BPM = 160
音楽ジャンル = 「ファッション・エレクトロ」
音楽の質感 = 「強いビート、硬質な打音、細かいリズム、跳ねる低音」

## 画面とグラフィック
書体 = 「太いサンセリフ」
暗色 = 「黒」
明色 = 「白」
アクセント色 = 「淡い金色」

## 舞台
部屋の雰囲気 = 「夜の落ち着いた部屋」
照明 = 「青い窓明かりと暖かなランプ光」

# 【設定ここまで／以下は変更不要】

15秒、設定した画面比率のハイテンポなファッションMV。
冒頭の設定を全編に適用する。設定名や説明文は画面に表示しない。

# 主人公と参照画像
添付した参照画像の人物を主人公にする。
顔立ち、外見の特徴、髪型、髪色、体格、衣装、靴、既存のアクセサリーを反映し、全カットで同一人物として維持する。
アニメやイラストなら線・塗り・質感を、写真なら写真的な見た目と質感を維持する。
固定の性別、髪色、衣装、靴、画風を別途当てはめない。

キャラクターシート内の複数の姿は同一人物の資料として扱う。
登場人物は主人公1人。参照画像の背景、枠線、並列配置は使わない。
画像で確認できない部分は、見えている外見や服装に合う簡潔な形で補完し、全カットで固定する。
髪や衣服などの揺れは、参照画像に存在する可動部分だけで表現する。動きを付けるために髪やアクセサリーを追加しない。

# 人物の動き
主人公の動作は、ソファから立ち上がる、ソファの脇を抜けてレンズの横を通り過ぎる、足を止めて肩越しに一度振り返る、という一連の流れ。
一つの動作を複数のカメラ位置からつなぎ、短いカットごとに別の振り付けを始めない。

立ち上がるときは少し前へ重心を移し、肘掛けに添えた手を支えにして、上体を滑らかに起こす。
移動するときは肩の力を抜き、腕を身体の近くで自然に振る。視線は進む先へ向け、頭の高さを安定させる。髪や衣服の可動部分が動きに少し遅れて揺れる。
振り返るときは先に視線、次に顔、最後に肩がわずかに動く。片足に重心を残し、首と肩の角度で表情を見せる。

手で文字を押す、引く、払う動作や、ビートごとに踏み替えるステップは入れない。
人物の動作は自然な速さでつなぐ。鋭い速度感は、カメラの急加速、前景文字の通過、画角の切り替えで作る。
文字は主人公の立ち上がり、進行方向、身体の向き、視線の変化に反応する。

# 速度と演出
最初のフレームから立ち上がりの途中。カットは主に0.375〜1.125秒。
人物の動作の始点と着地、カメラの移動、文字の反応、カットの切り替えへ、音のアクセントを合わせる。動作の途中を一拍ずつ区切らない。
BPMを変更しても動画は15秒とし、各タイムコードを維持する。音楽の細かなリズムや短い打音でカット位置へアクセントを置き、すべてのカットを拍頭へ強制的に合わせない。
スローモーションや長い導入を入れない。
ムードは設定した照明、顔の陰影、参照画像に合う質感で表す。
文字の叩き込み、短い複製、3分割、字間の伸縮をアクセントにする。3分割では中央だけに人物、左右には文字と図形を配置する。

# 舞台
設定した部屋の雰囲気と照明を反映した、同じ一つの室内。
肘掛けのあるソファと、その背後の壁に窓を配置する。人物の移動とカメラの回り込みができる空間を確保する。
光源と内装の位置は固定し、カメラは室内を大きく移動する。
主人公の移動経路は、ソファの座面前からその脇を抜け、カメラの横まで。全編を同じ室内でつなぐ。

# 文字とグラフィック
表示するのは、設定した文字列A・B・C・D・Eの内容だけ。
各文字列の綴り、大文字小文字、空白、記号を入力どおりに保つ。文字列Aなどの内部呼称、設定項目名、Shot番号、タイムコードは画面へ描かない。
文字数や言語に合わせて大きさと字間を調整し、読む区間では各文字列を1行で画面内に収める。長い文字列は文字サイズを調整する。文字数を勝手に増減させない。

設定した書体による、厚みのない鮮明な2D文字。入力した言語を表示できる同系統の書体で統一する。
グラフィックには暗色・明色・アクセント色の設定を使う。この配色を人物の髪や服へ適用しない。
背景に巨大な文字列Cの輪郭文字、中景に文字を伴わないバー・ドット・円弧、前景に主文字。
背景は横へ、中景は縦へ、主文字は人物の動きに反応して動き、3層の速度差を作る。
背景と前景の同じ綴りは、意図した別層の使用。
人物の手前と背後に文字を置き、カメラ移動で強い視差を作る。腕や身体による遮蔽を自然に保つ。

グラフィックの地色は冒頭で暗色、文字は明色。
00:01.500で地色を明色、00:05.250で暗色、00:11.625で明色へ切り替える。文字色はその都度、地色と反対の設定色へ切り替える。
反転はグラフィック層に適用し、室内の照明と人物の色は固定する。

主文字を左右へ複製するのはShot 7だけ。左右に1つずつ配置した後、区間の終わりで画面外へ抜ける。
Shot 8では人物・全グラフィック・室内の動きを止め、カメラだけを動かす。
終幕の00:14.625以降はカメラを含む全体を止める。それ以外ではカメラとグラフィックの運動をつなぐ。
読む区間では全文を画面内に収め、顔と重ねない。設定した画面比率に合わせて構図、文字の大きさ、余白を調整する。3分割でも人物は中央列に1人だけ配置する。

# シーン
時刻は動画全体の絶対タイムコード。各区間を指定どおり配置し、後半を短縮しない。

[Shot 1] 00:00.000–00:00.750
ソファから立ち上がり途中の主人公へ高速ドリーイン。
上体が起き上がる勢いに合わせて文字列Cが前景へ叩き込まれる。
最後の0.375秒は全文を読ませる。主人公の手は肘掛けを支えている。

[Shot 2] 00:00.750–00:01.125
顔へスナップズーム。立ち上がりながら、主人公の視線が進む方向へ移る。
視線の変化に合わせ、前景文字が横へ抜ける。

[Shot 3] 00:01.125–00:01.500
足元の接写。立ち上がった体重が足裏へ乗る。靴の種類や素足の状態は参照画像の設定を保つ。
自然な荷重の瞬間にアクセント色の短い線が床面を走り、短い打音が重なる。

[Shot 4] 00:01.500–00:02.250
全身ローアングル。
立ち上がり終えた主人公が、一方の肩を引いてソファの脇へ向きを変える。
その方向転換に引かれ、背後の文字列Aが大きく横切る。カメラも低い位置から横へ加速する。

[Shot 5] 00:02.250–00:03.000
斜め正面からのミディアム。主人公の指先が肘掛けから自然に離れる。
身体が進み始めるタイミングで文字列Aが人物の横へ集まり、文字列全体の横幅が一瞬圧縮されて戻る。
カメラは正面へ急接近する。

[Shot 6] 00:03.000–00:03.750
方向転換から最初の一歩へつながる動作。
主人公は足の向きに合わせて上体を回し、髪や衣服の可動部分が少し遅れてついてくる。
カメラは逆方向へ高速オービット。文字列Aは身体の回転に引かれて円弧を描く。

[Shot 7] 00:03.750–00:04.500
主人公が一歩でソファの脇へ出る。
その移動に合わせて2本のバーが画面を3分割する。
中央に移動中の主人公、左右に文字列Aを1つずつ配置し、文字は逆方向へ流れて画面外へ抜ける。
人物の手は自然に下ろしたまま。

[Shot 8] 00:04.500–00:04.875
0.375秒だけのバレットタイム。
歩き出した一歩の途中で、身体、髪、衣装、背景文字、中景の装飾、室内を完全停止する。
カメラだけが約90度、素早く回り込む。
空間内の各要素は動かず、カメラ移動だけで重なりと距離感が変わる。

[Shot 9] 00:04.875–00:05.250
即座に時間再開。主人公は止まっていた一歩をそのまま着地まで続ける。
前へ進む勢いに合わせて文字列Aがレンズ直前を横切り、画面外へ抜ける。
カメラもその通過方向へ鋭く振る。

[Shot 10] 00:05.250–00:06.375
ワイド。続く移動を正面から捉え、カメラは高速で後退する。
主人公は進む先を見て、腕を自然に振りながら近づく。
その前進に合わせて文字列Bの字形を作る要素が左右から集まり、一行に整う。アクセント色の平面円が中央から広がる。
文字が整う瞬間も、主人公の移動は途切れない。

[Shot 11] 00:06.375–00:07.125
カメラが主人公の腰の横を高速通過する。
主人公は進む方向を保ち、レンズの横へ近づく。
文字列Bが背後から手前へ追従し、身体に隠れてから横へ現れる。

[Shot 12] 00:07.125–00:07.875
移動中の肩から顔へ、カメラが短く上がる。
主人公の目線は進む先に向いたまま。頭や肩の輪郭を光がかすめ、髪や衣服の動きが見える。
人物の移動に合わせ、背後の文字列D・文字列Eが上下2行で上がる。
最後の0.375秒は顔を避けた位置で、両方の全文を読ませる。

[Shot 13] 00:07.875–00:08.625
主人公がレンズのすぐ横を通り過ぎる。
肩とその輪郭が前景を大きく横切り、その流れに文字列Bが追従して急接近する。
カメラは同時に後退し、人物と文字の距離差を広げる。

[Shot 14] 00:08.625–00:09.375
短い文字主体のカット。文字列Cを線分から組み上げる。
直前の人物の通過方向を引き継ぎ、中景のバーが高速で横断する。
背景の輪郭文字は別速度で流れ続ける。

[Shot 15] 00:09.375–00:10.125
全身へハードカット。
主人公が最後の一歩を置き、片足へ自然に体重を預けて移動を終える。
その接地に合わせて平面の円弧が外へ広がる。
カメラは床近くから一気に上がり、顔まで捉える。

[Shot 16] 00:10.125–00:10.875
主人公が肩越しに一度だけ振り返る。
先に視線、次に顔が動き、肩がわずかに続く。足の位置は保つ。
カメラは逆方向へ回り込み、文字列Bが肩の背後へ隠れて反対側へ抜ける。

[Shot 17] 00:10.875–00:11.625
俯瞰。直前の振り返りをそのまま続ける。
カメラが斜め下へダイブして顔へ近づき、顔の向きの変化に合わせて文字列Cが画面下から上へ走る。
主人公の腕は身体の脇に自然に下ろされている。

[Shot 18] 00:11.625–00:12.750
各0.375秒の3カット。すべて同じ振り返りの続き。
1：肩と、その周囲の髪や衣服に残る動きを近距離で捉える。
2：片足へ重心を預けた全身を斜め横から捉える。
3：レンズへ向いた顔へ切り替える。
角度とスケールを毎回変え、姿勢と視線をつなぐ。

[Shot 19] 00:12.750–00:13.875
目線の高さの斜め正面。主人公がレンズへ視線を合わせる。
片足に重心を残し、肩の線をわずかに斜めにする。腕は自然に下ろす。
視線が定まるタイミングで、上段に文字列D、下段に文字列Eが左右から集まる。
各1行で正しい間隔へ整列し、顔を避けた位置へ収まる。

[Shot 20] 00:13.875–00:15.000
文字列D・文字列Eの2行を全文表示し続ける。
主人公は前カットの姿勢と表情を保ち、カメラが短く寄る。背景の輪郭文字と中景の装飾は動き続ける。
00:14.625でカメラ、人物、全グラフィックを止める。
最後の0.375秒、主人公の顔と二つの文字列が明瞭な構図を保持して終わる。

# 音
BPMの設定値、4拍子、設定した音楽ジャンルと音楽の質感を使う。
楽器と音色はジャンルに合わせて選び、冒頭からリズムを鳴らす。
動作の始点と着地、カメラの加速、カット、文字の着弾へ音のアクセントを合わせる。
Shot 8の0.375秒だけ低域を薄くし、そのジャンルに合う高域のリズムと残響を残す。Shot 9で低音を即復帰する。
BPMを変えた場合もカット時刻を優先し、細かなリズムや短い打音で指定位置にアクセントを置く。

どちらの場合も歌・セリフ・ナレーションは入れない。
終盤も映像を減速させず、最後の停止に短い打音を合わせて締める。

prompts.title: A 10-Cut Autumn Ad for Recovery Pajamas
prompts.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1>: Attached RAKUNE autumn storyboard: ten panels in two columns and five rows, read left to right, top to bottom. Use each panel as its corresponding shot anchor.
<Subject 1>: The same fictional young adult Japanese actress in <Picture 1>, with shoulder-length dark hair, natural bangs, minimal makeup, and an approachable smile.
<Subject 2>: The reference's rust-colored long-sleeved button-front pajamas with ivory piping and matching full-length trousers.
<Subject 3>: The reference's orange, golden-yellow, navy, and ivory graphics: huge typography, circles, diagonal bands, stars, radial lines, and geometric autumn leaves.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a 15-second, horizontal 16:9 commercial with exactly ten shots following <Picture 1>. Combine photorealistic <Subject 1>, clear views of <Subject 2>, and boldly animated <Subject 3>. Emphasize vitality through physical movement, explosive typography, and tightly synchronized music. Finish with a stable, readable brand card.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: partially_preserved — Keep panel order and key compositions; exclude grid, margins, heading, numbers, and timecodes.
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved — Maintain identity, hair, natural appearance, and anatomy.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved — Maintain color, long sleeves, trousers, buttons, piping, and fit.
<Subject 3>: attribute_transfer — Animate the reference's design vocabulary as separate layers.

detailed_description:
Use bright, natural studio lighting throughout, keeping faces and fabric clear. Shots 1–3 show <Subject 1> in the reference's ivory casual top; shots 4–10 show her in <Subject 2>. Every shot fills the 16:9 screen. Use rapid acceleration, controlled overshoot, elastic settling, and clear visual hierarchy. Never animate the storyboard as a flat slideshow.

[Shot 1] Follow panel 01 of <Picture 1>. Medium shot of <Subject 1> turning toward camera against golden yellow, hair following naturally. Orange circles expand and angular leaves sweep outward. Huge navy text "秋だ！" snaps in with one rebound. The camera pushes in slightly at fast speed and settles. A short graphic rush coincides with the first musical hit.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, the camera cuts to panel 02's three-strip layout. Show <Subject 1> finishing work, lightly stretching, and smiling in separate strips. Slide them in opposing directions while a navy banner carries white text "今日も、全力。". Cameras within the strips remain fixed; gestures and panels provide movement. Add short sliding sounds.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.200, the camera cuts to panel 03's close-up. <Subject 1> smiles and snaps her fingers near the lens with natural hand anatomy. The camera makes a small, fast push toward her hand. Orange rings expand from the snap; text "じゃ、着替えよ！" appears beside her face. The rings cover the frame. Synchronize a crisp finger snap and expanding rush.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts through the wipe to panel 04's full-body reveal. <Subject 1>, now in <Subject 2>, completes a lively quarter-turn against golden yellow. Fabric moves naturally. Giant navy "RAKUNE" lands behind her with one overshoot and an orange starburst. The camera pulls back moderately at fast speed to reveal the whole outfit. Add a fabric swish and short impact.

[Shot 5] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to panel 05's product triptych: collar and buttons, long-sleeve cuff, and full-length trouser hem of <Subject 2>. Three angular windows slide into position on consecutive accents. Small, slow camera moves reveal fabric and ivory piping. Display "秋のリカバリーウェア" on a readable ivory band. Add three crisp ticks.

[Shot 6] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to panel 06's wide composition. Center <Subject 1> in <Subject 2> against ivory. She opens both arms upward, triggering navy and orange lines that extend beyond the frame. Large navy text "夜を、" expands without covering her face. The camera pulls back slightly at moderate speed. Add soft clothing movement and a rising rush.

[Shot 7] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to panel 07's eye-level, three-quarter full-body view. <Subject 1> steps forward in <Subject 2>. Her footfall triggers a navy diagonal sweep carrying huge yellow text "着替えろ。", which stops sharply. The camera tracks sideways slightly at moderate speed. Keep trousers and body proportions clear. Add a light footfall and sweeping sound.

[Shot 8] At 00:09.500, the camera cuts to panel 08's navy background. <Subject 1> side-steps in <Subject 2> and looks back with a spontaneous smile. Orange and yellow balls bounce at different depths; curved paths draw behind her. Ivory text "明日を、" bounces into place. The camera tracks laterally with moderate amplitude at fast speed, then settles. Add light footfalls and graphic pops.

[Shot 9] At 00:11.000, the camera cuts to panel 09's golden-yellow full-body view. <Subject 1> makes one small jump in <Subject 2>, both feet briefly above the floor. At the apex, stars, circles, and navy radial lines burst outward: the commercial's largest graphic expansion. Huge navy text "弾ませろ。" lands in a readable arrangement. The camera follows upward slightly, then follows her descent. Add a concentrated graphic rush; avoid prolonged slow motion.

[Shot 10] At 00:13.000, the camera cuts to panel 10's end card. Within 0.3 seconds, shapes align into an ivory-and-orange layout. Place smiling <Subject 1> in <Subject 2> on the right, waving gently. Left: large navy "RAKUNE", subtitle "疲労回復パジャマ", and a clear product arrangement of shirt and trousers. Bottom: "夜を着替えろ。明日を弾ませろ。". Fix the camera and hold all text through 15 seconds, with only subtle background movement. Add a light landing sound. At approximately 00:13.700, a bright female brand voice (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover <d>[Japanese] ラクネ！</d>. The on-screen character's lips remain closed.

Keep Japanese text exact. Do not add people, extra copy, medical diagrams, or unsupported efficacy claims. Maintain consistent faces, hands, and garments. Create intensity through graphic motion and composition, not flashing strobes or persistent camera shake.

overall_soundscape:
Use subtle fabric movement, a crisp finger snap, and light footfalls synchronized to actions. Add short graphic rushes, ticks, pops, and impacts at the specified transitions, below the brand voice. Let movement sounds decay before the ending.

non_diegetic_music:
Original instrumental electro-pop at approximately 160 BPM, with punchy kick, syncopated bass, sharp claps, bright synth stabs, and short rising fills. Start immediately, accent the specified edit points, and build to the jump's strongest hit. Resolve into a sonic-logo cadence, lower the track beneath the brand voice, and end cleanly at 15 seconds without sung lyrics.

prompts.title: A Golden Celebration Sphere Unfolds into Thank-You Typography
prompts.prompt:
高品質な祝福タイポグラフィアニメーション
表示文字：「X」「フォロワー」「5300人」「YaReYaRu」「ありがとう！」
綴りと大文字・小文字を正確に保持する

【ビジュアル】
深いミッドナイトブルーを背景に、ゴールド、ホワイト、鮮やかなエメラルドグリーンで統一
主役は大きく読みやすい文字、くす玉と花火は文字の登場や変形に連動する
極太サンセリフの数字、洗練された立体文字、薄い金属反射、奥行きのある紙吹雪
上品な授賞式の華やかさと、SNSらしい軽快で力強いモーションを組み合わせる
重要な文字は中央の安全領域に配置、画面下端や右端に寄せない

【0〜2秒｜期待をつくる】
暗い画面中央で小さな金色の火花が弾け、白い「X」が瞬発的に出現
文字が一度だけ大きく弾み、細い光のリングが外側へ広がる
「X」が上部中央へ縮小移動、その下に「フォロワー」が一文字ずつ軽快に着地
背後から金色の細いリボンが左右へ走り、中央を空ける

【2〜5秒｜くす玉登場】
画面上から豪華な金色のくす玉が中央へ降りてくる
上下に重なる金色の鱗状装飾、緑の房飾り、左右対称の球体
減速して止まり、小さく一度だけ揺れる
カメラがゆっくり接近、周囲の光が絞られ、くす玉の継ぎ目から緑と金の光が漏れる
下に伸びた一本の紐がぴんと張り、開く直前に一瞬静止

【5〜8秒｜5300人を大きく見せる】
強い打音と同時にくす玉が左右へぱかっと開く
左右の半球は吊られたまま残り、内側から金と緑の紙吹雪、長いカールリボンが勢いよく放出される
中央から白い垂れ幕が下へほどけ、その表面に極太の「5300人」が現れる
「5300」の数字が垂れ幕から手前へ立体的にせり出し、画面中央を大きく占める
数字は一度だけ軽くオーバーシュートして定位置へ収まり、「人」は数字の右下へ整然と配置
同時に背景の左右上方で大輪の花火が開く
短い光の衝撃と画面の微振動で到達の喜びを強調、文字が読めなくなる全面白飛びは起こさない

【8〜11秒｜名前を主役に】
「5300人」が少し上へ移動し、その下へ「YaReYaRu」が左から右へ一文字ずつ滑り込む
文字の着地に合わせて金色の小さな火花が散り、最後の「u」が収まると名前全体を緑の光が一度だけ横切る
カメラが緩やかに引き、上部の「X」、その下の「フォロワー」、中央の「5300人」、下部の「YaReYaRu」がひとつの祝福ポスターとして整う
背景に高さと大きさの異なる花火が時間差で開花
紙吹雪は文字の背後を中心に落下し、少量だけ手前を横切って奥行きを出す

【11〜13秒｜ありがとう】
「YaReYaRu」の下に「ありがとう！」が柔らかな弾みをつけて出現
左右から金色のリボンが弧を描き、文字全体を囲む祝福のフレームになる
最後に背景中央上方で最大の金色の花火が開き、その内側に緑の小さな花火が重なる
花火の明るさに合わせ、文字の縁が一瞬だけ輝く

【13〜15秒｜読ませる完成画面】
文字とカメラを静止させ、完成したレイアウトを2秒間保持
「X」
「フォロワー」
「5300人」
「YaReYaRu」
「ありがとう！」
「5300人」を最も大きく、次に「YaReYaRu」を強調
開いたくす玉を上部左右に残し、花火の残光とゆっくり落ちる紙吹雪だけが動く
最後まで文字を鮮明に読める状態で終了

【音・編集】
華やかなエレクトロポップ、文字の着地に短い打音、くす玉開放に祝砲、花火に奥行きのある炸裂音
5秒のくす玉開放で音楽が大きく展開し、最後は明るい余韻
ナレーションなし
カットの切り替えよりも、文字の位置移動、拡大縮小、リボンの軌道で場面を滑らかにつなぐ
文字の誤字、重複、勝手な文言追加、数字の変化、過度な点滅、粒状ノイズ、ウォーターマークは禁止

prompts.title: Liquid Metal Forms a Futuristic Sports Car
prompts.prompt:
A hyper-realistic, photorealistic 8K CGI advertisement sequence for a futuristic luxury electric concept sports car, styled like a high-end commercial with a sleek, powerful, and sophisticated mood.

Setting & EnvironmentSet in an infinite, minimalist virtual studio with a deep black void background and a perfectly polished, highly reflective black obsidian floor that crystal-clearly mirrors the scene. The atmosphere is crystal clear with subtle light bloom.
Lighting

Key Light: A cool-white (6000K) softbox panel light descends from above, growing larger to cast clean defining highlights over the final car.

Emissive Accent Light: Silvery-white and vibrant electric-blue light glows directly from the fluid liquid metal, projecting dynamic reflections onto the floor.

Subject Transformation

Initial Form: A single, pristine sphere of mercury-like liquid metal hovering above the floor, rippling with high reflectivity and surface tension.

Final Form: A low-profile, aerodynamic futuristic sports car with smooth, single-piece molded body panels in deep gloss black pearlescent paint that subtly shifts to dark blue, featuring razor-sharp LED light bars.

Camera ChoreographyAn uninterrupted, dynamic camera move starting as an extreme close-up macro (85mm, f/1.8 shallow depth of field) focused on the hovering liquid drop. The camera smoothly pulls back and accelerates into a sweeping clockwise orbit, transitioning to a wide shot (35mm, f/5.6 deep focus) to reveal the complete vehicle sharp and in full view.

Action & Animation Sequence
0–2s: The liquid metal sphere slowly pulses and ripples to a low-frequency bass hum.

2–5s: The sphere explodes outward in zero-gravity as liquid tendrils stretch to form the car's wireframe, traced by glowing electric-blue energy lines, accompanied by high-tech chimes and metallic crackles.

5–7s: Liquid metal flows over the energy frame, solidifying into smooth body panels and forming wheels to a heavy bass thrum.

7–8s: The car gently settles onto the reflective obsidian floor, its razor-sharp LED headlights and taillights flash on with a powerful pulse, fading into the subtle hum of a high-tech electric motor.

prompts.title: Full-Speed Roller Skating on a Neon Track
prompts.prompt:
MiniMax H3を使用して、15秒・2Kのスタイリッシュなローラースケート動画を制作する。最優先するのは圧倒的なスピード感。開始直後から高速で滑走し、最後まで減速せず、勢いを維持する。
主人公は、スポーツウェアとヘルメットを着用した成人スケーター一人。人物と衣服を黒一色のシャープなシルエットとして描く。両足には、片足4輪のクワッド型ローラースケートを履く。
舞台は、鮮やかなシアン、マゼンタ、コーラル、イエローで構成された、広く滑らかな架空の専用スケートコース。長い直線と大きなカーブを組み合わせ、前方へ伸びる床のライン、連続する柱、幾何学的なアーチによって強い遠近感を作る。

【0～4秒：冒頭から全速力】
最初のフレームから、主人公はすでに高速で滑走している。
上半身を低く倒し、膝を曲げ、左右の足で力強く連続して路面を押す。腕を大きく前後へ振り、蹴り出しと連動させる。足をそろえて流すだけでなく、自ら加速している動きを明確に見せる。
カメラは車輪の高さから主人公の横を高速で並走する。手前の路面、コースライン、柱が画面を勢いよく通過する。主人公とスケートは鮮明に保ち、近景ほど強く流れるモーションブラーで速度を表現する。

【4～8秒：高速カービング】
主人公は速度を維持したまま、大きなカーブへ進入する。全身を内側へ傾け、力強いクロスオーバーで曲がりながら加速する。
カメラは斜め前方で後退しながら追跡し、主人公が迫ってくる構図を作る。次の強いビートで斜め上からの追従ショットへ切り替え、長いコースを高速で進む軌道を見せる。
背景の太いラインと長方形が後方へ飛び去り、カーブに合わせて画面の色面がシアンからマゼンタへ瞬時に切り替わる。コースの幅と形状は安定させ、滑走ルートを明確にする。

【8～12秒：直線でさらに加速】
カーブを抜けると長い直線コースが開ける。主人公は姿勢をさらに低くし、左右の蹴り出しをテンポよく繰り返して加速する。
カメラは真横の全身ショット、斜め後方からの高速追従、地面すれすれの車輪ショットをビートに合わせて切り替える。アングルが変わっても前進する勢いを途切れさせない。
コース脇の柱と頭上のアーチが短い間隔で次々と通過し、路面のラインが画面手前へ鋭く流れる。背景だけを動かすのではなく、人物が実際にコース上を高速で移動する様子を描く。

【12～15秒：カメラを追い越して終了】
主人公は最後の直線を全速力で駆け抜ける。
カメラは斜め前方から並走し、主人公が追いついてくる動きを捉える。最後の強いビートで主人公がカメラを追い越し、画面手前から奥へ勢いよく滑っていく。
カメラは滑らかに向きを変えて後ろ姿を追う。主人公は蹴り出しを続け、前方へ伸びる鮮やかなコースを高速で進んだまま映像を終了する。最後まで減速、停止、決めポーズを入れない。

【モーショングラフィックと音楽】
背景の長方形、三角形、グリッド、太いラインを、進行方向と反対側へ高速でスライドさせる。蹴り出すたびに短い光のラインが路面を走り、カーブでは図形が滑走軌道に沿って流れる。
音楽は速いテンポのドラムンベースまたはエレクトロニック・ミュージック。力強いベース、細かなパーカッション、車輪の走行音、風切り音を組み合わせ、蹴り出しとカメラの切り替えをビートへ同期させる。
スローモーション、ダンス、足踏み、スピン、後ろ向き滑走は入れない。全編を高速の前進滑走と大きなカーブで構成する。
同じ黒いスケーターと同じ一組のクワッド型ローラースケートを維持する。車輪は路面との接触と移動速度に合わせて回転する。文字やロゴは表示しない。
シャープな人物、激しく流れる近景、強い遠近感、力強い蹴り出し、途切れない高速追従によって、風圧まで感じるような、疾走感を最優先した15秒動画に仕上げる。

prompts.title: An Approaching Train on a Rainy Night Platform
prompts.prompt:
A single continuous live-action long take on a Japanese elevated train platform at night in the rain. One woman waiting alone, camera locked in place at her right side, filming her right profile down the length of the platform. It runs from her small waiting fidgets, through a commuter train arriving and passing in front of her, to the train nearly stopping and a soft side-profile smile. One take, camera fixed with only slight handheld breathing, no cuts, no zoom, no push-in. Normal real-world speed throughout, no slow motion.

Shot 1 — 0.0s: Realistic cinematic, real-camera rainy-night platform, one continuous long take, medium shot from mid-thigh up, camera fixed at her right at chest height looking down the platform's depth. Right side of frame is the wet-bright yellow tactile paving, the platform edge, and two steel rails converging into the distance, with the arched glass windscreen beyond; left side is the platform interior and orange glowing shopfront boxes; cool fluorescent tubes recede overhead; red-blue-green neon bokeh at the far end; tiles wet-black and reflective. Riria stands center-slightly-left inside the yellow paving, facing the tracks, her right profile to the lens, shopfront orange rimming her back and bun. The right-side rail is empty, no train yet. She is already mid-action: tilting the umbrella back a little, looking up past its rim at the night sky beyond the canopy, reaching her right hand forward toward the track side past the umbrella rim, palm up, holding a beat to test whether it's still raining, a few drops landing in her palm.

Shot 1 continues — 1.5s: She pulls her hand back, rights the umbrella back over her head, lets out a soft breath, and shifts her weight from one foot to the other.

Shot 1 continues — 2.0s: Two small, soft cool-white headlights light up at the far end of the right-side rail. She leans her upper body slightly forward (feet not crossing the yellow paving), peering toward the far end of the tracks, body still squared to the rails. The headlights grow larger and brighter extremely gradually along the right rail, the steel, the standing water, and the platform edge lighting up bit by bit.

Shot 1 continues — 3.5s: She straightens up, steps back half a step, grips the umbrella handle again with her left hand, her gaze following the approaching train. The light keeps rising slowly and evenly — first catching the side-profile edge of her forehead, nose bridge, and lips, then washing softly onto her face. The same light also falls on the droplets on the umbrella, the rain, the wet tiles, and her coat, no hard edges, no flicker. Her skin is only softly brightened overall, still matte, no shine spot. She squints slightly and tucks her chin a little into the turtleneck.

Shot 1 continues — 5.5s: A silver stainless-steel commuter train with a green waistline reaches her along the right-side rail, wheels on the rails, body tight to the platform edge, the nose passing in front of her and exiting frame right. In the same instant a gust blows in from the depth of frame: bangs and side hairs pressed to her cheeks, coat hem, lapels, and back belt lifting, umbrella tilting about a hand's width and trembling. Her left hand steadies the umbrella, her right hand lifts to gather the blown-open coat front at her chest, still facing the tracks. The cool-white headlight glow transitions smoothly into the warm-white carriage glow over about a second, brightness roughly unchanged, only cool-to-warm. Carriages run past in front of her on the right with motion blur, the warm-white light a long steady even band on her face, coat front, and umbrella rim, no flicker. Her feet stay planted, sharp, normal speed, no slow motion.

Shot 1 continues — 7.0s to 10.0s: The train visibly decelerates, carriages resolving back into distinguishable windows, inside them only defocused warm-white light and blurred shapes, but the warm light on her stays constant. The wind eases, hems settle, hair slowly drops. Around 8.5s she releases the coat front and uses her right fingertips to tuck the strands stuck to her cheek behind her ear, revealing the pearl stud, then lets her right hand fall naturally.

Shot 1 continues — 10.0s: The train glides slowly toward a near-stop, settling on the right-side rail, the warm-white light still steady and soft on her face.

Shot 1 continues — 10.5s: Her head turns only slightly toward the lens side, feet and shoulders still toward the tracks, still a clean right profile in frame, at most the far corner of her eye and mouth just showing, never a three-quarter front or full face. Her gaze slants gently toward the lens side, not direct to camera. Framing stays mid-thigh-up medium, no push-in.

Shot 1 continues — 12.5s: The corner of her mouth slowly lifts into a soft, restrained closed-lip smile on the profile, cheekbone rising a touch, eye corner curving, never a toothy grin or a posed frozen smile. The smile holds on the profile, she blinks once and breathes out softly, a strand of hair still swaying in the leftover wind, the train completing its last short glide at walking pace with doors staying shut. The image ends while these tiny motions are still underway, never a freeze frame. Live throughout — rain keeps falling, droplets slide and pool on the umbrella, the turtleneck collar rises faintly with her breath, flyaways drift, puddle ripples shimmer, distant neon glows steady, the handheld frame breathing lightly.

All light changes are continuous, slow gradients, never blinking: no flicker, strobe, or on-off pulsing, no per-frame brightness jumps, no sudden light on or off, no hard-edge pools or stage-spotlight circles, no window-shaped light patches sweeping across her face. The windows are large and the carriage light diffuse, so what lands on her is one steady sheet of warm light. The headlights are just two softly growing points, never direct into the lens, the frame never flashes white. The same light lands on the umbrella, the rain, the wet tiles, the platform edge, and her coat at once, never only on her face. Fluorescent tubes and distant neon glow steady, never flickering. Camera exposure locked the whole time, no auto-brightening or darkening. The whole clip brightens smoothly only once, then holds steady, never bright-then-dark-then-bright. The nose passing in front of her and the gust lifting her hair and hems happen in the same instant (around 5.5s), never wind-before-train or train-already-past-before-wind.

Prohibited

No subtitles, watermark, logo, or overlay text; platform light boxes, billboards, and train destination displays appear only as defocused glowing color blocks, never any readable text. No dialogue or narration. No standing still before the train or woodenly posing before it; no flicking water off the hand. No light blinking, flickering, strobing, or on-off pulsing; no bright-then-dark-then-bright; no sudden light on or off; no headlight flaring white into the lens; no window-shaped light patches sweeping across her face; no stage-spotlight circles or hard light beams; no light landing only on her face; no exposure wavering; no flickering tubes or neon. No standing with her back to the tracks; no facing the shopfronts, platform interior, or lens; no chest toward frame left. No rail on the left side of frame; no train driving onto the platform; no train on the left or shopfront side; no train crossing the frame; no train floating or off the rails; no train passing behind her; no train between her and the lens; no train coming from behind the camera, driving off into the distance, or reversing. No push-in, pull-out, zoom, or orbit. No chest-up close-up or face close-up. No full face to lens, three-quarter front glance back, or direct eye contact. No turning the shoulders or turning around. No early smile. No skin oil, sweat, water shine, specular spots, wet reflection, or droplets on the face. No rubbery, silicone, waxwork, or plastic skin, no smoothing, no freckles vanishing. No grey studio backdrop. No triptych, split-screen, or a second Riria. No other passengers or staff on the platform. No doors opening or anyone getting off. No slow motion or slowed hair drift. No umbrella flipping inside out, flying from her hand, or the shaft crossing her face; no right hand covering her face. No features drifting into a similar-looking different person — it is this person from the reference. No toothy grin. No global amber or teal-orange filter. No CG, anime, over-sharpening, or HDR look. No freeze frame. No third hand or finger distortion.

A low tracking shot through a wide open meadow of tall gold grass, low sun ahead on the horizon, no buildings, no road. A Japanese schoolgirl runs screen-left to screen-right, feet-first, toward the open field and the sun, not back toward the camera. Same girl, same lock: late teens, black shoulder-length hair, red ribbon, navy sailor uniform, white collar, red neckerchief, pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers. She plants her right foot and leaps straight up, arms opening, skirt and hair lifting, loafers leaving the grass. The sun sits behind her so she is a rim-lit silhouette against a clear gold sky. She does not fall back. She does not look at the camera. Mouth stays closed. The camera tilts up at fast speed with large amplitude, following her rise, grass blades sharp in the near foreground. No speech. No narrator.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, the camera cuts to a medium shot of her at the top of the leap, same body, same face, same navy uniform and red ribbon, against the gold sky. One continuous morph, no second figure, no costume left behind, no small bird hatching out of her. Gold fire kindles at her outstretched fingertips and at the hem of the skirt, climbs the arms, and becomes long primary feathers. The sailor collar and skirt burn away into plumage on the same body. Her face lengthens into a raptor beak in that same head; the eyes stay in place and turn coal-bright. Her legs tuck and become talons. What finishes the morph is a phoenix the size of a large crane, wingspan wider than she was tall: gold breast, crimson flight feathers with white-hot edges, a long trailing tail of fire, not a cartoon flame blob, not a sparrow, not a chicken. The phoenix only: crane-sized, gold breast, crimson flight feathers, white-hot edges, long fire tail, coal-bright eyes, talons tucked. use the woman in  <Picture 1> is lucy. 

Lucy stepped out of the small diner where she worked, the doorbell jingling softly behind her. The night air was cool and crisp, a welcome change from the stuffy warmth inside. She took a deep breath, feeling the slight chill of the evening settle on her skin. The street was quiet, only the distant hum of traffic breaking the silence.

Her shift had been long and exhausting, filled with the clatter of dishes and the constant chatter of customers. Now, the quiet seemed almost surreal, a stark contrast to the noise and chaos she had just left behind. Lucy adjusted her bag on her shoulder, glancing around as she began her walk home.

The dim streetlights cast long shadows across the pavement, their flickering bulbs adding an eerie quality to the otherwise peaceful night. Lucy's footsteps echoed softly, a rhythmic accompaniment to her thoughts. She felt a strange mix of relief and unease; relief that her shift was over, and unease that she had to walk home alone at this hour.

She tried to shake off the feeling, telling herself it was just her imagination. But as she walked, the sensation of being watched grew stronger. Lucy's eyes darted to the darkened alleyways and the shadowy corners of the street, half-expecting to see someone lurking there. Each time, there was nothing but the oppressive darkness.

Her thoughts wandered to the events of the day, the usual frustrations of work blending with snippets of conversations she'd had with her coworkers. She thought of Megan, her closest friend at the diner, and their plans to go out together on the weekend. The thought brought a small smile to her lips, momentarily easing her tension.

But the feeling of being watched persisted. Lucy quickened her pace, her heartbeat matching the rapid rhythm of her footsteps. She turned down a quieter street, the buildings looming tall and silent on either side. The oppressive silence pressed in on her, amplifying every sound, every rustle of leaves, every distant car horn.

A sudden noise behind her made Lucy stop in her tracks. She spun around, eyes wide, searching the shadows for the source. The street was empty, the only movement the gentle sway of a tree branch in the breeze. She stood there for a moment, heart pounding, before forcing herself to turn back and keep walking.

"It's just your imagination," she muttered under her breath, trying to steady her nerves. But the cold knot of fear in her stomach told her otherwise.

A vast abandoned Victorian ballroom at midnight, completely different from a corridor. 7–10 秒：摄影机快速后拉，揭示整个海港只是桌面模型、风机和灯具；特效师关机，水雾缓慢落下，形成幽默而清晰的尺度反转。

声音先是放大的风浪与港口钟，揭示后切回小风机和水泵的真实声音。无建筑摧毁、无洪水、无人员伤亡、无文字、无模型凭空增加。

prompts.title: 翡翠香氛液体雕塑
prompts.prompt:
8 秒，16:9，高端虚构香氛广告。产品锁定：深翡翠色矮方形切面玻璃瓶、圆角肩部、金色短圆瓶盖、正面空白标签区、液面位于瓶身 80%；所有镜头保持比例、颜色、瓶盖与标签位置不变。

0–2 秒：黑色镜面水面上方，摄影机微距贴近玻璃棱线，一滴透明水珠向下滑动，折射出一条金色轮廓光。
2–5 秒：摄影机顺时针环绕 60 度，产品本身不旋转。半透明叶片和细液体丝带被同一股气流从右后方卷起，沿瓶身后侧通过，不遮挡正面空白区。
5–8 秒：瓶子缓慢下降但不接触水面，空气压力形成同心波纹；最后所有液体丝带在后方组成简洁拱形并停住。

黑、翡翠绿、暖金，真实玻璃折射、焦散与微小划痕。声音：水滴、低沉气流、结尾一声细金属音。无文字、无手、无商标、无瓶体软化、无液体穿透玻璃、无突然爆炸。

prompts.title: 折叠耳机机械展开
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，16:9，精密工业设计广告。虚构头戴式耳机：哑光石墨灰椭圆耳罩、薄香槟金铰链、深灰织物头梁、无标志。产品几何、左右结构和材质全程固定。

0–3 秒：耳机以折叠状态放在浅灰无缝台面，顶光在金属边缘形成细线。摄影机以 85mm 产品镜头缓慢推近，背景静止。
3–7 秒：左右耳罩按真实铰链顺序展开：左侧先旋转 90 度并锁定，右侧随后镜像展开，头梁只上升少量。每次锁定都有可见的机械停顿，零件不分裂、不悬浮。
7–10 秒：摄影机降低到与耳罩齐平，柔和声波可视化仅以背景空气中的细微同心折射出现；耳机保持静止，最终构图留出右侧文案空间但不生成文字。

极简银灰与暖金，柔和高键灯光，金属拉丝和织物纹理清晰。声音：两次清脆机械卡扣、低频脉冲一次。不要额外按钮、不要电线、不要磁悬浮爆炸、不要品牌或乱码。

prompts.upstreamId: ads-and-products#03-冰茶从茶园到餐桌的匹配剪辑
prompts.title: 冰茶从茶园到餐桌的匹配剪辑
prompts.prompt:
12 秒，9:16，清爽饮料社交广告，虚构无标签玻璃瓶。产品锁定：细长透明瓶、琥珀色茶液、银白瓶盖、瓶身无字。

0–4 秒：清晨茶园微距，一片带露水的茶叶被手指轻摘；叶片向下移动经过镜头形成遮挡。
4–8 秒：动作匹配切到透明冰块从上方落入高杯，茶液随后沿杯壁注入，冰块只碰撞两次，水汽在杯外凝结。摄影机保持竖屏中心构图，阳光从左后方穿过琥珀色液体。
8–12 秒：同一片茶叶落在木桌边，焦点从叶片移到后方无标签茶瓶和杯子；一阵微风推动白色桌布但产品不移动。最后一个气泡沿冰块边缘上升并破裂。

声音以采茶轻响连接冰块碰撞，再进入倒茶声与夏日远蝉。自然绿色、琥珀金、洁净白。无商标、无可读文字、无夸张液体飞溅、瓶盖不消失、杯中冰块不融化变形。

prompts.upstreamId: ads-and-products#04-模块化台灯的日夜变换
prompts.title: 模块化台灯的日夜变换
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，16:9，北欧感家居科技广告。产品锁定：奶白色圆盘底座、细黑立杆、可旋转半月形灯头、单个黄铜触控点；桌面位置和比例固定。

0–3 秒：白天书桌，灯关闭。摄影机从书架空隙缓慢横移，显示纸张、陶杯与一株小蕨；所有物体真实投影。
3–7 秒：一只手触碰黄铜点一次，灯头沿真实转轴向下旋转 35 度，暖光逐渐亮起。同时窗外天色以平滑时间流逝从下午过渡到蓝调夜晚，但桌上物体不跳位。
7–10 秒：手离开，摄影机轻轻推近灯下书页和陶杯蒸汽；暖光只照亮工作区，背景保持冷蓝。右上角留空但不生成文字。

声音：触控轻音、转轴微响、日间鸟鸣过渡到夜晚远车声。不要让灯自行拆分，不要多出按钮，不要改变书桌布局，不要品牌或字幕。

prompts.upstreamId: ads-and-products#05-巧克力薄片的声画节拍
prompts.title: 巧克力薄片的声画节拍
prompts.prompt:
6 秒，1:1，精品黑巧克力微距广告，强调 ASMR。虚构产品：四乘四格深色巧克力薄片，每格只有抽象放射纹，无文字无标志。

0–2 秒：超微距侧逆光，一把细刀沿格线缓慢施压，巧克力表面出现真实细裂纹，摄影机完全静止。
2–4 秒：薄片在格线处干净断开，碎屑只向前落下少量；断裂声与画面精准同步，焦点从刀锋转到粗糙断面。
4–6 秒：断开的方块落入一杯热可可，液面下沉后形成一次圆形回弹，一缕蒸汽遮住镜头作为结束。

深棕、铜金、奶油色，高对比但不过曝，真实可食用质感。只出现一把刀和一只杯子；不要融化成塑料、不要无限碎裂、不要手指进入刀锋区域、不要包装或文字。

prompts.upstreamId: ads-and-products#06-概念电动车的风洞光绘
prompts.title: 概念电动车的风洞光绘
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，2.39:1，原创概念电动车发布片。车辆锁定：低矮四门快背轮廓、珍珠灰车漆、连续但无标志的前灯带、五辐封闭轮毂、无车牌文字；车身比例与轮毂始终一致。

0–3 秒：黑色风洞内，车辆静止，只有一条白色扫描光从车头移动到车尾，揭示曲面与漆面微粒。摄影机在前左 3/4 角低位静止。
3–7 秒：蓝白色空气流线从前方掠过，沿车顶和侧面弯曲，流线只表现气流不穿透车身；摄影机沿车辆侧面平稳滑轨移动，车轮不转。
7–10 秒：气流熄灭，前灯从中心向两侧渐亮，摄影机停在后左 3/4 角；地面反射与车辆位置匹配，背景留出上方空间。

声音：风洞低频、扫描电子音、灯光启动轻音；无引擎轰鸣。不要打开车门、不要车辆变形、不要驾驶员、不要品牌、不要文字、不要让摄影机穿过车体。

prompts.title: 云海纸鹤门
prompts.prompt:
12 秒，2.39:1，原创东方幻想电影，写实山体与克制水墨粒子结合。身份锁定：青年女剑客，长黑发半束，象牙白内袍、靛蓝长外衣、旧银护腕、腰间无纹长剑；脸、发型、服装和剑全程一致。

0–4 秒：黎明云海超广角，她站在狭窄玄武岩桥端，远处第一群纸鹤从右下方逆风进入，衣摆和发丝向左摆动。
4–8 秒：摄影机缓慢推近到全身景，纸鹤绕太阳形成向内收拢的螺旋门；她没有拔剑，只向前迈一步，脚落地时岩面细尘向外散开。
8–12 秒：摄影机轻微升高，螺旋门后的群峰显露，纸鹤保持纸张折痕与统一飞行方向。她抬头，护腕反射一道晨光，画面停在肃静而非爆炸的奇观。

声音：山风、纸翼轻响、远处钟声一次、极轻弦乐。无对白、无文字。不要已有角色、不要法术光束、不要纸鹤变成鸟、不要剑漂浮、不要人物站位跳变。

prompts.title: 墨水鲸穿过图书馆
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，16:9，手绘 2D 动画与纸张纹理。古老圆形图书馆，一名戴圆眼镜、穿芥末黄背带裤的小男孩伏在大地图上睡着。角色采用简洁线条、有限色块和轻微逐帧抖动，但脸部与服装保持一致。

0–3 秒：蓝黑墨水从地图上的海域缓慢聚集，先形成尾鳍，再形成一条半透明鲸鱼；墨水总量连续，不从桌面滴落。
3–7 秒：鲸鱼游离纸面，在书架之间缓慢上升，经过时书页被气流翻动。摄影机以 2D 多层视差向上跟随，前景梯子、中景鲸鱼、后景书架移动速度不同。
7–10 秒：鲸鱼穿过圆顶天窗变成夜空星座，蓝色墨点排列成鲸形；男孩醒来抬头，眼镜反光中出现星座，地图恢复为空白海面。

声音：纸页、柔和水下回声、木结构轻响；无对白。不要 3D 塑料质感、不要真实水淹图书馆、不要改变角色年龄、不要文字或现成角色。

prompts.upstreamId: anime-fantasy#03-苔藓机器人照料最后一株花
prompts.title: 苔藓机器人照料最后一株花
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，1:1，原创定格动画质感。废弃温室里，一个由旧黄铜盒、两条木质手臂和圆形玻璃眼组成的小机器人，身体覆盖少量苔藓；面前是一株只有两片叶子的白花。机器人结构、苔藓位置和花朵数量保持一致。

0–3 秒：机器人用双手捧起生锈小水壶，关节以可见的逐格节奏转动，玻璃眼内部暖光变亮。
3–7 秒：它缓慢倾斜水壶，只有三滴水落入土壤；第三滴落下后土壤颜色变深，白花从垂下状态轻轻抬起，而不是快速生长。
7–10 秒：温室破窗透入一道晨光，机器人把水壶放回原位，头部向花朵倾斜 10 度；一只纸做的小蛾停在它肩上，玻璃眼眨动一次作为结束。

材料呈现手工木纹、黄铜氧化、羊毛苔藓和指纹感，暖绿与旧金。声音：关节咔嗒、水滴、玻璃温室风声。无对白、无品牌、无机械零件增殖、无突然花海。

prompts.title: 冰原上的光兽约定
prompts.prompt:
15 秒，2.39:1，原创高幻想动画电影。身份锁定：16 岁信使，深棕短发、青绿色厚披风、白色毛领、背小皮邮袋；光兽是一只鹿形半透明生物，角像缓慢流动的极光。两者外观全程一致。

0–5 秒：蓝调冰原远景，信使沿冰裂边缘小心前行，远处光兽在风雪中逐渐显形；脚印连续留在身后。
5–10 秒：中景，信使从邮袋取出一枚圆形铜片放在冰面，后退半步。光兽靠近，用鼻尖触碰铜片，接触点出现一圈柔光沿冰裂向外扩散，但冰面不破碎。
10–15 秒：摄影机环绕两者 45 度，暴风雪逐渐减弱，极光角在天空映出通往山口的路线；信使抬头理解方向，光兽转身先走一步，邀请她跟随。

声音：风雪、皮靴压雪、铜片轻响、遥远合唱氛围。无对白。不要已有怪物设计、不要骑乘、不要战斗、不要人体变形、不要让铜片变成武器。

prompts.title: 轨道城的窗户清洁机
prompts.prompt:
8 秒，16:9，明亮复古未来主义 3D 动画。巨大环形太空城内侧，一台橙白色双吸盘窗户清洁机器人沿弧形观景窗工作，机器人有一只方形显示眼和两条短机械臂；结构与颜色不变。

0–3 秒：摄影机在室内跟随机器人横向移动，窗外可见弯曲地平线、农田与倒挂建筑。左吸盘固定，右吸盘向前移动并重新吸附，动作符合交替爬行。
3–6 秒：机器人喷出少量泡沫，用圆形刷头擦出一条清晰弧线；透过干净区域，一艘小型通勤飞船从远处缓慢经过，视差真实。
6–8 秒：机器人发现一块顽固污点，显示眼变成专注的窄线，再用刷头快速擦两下；污点消失，它显示一个简单亮点而非文字。

干净几何、柔和橙蓝配色、可信塑料与金属。声音：吸盘、微电机、泡沫、轻快电子节奏。不要让机器人脱离玻璃、不要无限手臂、不要宇宙爆炸、不要文字或商标。

prompts.title: 纸偶剧场里的龙影
prompts.prompt:
12 秒，4:3，原创纸偶与剪影动画，舞台材质清晰可见。小型木框纸偶剧场中，一个红衣旅行者纸偶站在桥左侧，一只蓝灰色龙形剪影藏在山后；所有角色由可见细杆操控，纸张边缘和关节保持一致。

0–4 秒：暖色背光亮起，旅行者向桥中央移动三小步，每步都是有限关节纸偶动作；山后龙影缓慢升起，看似巨大威胁。
4–8 秒：龙影张口，旅行者举起小盾牌。背光突然侧移，揭示“巨龙”其实是一只很小的蜥蜴纸偶靠近灯源造成的放大影子。
8–12 秒：旅行者放下盾牌，把一张叶子形纸片递给小蜥蜴；蜥蜴叼走叶子，影子也随距离缩小。镜头最后后拉，露出舞台边缘、操偶细杆和观众席一排孩子的剪影。

声音：纸张摩擦、木杆轻响、孩子压低的惊叹与笑声。无对白、无字幕。不要真实动物、不要火焰、不要纸偶变成立体人物、不要隐藏所有操控结构。

prompts.title: Honest micro-apartment walkthrough
prompts.prompt:
18 seconds, 16:9, truthful real-estate walkthrough of a fictional 32-square-meter studio. Geometry lock: entry door, kitchenette, fold-down table, sofa bed, one east-facing window, and bathroom door must keep exact positions and proportions.

00:00–00:06: Start at normal standing eye level just inside the entry with a 28mm-equivalent lens, no fisheye. Move forward one meter to reveal the kitchenette on the left and closed bathroom door on the right; pause so the narrow clearance is visible.
00:06–00:12: Turn slowly toward the living area. A resident lowers the wall table using both hands and places one chair, demonstrating real walking clearance without removing furniture.
00:12–00:18: Continue to the window, then turn back toward the entry in one continuous movement, showing the full path and sofa-bed depth. Finish on a stable wide frame with no hidden wall.

Audio: room tone, hinge, distant street. Natural morning light and neutral grade. No impossible wide-angle expansion, moving walls, duplicated doors, instant decluttering, fake view, text, logo, or watermark.

prompts.title: Transit plaza human-scale study
prompts.prompt:
15 seconds, 2.39:1, architectural previsualization of an original transit plaza at weekday morning peak. Fixed elements: tram stop, two shelters, four shade trees, raised crossing, protected cycle lane, and ground-floor café; preserve all counts and routes.

00:00–00:05: Camera begins at pedestrian eye level under a shelter. A tram arrives on the left track while cyclists continue through the protected lane; passengers wait behind the tactile edge.
00:05–00:10: Track beside one parent with a stroller crossing on the raised table after the signal changes. A delivery cyclist slows and yields; no collision or crowd teleportation.
00:10–00:15: Lift only to second-floor height, revealing how walking, cycling, tram, and café seating fit without overlap. Tree shadows match the morning sun and shelter roofs provide real coverage.

Audio: tram bell, rolling wheels, footsteps, restrained city ambience. No futuristic pods, impossible traffic flow, inaccessible curb, vehicle crossing through people, changing tree count, advertising text, or watermark.

prompts.title: Accessible library route validation
prompts.prompt:
20 seconds, 16:9, route-validation film inside a fictional public library. Follow an adult power-wheelchair user wearing a burgundy jacket from entrance to a low-height book pickup shelf. Keep identity, wheelchair geometry, route, doors, and furniture fixed.

00:00–00:05: Exterior automatic door opens before arrival; camera tracks at seated eye level from the side. Threshold remains flush and the user enters without assistance.
00:05–00:10: Continue through the lobby. The user pauses at a low information display, turns within a clearly visible circle, then follows a high-contrast floor stripe.
00:10–00:15: At one aisle, another patron moves a small step aside while maintaining comfortable distance. Shelf spacing remains honest; the wheelchair does not narrow or clip furniture.
00:15–00:20: The user reaches the pickup shelf, scans a card, and retrieves one book from reachable height. Finish with an unobstructed route visible behind.

Audio: door motor, quiet library, wheel motor, scan confirmation. No inspirational narration, hidden ramps, staff pushing the chair, changing aisle width, unreadable policy claims, logo, or watermark.

prompts.title: Co-living kitchen morning choreography
prompts.prompt:
15 seconds, 16:9, lifestyle architecture film showing how four adults share a compact co-living kitchen. Geometry lock: one island, two induction zones, sink, refrigerator, and four stools; keep people, wardrobe colors, props, and left-right relationships consistent.

00:00–00:05: Wide corner view. Blue-shirt resident chops fruit at the island; yellow-sweater resident fills a kettle at the sink; red-cardigan resident opens the refrigerator; gray-shirt resident enters and hangs a bag. Paths do not intersect.
00:05–00:10: Camera slides behind the island. Refrigerator closes before gray-shirt resident passes; kettle moves to the induction zone; fruit bowl is placed at the center. Show realistic counter depth and hand contact.
00:10–00:15: All four sit or lean at different sides of the island, sharing breakfast while the workspace remains navigable. End on a top-down plan-like view from modest ceiling height, not an impossible cutaway.

Audio: knife, kettle, refrigerator, casual low conversation without exact dialogue. No magically clean counters, duplicated food, colliding bodies, changing kitchen dimensions, brand, text, or watermark.

prompts.title: Cargo e-bike bakery delivery
prompts.prompt:
12 seconds, 9:16, realistic urban mobility mini-documentary. Vehicle lock: forest-green long-tail electric bicycle, two tan insulated panniers, front light, no logo. Rider wears matte black helmet, cream rain shell, dark trousers; preserve vehicle, cargo count, clothing, and travel direction.

00:00–00:04: At a bakery loading curb, rider secures two bread crates inside the panniers and checks both straps. Camera stays close enough to show real fastening, with kickstand down.
00:04–00:08: Rider retracts kickstand, starts smoothly, and enters a protected lane after checking behind. Low side tracking shows both tires contacting wet pavement and panniers remaining stable over a speed table.
00:08–00:12: At a café, rider brakes, places left foot down, and opens only the right pannier to hand over one sealed crate. Finish on a quick receipt scan with no readable customer data.

Audio: straps, freewheel, light rain, bell once, brake, scan. No dangerous sidewalk riding, cargo teleportation, wheel deformation, brand, address, fake sustainability number, or watermark.

prompts.title: Night tram maintenance inspection
prompts.prompt:
15 seconds, 2.39:1, industrial night-shift documentary inside a tram depot. Two adult technicians wear navy coveralls, reflective vests, gloves, and eye protection. Tram lock: silver body, blue stripe, four visible doors on this side; preserve staff, tools, body panels, and track position.

00:00–00:05: Wide static shot. Tram is fully stopped, power-isolation indicator is visibly active as a simple red lock icon. Technician A places wheel chocks; Technician B confirms against a tablet with no readable private data.
00:05–00:10: Low tracking shot follows a handheld inspection light along wheel and brake components. Technician A points to one normal wear surface; no hands enter pinch zones.
00:10–00:15: Camera rises beside the body as Technician B checks door alignment using a physical gauge. They close the access panel, remove tools, and sign off together before power changes.

Audio: depot ventilation, metal tool contact, brief radio confirmation. No live-track danger, sparks, moving tram, missing PPE, technical claim beyond visible inspection, logo, or watermark.

prompts.title: Autonomous river ferry docking test
prompts.prompt:
14 seconds, 16:9, realistic prototype test of a fictional small electric river ferry with supervised autonomous docking. Ferry lock: white catamaran, teal roof, two side bumpers, twelve empty seats, one onboard safety operator; preserve hull, passenger count, dock, and river direction.

00:00–00:05: Shore camera sees ferry approach at low speed, aligned slightly upstream. Water wake remains small; safety operator watches controls with hands nearby.
00:05–00:10: Overhead camera at crane height, not satellite height. Ferry rotates less than 15 degrees and uses two visible side thrusters; bow and stern maintain clearance while wind pushes a small surface ripple downstream.
00:10–00:14: Side close-up as the teal bumper contacts the dock gently, compresses, then settles. Automatic mooring arm engages one fixed point; operator confirms before the gate unlocks, but no passenger boards.

Audio: water, electric motor hum, soft contact, confirmation tone. No claim of unsupervised safety, high-speed impact, changing hull, impossible zero wake, people on deck, brand, or watermark.

prompts.title: Accessible hotel room arrival
prompts.prompt:
18 seconds, 16:9, honest hospitality walkthrough of an original accessible hotel room. Guest uses a manual wheelchair and wears a dark green jacket. Geometry lock: inward entry, transfer space beside bed, low wardrobe rail, roll-in shower, fold-down seat, and reachable controls; preserve dimensions and fixture positions.

00:00–00:06: Follow from hallway at seated eye level as the guest unlocks the room, opens the door, and turns inside without reversing into furniture. Door and wardrobe clearances remain visible.
00:06–00:12: Guest approaches the bed, demonstrates unobstructed side transfer space without transferring, then reaches one bedside light control. Camera stays wide enough to show reach and floor area.
00:12–00:18: Cut to bathroom entrance from the room side. Guest rolls across a flush threshold, turns toward the shower, and lowers the fold-down seat by hand. End on a wide view showing grab bars and clear floor space together.

Audio: key lock, wheels, switch, shower-seat hinge. No luxury exaggeration, hidden threshold, magically expanding room, staff assistance without consent, fake certification, brand, text, or watermark.

prompts.title: Courtyard light study from dawn to evening
prompts.prompt:
15 seconds, 16:9, architectural light study of one original brick courtyard. Lock all geometry: L-shaped wall, three arched openings, shallow reflecting pool, one olive tree, two benches. Camera remains on the same tripod and lens for the full sequence.

00:00–00:05: Dawn. Cool skylight fills the courtyard, warm sun first touches the upper right brick edge; pool is still and benches are empty.
00:05–00:10: Smooth but honest time transition to midday. Shadows shorten according to the same sun path; two people cross once for scale without moving furniture. Olive leaves create detailed shadow texture.
00:10–00:15: Continue to blue-hour evening. Concealed low lights turn on sequentially along the arches; the pool reflects them with slight wind ripples. End with the same framing as the first frame.

Audio transitions from morning birds to midday footsteps to evening crickets; no dramatic music. No moving walls, changing tree, impossible two-sun shadows, seasonal change, furniture jump, logo, or watermark.

prompts.title: Conflict-free school pickup curb study
prompts.prompt:
18 seconds, 16:9, human-scale previsualization of a fictional primary-school afternoon pickup. Fixed layout: school gate, raised crossing, protected cycle lane, short bus bay, three family pickup spaces, and continuous sidewalk; preserve all routes and vehicle counts.

00:00–00:06: Eye-level camera beside the gate. Children exit with adults onto the wide sidewalk while one school bus stops completely in its bay. No child enters the vehicle lane.
00:06–00:12: Follow a family walking across the raised crossing after a crossing guard signals. A cyclist approaches in the protected lane, slows before the crossing, and continues only after the family clears.
00:12–00:18: Rise to second-floor height to show one pickup car leaving forward, the bus bay remaining unobstructed, and the sidewalk route continuing behind parked vehicles. End on clearly separated movement paths.

Audio: school bell, low conversation, bicycle freewheel, one crossing whistle. No speeding, double parking, child alone in traffic, vehicle teleportation, inaccessible curb, readable school name, brand, or watermark.

prompts.title: Flat-pack emergency shelter assembly rehearsal
prompts.prompt:
20 seconds, 16:9, logistics rehearsal for an original temporary emergency shelter module, presented as a prototype rather than a certified solution. Module lock: gray floor cassette, four blue wall panels, two roof halves, eight numbered fasteners shown only as colored shapes; preserve component count and scale.

00:00–00:05: Four trained adults in gloves unload components onto a marked flat pad, keeping the access route clear. Camera begins high enough to show the complete layout.
00:05–00:10: Two workers unfold the floor legs while two position the first wall panel into visible slots. Panels retain weight; no part floats into place.
00:10–00:15: Remaining walls connect in sequence, then roof halves lift with a manual pole system and meet at the ridge. Fasteners engage at each corner before hands release.
00:15–00:20: Team installs one ramp and checks the door swing, ventilation opening, and anchor straps. Pull back to show the complete module and remaining safe circulation space.

Audio: panel contact, fasteners, concise team calls. No disaster victims, impossible one-person lift, instant assembly, missing anchors, weather-resistance claim, logo, text, or watermark.

prompts.title: 末班渡轮上的未寄信
prompts.prompt:
15 秒，2.39:1，克制的现实主义电影短片，冬夜港口。身份锁定：28 岁女性，齐肩黑发，鼻梁有浅雀斑，深灰羊毛大衣，右手戴旧银戒；所有镜头保持同一张脸和服装。

0–4 秒：空旷渡轮下层客舱，中景静止。她独坐在靠窗座位，把一封没有邮票的信压在掌心；窗外港灯随船体轻晃，玻璃上雨水向后流。只有呼吸、拇指摩擦信封边缘和远处发动机低鸣。
4–9 秒：摄影机沿桌面缓慢横移到侧脸近景。广播提示“本班船即将返航”，她抬眼看向对岸邮筒的红色小点，嘴唇微张但没有说话；灯塔扫光经过脸部一次，眼眶反光短暂出现。
9–15 秒：切至船尾外景，保持轴线。她跑出舱门却在栏杆前停下，没有把信丢进海里，而是将它重新放进内袋。摄影机缓慢后退，渡轮离岸，对岸邮筒越来越小。冷青夜色，舱内钨丝灯暖黄，细腻胶片颗粒。

声音：柴油机低频、雨点敲玻璃、舱门液压声、广播女声；最后只留下水浪。无配乐、无字幕。保持信封完整、戒指位置和港口方向一致；不要哭喊、不要慢动作奔跑、不要换脸、不要额外乘客突然出现。

prompts.title: 停电后的面包店
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，16:9，温暖生活电影。暴雨导致街区停电，一间狭小面包店里，58 岁短灰发女店主穿墨绿色围裙，和一个背黄色书包的 9 岁男孩隔着柜台。身份、围裙和书包全程一致。

0–3 秒：灯光突然熄灭，烤箱风扇停下，画面只剩窗外蓝灰色闪电轮廓；两人同时停住动作，男孩抱紧纸袋。
3–7 秒：店主划亮一根火柴，先点燃柜台上的小蜡烛，再把刚出炉的圆面包推向男孩。摄影机从蜡烛微距缓慢拉焦到两张脸，暖光逐步建立，玻璃柜上的倒影符合位置。
7–10 秒：男孩把面包掰成两半，先把较大一半递回给店主；她愣 0.4 秒后笑起来。窗外整条街依次恢复供电，但店内仍以烛光为主，镜头停在两双手和面包蒸汽上。

声音：暴雨、断电的轻响、火柴摩擦、面包脆壳、远处店铺恢复供电的欢呼。无对白、无字幕、无品牌。动作自然克制；不要让蜡烛位置跳变、不要让面包自动复原、不要改变人物年龄。

prompts.title: 月台上错过的三秒
prompts.prompt:
12 秒，2.39:1，现代都市悬疑，清晨地铁终点站。身份锁定：穿沙色风衣的男记者，左手拿折叠报纸；穿海军蓝制服的女站务员，胸前只有空白名牌。

0–3 秒：超广角建立空月台，一列无乘客列车正要关门。记者从画面深处跑来，摄影机低位平行跟拍，鞋底在湿地留下连续脚印。
3–6 秒：车门在他面前闭合，他抬手敲门；列车内部，一个与他外貌完全相同但穿黑色大衣的人隔着玻璃同步抬手。镜头保持稳定，不做恐怖变形。
6–9 秒：列车启动，玻璃中的相同人物没有随列车移动，而像倒影一样留在原位置半秒后才被带走。记者后退一步，报纸从左手滑落。
9–12 秒：站务员进入前景，弯腰捡起报纸；头版日期是明天，但画面不要求可读文字，只以异常版式暗示。摄影机缓慢推近她困惑的眼神，远处隧道风吹起报纸一角。

冷白荧光、浅雾、对称构图。声音：闭门提示音、鞋步、列车加速、纸张落地；音乐仅用一条低频持续音。保持两名相同人物的脸一致但服装明确不同；无血腥、无怪物、无乱码标题、无越轴。

prompts.title: 1958 年的天台收音机
prompts.prompt:
15 秒，4:3，1950 年代东亚城市年代片，褪色彩色胶片，服装与道具符合时代。夕阳天台，一名穿浅蓝短袖衬衫、深色高腰长裤的青年修理木壳真空管收音机；一名扎低辫、穿米白连衣裙的青年女性扶着晾衣绳。两人身份和服装保持一致。

0–5 秒：固定中景，青年旋动旋钮，只有沙沙电流；晾晒的白床单受风鼓起，周期性遮挡两人，形成自然转场。城市烟囱和旧天线在远景。
5–10 秒：床单掠过镜头后切到手部近景，他轻敲木壳，收音机突然传出舞曲。她先看向收音机，再看向他，伸出右手做邀请姿势。他停顿后把螺丝刀放下。
10–15 秒：摄影机缓慢环绕 45 度，两人在狭小空间只跳两个简单舞步，脚步真实、不滑行。最后床单再次充满画面，声音仍继续半秒作为结束。

夕阳侧逆光，衣料与木材质感真实，轻微胶片抖动但人物不抖。声音：电流、屋顶风、远处自行车铃、年代感舞曲。不要现代建筑、LED、塑料耳机、文字水印或复杂舞蹈。

prompts.title: 雪山救援的一镜到底
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，16:9，写实高山救援纪录片，一镜到底。首图人物锁定：橙红色救援服、白色头盔、黑色护目镜的救援员；倒在雪坡上的滑雪者穿钴蓝外套。保持两人服装、装备和雪坡方向不变。

摄影机从救援员肩后开始，以轻微手持但可读的方式向下跟随。他把冰镐固定在左侧硬雪中，半跪降低重心，用右手扣住滑雪者胸前安全带；强风从画面右向左，吹动同一方向的雪粉和衣物。救援绳拉紧后，两人只向上移动半米，雪面出现真实压痕。摄影机绕到侧面不超过 30 度，最后停在安全扣完全闭合的微距，救援员用拇指检查一次锁门。

高海拔冷色散射光，呼吸水汽随风偏移，皮肤不暴露。声音：强风、金属扣清脆闭合、绳索受力、短促无线电“连接完成”。无雪崩、无坠落、无夸张英雄姿势。手套不消失，绳索不穿过身体，人物不在雪面滑行，摄影机不切镜。

prompts.upstreamId: cinematic-storytelling#06-厨房到星空的遮挡转场
prompts.title: 厨房到星空的遮挡转场
prompts.prompt:
8 秒，9:16，诗意竖屏短片，用一次自然遮挡完成现实到想象的转场。夜晚小厨房，一个 12 岁女孩穿宽松白色睡衣，在桌上把蓝莓放入玻璃碗，父亲只以双手和深蓝毛衣袖口出现。

0–3 秒：俯拍微距，最后一颗蓝莓从女孩指尖滚落，绕碗边一圈后停住；父亲将牛奶从画面上方缓慢倒入，白色液面向镜头扩散。
3–5 秒：牛奶完全遮住画面时无缝变成一片乳白星云，蓝莓对应为深蓝行星，位置与运动方向连续；摄影机继续同一方向向下穿行。
5–8 秒：星云逐渐变回玻璃碗中的早餐，女孩的勺子轻轻搅动一次，窗外第一缕晨光出现。她抬头看向父亲的方向微笑，但父亲不露脸。

梦幻但物理连贯，蓝、乳白、晨金配色。声音桥：牛奶流动声逐渐变为低沉宇宙氛围，最后回到勺子碰碗。无对白、无文字。保持女孩的手、碗和蓝莓数量大致稳定；不要硬切、不要出现宇航员、不要改变厨房布局。

prompts.title: Linen overshirt fit-and-motion demonstration
prompts.prompt: Use the supplied full-body product image as the identity and garment reference. Create a natural vertical fitting-room demonstration of an unbranded sand-colored linen overshirt. 0–3s: the model faces camera, pinches the cuff once, and releases it so the fabric settles. 3–7s: they turn exactly 90 degrees to show the side seam and relaxed shoulder; the camera makes one slow waist-height arc in the opposite direction. 7–12s: they take two steps toward a window, roll one sleeve once, and stop in a clean three-quarter pose. Soft daylight reveals weave and wrinkles without artificial gloss. Sound: quiet room tone, cloth movement, two footsteps. Preserve face, body proportions, button count, pocket placement, hem length, and color. No body reshaping, morphing seams, added jewelry, logos, captions, jump cuts, or runway-speed movement.

prompts.title: Modular lunchbox latch and capacity demo
prompts.prompt: Reference Image 1 defines the lunchbox geometry and sage-green color; Image 2 defines the removable divider layout; Video 1 supplies hand-motion rhythm only. On a bright kitchen counter, demonstrate the fictional modular lunchbox in four connected actions. First, two hands release both side latches simultaneously and lift the lid straight up. Next, one hand moves a divider from the center slot to the right slot while the other stabilizes the base. Then three prepared foods are placed into separate compartments without spilling. Finally, close the lid and press each latch until one audible click. Camera: locked 45-degree tabletop view with a short macro push-in for the latch, then return to the original framing. Preserve dimensions, hinge side, latch count, divider slots, surface finish, and food placement between cuts. No floating parts, duplicated fingers, transparent plastic, brand marks, steam covering the product, or impossible capacity.

prompts.title: Mineral sunscreen texture comparison
prompts.prompt: Create an educational split-screen skincare texture demonstration using a fictional, unbranded mineral sunscreen. The same adult forearm appears on both sides under neutral studio daylight. At 0s, place one equal pea-sized amount on each side. Left: a thick application is rubbed in too quickly and leaves a visible uneven white cast. Right: the same amount is warmed between two fingertips, dotted across the skin, then blended in three slow passes to an even satin finish. Keep exposure, skin tone, amount, crop, and elapsed time identical so the technique is the only variable. Camera remains locked in macro top-down view; end on a two-second comparison hold. Sound: soft fingertip movement and one neutral chime at the final hold. No medical claims, before-and-after skin alteration, labels, text overlays, irritation, exaggerated whitening, extra hands, or beauty-filter smoothing.

prompts.title: Ceramic pan heat-response demonstration
prompts.prompt: Animate the supplied first frame of an unbranded cream ceramic pan on an induction hob. Preserve the exact pan, handle, hob, backsplash, and camera position. 0–4s: three droplets of water land near the center, gather into beads, and travel outward as the pan warms. 4–9s: a cook pours a thin ribbon of beaten egg from the right; it spreads from the center with physically accurate viscosity and begins setting at the edges. 9–14s: a silicone spatula makes one clean fold, revealing an intact matte cooking surface, and rests beside the fold. Camera: fixed close three-quarter angle with a very subtle push-in only. Sound: droplets, low induction hum, gentle sizzle, one spatula scrape. Keep handle orientation, pan color, liquid volume, hand identity, and action direction stable. No flames, oil flare, smoke, food teleportation, warped utensil, logo, caption, or unsupported durability claim.

prompts.title: Handmade tea gift order from selection to parcel
prompts.prompt: Create a warm vertical micro-story for a fictional neighborhood tea studio, following one gift order without continuity breaks. Shot 1, 0–4s: a customer points to a small amber tea tin on a wooden shelf; the shopkeeper lifts that exact tin. Shot 2, 4–8s: macro view as the lid opens and dry curled leaves are measured into a paper sachet. Shot 3, 8–13s: the same tin and sachet are placed into a natural-cardboard box with a blank cream card and tied once with indigo cotton ribbon. Shot 4, 13–18s: the sealed parcel is handed across the counter; the customer receives it with both hands and smiles. Use match-on-action cuts and preserve tin dents, ribbon color, box size, clothing, hand positions, and left-to-right ownership transfer. Sound: wooden lid, leaves, paper, ribbon, quiet shop ambience. No readable branding, duplicated parcel, changing packaging, floating leaves, excessive steam, subtitles, or price claims.

prompts.title: Compact projector setup in a small apartment
prompts.prompt: Image 1 defines the exact fictional compact projector; Image 2 defines the apartment layout; use no visual identity from other references. Make a fast but physically clear vertical setup demonstration. 0–3s: the device is placed on the marked shelf facing a blank wall. 3–6s: one cable is connected to the rear-left port, then a single button is pressed. 6–9s: the lens lights and a soft rectangular test image appears, initially skewed, then corrects once into a level 16:9 frame. 9–12s: curtains close halfway and the room becomes comfortable for viewing while the projector remains visible in the foreground. Camera makes one continuous side-to-front slide; do not cut during cable insertion. Sound: plug click, button click, quiet fan, short startup tone. Preserve device dimensions, port position, lens location, shelf, cable path, and room geometry. No brand UI, impossible wireless cable disappearance, light before power, blown-out projection, text, logo, or extra hands.

prompts.title: Accessible shoe fastening demonstration
prompts.prompt: Use the input image as the exact shoe, hand, and seated-body reference. Demonstrate a fictional adaptive sneaker with a wide pull tab and magnetic side closure, without making medical claims. 0–4s: the wearer holds the large heel loop, guides the foot into the shoe, and plants the sole on the floor. 4–8s: one hand brings the side flap toward the closure; the magnets align only when close and connect with a soft click. 8–12s: the wearer presses the flap once, rocks heel-to-toe to check the fit, and rests both feet parallel. Camera: stable low side close-up, then a small tilt down to the closure; no orbit. Preserve shoe silhouette, closure location, sole thickness, sock color, hand anatomy, and seated posture. Sound: fabric, closure click, sole on wood. No self-moving shoe, exaggerated magnetic force, body transformation, laces appearing, claims of treatment or universal suitability, logos, text, or inaccessible tiny controls.

prompts.title: Fragrance layering consultation at a retail counter
prompts.prompt: At a refined but unbranded fragrance counter, stage a calm consultation between one advisor and one customer. Two fictional bottles remain fixed: tall clear bottle on the left, short amber bottle on the right. 0–5s: the advisor sprays the clear bottle once onto a paper strip, fans it twice, and places it horizontally. 5–10s: they spray the amber bottle onto a second strip, cross it beneath the first, and wait one beat. 10–16s: the customer smells both together and says in natural French, “Le bois adoucit vraiment les agrumes.” The advisor listens silently and gives one small nod. Camera: eye-level two-shot, macro insert on the crossed strips, return to two-shot. Warm side light with realistic glass reflections. Preserve bottle shapes, liquid levels, strip order, hand ownership, faces, wardrobe, and eyelines. No subtitles, lip movement from the silent advisor, extra sprays, floating mist, product labels, celebrity likeness, medical claims, or changing bottle positions.

prompts.title: Humidity-resistant curl routine comparison
prompts.prompt: Edit the supplied two-panel salon demonstration. Change only the right panel to show a clearly ordered humidity-care styling routine while preserving the original person, hair length, curl pattern, lighting, background, camera, and timing. On the right: apply one measured pump to wet palms, distribute from mid-length to ends, scrunch upward three times, diffuse at low speed from below, then hold the finished natural curls for two seconds. Keep the left panel unchanged as the untreated comparison. Add subtle bathroom humidity to both backgrounds equally; do not alter facial skin, body, hair density, or the left-panel motion. Sound: preserve room tone, add quiet product pump and low diffuser only on the right. No guaranteed performance claim, fake weather gauge, instant hair growth, strand teleportation, wet-to-dry jump without transition, label text, logo, subtitles, or beauty-filter changes.

prompts.title: Interchangeable watch-strap batch campaign
prompts.prompt: Create three matching catalog clips from one approved setup. Image 1 defines the fictional watch case and dial; Images 2–4 define cobalt textile, terracotta leather, and graphite silicone straps. The watch case, dial, crown, hands set to 10:08, tabletop, lighting, camera path, and timing must be identical in every clip. At 0–2s the watch lies centered without a strap. At 2–5s two strap halves slide in from top and bottom along the table, stop at the lugs, and attach with physically plausible spring bars; do not show parts passing through metal. At 5–8s the assembled watch rotates exactly 35 degrees while the camera pushes closer, then holds. Each render uses only its assigned strap material and color. Sound: two small mechanical clicks and a soft fabric/leather/silicone movement appropriate to the variant. No changing case geometry, dial text, extra straps, liquid morphing, inconsistent shadows, logos, captions, hands changing time, or mismatched camera speed.

prompts.title: How street trees cool a summer block
prompts.prompt:

prompts.title: 清晨豆浆摊第一视角
prompts.prompt:
10 秒，9:16，第一视角手机探店，冬日清晨的街边豆浆摊。摄影者的双手偶尔进入画面，穿深棕针织袖口；摊主是戴白色棉帽、穿藏蓝围裙的中年女性，身份与服装保持一致。

0–3 秒：手机从蒸汽后方靠近摊位，自动曝光因白色蒸汽短暂变暗后恢复；摊主掀开锅盖，蒸汽向上散开，镜头轻微后退躲避。
3–7 秒：她用长柄勺将热豆浆倒进素白陶碗，液面上升真实，摄影者把一小碟酥脆油条推到旁边。手持微动自然，不进行电影式环绕。
7–10 秒：摄影者双手捧起陶碗，镜头随之略微上升；背景自行车从左向右经过，摊主笑着说“慢点，烫。”

对白普通话、亲切自然，无字幕。声音：锅盖、液体、街道自行车铃、远处早市交谈。冷晨光与摊位暖灯混合；不要品牌招牌、不要额外手指、不要夸张蒸汽遮满全程、不要让陶碗变成纸杯。

prompts.upstreamId: ugc-food-travel#02-海边民宿的-15-秒入住日记
prompts.title: 海边民宿的 15 秒入住日记
prompts.prompt:
15 秒，9:16，自然手机旅行 Vlog，剪辑轻快但不炫技。主角锁定：短发女性旅行者，白色亚麻衬衫、卡其短裤、帆布托特包；只在镜面中短暂出现脸部。

0–4 秒：第一视角推开浅蓝木门进入海边民宿，门轴轻响，室内从背光逐渐自动曝光；一只橘猫从右侧慢慢经过，不看镜头。
4–8 秒：动作匹配切到托特包放在藤椅上，摄影者拉开白色窗帘，海面和小渔船出现；窗帘被海风吹向镜头形成遮挡。
8–12 秒：遮挡后切到阳台桌面，手放下一杯冰柠檬水，杯壁凝露明显；镜头轻微俯拍记录明信片、钥匙和贝壳。
12–15 秒：镜头转向栏杆外落日，橘猫跳上空椅但不打翻物品，尾巴掠过镜头结束。

自然海风、木门、冰块和海鸟声，只有很轻的原声吉他。无对白、无字幕、无酒店品牌。保持房间方位、托特包和猫的花色一致；不要无人机镜头、不要过度稳定、不要快速 360 度旋转。

prompts.title: 夜市炭火烤玉米记录

prompts.upstreamId: ugc-food-travel#04-旧城电车窗边的雨天旅行
prompts.title: 旧城电车窗边的雨天旅行

prompts.upstreamId: ugc-food-travel#05-周末陶艺课的失败与修复
prompts.title: 周末陶艺课的失败与修复

4–8 秒：老师的双手从左侧进入，示范降低手掌、用拇指稳定中心；主角跟随动作，塌下部分被缓慢压回矮碗形，陶泥守恒、不凭空增加。
8–12 秒：主角松开手，歪但完整的小碗继续旋转，她用沾泥的手背擦额头，留下一小道泥痕；镜头自动对焦短暂落在泥痕后回到作品。

声音：陶轮电机、湿泥摩擦、两人轻笑，老师说“慢一点，先找中心。”无字幕、无音乐。不要额外手指、不要陶器突然完美、不要快速时间流逝、不要品牌。

prompts.title: 山村早餐的无旁白 ASMR
prompts.prompt:
15 秒，16:9，安静自然的山村早餐纪录片，无旁白。一名穿深蓝棉麻上衣、头发低低束起的女性在木窗旁准备一碗菌菇面；人物脸、服装与厨房陈设保持一致。

0–5 秒：晨光穿过木窗，微距拍摄菜刀把两朵香菇切成薄片，刀每次完整接触木板，动作熟练但不加速；背景水壶开始冒出细蒸汽。
5–10 秒：中近景，她把面条放入陶锅，用竹筷轻轻分开，汤面产生真实旋涡；摄影机沿灶台缓慢横移，焦点依次经过火苗、锅沿和她专注的侧脸。
10–15 秒：碗放到窗边木桌，加入香菇和一小把葱。她坐下，先吹散蒸汽再尝一口，窗外远山被薄雾覆盖。镜头停住两秒让蒸汽自然上升。

声音前景为刀与木板、汤水、筷子和轻呼吸；远景为鸡鸣和山风；无音乐、无对白。食材数量连续，蒸汽不遮脸，火焰受控；无古装表演感、无字幕、无商标。

prompts.title: Tear-Filled Gunpoint Confrontation
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the only protagonist. Strictly preserve the protagonist’s facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, age, overall aura, and visual identity throughout the entire clip. Generate a 30-second emotionally intense dramatic scene. This is not an action scene or a gunfight. The focus is not on shooting itself, but on the protagonist’s extremely painful and conflicted emotional struggle in the moment before pulling the trigger. The entire clip should center on the character’s performance and facial expression.

The setting should be a quiet, oppressive, high-tension environment with a cinematic atmosphere. It can be a dim interior, an abandoned room, a dark hallway, an empty warehouse, or a nighttime indoor setting. The background should not be too visually busy or distracting. The lighting should feel restrained, dramatic, and moody, with clear contrast on the protagonist’s face. The eyes and the visible moisture of tears must be clearly readable. The overall atmosphere should feel silent, heavy, and emotionally suffocating.

The camera uses an over-the-shoulder shot from behind the other person. Do not show the other person’s face. The foreground should include a blurred shoulder, the back of the head, or the silhouette edge of the other person’s body, creating a clear over-the-shoulder composition. The camera faces the protagonist directly. Focus must stay locked on the protagonist’s facial expression and the gun pointed forward. The gun is aimed toward the camera, meaning it is aimed at “us,” the unseen other person. The camera style should feel like a stable cinematic handheld shot with a subtle sense of breathing. A very slight slow push-in is allowed, gradually tightening on the protagonist’s face to intensify the emotion, but avoid exaggerated camera movement.

The protagonist is holding a gun aimed at the person in front of him. His emotions are extremely complex: anger, hurt, resentment, and the forced determination to do something terrible, mixed with clear reluctance, sorrow, and an inability to truly go through with it. He is not a cold-blooded killer, and he is not simply afraid. This is the feeling of “I have to do this, but I cannot bring myself to do it.” His eyes are red and wet with tears. He is breathing hard. His lips tremble slightly. His jaw is tense. He keeps the gun raised, but his hand shakes subtly. He tries to stay hard, angry, and determined, but that determination keeps breaking under the weight of his pain and reluctance.

At the start of the shot, the protagonist already has the gun raised and aimed directly forward, but his expression is tightly restrained and full of tension. He stares at the person in front of him as if forcing himself not to soften. At first, his face holds down anger and emotional restraint. Then the emotion slowly rises: his eyes become wetter, his breathing grows heavier, his throat tightens, and it feels like there are many unspoken words stuck inside him. Several times, it looks like he is about to pull the trigger. His finger tightens slightly. But every time, he stops at the last possible moment. His eyes constantly shift between rage, heartbreak, pain, resentment, and deep unwillingness, as if he wants to hate the person in front of him, yet cannot truly harm them.

Several key details must be clearly visible:

The gun stays raised the whole time, but his arm and fingers tremble slightly.
He repeatedly tries to force himself to commit, breathing harder, as if trying to make himself do it.
Tears remain held back; he does not fully break down crying, but the tear-filled eyes must be very visible.
When he looks at the other person, the expression is not purely hateful — it contains pain, attachment, heartbreak, and reluctance.
His emotional layers are rich and mixed: anger, hurt, resentment, unwillingness, tenderness, pain, self-forced determination.
Throughout the clip, he never reaches a clean or easy decision. He remains trapped in an overwhelming emotional conflict.

The performance should be restrained, not exaggerated. No screaming, no melodramatic breakdown. What makes the scene powerful is not shouting, but the feeling of someone holding themselves together while being on the edge of collapse. Let the tears gather in his eyes. Let his breathing become heavier. Let his lips shake slightly. Let him look like he may completely fall apart in the next second, but is still forcing himself to hold on. The ending should remain in this most tense unresolved state: he is still holding the gun, still unable to pull the trigger, eyes full of tears, breathing uneven, as if he is still forcing himself to make the decision. The scene should end on this suspended, unresolved, high-pressure moment. Do not resolve it too easily.

The overall style should feel like a cinematic emotional close-up driven by performance, with emphasis on subtle facial acting, breathing, tear-filled eyes, the gun, trembling hands, and the over-the-shoulder composition. Do not turn it into a gunfight. Do not make it feel like an action movie. Do not cut too frequently. Do not add large physical movements. The scene should feel more like a tense dramatic film moment than an action sequence.

For sound design, use only real environmental sound. No background music. You may include faint ambient room tone, distant hollow reverb, the protagonist’s uneven breathing, soft clothing movement, and tiny sounds caused by the trembling hand and body tension. No subtitles. No text. No narration. No UI elements.

Style keywords:
cinematic, emotional confrontation, over-the-shoulder shot, gun aimed forward, tear-filled eyes, restrained breakdown, conflicted emotion, unable to shoot, internal struggle, high tension silence, character close-up, dramatic film scene.

prompts.title: CHASE Recovery MiniDV Diary
prompts.prompt:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.
LOOK:
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts per location (clinical soft light at physio → warm home light for stretching → soft steamy bathroom light → dim cozy bedroom light).
STYLE:
Slow, gentle montage feel — calmer and more tender than her usual bubbly vlogs. Quiet reflective voiceover narration plays over the visuals instead of synced dialogue. Mood stays soft and caring throughout, centered on rest and self-care.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long straight black hair, natural and softly tied back, dewy glass skin, minimal to no makeup, tired but peaceful expression. Wearing a modest robe or oversized loungewear throughout — fully covering arms, torso, and legs at all times, including during the bath/shower segment (framed only from shoulders up or via steam/robe coverage, nothing revealing shown).
Setting Progression
Physio/massage clinic (afternoon) → her room, stretching mat (early evening) → bathroom, steamy warm light (night) → bedroom (late night).
Storyboard (20s, 6 cuts)
